title: AI Engineer
description:
**position overview**

we are seeking a talented ai engineer to design, develop, and deploy ai-powered applications using modern artificial intelligence and generative ai technologies. the ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with large language models (llms), retrieval-augmented generation (rag), ai agents, and python-based application development.

the candidate will work with engineering and business teams to build intelligent applications, integrate ai capabilities into existing systems, and deliver scalable, reliable solutions for real-world business problems.

**key responsibilities**

design, develop, and maintain ai-powered applications using python and modern ai frameworks.

integrate large language models (llms), including gpt, claude, llama, or similar models, into enterprise applications.

build and optimize rag pipelines using embeddings, vector databases, semantic search, and document retrieval.

develop ai agents and intelligent workflows using frameworks such as langchain, langgraph, or similar technologies.

implement prompt engineering, tool calling, and model evaluation techniques to improve ai response quality and reliability.

develop rest apis and backend services to integrate ai solutions with enterprise applications, databases, and external systems.

work with structured and unstructured data to support ai applications, knowledge retrieval, and model inference.

deploy and maintain ai applications on cloud platforms such as aws or microsoft azure.

test, troubleshoot, and optimize ai applications for accuracy, performance, scalability, and cost efficiency.

implement logging, monitoring, security controls, and appropriate safeguards for production ai systems.

collaborate with software engineers, data engineers, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into practical ai solutions.

**required qualifications**

bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, engineering, data science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

3+ years of relevant software engineering, ai/ml, or application development experience.

strong programming skills in python and experience building backend applications or apis.

hands-on experience with llms, generative ai, or machine learning applications.

understanding of rag architectures, embeddings, semantic search, and vector databases.

experience with at least one ai development framework, such as langchain, langgraph, or llamaindex.

experience developing rest apis using fastapi, flask, or similar frameworks.

familiarity with cloud platforms, preferably aws or azure.

knowledge of git, software testing, debugging, and collaborative development practices.

strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

**preferred qualifications**

experience building ai agents, agentic workflows, or multi-step ai automation.

familiarity with model context protocol (mcp), tool calling, and agent orchestration.

experience with aws bedrock, amazon sagemaker, azure openai, or azure ai foundry.

familiarity with vector databases such as faiss, pinecone, or chromadb.

knowledge of machine learning frameworks such as pytorch, tensorflow, or scikit-learn.

experience with docker, kubernetes, ci/cd, or mlops/llmops practices.

familiarity with sql, data pipelines, apache spark, or pyspark.

experience with microsoft copilot studio, power automate, or conversational ai solutions.

knowledge of ai evaluation, hallucination mitigation, data privacy, and responsible ai practices.

**what we're looking for**

**mid-level engineers:** strong hands-on development skills, a solid understanding of llms and rag, and the ability to build and maintain ai applications with appropriate guidance.

**senior engineers:** deeper experience designing production ai solutions, optimizing rag and agent workflows, making technical decisions, and supporting deployment and performance improvements.

candidates do not need to have experience with every technology listed. strong python development skills and practical experience building ai applications are the primary priorities.

pay: from $85,000.00 per year

benefits:

* 401(k)
* dental insurance
* health insurance
* health savings account
* paid time off
* vision insurance

experience:

* copilot studio: 4 years (required)
* contact center: 4 years (required)

work location: hybrid remote in sterling, va 20166

title: AI Architect
description:
are you looking to make an impactful difference in your work, yourself, and your community? why settle for just a job when you can land a career? at icw group, we are hiring team members who are ready to use their skills, curiosity, and drive to be part of our journey as we strive to transform the insurance carrier space. we're proud to be in business for over 50 years, and its change agents like yourself that will help us continue to deliver our mission to create the best insurance experience possible.

headquartered in san diego with regional offices located throughout the united states, icw group has been named for the twelfth consecutive year in a row and for the 20th time overall as a top 50 performing p&c organization offering the stability of a large, profitable and growing company combined with a focus on all things people. it's our team members who make us an employer of choice and the vibrant company we are today. we strive to make both our internal and external communities better everyday! learn more about why you want to be here!

**purpose of the job**

the ai architect ii is a senior technical leadership role working to modernizing the company’s technology platform. this position will provide both thought and technical leadership, influencing cloud and ai strategy while working hands-on to deliver solutions that matter. this role will make architectural decisions that have real business impact and utilize expertise to help shape the direction of a rapidly evolving organization.

**essential duties and responsibilities**

* establish architectural standards, patterns, and reference architectures for ai solutions — covering rag pipelines, agentic workflows, model serving, and ai gateway design.
* lead the evaluation, selection, and integration of ai/ml services and frameworks including llms, ai agents, and multi-agent systems using protocols such as mcp and a2a.
* establish and enforce responsible ai practices including model risk management, content filtering, and data privacy guardrails across ai initiatives.
* define and oversee mlops practices to ensure reliable model deployment, monitoring, and lifecycle management across the enterprise.
* design enterprise ai patterns including ai gateway architecture, knowledge bases, and integration of ai capabilities into existing business systems and workflows.
* design and implement scalable cloud architectures on aws, leveraging serverless technologies and design patterns.
* define and enforce cloud architecture standards, patterns, and guardrails across development teams to ensure consistency, security, and cost optimization.
* collaborate with business and technology stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical architecture solutions aligned with enterprise strategy.
* lead systems design efforts including microservices architecture, api design, event-driven systems, and integration patterns across cloud-native and hybrid environments.
* evaluate emerging ai technologies and provide recommendations on adoption strategies, including generative ai, agentic workflows, and intelligent automation.
* develop and maintain architecture documentation, reference architectures, and technology roadmaps guiding the organization's cloud and ai transformation.
* provide technical mentorship and guidance to engineering teams on cloud best practices, ai implementation patterns, and modern software design principles.
* conduct architecture reviews, risk assessments, and proof-of-concept initiatives to validate technology decisions and drive innovation.
* lead application rationalization initiatives to assess, consolidate, and modernize the application portfolio, reducing technical debt and aligning technology investments with business priorities.

**supervisory responsibilities**

this position has no supervisory responsibility.

**education and experience**

* bachelor's degree required in computer science, information systems, or related field.
* minimum 5–7 years with cloud technologies and it systems, with demonstrated expertise in enterprise-scale solution design and delivery.
* minimum 2–3 years hands-on with ai/ml technologies including practical application of llms, agentic frameworks, or ai/ml services in a cloud environment.

**preferred certifications**

* togaf, zachman framework, feaf
* solutions architect associate, solutions architect professional, machine learning – specialty, data engineer
* snowpro core, snowpro advanced architect
* ai/ml, data engineering, devops, security

**knowledge and skills**

* strong understanding of ai concepts including llms, ai agents, agentic frameworks, model context protocol (mcp), agent-to-agent (a2a) communication, and prompt engineering.
* hands-on experience with aws ai/ml services: amazon bedrock, sagemaker, kendra, and amazon q business for building and deploying intelligent applications.
* familiarity with llm fine-tuning, embedding models, vector stores, and chunking strategies for rag pipelines.
* experience with ai orchestration frameworks such as langchain, langgraph, and aws strands agents for multi-step agentic workflows.
* knowledge of frontier model evaluation, benchmarking methodologies, and model selection criteria for responsible and cost-effective ai adoption.
* familiarity with open-source ai tooling such as open webui and litellm for unified llm api gateway and proxy management.
* understanding of responsible ai principles including bias detection, model risk management, content filtering, pii handling, and data residency; amazon bedrock guardrails experience preferred.
* familiarity with mlops tooling including sagemaker pipelines or mlflow for model versioning, experiment tracking, and drift detection.
* knowledge of llm function calling, structured output patterns, and tool integration techniques for reliable agentic systems.
* familiarity with multimodal ai use cases including document understanding, image analysis, and audio processing.
* understanding of ai cost and performance optimization: token management, prompt caching, model quantization, and right-sizing for inference workloads.
* deep knowledge of aws cloud services with emphasis on serverless architectures and design patterns.
* proficiency in linux and windows system administration including networking, storage, security, and scripting.
* proficiency in python for scripting, automation, and cloud-native application development.
* hands-on experience with snowflake, aws aurora (postgresql), dynamodb, glue, redshift, athena, s3-based data lakes, and data pipeline design.
* experience with infrastructure-as-code tools: aws cdk, cloudformation, or terraform for automated, repeatable cloud deployments.
* knowledge of enterprise integration patterns, restful api design, event-driven architecture, and microservices design principles.
* familiarity with devsecops practices including ci/cd pipelines, automated testing, container orchestration (ecs, eks), and security-by-design.
* understanding of cloud cost management, finops principles, and architectural trade-off analysis.
* experience with observability and monitoring tools: amazon cloudwatch, aws x-ray, and third-party apm solutions.
* strong communication skills with the ability to present complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences, including executive leadership.

office environment – no specific or unusual physical or environmental demands and employees are regularly required to sit, walk, stand, talk, and hear.

this position operates in an office environment and requires the frequent use of a computer, telephone, copier, and other standard office equipment.

title: AI Software Engineer
description:
founded in richmond, virginia in 1997, capcenter exists to help individuals and families achieve one of life's most meaningful milestones—homeownership. by bringing mortgage, realty, and insurance services together under one roof, we provide a simpler, more transparent experience designed to save clients time and money. our commitment to innovation, including our zero closing cost mortgage, has earned the trust of thousands of clients and fueled our growth through repeat business and referrals.

at capcenter, our mission extends beyond serving clients. we foster a collaborative, high-impact environment where employees are empowered to do meaningful work, grow professionally, and make a real difference in the lives of the people we serve.

**job overview:**

we are seeking an innovative **ai software engineer** to design, build, and deploy advanced software solutions that transform both internal mortgage operations and external customer experiences. this role combines software engineering, artificial intelligence, cloud-native infrastructure, and mortgage-industry problem-solving to deliver tools that increase efficiency, enhance customer engagement, and support data-driven decision-making across the organization.

**key responsibilities:**

***ai-driven software development***

* architect, develop, and deploy ai-powered applications for internal operations (e.g., loan processing tools, underwriting automation, compliance checks, workflow optimization).
* build customer-facing and marketing-facing software such as intelligent chat assistants, personalized loan recommendation engines, automated prequalification tools, and interactive calculators.
* integrate ai models (llms, predictive models, generative ai) into new or existing products using modern development frameworks and apis.

***cloud infrastructure & deployment***

* design, deploy, and operate applications on microsoft azure, using services such as azure kubernetes service (aks), app service, azure functions, azure sql, storage, key vault, and azure openai / ai foundry.
* containerize applications with docker and run them on kubernetes. this includes writing and maintaining manifests and helm charts, and managing deployments, scaling, ingress, secrets, and resource limits.
* build and maintain ci/cd pipelines (azure devops or github actions) that take code from commit to production reliably and repeatably.
* manage cloud resources with infrastructure-as-code (terraform, bicep, or arm templates).
* implement monitoring, logging, and alerting (azure monitor, application insights, log analytics) to keep production ai services healthy, and troubleshoot cluster and application issues when they come up.
* apply cloud security best practices, including entra id (azure ad) identity and role-based access, managed identities, network isolation, and secure secrets handling. all of this should meet the data-protection requirements for sensitive borrower information.
* optimize cloud cost and performance for ai workloads, including model hosting, inference scaling, and gpu/compute usage.

***collaborative product engineering***

* partner with operations, loan officers, compliance, marketing, and customer experience teams to identify high-impact use cases for ai and translate them into scalable products.
* work closely with data engineering to source, prepare, and validate datasets used for model training and evaluation.
* develop secure, compliant, and well-documented systems aligned with mortgage regulatory requirements.

***model development & optimization***

* train, fine-tune, or customize ai models to improve accuracy, performance, and relevance to mortgage workflows.
* implement continuous monitoring, versioning, and quality checks for ai models in production.
* evaluate emerging ai technologies and recommend adoption paths for the organization.

***technical leadership & best practices***

* establish development standards for ai-enabled software, including testing strategies, documentation, and model governance.
* provide guidance on responsible ai usage, data protection, and fair lending considerations in all deployments.
* contribute to long-term ai strategy to modernize the company’s tech stack and customer experience.

**qualifications:**

* bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, data science, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
* 3–5+ years of software engineering experience building web or backend applications.
* hands-on experience with machine learning or generative ai tools (openai, anthropic, huggingface, langchain, vector databases, etc.).
* proficiency in languages such as python, typescript/javascript, or c#.
* strong working knowledge of microsoft azure, including hands-on experience deploying, securing, and operating production workloads (compute, networking, identity, storage, and key vault).
* solid experience with containers and kubernetes (preferably aks), including deployments, services, ingress, config/secrets, autoscaling, and debugging workloads with kubectl.
* experience building and maintaining ci/cd pipelines for containerized applications.
* understanding of apis, microservices, and modern software architecture patterns.

**preferred:**

* experience in fintech or mortgage/lending systems.
* familiarity with mortgage workflows: los, pos, underwriting, rate/pricing engines, and compliance considerations.
* microsoft azure certifications (e.g., az-204 developer, az-104 administrator, az-305 solutions architect, or ai-102 ai engineer) and/or kubernetes certifications (cka or ckad).
* experience with infrastructure-as-code (terraform or bicep) and gitops or helm-based deployment workflows.
* experience deploying and scaling ai/llm workloads on azure (azure openai, ai foundry, or self-hosted models on aks).
* knowledge of mlops tools and frameworks for model deployment.
* experience building customer-facing digital experiences.

**key competencies:**

* strong problem-solving skills with the ability to map operational processes to technical solutions.
* ability to work cross-functionally and communicate complex concepts to non-technical teams.
* ownership of systems in production, from architecture through deployment, monitoring, and incident response.
* curiosity and eagerness to explore new ai capabilities.
* commitment to data security, fair lending, and responsible ai use.

**compensation:**

the estimated range of $90,000 – $115,000 reflects the budgeted amount for this position. individual compensation will be determined based on job-related business considerations, such as relevant qualifications, experience, location, education, certifications, skills, and other job-related reasons. where applicable, this position is eligible for incentive compensation and/or discretionary bonus opportunities.

**benefits:**

capcenter offers a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, a 401(k) plan with company match, paid vacation, paid holidays, and other programs designed to support the well-being and professional growth of our employees.

**physical requirements and work environment:**

work is primarily performed in a professional office environment and may involve extended periods of sitting, computer use, keyboarding, and telephone or virtual communication. the position may require managing competing priorities, responding to time-sensitive matters, maintaining accuracy and attention to detail, and working effectively in a fast-paced environment.

**reasonable accommodation:**

as required by law, reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position.

**equal opportunity employer:**

description:
**data platform architect (d360)**  
  
we are looking for a data platform architect to help us support our continued growth. the data platform architect is responsible for owning the overall design of the technical solution as well as recommending best practice solutions based on client needs. they provide technical guidance to the development of salesforce.com and other saas applications to support business and product strategies, with a heavy emphasis on maximizing the salesforce data 360 (d360) ecosystem.  
  
a data platform architect facilitates discovery sessions to understand client processes and challenges and translates findings into technical requirements supported by a documented solution design. they provide thoughtful leadership and communication to project and client team members in order to build the foundation as a trusted partner.  
  
**role responsibilities:**

* data architecture design:

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
**company description**

**about abbvie**

abbvie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. we strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our allergan aesthetics portfolio. for more information about abbvie, please visit us at www.abbvie.com. follow @abbvie on linkedin, facebook, instagram, x and youtube.

 **job description**

abbvie is seeking an experienced senior data scientist to join our analytics & ai organization and help advance the next generation of copay intelligence capabilities.

this role will focus on developing innovative machine learning and artificial intelligence solutions that help identify complex reimbursement and affordability program dynamics, improve patient access insights, and drive more proactive decision-making across patient support programs.

the successful candidate will play a key role in building predictive intelligence products that leverage healthcare, claims, enrollment, and patient-level data to identify emerging opportunities, uncover hidden patterns, and generate actionable recommendations. these capabilities support a long-term strategy to enhance copay program intelligence, improve affordability insights, and strengthen data-driven decision-making across the organization.

working closely with data engineering, business stakeholders, technology teams, and analytics partners, this individual will help transform large-scale healthcare data into scalable ai-powered solutions that create measurable business impact.

**what you'll be doing**

the senior data scientist will lead the design, development, deployment, and continuous improvement of advanced analytics and ai solutions supporting abbvie's copay intelligence initiatives. this individual will work on highly visible strategic programs focused on predictive intelligence, healthcare affordability analytics, patient access insights, and advanced machine learning applications. the role requires a combination of strong technical expertise, business acumen, and the ability to translate complex analytical findings into practical solutions. the ideal candidate is passionate about solving challenging problems with data and enjoys working across the full lifecycle of ai and machine learning product development.

**core responsibilities**

**ai & machine learning development**

* develop advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence models that support healthcare affordability and copay intelligence initiatives.
* build predictive models that identify patterns, risks, and opportunities from healthcare, claims, enrollment, and patient-level data.
* design scoring frameworks, recommendation engines, and decision-support systems that enable proactive business actions.
* evaluate and implement modern ai methodologies, including machine learning, deep learning, ensemble methods, graph analytics, and generative ai approaches.
* continuously improve model performance through experimentation, feedback loops, and performance monitoring.

**advanced analytics**

* analyze large and complex healthcare datasets to uncover actionable business insights.
* perform feature engineering, predictive modeling, forecasting, segmentation, optimization, and statistical analyses.
* assess and monitor model performance using both statistical and business outcome metrics.
* translate analytical findings into clear recommendations for technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* develop methodologies to measure business impact and return on investment for analytical solutions.

**ai product development & operationalization**

* partner with data engineering and technology teams to deploy machine learning solutions into production environments.
* design scalable and maintainable machine learning workflows and pipelines.
* implement model monitoring, automated retraining, model governance, and performance management processes.
* support development of enterprise ai products that can be scaled across multiple business functions.
* ensure solutions adhere to organizational standards for quality, privacy, security, and compliance.

**collaboration & leadership**

* partner with business stakeholders to identify opportunities where ai and advanced analytics can drive measurable value.
* serve as a subject matter expert in data science, machine learning, and predictive analytics.
* present findings, recommendations, and technical concepts to senior leadership and cross-functional teams.
* mentor junior data scientists and contribute to the growth of the broader analytics community.
* stay current on emerging technologies and industry trends in ai, machine learning, and healthcare analytics.

  
**qualifications**

**education & experience**

* bachelor's degree in statistics, computer science, data science, mathematics, engineering, economics, operations research, or a related quantitative discipline.
* advanced degree (master's or phd) is preferred but not required.
* equivalent combinations of education, specialized training, and relevant professional experience will be considered.
* 6+ years of experience developing and deploying machine learning, artificial intelligence, or advanced analytics solutions in production environments.

**technical skills**

* strong proficiency in python and sql.
* hands-on experience with machine learning frameworks such as scikit-learn, xgboost, lightgbm, tensorflow, or pytorch.
* experience building predictive, classification, forecasting, recommendation, or optimization models.
* strong knowledge of statistics, experimentation, predictive modeling, and model evaluation techniques.
* experience working with large-scale data platforms and cloud-based environments.
* familiarity with mlops, model deployment, model monitoring, and production ai practices.
* experience using modern software development and version control practices.

**business & leadership skills**

* strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
* excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* ability to translate business challenges into data-driven solutions.
* demonstrated ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across teams.
* strong organizational and project management skills.
* passion for innovation, continuous learning, and practical application of ai technologies.

**preferred qualifications**

* experience working with healthcare, pharmaceutical, claims, payer, patient support, or market access data.
* experience developing ai-powered decision support systems.
* experience with cloud platforms such as aws, azure, or google cloud.
* experience with snowflake, databricks, spark, or other large-scale data environments.
* experience deploying generative ai or large language model solutions.
* experience operating in regulated industries where data quality, governance, and validation are critical.

description:
***this is an on-site role in irvine california***

**about balt**

our purpose is to improve the lives of 150,000 patients in 2026.

**our story**

balt is a rapidly growing pioneer in an exceptional field. for 45 years, balt has been leading the way - collaborating with physicians and institutions to develop elegant medical devices. our products are being used by physicians across the world, and we have 13 offices in 11 countries – and counting.

we introduced one of the first neurovascular intervention devices in 1977 and now offer the world's broadest portfolio of medical devices for stroke. as the premier global neurovascular platform always seeking to expand beyond boundaries, we are now bringing our innovation to the peripheral vascular space.

we are proud of our mission, our people, and the incredible work we accomplish together as we empower physicians to save lives.

**why join balt? join a passionate team, dedicated to making a difference.**

* working at balt means giving meaning to your work! pride is a strong part of our identity.

* we are a close-knit team, with strong mission, vision and values that guide our day-to-day.

* recognition of work, respect, and our multicultural community are key aspects of the employee experience and contribute to our continued success.

* no matter the country, we take care of you.

would you like to be part of our story? don't hesitate, come and join us!

**about this opportunity – sr data & ai engineer - on-site: irvine, ca**

**description:**

the **data & ai engineer** at balt is part of the group data division within the it team and will provide data management solutions - and help evolve balt's ai capabilities - to support the company's growth, particularly in the us. the data & ai engineer will help architect, build, and optimize data solutions for various business departments, while also exploring and introducing practical ai use cases as balt's data and ai maturity grows. this role is as much about laying the groundwork for ai adoption as it is about hands-on data engineering.

**job responsibilities:**

* **data collection and processing**
  + gather requirements from various departments and identify necessary sources of data.
  + plan a scalable architecture to support rapid growth in the us, accommodating new topics or solutions - including future ai use cases.
  + implement technical solutions for data collection, transformation, storage, and display, in accordance with the defined architecture at the group data level.
  + establish automated processes and ensure proper monitoring and operation of these processes.
* **data quality and governance**
  + participate in defining and implementing the group's data management strategy.
  + promote this strategy to internal customers in the us.
  + define the development platforms and tools to support this strategy.
  + manage data lifecycle in accordance with defined policies.
  + industrialize and automate data cleansing.
  + support key users in using the data provided.
  + implement and monitor safety rules for data exposure.
* **ai exploration & enablement**
  + identify practical, low-risk opportunities to apply ai (e.g., automation, forecasting, natural-language reporting, or genai-assisted analytics) to business problems.
  + evaluate and pilot ai/ml tools and platforms that fit within balt's existing snowflake and tableau ecosystem (e.g., snowflake cortex) before recommending broader adoption.
  + prepare and structure data so it's ai-ready as the organization's ai capabilities mature.
  + partner with business departments to test small-scale proofs of concept and help set realistic expectations about what ai can and can't do.
  + help define early data governance and safety guardrails for any ai use cases as they're introduced.
* **daily-run activities**
  + support and manage external service providers.
  + maintain the group's data environment in operational condition: etl, data lake, mdm, etc.
  + stay informed about industry and technology advancements in the data and ai fields and bring forward relevant ideas.
  + write technical specifications as needed.
  + present the status of ongoing actions to the it team, users, or the data management committee.

**qualification requirements:**

* **skills:**
  + 5+ years of development experience with snowflake and talend cloud
  + 5+ years of development experience with data visualization tools such as tableau or power bi
  + 5+ years of expert-level sql skills
  + experience with openflow and python
  + curiosity about and some exposure to ai/ml or genai tools (e.g., experimenting with llms, copilot-style tools, or snowflake cortex) - no prior production ai experience required, but genuine interest and aptitude to learn is important
  + strong communication skills - written, verbal, in-person, and remote
  + strong presentation skills - able to explain technical concepts clearly and concisely, including non-technical stakeholders
* **pre-requisites / job experience:**
  + minimum 5 years of experience as a data engineer performing technical work such as setting up workflows, managing repositories, and managing data infrastructure
  + technical degree or equivalent certification (degree in cs or related field, or relevant technical certifications)
  + experience working in medical device and/or manufacturing industries a plus

**physical requirements:**

  

* extended periods of sitting or speaking.
* light lifting.
* occasional international travel, mainly to europe (expected 1-2 times annually)
* heavy computer use.
* must adhere to the company’s safety practices by performing work safely and in accordance with established standards.

**work environment:**

working conditions are normal for an office environment.

the above information on this description have been designed to indicate the general nature of work performed by employees within this position. this job description is only a summary of the typical functions of the job, not an exhaustive or comprehensive list of all possible responsibilities. tasks, and duties, and does not limit the assignment of additional duties for this position.

balt group is an equal employment opportunity employer.

more information please go to www.baltgroup.com

title: Full Stack Software Engineer
description:
### **about lantern**

lantern is the specialty care platform connecting people with the best care when they need it most. by curating a network of excellence comprised of the nation's top specialists for surgery, cancer care, infusions and more, lantern delivers excellent care with significant cost savings to employers and their workforces. lantern also pairs members with a dedicated care team, including care advocates and nurses, for the entirety of their care journey, helping them get back to good health, back to their families and back to work. with convenient access to specialists nationwide, lantern means quality care is within driving distance for most. lantern is trusted by the nation's largest employers to deliver care to more than 6 million members across the country. learn more about us at lanterncare.com.

lantern is a specialty care navigation company connecting more than 10 million members with the highest-quality surgery, oncology, and infusion therapy providers. our curated network of excellence delivers 55%+ cost savings versus average health plan rates while maintaining a surgical complication rate below 1%. we were ranked #3 on fast company's most innovative companies 2026 in healthcare.  
  
we are transforming from a technology-enabled health services company into a health ai company, where technology and ai sit at the forefront of everything we build. engineering is a strategy maker, not an order taker. if you want your code to change how specialty care is delivered at scale, this is the team.  
  
as a software engineer on the full stack, you will own features end-to-end, from the react interfaces our members and provider partners use to the python or .net services and data models behind them. you will ship ai-first experiences on azure, backed by our data platform, and set the technical bar for the engineers around you.  
  
this is a hands-on ic role. you will lead workstreams, drive code and design reviews, and make pragmatic architecture decisions. we deliver incrementally: every initiative articulates a first deliverable within four weeks. we ship fast through automation and testing, never by cutting corners, because quality and reliability are non-negotiable in healthcare.

**location:** hybrid - at least 3 days/wk in our dallas, tx or vancouver, bc canada offices

**what you will own**

* design, build, and operate full-stack features end-to-end across react front ends and python or .net back-end services.
* model and query relational data in postgresql or sql server, with a focus on correctness, performance, and data quality.
* build and run services on azure, provisioned and managed as code with terraform.
* embed ai into the products you build, integrating llm and ai capabilities into member and provider experiences and internal tooling.
* work with our data platform (databricks) and engineering partners to treat data as a first-class strategic asset with automated phi governance.
* lead technical design and code reviews, and raise the quality bar through testing, observability, and ci/cd automation.
* break large problems into incremental deliverables, shipping a first useful increment within four weeks.
* partner directly with product, design, and clinical stakeholders as an equal owner of product decisions.
* uphold security and hipaa/phi obligations by design, building safe-by-default systems rather than treating security as a gate.

**what you bring**

* 5+ years of professional software engineering experience building and operating production web applications.
* strong front-end skills with react and modern javascript/typescript.
* strong back-end skills in python or .net (c#), including designing and consuming rest and event-driven apis.
* solid relational database experience with postgresql or sql server, including schema design and query optimization.
* hands-on experience deploying and operating workloads on azure.
* infrastructure-as-code experience with terraform.
* experience with ci/cd, automated testing, and containerized deployment (docker, kubernetes/aks).
* demonstrated ai curiosity and fluency: you use ai tools in your daily work and are eager to build ai-powered features.
* a track record of owning work end-to-end and delivering incrementally in a fast-moving environment.

**strong candidates will also have**

* experience building ai or llm-powered product features in production.
* experience with data platforms such as databricks, and with data pipelines feeding analytics or ml.
* experience in healthcare, or another regulated domain, handling sensitive data such as phi under hipaa.
* full comfort across both python and .net, and both postgresql and sql server.
* a habit of mentoring peers and elevating team standards without formal authority.

**benefits**:

* medical insurance
* dental insurance
* vision insurance
* short & long term disability
* life insurance
* 401k with company match
* flexible paid time off
* paid parental leave

**about you:**

* you use **logic** in your decision making and understand that progress is critical to making change. you focus on the execution of your content while balancing a fast-paced environment and you take the time to celebrate both the small & big wins.
* **inclusion** is a core tenant of your personal beliefs. a diverse and inclusive environment is incredibly important to you. you understand and desire to be a part of a diverse team with different experiences and perspectives & you cherish the differences in each individual that you interact with.
* you have the **grit**, drive and ambition to tackle big problems. big problems require big ideas and a team that supports new ideas.
* you care deeply for your customers are driven to keep **humanity** in all decisions. your customers aren't just the individuals using your product. they are the driving factor in your motivation to make a change.
* integrity guides you in life. focusing on the **truth** vs. giving people the answers they want to hear.
* you thrive in a team environment. collaboration is key in innovation and creating change.

these pillars of **light** are a reminder to our team that we are making a difference by providing guidance and support in navigating the often complex and confusing landscape of healthcare. we hope that through this **light**, individuals can find their way to the best care, resources, and support they need to get back to life.

  

if this sounds like you, we would love to connect to speak further about career opportunities at lantern.

please apply to our role & someone from our talent acquisition team will reach out to help you navigate our interview process.

title: AI/ML Engineer
description:
**src, inc.** is currently seeking an ai/ml engineer to join a team building machine learning and generative ai capabilities for defense and national security missions. this is a hands-on, early-career engineering role focused on the practical work of turning data into working models: assembling and curating datasets, training and fine-tuning models, and building the evaluation harnesses that tell us whether a model is actually good enough to field. you will work under the direction of senior engineers and scientists on tasks scoped within larger programs, with increasing ownership of discrete technical tasks as you develop. the work spans classical machine learning, deep learning, reinforcement learning, and the rapidly evolving generative ai toolchain, applied to real sensor data and real mission problems in isr, ew, and advanced sensing. this is a strong fit for an engineer who wants to build depth in applied ml on problems where the data is messy, the ground truth is hard-won, and the results have to hold up under scrutiny.

**what you'll do**

* build, clean, label, and version datasets from real and simulated sources, including handling class imbalance, distribution shift, and sparse or noisy labels
* train, fine-tune, and benchmark models using standard open-source frameworks, running experiments as assigned and documenting results clearly
* develop and run evaluation pipelines — task-specific metrics, held-out and adversarial test sets, regression suites — and report findings honestly, including negative results
* support generative ai efforts through prompt development and iteration, structured output design, retrieval-augmented generation pipelines, and comparative evaluation of open-weight and commercial language models
* assist with parameter-efficient fine-tuning (lora/qlora) and supervised fine-tuning of open-weight models for domain-specific tasks
* implement reinforcement learning experiments in standard environments and instrument them for reproducible measurement
* maintain reproducible experiment tracking, environment configuration, and code hygiene so that results can be regenerated by others
* contribute data, figures, and written findings to technical reports, program reviews, and oral presentations
* collaborate with algorithm engineers and domain experts to understand the sensor data and physical phenomenology behind the datasets you work with

**what you'll bring**

* bachelor’s in computer science, engineering, mathematics, physics, statistics, or a related technical discipline and 0+ years of experience (internships, co-ops, research assistantships, and substantial academic project work count)
* working proficiency in python and the core scientific stack (numpy, pandas, scikit-learn, matplotlib)
* familiarity with at least one deep learning framework, preferably pytorch
* exposure to the hugging face ecosystem (transformers, datasets, tokenizers) or equivalent open-source model tooling
* understanding of ml fundamentals: train/validation/test discipline, overfitting and regularization, cross-validation, and the metrics appropriate to classification, regression, detection, and generation tasks
* comfort with git-based collaborative development
* clear written and verbal communication, and a willingness to say when a result doesn't hold up

**ways to stand out**

* experience fine-tuning open-weight language models using peft methods (lora, qlora) or the trl/axolotl/unsloth toolchain
* hands-on work with rag systems: embedding models, vector stores, chunking strategies, and retrieval evaluation
* familiarity with llm evaluation practice — llm-as-judge, rubric-based grading, eval harness design, and the failure modes of each
* experience with experiment tracking and data versioning tools (weights & biases, mlflow, dvc)
* exposure to reinforcement learning libraries (gymnasium, stable-baselines3, cleanrl) or to preference-based post-training methods (dpo, grpo)
* experience with agentic workflows, tool-calling, or the model context protocol (mcp)
* work with non-natural-image modalities: rf, radar, sar, audio, time series, or multimodal data
* containerization (docker) and experience running jobs on gpu clusters or cloud compute
* master's degree in a related technical discipline

**what sets us apart?**  
src, inc., a not-for-profit research and development company, combines information, science, technology and ingenuity to solve “impossible” problems in the areas of defense, environment and intelligence. across our family of companies, we apply bright minds, fresh thinking and relentless determination to deliver innovative products and services that are redefining possible®. when you join our team, you’ll be a part of something truly meaningful — helping to keep america and its allies safe and strong. you’ll collaborate with more than 1,400 engineers, scientists and professionals — with 20 percent of those employees having served in the military — in a highly innovative, inclusive and equitable work environment. you’ll receive a competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package that includes four or more weeks of paid time off to start, 10 percent employer contribution toward retirement, and 100 percent tuition support.

total compensation for this role is market competitive. the anticipated salary range for this position based out of dayton, oh is estimated at $70,000 to $96,000 annually. the actual salary will vary based on applicant’s experience, skills, and abilities, geographic location as well as other business and organizational needs. src offers competitive benefit options, for more details please visit our website.

title: Senior Software Engineer

title: AI/ML Engineer
description:
**src, inc.** is currently seeking an ai/ml engineer to join a team building machine learning and generative ai capabilities for defense and national security missions. this is a hands-on, early-career engineering role focused on the practical work of turning data into working models: assembling and curating datasets, training and fine-tuning models, and building the evaluation harnesses that tell us whether a model is actually good enough to field. you will work under the direction of senior engineers and scientists on tasks scoped within larger programs, with increasing ownership of discrete technical tasks as you develop. the work spans classical machine learning, deep learning, reinforcement learning, and the rapidly evolving generative ai toolchain, applied to real sensor data and real mission problems in isr, ew, and advanced sensing. this is a strong fit for an engineer who wants to build depth in applied ml on problems where the data is messy, the ground truth is hard-won, and the results have to hold up under scrutiny.

**what you'll do**

* build, clean, label, and version datasets from real and simulated sources, including handling class imbalance, distribution shift, and sparse or noisy labels
* train, fine-tune, and benchmark models using standard open-source frameworks, running experiments as assigned and documenting results clearly
* develop and run evaluation pipelines — task-specific metrics, held-out and adversarial test sets, regression suites — and report findings honestly, including negative results
* support generative ai efforts through prompt development and iteration, structured output design, retrieval-augmented generation pipelines, and comparative evaluation of open-weight and commercial language models
* assist with parameter-efficient fine-tuning (lora/qlora) and supervised fine-tuning of open-weight models for domain-specific tasks
* implement reinforcement learning experiments in standard environments and instrument them for reproducible measurement
* maintain reproducible experiment tracking, environment configuration, and code hygiene so that results can be regenerated by others
* contribute data, figures, and written findings to technical reports, program reviews, and oral presentations
* collaborate with algorithm engineers and domain experts to understand the sensor data and physical phenomenology behind the datasets you work with

**what you'll bring**

* bachelor’s in computer science, engineering, mathematics, physics, statistics, or a related technical discipline and 0+ years of experience (internships, co-ops, research assistantships, and substantial academic project work count)
* working proficiency in python and the core scientific stack (numpy, pandas, scikit-learn, matplotlib)
* familiarity with at least one deep learning framework, preferably pytorch
* exposure to the hugging face ecosystem (transformers, datasets, tokenizers) or equivalent open-source model tooling
* understanding of ml fundamentals: train/validation/test discipline, overfitting and regularization, cross-validation, and the metrics appropriate to classification, regression, detection, and generation tasks
* comfort with git-based collaborative development
* clear written and verbal communication, and a willingness to say when a result doesn't hold up

**ways to stand out**

* experience fine-tuning open-weight language models using peft methods (lora, qlora) or the trl/axolotl/unsloth toolchain
* hands-on work with rag systems: embedding models, vector stores, chunking strategies, and retrieval evaluation
* familiarity with llm evaluation practice — llm-as-judge, rubric-based grading, eval harness design, and the failure modes of each
* experience with experiment tracking and data versioning tools (weights & biases, mlflow, dvc)
* exposure to reinforcement learning libraries (gymnasium, stable-baselines3, cleanrl) or to preference-based post-training methods (dpo, grpo)
* experience with agentic workflows, tool-calling, or the model context protocol (mcp)
* work with non-natural-image modalities: rf, radar, sar, audio, time series, or multimodal data
* containerization (docker) and experience running jobs on gpu clusters or cloud compute
* master's degree in a related technical discipline

**what sets us apart?**  
src, inc., a not-for-profit research and development company, combines information, science, technology and ingenuity to solve “impossible” problems in the areas of defense, environment and intelligence. across our family of companies, we apply bright minds, fresh thinking and relentless determination to deliver innovative products and services that are redefining possible®. when you join our team, you’ll be a part of something truly meaningful — helping to keep america and its allies safe and strong. you’ll collaborate with more than 1,400 engineers, scientists and professionals — with 20 percent of those employees having served in the military — in a highly innovative, inclusive and equitable work environment. you’ll receive a competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package that includes four or more weeks of paid time off to start, 10 percent employer contribution toward retirement, and 100 percent tuition support.

total compensation for this role is market competitive. the anticipated salary range for this position based out of dayton, oh is estimated at $70,000 to $96,000 annually. the actual salary will vary based on applicant’s experience, skills, and abilities, geographic location as well as other business and organizational needs. src offers competitive benefit options, for more details please visit our website.

**about the department**

globus (www.globus.org) is a sustainable, non-profit unit within the university of chicago delivering solutions to the research community worldwide. globus develops and provides critical services that support scientific research for governmental, academic, and commercial organizations in a wide range of disciplines including life sciences, physics, and astronomy. we develop and operate commercial-quality, cloud-based software application and platform services used by 10s of thousands of researchers to manage their large–and growing–data management challenges. we have offices located at the nbc tower in the heart of downtown chicago and remote employees who work-from-home. globus, together with globus labs, a research group within the university of chicago, and part of the data science and learning division at argonne national labs, develop and deploy cutting edge technologies to solve new challenges facing the scientific community and enable break-through scientific discoveries.

**job summary**

the globus operations team is a 4-5 person group that designs, builds, and operates the cloud infrastructure behind a research-computing platform used by hundreds of institutions worldwide. globus is a hybrid solution combining aws-hosted orchestration services with installable applications, delivering identity and access management, data transfer and sharing, and task automation as both software-as-a-service (saas) and platform-as-a-service (paas). as a senior member of this small, high-autonomy team, you will ensure software development and operational best practices are effectively integrated across our services and aws infrastructure. the team owns an unusually broad estate — an aws organization of roughly thirty production accounts, a golden-image pipeline producing around thirty machine images, a self-hosted monitoring platform, a centralized security-logging pipeline, and in-house compliance and security automation — all managed as code in python, bash, terraform, cloudformation, and ansible. you will work both collaboratively and independently on complex issues and projects, in some cases making progress under minimal guidance. you will also embed with select software engineering teams to provide operational and infrastructure guidance on best practices.  
  
we are looking for a senior engineer equally comfortable improving a build pipeline and debugging a production incident, and who will be a leader and educator both within and across teams.

* sre/operations: deploy, operate, and monitor production globus services for high availability. participate in an on-call rotation, lead incident response, and author root-cause analyses. identify recurring operational toil and eliminate it through automation and better defaults.

title: AI Solutions Engineer
description:
the ai solutions engineer is a key role within the ai team that partners with business teams to turn real operational challenges into practical ai-enabled solutions. this person combines strong business curiosity, consultative problem-solving, and hands-on ai capability in designing, building, testing, and improving sophisticated ai agents and workflows.

they will help teams identify where ai can create meaningful value, translate needs into clear solution designs, and build usable prototypes and production-ready solutions in collaboration with business stakeholders and technical partners.

**key responsibilities**

**partner with the business**

* partner with business units to understand their goals, processes, pain points, and opportunities for improvement.
* participate in discovery sessions that translate ambiguous business problems into well-defined ai solution requirements.
* collaborate with the broader ai team to shape solution designs, provide practical feedback on feasibility and user needs, and help prioritize the ai opportunity pipeline based on business value, complexity, risk, and strategic alignment.
* work with data, technology, security, legal, and risk partners to ensure solutions are reliable, responsible, and appropriate for the business context.

**build and integrate**

* design, build, and iterate ai agents, copilots, automations, and workflow integrations using modern ai platforms and tools.
* develop agent instructions, tools, knowledge sources, guardrails, and human-review workflows.
* create prototypes that demonstrate value quickly, then help evolve successful concepts into durable solutions.

**test and improve**

* define success metrics and evaluation approaches before build, so each solution has a clear bar for what good looks like.
* test ai solutions for accuracy, usefulness, safety, consistency, and user experience; continuously improve them based on feedback and performance data.
* monitor solutions in production for adoption and accuracy drift; retire or rework anything that no longer meets its success bar.

**enable and share**

* explain ai capabilities, limitations, tradeoffs, and recommended practices in clear, non-technical language.
* build adoption through training, documentation, office hours, and hands-on support for business users.
* stay current on ai tools, agent patterns, governance practices, and emerging opportunities; bring relevant ideas back to the organization.
  

**required qualifications**

* 3+ years of hands-on experience building ai agents, copilots, or automations using generative ai platforms, apis, low-code tools, or development frameworks, including work with structured and unstructured data, knowledge bases, and retrieval-augmented generation.
* 5-7+ years experience solving business problems through process improvement, consulting, business analysis, operations, or a similar role, with demonstrated ability to work with non-technical stakeholders and build trust across business functions
* hands-on experience building ai agents, copilots, or automations using generative ai platforms, apis, low-code tools, or development frameworks, including work with structured and unstructured data, knowledge bases, and retrieval-augmented generation.
* experience solving business problems through process improvement, consulting, business analysis, operations, or a similar role, with demonstrated ability to work with non-technical stakeholders and build trust across business functions.
* basic programming or scripting capability, such as python, javascript, sql, or api integration, with experience in workflow automation, systems integration, or service design.
* experience evaluating ai systems (test cases, quality measurement, prompt iteration, monitoring) and applying responsible ai practices (privacy, security, model risk, change management).
* strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to make technical topics understandable and actionable.
* sound judgment about when ai is appropriate versus a simpler solution, and comfort experimenting, learning quickly, and moving concepts to usable solutions.
  

**preferred qualifications**

* ability to translate business requirements into solution designs, user journeys, and measurable success criteria.
* product management experience, including working with product roadmaps and stakeholder prioritization.
* media or broadcast industry experience, including familiarity with newsroom, sales, or traffic operations, or systems such as wideorbit or osi.
* experience with modern agent frameworks and evaluation tooling, such as langchain, llamaindex, openai agents sdk, model context protocol, langsmith, or braintrust.
* data analysis and enterprise data platform experience, such as snowflake, power bi, or dbt, and sql beyond basics.
* prior experience on an internal ai enablement, digital transformation, or innovation team.
  

**what success looks like**

the ai solutions engineer is a constructive, trusted contributor to the broader ai team, bringing business-unit insight into solution design and helping the organization focus its ai investment on the highest-value opportunities. within the first year, the ai solutions engineer will have delivered several solutions that improve productivity, quality, speed, or customer and employee experience. they will be known as a practical business partner who can turn ai potential into responsible, measurable results.

**core competencies**

* business problem framing
* consultative stakeholder partnership
* ai agent and workflow design
* rapid prototyping and iterative delivery
* clear communication and enablement
* responsible ai judgment
* analytical thinking and prioritization
* curiosity, adaptability, and ownership

**position summary:** atlas air is seeking a data engineer to join our data platform and engineering team. this is an early-career individual contributor role for an engineer who can deliver well-defined data solutions with guidance, build strong engineering fundamentals, and grow ownership over increasingly complex work.

as we continue to build our data environment on databricks, you will help build and operate reliable data pipelines, transformations, and data models. you will work within established architecture and standards, partner with more experienced engineers, and author production-quality code that supports analytics, data science, ai/ml, and operational decision-making.

**major accountabilities:**

**data pipeline development**

* build, test, deploy, and maintain batch and streaming data pipelines for structured and semi-structured data sources using established patterns and frameworks.

* use databricks, spark, orchestration tools, and cloud services to complete scoped engineering work with support from senior team members.

**data quality & operations**

* create automated tests, validation checks, logging, and monitoring the pipelines and datasets you develop.
* investigate data quality, reliability, and performance issues; resolve routine issues independently and escalate broader problems appropriately.
* produce clear technical documentation, including data definitions, lineage, runbooks, and support notes.
* participate in the team's on-call and incident response practices, with appropriate guidance and escalation support.

**collaboration & growth**

* work with data analytics, data science, software engineering, it, security, and business partners to clarify requirements and deliver fit-for-purpose solutions.
* break defined requirements into engineering tasks, communicate progress and risks, and deliver work within agreed timelines.
* contribute to team standards for source control, testing, ci/cd, documentation, and operational readiness.
* learn the atlas air business domain and use that understanding to improve the usefulness and reliability of data products.
* seek feedback, share knowledge, and progressively take ownership of larger components and less-defined problems.

**required qualifications:**

* bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, or a related quantitative field; or equivalent practical experience.
* minimum 1 year of professional experience in data engineering, software engineering, analytics engineering, or a closely related field.
* working proficiency in sql and at least one general-purpose programming language (e.g., python, typescript, rust, java, c++, etc.).
* experience building or supporting data pipelines, transformations, or data models in a professional, internship, academic, or substantial project setting.
* familiarity with core data engineering concepts, including etl/elt, relational data modeling, data quality testing, and pipeline orchestration.
* experience with git-based development practices and an understanding of code review, automated testing, and deployment workflows.
* ability to troubleshoot technical issues methodically, communicate clearly, and collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical partners.

**desired qualifications:**

* hands-on exposure to databricks, apache spark, or another distributed data-processing platform.
* experience with dbt or a similar transformation framework and an orchestration tool such as airflow, prefect, or dagster.
* familiarity with one major cloud platform and its data services: aws, azure, or gcp.
* exposure to streaming or event-driven technologies such as kafka, kinesis, spark structured streaming, or flink.
* familiarity with bi, data science, or machine learning workflows and the data products that support them.
* experience in aviation, transportation, logistics, or another operationally complex industry.

title: Sr. Software Engineer
description:
senior software engineer

  
  

**we are lennar**

lennar is one of the nation's leading homebuilders, dedicated to making an impact and creating an extraordinary experience for their homeowners, communities, and associates by building quality homes and providing exceptional customer service, giving back to the communities in which we work and live in, and fostering a culture of opportunity and growth for our associates throughout their career. lennar has been recognized as a fortune 500® company and consistently ranked among the top homebuilders in the united states.

  
  

**join a company that empowers you to build your future**

we are seeking an experienced senior software engineer to join our technology team. the ideal candidate will bring deep software engineering expertise, a strong understanding of system design and integration, and experience working with both in-house teams and outsourcing partners. as a senior software engineer, you will design, build, and maintain high-quality software that is scalable, secure, and easy to use, and you will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to deliver solutions that make a real difference for our homebuyers and associates. a career with purpose. a career built on making dreams come true. a career built on building zero defect homes, cost management, and adherence to schedules.

  
  

your responsibilities on the team

* **software development:** design, develop, and maintain applications, ensuring scalability, performance, and security. write clean, maintainable, and efficient code, following best practices and coding standards. build user-facing and back-end components using modern languages, frameworks, and apis. leverage ai tooling to supercharge productivity.
* **architecture and design:** contribute to the architecture and design of software systems, ensuring alignment with business goals and technical strategy. participate in technical design reviews, providing feedback and recommendations to improve system design and code quality.
* **testing and quality assurance:** develop and execute unit tests, integration tests, and automated tests to ensure software quality. identify and resolve defects and performance issues, conducting thorough code reviews to maintain high standards of code quality. work closely with qa teams to implement and improve testing strategies and processes.
* **collaboration and teamwork:** collaborate with product managers, designers, and other engineers to deliver high-quality features and enhancements. participate in agile ceremonies such as sprint planning, stand-ups, and retrospectives, contributing to the continuous improvement of the team's processes. communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, providing updates on progress and potential challenges. help troubleshoot and resolve incidents as needed.
* **mentorship and leadership:** mentor and guide junior engineers, sharing knowledge and best practices to help them grow in their roles. lead by example, demonstrating a strong work ethic, a commitment to quality, and a proactive approach to problem-solving. take ownership of features or projects, driving them from concept to completion with minimal supervision.
* **continuous improvement and innovation:** stay up to date with industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices, and bring new ideas to the team. identify opportunities for process improvements, refactoring, or technical enhancements to optimize the software development lifecycle. participate in technical discussions and contribute to the evolution of the team's technical direction.
  

  

requirements

* **education:** bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* **experience:** minimum 5-7 years in software engineering, with demonstrated experience designing, building, and shipping production software.
* **technical proficiency:** strong command of at least one modern programming language and its associated frameworks, along with solid understanding of web and api development, data structures, and software design principles.
* **agile mindset:** comfortable working in agile environments, adapting quickly to evolving requirements and priorities.
* **problem solving:** strong analytical skills with a detail-oriented mindset and a proactive approach to ownership and accountability.
* **communication:** excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams.
* **initiative & drive:** self-starter with a passion for technology, continuous learning, and driving projects forward with minimal supervision.
* **integrity & quality:** committed to delivering high-quality, secure, and maintainable software solutions with professionalism and accountability.
  

  

additional skills

experience in the following areas is a strong plus:

* **full-stack exposure:** hands-on experience across both front-end and back-end development, with a solid grasp of microservices architecture and api design.
* **cloud & infrastructure:** working knowledge of cloud platforms such as azure, aws, or gcp, and containerization tools like docker and kubernetes.
* **ci/cd & devops:** experience integrating applications into ci/cd pipelines using tools like azure devops (ado) and github actions, with a solid understanding of version control and automation.
* **architecture & databases:** deep understanding of restful apis and database design for both sql and nosql systems.
  

  

physical & office/site presence requirements

this is primarily a sedentary office position which requires the incumbent to have the ability to operate computer equipment, speak, hear, bend, stoop, reach, lift, and move and carry up to 25 lbs. finger dexterity is necessary.

at lennar, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching environment for our associates, offering a comprehensive array of benefits designed to enhance their well-being and professional growth. our associates have access to robust health insurance plans, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, ensuring their health needs are well taken care of. our 401(k) retirement plan, complete with a $1 for $1 company match up to 5%, helps secure their financial future, while paid parental leave and an associate assistance plan provide essential support during life's critical moments. to further support our associates, we provide an education assistance program and up to $30,000 in adoption assistance, underscoring our commitment to their diverse needs and aspirations. from the moment of hire, they can enjoy up to three weeks of vacation annually, alongside generous holiday, sick leave, and personal day policies. additionally, we offer a new hire referral bonus program, significant home purchase discounts, and unique opportunities such as the everyone’s included day. at lennar, we believe in investing in our associates, empowering them to thrive both personally and professionally. lennar associates will have access to these benefits as outlined by lennar’s policies and applicable plan terms. visit lennartotalrewards.com to view our suite of benefits.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
**who we are**

digicert is a global leader in intelligent trust. we protect the digital world by ensuring the security, privacy, and authenticity of every interaction. our ai-powered digicert one platform unifies pki, dns, and certificate lifecycle management, to secure infrastructure, software, devices, messages, ai content and agents. learn why more than 100,000 organizations, including 90% of the fortune 500, choose digicert to stop today's threats and prepare for a quantum-safe future at www.digicert.com

**job summary**

**this position is for the ssl store, powered by digicert**

we are hiring a senior software engineer to build and run the platform behind our certificate management, tls and vulnerability monitoring, uptime, and security products. the platform is a typescript monorepo: fastify and express services, next.js and react frontends, mysql and redis, queues and workers on aws, deployed to kubernetes through terraform, helm, and azure devops pipelines. it also carries a legacy .net estate that we are steadily retiring, and a growing set of ai-assisted features and internal tooling.

you will own features end to end, from schema and api through ui, pipeline, and production. we work in a small team with a lot of surface area, so the job rewards engineers who pick up whatever the problem needs, whether that is a new framework, a scanner's quirks, or a cloud primitive they have not touched before

  

**what you will do**

* design, build, and ship features across the full stack: fastify or express apis, next.js and react frontends, mysql schemas and migrations, sqs-driven workers, and the infrastructure that runs them.
* own services in production: observability with sentry and grafana, on-call participation, incident root-causing, and the follow-through fixes.
* build and evolve security and monitoring products that scan, probe, and score real customer infrastructure at scale, with correctness and performance budgets that matter.
* maintain and incrementally retire legacy .net and python components, moving behavior into the typescript platform with parity verified rather than assumed.
* extend ci/cd and infrastructure: azure devops pipelines, docker images, helm charts, and terraform for eks, rds, sqs, and related aws services.
* integrate third-party and partner apis (certificate authorities, scanners, identity providers) and keep those integrations resilient.
* use ai-assisted development tools as part of daily work, and build ai-backed features where they genuinely improve the product.
* review code, write tests, and raise the bar on standards that apply to human and ai-generated code alike.
* mentor other engineers and write up decisions so others can act on them without you in the room.

  

**what you will have**

* 6+ years building and operating production web services and the frontends on top of them.
* strong typescript and node.js, including a modern api framework (fastify preferred, express acceptable) and a react framework (next.js preferred).
* production experience in more than one language or ecosystem, and at least one stack change you drove or adapted to in the last few years. depth in a single language is not enough for this role.
* solid relational database skills on mysql or postgres: schema design, migrations, indexing, query performance, and transaction and locking behavior.
* comfort owning what you ship: logging, metrics, alerting, and calm, evidence-led debugging in production.
* security awareness as a habit: authentication and authorization flows, secrets handling, input validation, and dependency hygiene.
* clear written communication. you can explain a design, a trade-off, or an incident to engineers and non-engineers.

  

**nice to have**

* hands-on aws (compute, queues, storage, secrets) and the ability to read and change terraform.
* containers and kubernetes at a working level: writing a dockerfile, reading a helm chart, debugging a failing pod.
* ci/cd pipeline work in azure devops or similar, plus cloudflare or aws waf experience.
* grafana, sentry, or equivalent observability tooling beyond basic dashboards.
* experience with pki, tls, or certificate lifecycle management, or with monitoring and scanning products (uptime, vulnerability, dns or email security).
* oauth 2.0 and openid connect implementation experience, especially multi-tenant identity providers.
* c# and .net, enough to read, maintain, and migrate legacy services without making them your home.
* python for data pipelines, scanners, or tooling.
* large-scale scanning or crawling systems: fleets of workers, rate limits, timeouts, and the cost math behind them.
* building with llm apis, mcp servers, or agentic workflows in a product context.

  

**benefits**

* competitive compensation and comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage
* retirement savings programs with company matching (401(k) or rrsp)
* generous paid time off, including holidays, and vacation
* paid parental leave and family support benefits
* life and disability coverage
* flexible spending and health savings options (where applicable)
* health and wellness support, including gym reimbursement and wellness programs
* employee assistance program with 24/7confidential support for employees and families
* education assistance and professional development opportunities
* access to linkedin learning and continuous learning resources
* employee referral bonus program and additional company perks and discounts
* internal rewards and recognition platform (motivosity) to celebrate and acknowledge project wins, milestone achievements, and the outstanding contributions of our colleagues
* business travel insurance and global employee support programs

the la county board of supervisors recently declared a local state of emergency for homelessness, and the county is working to revise and expand our response to help all who are affected. we are looking for qualified and passionate individuals to help us in the mission of addressing issues like housing, mental health, and substance use. if you are looking for a new career that will directly benefit the population of la county, this may be the opportunity for you.

---------------------------

* assists department stakeholders to define data needs and requirements to ensure data science projects meet business needs at the community, regional, divisional, departmental, or county-wide level.
* collaborates with other department subject matter experts to understand, identify, and select available and relevant sources of data for use cases, including internal and external data sources.
