title: Sr. Solutions Engineer
description:
overview:

**advance your career. advance the world.**

at amd, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. from advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering ai and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at amd is shaping the future.

whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling ai breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at amd contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.

responsibilities:

**the role:**

amd's software and solutions team is seeking a **solution engineering technical leader** to accelerate the integration and adoption of amd technology across the open software ecosystem. this role will define and deliver production-oriented solutions that connect amd cpus, gpus, dpus, networking, memory, and software platforms with the operating systems, databases, runtimes, apis, developer frameworks, and cloud-native services customers use to build and operate modern infrastructure.

the role will bridge amd architecture and the broader open ecosystem by creating reference architectures, upstream integrations, reusable software components, validated deployment patterns, and early customer proof-of-concepts. primary focus areas include linux and other operating-system kernels, runtime and system services, database and data-platform enablement, api layers, model context protocol (mcp) integrations, container and orchestration environments, observability, security, and performance engineering.

working across amd + amd (a+a) and amd + nvidia (a+n) environments and leveraging **rocm™, amd zen software studio, amd enterprise ai,** open-source projects, industry standards, and upstream communities, this leader will make amd platforms easier to adopt, integrate, operate, and optimize. ai is one supported workload domain—particularly inference, retrieval, developer tooling, and data-intensive services—but the role is fundamentally centered on open systems integration and solution engineering.

as a recognized technical authority, this individual will collaborate with silicon architecture, product engineering, software organizations, customers, hyperscalers, isvs, standards bodies, and open-source communities. the role will influence amd hardware and software roadmaps through implementation evidence, workload analysis, ecosystem gaps, customer requirements, and measurable improvements in compatibility, performance, scalability, security, manageability, and developer experience.

this is a highly technical, hands-on individual contributor role focused on architecture, integration, implementation, performance engineering, and ecosystem leadership. it is not a people management, program management, or alliance management position.

**the person:**

a deeply technical solution engineer and systems architect with broad expertise across operating systems, kernel and driver interfaces, runtime services, databases, distributed systems, apis, cloud-native infrastructure, heterogeneous computing, networking, storage, virtualization, security, and performance engineering. this individual has a record of turning platform capabilities into integrated, supportable solutions that customers and open-source communities can deploy at scale.

the ideal candidate understands how applications move through api, middleware, runtime, kernel, driver, firmware, and hardware layers, and how data moves across transactional databases, analytical platforms, caches, object stores, and retrieval systems. they can diagnose integration barriers, contribute production-quality code, shape stable interfaces, and optimize end-to-end behavior across amd and third-party components. familiarity with practical ai infrastructure, model serving, vector search, and mcp-enabled tools is valuable where these technologies intersect with broader platform solutions.

this individual thrives in customer-facing and community-facing environments where long-term technical direction must be grounded in working code, benchmarks, upstream collaboration, and repeatable deployment outcomes. they lead through technical excellence and influence while partnering across engineering organizations and engaging directly with strategic customers, cloud providers, oems, isvs, database vendors, operating-system communities, and standards organizations.

**key responsibilities:**

* define and execute amd's solution engineering strategy for integrating amd hardware and software into open-source, commercial, enterprise, cloud, and edge ecosystems, creating end-to-end reference architectures, reusable components, integration guides, validated configurations, and customer proof-of-concepts spanning amd cpus, gpus, dpus, networking, memory, storage, and accelerators.
* drive enablement and upstream collaboration across linux kernels, device drivers, firmware interfaces, system libraries, package ecosystems, container runtimes, kubernetes, schedulers, service meshes, and observability platforms, and optimize runtime services—including language runtimes, compilers, libraries, inference and data-processing frameworks, communication stacks, and background system services—for amd architectures.
* integrate and optimize relational, nosql, analytical, vector, graph, and distributed database platforms on amd systems, addressing query execution, concurrency, memory hierarchy, storage i/o, networking, resiliency, and scale-out performance.
* design stable, secure, high-performance apis and sdk integration patterns that expose amd platform capabilities while simplifying application portability and developer adoption, and develop mcp servers, connectors, and reference patterns where mcp provides a practical interface between developer tools, enterprise data, platform services, and selected ai-assisted workflows.
* support both **amd + amd (a+a) and amd + nvidia (a+n)** deployment models, improving interoperability, workload portability, operational consistency, and customer choice.
* apply rigorous profiling, benchmarking, tracing, and systems analysis to improve latency, throughput, scalability, availability, energy efficiency, total cost of ownership, and quality of service.
* build security into solution architectures through confidential computing, trusted execution, attestation, identity, secure boot, software supply-chain controls, cryptography, data protection, governance, and auditability.
* enable practical ai workloads where relevant, including model serving, retrieval, vector search, data pipelines, and developer productivity, without making ai the sole focus of the platform solution.
* partner directly with strategic customers, hyperscalers, oems, isvs, database and platform vendors, and open-source maintainers to resolve integration barriers and validate production readiness, translating implementation findings and ecosystem requirements into actionable feedback for amd silicon, firmware, compiler, operating-system, runtime, library, and product roadmaps.
* represent amd through technical publications, conferences, standards bodies, upstream contributions, architecture reviews, and executive customer engagements, and mentor senior engineers and architects in systems integration, open-source engagement, performance engineering, and production solution design.

**preferred experience:**

* extensive experience delivering systems software, platform integration, solution architecture, or customer engineering for large-scale enterprise, cloud, data-center, or edge environments, with deep expertise in heterogeneous computing across cpus, gpus, dpus, networking, storage, memory subsystems, virtualization, and cloud infrastructure.
* strong knowledge of linux kernel architecture, drivers, system calls, memory management, i/o, networking stacks, security mechanisms, performance tooling, and upstream development practices, plus hands-on experience with runtime services, compilers, language runtimes, system libraries, containers, kubernetes, distributed schedulers, observability, ci/cd, and software supply chains.
* strong database and data-platform expertise spanning relational, nosql, analytical, vector, graph, caching, messaging, and distributed storage technologies, including performance and scale-out optimization.
* experience designing and integrating rest, grpc, event-driven, and systems-level apis, with attention to compatibility, security, observability, versioning, and developer experience, along with working knowledge of model context protocol (mcp), including server, client, tool, resource, authentication, and enterprise integration patterns.
* strong programming skills in c, c++, python, go, rust, or comparable systems languages, with comfort in performance-critical paths, profiling, debugging, and production-quality open-source development.
* experience with **rocm™, amd zen software studio, amd enterprise ai**, or comparable accelerator, compiler, runtime, and developer-tool ecosystems is desirable; practical familiarity with ai infrastructure, model serving, retrieval-augmented applications, vector databases, and inference performance is beneficial, but broad systems integration depth is more important than specialization in ai.
* demonstrated technical leadership with customers, hyperscalers, oems, isvs, standards groups, and open-source communities, supported by shipped solutions, upstream contributions, patents, publications, or conference presentations.

**academic credentials:**

* master's degree in computer science, computer engineering, electrical engineering, software engineering, or a related technical discipline; equivalent advanced industry experience may be considered.

**alternate location:**

* santa clara ca

**this role is not eligible for visa sponsorship.**

$175,000 - $210,000 + bonus

our fast-paced and collaborative environment inspires us to create, think, and challenge each other in ways that make our solutions and our teams better. whether you’re interested in engineering or development, marketing or sales, or something else – if this sounds like you, then we’d love to hear from you!

we are headquartered in denver, colorado, with offices in the us, canada, and india.

**$175,000 + $210,000 + bonus**

the insurance industry runs on vertafore. we equip agencies, mgas, and carriers with the core digital systems, specialized ai, and data-driven foundation to eliminate distribution drag across the insurance lifecycle, spanning sales, servicing, and back-office operations.

underpinned by unmatched speed and performance power, we are the trusted backbone that’s taking the insurance industry from friction to flow with distribution velocity – speed, performance, and trust - to drive growth at scale.

with over 95% of the top agencies and insurers and 50% of industry compliance transactions running through vertafore, we lead at the intersection of innovation and trust, giving insurance professionals the confidence to transform and win in the ai era.

our reach is global, with headquarters in denver, colorado, and offices across the u.s., canada, and india.

**about the role**

as a **senior ai engineer**, you will design, build, and operate the ai systems behind vertafore’s next generation of products for agencies, mgas, and carriers. you will build production-grade agents that can reason through complex, multi-step insurance workflows, and you will be responsible for making those systems reliable, measurable, and safe in a highly regulated industry.

you will work in small pods with complete agency to build end to end products. this role is hands-on. you’ll be expected to directly contribute to the successful implementation and launch of critical features and empowered to make the decisions needed to get there. vertafore designs these pods as end to end development teams so fluidity going up and down the stack is expected.

we are looking for an engineer who is strong in software and systems engineering, understands machine learning well, and has a habit of shipping. you use the latest agentic coding tools to work faster, and you hold yourself fully accountable for the quality, security, and correctness of what you ship.

**core requirements and responsibilities:**

**essential job functions included but are not limited to the following:**

* design, build, and deploy complex reasoning agents and multi-agent systems for production workloads using langgraph and related python orchestration frameworks

* architect agent workflows, including state management, tool use, memory, planning, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, error recovery, and fallback behavior

* design and build clean, well-documented, versioned apis that expose ai capabilities to vertafore products and to external partners

* define and own evaluation strategy for ai systems. this includes building eval datasets, writing graders (programmatic, model-based, and human review), running offline and online evaluations, and turning results into concrete improvements

* set up regression testing for prompts, models, and agent behavior so that changes ship with measurable confidence

* instrument ai systems for observability, including tracing, latency, cost, token usage, failure modes, and quality metrics in production

* build retrieval and context pipelines (rag, document processing, structured extraction) over insurance data such as policies, submissions, and compliance documents

* troubleshoot and resolve production issues across the ai stack, from model behavior to infrastructure

**knowledge, skills and abilities:**

* expert-level python, including writing idiomatic, typed, tested, production-quality code and using async programming

* solid understanding of ml fundamentals, including model training and generalization, overfitting, bias and variance, embeddings, classification and ranking metrics, and statistical significance

* deep understanding of how large language models behave in practice, including failure modes, non-determinism, context limits, and strategies for reliable outputs

* rigorous, experimental mindset; you form hypotheses, measure, and let data drive decisions rather than intuition about model output

**basic qualifications:**

* bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, physics, mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

* 7+ years of professional software engineering experience, with significant time building backend services and systems in python

* 2+ years building and shipping llm-powered applications or agentic systems to production

* hands-on production experience with langgraph (or comparable agent orchestration frameworks such as langchain, llamaindex, or custom orchestration)

* 5+ years designing and building restful apis (experience with fastapi or similar frameworks preferred)

* demonstrated experience designing and running evaluations for ml or llm systems, and using results to drive measurable quality improvements

* experience with cloud platforms (aws preferred), docker, and ci/cd pipelines

**preferred qualifications:**

* experience with llm observability and evaluation tooling (such as langsmith, langfuse, braintrust, or similar)

* experience with fine-tuning, embedding model selection, or classical ml pipelines

* experience in insurance, financial services, healthcare, or another regulated industry

* experience with model context protocol (mcp) or building tool integrations for agents

* open-source contributions or public writing on ai engineering

title: SW Engineer
description:
**about us**  
visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

at visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

join visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. progress starts with you.

**job description**

the sw engineer is responsible for conducting, planning, or overseeing one or more aspects of the analysis, design, programming, debugging, and modification of computer programs for commercial or end user applications. this role involves writing code, completing programming tasks, and performing testing and debugging of applications. the sw engineer also completes documentation and procedures for installation and maintenance, and may interface with users to define system requirements and/or necessary modifications or develop cost estimates, budgets, and schedules.  
  
all roles require digital fluency, including the ability to work with emerging technologies such as generative ai tools (e.g. chatgpt, microsoft copilot) to support everyday work.  
  
**what you'll do**

* conduct analysis, design, programming, debugging, and modification of computer programs for commercial or end user applications.
* write code, complete programming tasks, and perform testing and debugging of applications.
* complete documentation and procedures for installation and maintenance.
* interface with users to define system requirements and/or necessary modifications.
* develop cost estimates, budgets, and schedules as needed.

this is a hybrid position. visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your hiring manager.

**qualifications**

**basic qualifications**

* be based in austin, tx or the greater austin metropolitan area
* bachelor's degree, or 3+ years of relevant work experience
* programming languages: strong proficiency in java / python including async/await patterns, type hints (pydantic v2), and high-performance serialization (orjson).
* ai/ml frameworks: hands-on experience with langchain, rag architectures, llm api integration, prompt engineering, and agentic ai patterns. familiarity with intent classification and nlp pipelines.

**preferred qualifications**

* experience with fastapi for building production apis.
* experience in analysis, design, and programming of computer applications.
* experience in debugging and modifying software programs.
* experience in writing and maintaining technical documentation.
* experience in performing software testing and troubleshooting.
* experience in collaborating with users or stakeholders to gather requirements.
* experience in developing or supporting installation and maintenance procedures.
* protocols & integration: experience with model context protocol (mcp) json-rpc 2.0, rest apis, server-sent events (sse), and mtls. understanding of agent-to-agent communication patterns.
* api development: ability to design and implement robust apis using fastapi, including request validation (pydantic), authentication (oauth2, api key, mtls), and streaming responses.

title: Senior Software Engineer - HMI & AI Systems
description:
fairmount technologies (ft) is a growing advanced manufacturing company developing **tooling-free cnc systems** for aerospace and defense applications. our mission is to integrate real-time automation directly onto the factory floor, ensuring unprecedented precision, safety, and efficiency in aerospace component production.

**recent milestone:** ft was selected for a u.s. department of defense **apfit award**, supporting deployment of our systems across multiple air force maintenance depots. as we scale production and system capability, we’re expanding our software team.

we are seeking a versatile **senior software engineer** to bridge the gap between robust industrial hardware and advanced artificial intelligence.

**position overview**

in this role, you will build and modernize **human-machine interface (hmi)** desktop applications that control and monitor complex cnc machining systems. you will use **c#** to drive high-performance, real-time desktop uis and **python** to deploy predictive machine learning models at the edge. this role is critical to transforming raw machine telemetry into actionable, intelligent automation on the shop floor.

**core responsibilities**

* **next-gen hmi development:** design, scale, and optimize high-performance desktop interfaces that connect operator control systems directly with cnc machinery.
* **ui modernization:** maintain and enhance legacy **winforms** developed on **wpf** applications, while actively pioneering migrations to modern, fluent architectures like **wpf** or **winui** and cross-platform ecosystems like **avalonia**.
* **edge machine learning integration:** deploy, test, train, and optimize pytorch and **tensorflow** models inside production environments to handle anomalies, predict tool wear, and automate vision-based quality control in addition to predicting part deviations.
* **hybrid data architecture:** build and manage data layers that combine structured configuration/part logs with scalable nosql (**mongodb**) for high-frequency time-series sensor data.
* **hardware-software synthesis:** collaborate with mechanical, electrical, and automation engineers to ingest cnc controller data seamlessly into your application workflows.

**technical requirements**

**desktop & hmi frameworks (c#)**

* **advanced wpf :** deep expertise in windows desktop environments, including mvvm architecture, multithreading, custom control rendering, and memory management.
* **winui & avalonia:** hands-on experience or strong working knowledge of building fluid windows 11 apps and cross-platform desktop interfaces (windows/ ui deployment).

**machine learning & intelligence (python)**

* **pytorch & tensorflow:** practical experience deploying and inferencing machine and deep learning models in real-world environments.
* **python engineering:** mastery of python for analytics pipelines, sensor data preprocessing, and scripting to communicate with c# backends.

**databases & telemetry**

* **sql:** strong proficiency in relational database schema design, indexing, and complex queries (e.g., sql server, postgresql).
* **mongodb:** solid understanding of nosql concepts for managing semi-structured telemetry, time-series data, and machine logs.

**qualifications & preferred skills**

* **experience:** 5+ years of software engineering experience, with a heavy emphasis on desktop engineering and heavy data/ai application integration.
* **domain knowledge:** previous experience with manufacturing execution systems (mes), cnc controllers (beckhoff preferred or similar systems like fanuc, siemens), or aviation/aerospace safety standards is a massive plus.
* **education:** bachelor’s degree in computer science, aerospace engineering, robotics, or a related field.
* **mindset:** a strict commitment to software reliability, code safety, and high-precision execution required for manufacturing environments.

**regulatory & location requirements**

* **export control compliance:** this position requires access to **itar/ear-controlled technologies**. applicants must be u.s. citizens or lawful permanent residents (green card holders) and eligible for employment under u.s. export control laws.
* **location:** **relocation to the wichita / derby, ks area is required**. this role involves working closely with physical cnc hardware and aerospace manufacturing environments on the shop floor.

**compensation & benefits**

* **competitive salary based on experience and scope of role**
* *(typical range: $80,000–$140,000+)*
* **flexible working hours** to support your optimal work-life schedule.
* **pto** to ensure dynamic work-life balance.
* optional **health, dental and vision insurance**
* **profit sharing**, so you benefit directly from the company’s success
* direct access to leadership and technical decision-making
* a chance to grow with the company as our manufacturing footprint scales

title: Senior Data Scientist - Flex Pay
description:
**about the role:**

we are seeking a highly analytical and results-driven data scientist to join our buy now pay later (bnpl) sector called flex pay. you will play a key role in building predictive risk models, optimizing offers and pricing, and extracting insights that drive product development, risk mitigation, and customer strategy. this role requires a strong foundation in statistics, machine learning, and programming.

  

***while this position is ideally based in our san francisco office on a hybrid basis, we are also open to considering remote candidates.***

  

**what you'll do**:

  

* build and maintain credit and fraud policy simulators used to ensure properly functioning systems and identify risk decisioning enhancements.
* build and deploy statistical models and machine learning algorithms to solve business problems in areas like credit risk, fraud detection, pricing, customer segmentation, and marketing attribution.
* validate models to identify factors that may affect model performance.
* analyze large, structured and unstructured datasets using sql, python or similar tools.
* stay up to date with the latest trends and technologies in data science and fintech, actively research new tools and techniques available for model development.
* collaborate with cross-functional teams including risk, marketing, product, and engineering to define data-driven strategies.

  

**what we look for**:

  

* advanced degree (ms/phd) in data science, statistics, mathematics, computer science, finance, or a related quantitative discipline.
* 3-5+ years of hands-on experience in a data science or analytics role, preferably in financial services.
* experience and/or strong interest in machine learning techniques (random forest, gradient boosted trees, etc.) strongly preferred.
* strong proficiency in python (pandas, numpy, scikit-learn) and sql.
* ability to write documentation and present analysis to people with different levels of expertise (e.g., technical staff, business leads, etc.).
* proactive, driven, and ability to work in a fast paced environment.

  

**nice to have**:

  

* experience with data visualization tools (e.g., tableau, power bi).
* experience with ai tools such as claude
* experience with data technologies like pyspark.
* understanding of financial services concepts such as credit scoring, portfolio risk, or customer lifetime value.

  

**what we offer you**:

  

* competitive salary and stock option plan
* paid coverage of medical, dental and vision insurance
* competitive 401(k) and rrsp program
* flexible pto
* opportunities for professional growth and development
* paid parental leave
* health & wellness initiatives

  

*the compensation range of this position in san francisco, ca is usd $100,000-$150,000 annually plus equity and benefits. within this range, an individual's base pay will be dependent on a variety of factors, including without limitation, job-related knowledge, skills, education, and experience.*

for more than 170 years, the hanover has been committed to delivering on our promises and being there when it matters the most. we live our values every day, demonstrating we care through our values, sustainability initiatives and inclusive corporate culture.

our technology team is currently seeking a **senior data engineer** to join our growing team in our worcester ma office, or via a remote work arrangement.

this is a full-time, exempt position.

**position overview:**

the senior data engineer will lead a team of developers (internal and vendor resources) for the end-to-end design, development, implementation, and optimization of our enterprise data integration and warehousing solutions. in this role, you will build and maintain robust etl (extract, transform, load) pipelines, bridge source systems with target analytics platforms, and establish scalable data models.

you will work closely with external vendors for supporting data operations, data architects, business analysts, and reporting teams to translate complex business requirements into high-performing technical solutions across oracle, sql server, db2, and data lake environments. you will collaborate with business partners to define work priorities and assume a data/tech lead role on cross-functional teams delivering data/reporting solutions.

**in this role, you will:**

* work with external vendors teams for supporting data operations.
* proven expertise in designing, implementing, and testing complex data mappings and transformations using informatica powercenter.
* strong background in data integration, etl processes, and data warehousing architectures, with hands-on experience optimizing ingestion pipelines for scale, performance, reliability, and cost-efficiency.
* advanced proficiency in sql along with deep technical experience in oracle, sql server, and db2 databases—specifically focusing on performance tuning, partitioning, pushdown optimization (pdo), and stored procedures.
* strong background in linux scripting and enterprise job scheduling software.
* familiarity with diverse integration connectors including apis, files, sftp/ftps, streaming data, database connectors, soap, and rest.
* experience in data governance & architecture with functional knowledge of data modeling, data governance frameworks, and metadata management strategies.
* ability to enforce and implement data quality, data security protocols, and strict industry compliance standards.
* operations & troubleshooting skills for large data sets, debugging technical issues, and continuously monitoring and maintaining active data pipelines.
* team leadership skills for professional communication, mentoring, coaching, and guide junior development team members.
* exceptional organizational skills to document data processes, workflows, and complete technical etl solutions.

**what you need to apply:**

* bachelor’s degree or higher in computer science, information systems, business information technology, or an equivalent field.
* 5+ years of professional, hands-on experience in data engineering, data architecture, or data integration.
* must be eligible to work in the united states without requiring sponsorship now or in the future (i.e., us citizen or green card holder).

**bonus points for:**

* experience working within agile development methodologies and modern devops environments.
* hands-on experience using git/github for version control and ci/cd pipelines.
* familiarity with bi reporting tools like power bi, obiee, hyperion essbase
* master’s degree in information systems, business information technology, or an equivalent field.

**career development:**

it’s not just a job, it’s a career, and we are here to support you every step of the way. we want you to be successful and fulfilled. through on-the-job experiences, personalized coaching and our robust learning and development programs, we encourage you – at every level – to grow and develop.

  

**benefits:**

we offer comprehensive benefits to help you be healthy, build financial security, and balance work and home life. at the hanover, you’ll enjoy what you do and have the support you need to succeed.

  

benefits include:

* medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance

title: Software Engineer, ML Infrastructure, ML Platform Level 5
description:
snap inc is a technology company. we believe the camera presents the greatest opportunity to improve the way people live and communicate. snap contributes to human progress by empowering people to express themselves, live in the moment, learn about the world, and have fun together.

  
  

the company operates snapchat , a visual messaging app that enhances your relationships with friends, family, and the world, and specs inc. , a wholly-owned subsidiary dedicated to making computing more human, in addition to bitmoji , saturn, and other digital services.

  
  

snap engineering teams build fun and technically sophisticated products that reach hundreds of millions of snapchatters around the world, every day. we’re deeply committed to the well-being of everyone in our global community, which is why our values are at the root of everything we do. we move fast, with precision, and always execute with privacy at the forefront.

  

we’re looking for a software engineer to join the **ml platform experience team** , part of the core ml platform organization. we are an ai native team which builds the agentic user experience for building, managing, and operating foundational models at snapchat. we utilize python as the primary language with java/go as supporting languages, we build agents on adk, langfuse, and frontier llm models, and are responsible for many other foundational technology such as model lineage, model orchestration, model data quality, and more.

  

what you’ll do:

* design and optimize infrastructure systems for machine learning workloads at scale and drive reliability and efficiency improvements across snapchat’s ml infrastructure
* build and enhance feature generation and serving pipelines that power online inferencing and offline training data generation
* develop high-performance inference systems to ensure fast and efficient ai model serving
* build infrastructure to perform scalable ml model training, evaluation, and inference in the cloud
* develop high-performance inference systems to ensure fast and efficient ai model serving
* build comprehensive data management systems for scalable data collection, labeling, processing, and evaluation
* work closely with ml engineers to deploy cutting-edge models into production
utilize ai tools and high velocity engineering workflows to design and ship scalable services while upholding rigorous standards for code correctness, security, and production ready quality code  

  

knowledge, skills & abilities:

* strong programming skills in python, java
* strong problem-solving skills with a focus on system performance, scalability, and efficiency
* good understanding of distributed systems and the infrastructure components of large-scale ml
* experience with big data processing frameworks such as spark, flink, or ray
* ability to collaborate and work well with others
* proven track record of operating highly-available systems at significant scale
* ability to proactively learn new concepts and apply them at work
adaptability in learning and applying evolving ai systems and tools to remain at the forefront of engineering trends and modern development practices  

  

minimum qualifications:

* bachelor’s degree in a technical field such as computer science or equivalent experience
* 6+ years of post-bachelor’s software development experience; or master’s degree in a technical field + 5+ year of post-grad software development experience; or phd in a relevant technical field + 2+ years of post-grad software development experience
experience building large scale production machine learning systems, distributed systems or big data processing  

  

preferred qualifications:

* masters/phd in a technical field such as computer science or equivalent industry experience
* experience working with ml training platforms or optimizing ai model inference
* familiarity with ml frameworks such as tensorflow, pytorch, caffe2, spark ml, scikit-learn, or related frameworks

"default together" policy at snap: at snap inc. we believe that being together in person helps us build our culture faster, reinforce our values, and serve our community, customers and partners better through dynamic collaboration. to reflect this, we practice a “default together” approach and expect our team members to work in an office 4+ days per week.

  
  

at snap, we believe that having a team of diverse backgrounds and voices working together will enable us to create innovative products that improve the way people live and communicate. snap is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and committed to providing employment opportunities regardless of race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, pregnancy, childbirth and breastfeeding, age, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other protected classification, in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. eoe, including disability/vets.

  
  

we are an equal opportunity employer and will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable law (by example, the requirements of the san francisco fair chance ordinance and the los angeles fair chance initiative for hiring, where applicable).

  
  

our benefits : snap inc. is its own community, so we’ve got your back! we do our best to make sure you and your loved ones have everything you need to be happy and healthy, on your own terms. our benefits are built around your needs and include paid parental leave, comprehensive medical coverage, emotional and mental health support programs, and compensation packages that let you share in snap’s long-term success!

title: Data Scientist
description:
**career area:**

technology, digital and data

**job description:**

**your work shapes the world at caterpillar inc.**

when you join caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. we are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. we don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

**role summary**
  
as a data scientist, you will play a key role in building the next evolution of analytics at caterpillar. you will work with internal customers to understand complex, nuanced problems and partner with product service engineers, dealers, and other product group engineers to design data products to answer their questions. this role sits in the medium wheel loader product support organization and will work cross-functionally to support decision makers across all of the global product support teams.

**what you will do (job duties)**

* lead large-scale data collection, mining, processing, and modeling. apply natural language processing, text analytics, and machine learning to expand semantic data capabilities.
* define analysis requirements and scope, then present actionable insights to leaders through clear data visualizations.
* research and optimize data models and algorithms to improve analytical accuracy and effectiveness.
collaborate with engineers to translate data insights into actionable requirements that support equipment operation and the development of systems integrated with machine hardware.  

  
  
  

**what you will have (core skills)**

**business data analysis:** skilled in using sql, dashboards (tableau, power bi), python, microsoft excel, powerpoint, snowflake or cloud data services. experience with data analytics techniques, automation, data science, ai to drive business kpi results.
  
**accuracy and attention to detail:** demonstrates working knowledge of review methods and quality controls to process detailed information accurately, verify outputs, assess errors or omissions, and prevent recurrence.

**effective communications:** excellent oral and written communication skills. demonstrated ability to effectively communicate and collaborate with internal and external business partners including senior leaders. excellent human relations skills to develop a collaborative environment with leadership and key stakeholders.
  
**analytical thinking:** applies working knowledge of structured analysis to define business problems, identify key factors and stakeholders, evaluate patterns and trends, and recommend effective solutions using sound judgment.

**requirements analysis:** applies working knowledge of established methods to partner with customers and users, define and confirm requirements, and produce clear business and system documentation using appropriate tools and standards.

  
  

**top candidates will have**

* experience working with mechanical systems or large construction equipment.
* proven ability to translate complex datasets and analytical findings into clear, actionable instructions and documentation.
* experience transforming large, complex datasets into actionable business insights.
    
  strength in statistical analysis, data mining, processing, and modeling.
* experience applying machine learning, natural language processing, or text analytics to business challenges.
* ability to define analytical requirements and communicate clear recommendations through compelling data visualizations.
* proficiency with programming languages, query tools, databases, and data warehouses.
* a track record of improving data models and algorithms to increase analytical accuracy and business value.
* strong attention to detail, analytical judgment, and the ability to partner with customers and users to translate requirements into effective solutions.

title: RFIC Layout & Design Automation
description:
overview:

keysight is at the forefront of technology innovation, delivering breakthroughs and trusted insights in electronic design, simulation, prototyping, test, manufacturing, and optimization. our ~15,000 employees create world-class solutions in communications, 5g, automotive, energy, quantum, aerospace, defense, and semiconductor markets for customers in over 100 countries. learn more about what we do.

our award-winning culture embraces a bold vision of where technology can take us and a passion for tackling challenging problems with industry-first solutions. we believe that when people feel a sense of belonging, they can be more creative, innovative, and thrive at all points in their careers.

we are seeking a highly skilled r&d engineer to develop next-generation layout and design automation technologies for rfic, analog, and microwave applications. the role is primarily focused on rfic layout, parameterized layout generation, and layout automation, complemented by python-based automation, simulation-driven optimization, and machine learning.

responsibilities:

* develop rfic, analog, and microwave layouts, including parameterized and reusable layout structures.
* develop automated parameterized layout generation capabilities that translate circuit and design parameters into design-rule-compliant physical layouts.
* design and implement layout automation including geometry generation, placement, routing, symmetry, design-rule constraints, and em-aware design.
* integrate layout generation with circuit and em simulation to support parameter exploration, design-space analysis, and optimization.
* develop python-based tools and scalable software for automated layout and design workflows.
* apply optimization and machine learning techniques, including surrogate modeling and bayesian optimization, to accelerate design exploration and convergence.
* collaborate with rfic designers and software engineers to deliver production-quality design automation capabilities.

qualifications:

* ms or phd in electrical engineering, computer engineering, computer science, eda/cad, or a related discipline.
* strong hands-on experience in rfic, analog, microwave, or mixed-signal layout and design.
* experience with rfic passive and active components such as inductors, transformers, transmission lines, filters, matching networks, mixers, and power amplifiers.
* deep hands-on experience in parameterized layout generation and pcell development, including automated generation of design-rule-compliant layouts from circuit and design parameters.
* strong understanding of semiconductor layout methodologies, design rules, physical verification, parasitics, and em-aware design practices.
* strong programming experience in python; c++ experience is a plus.
* experience with circuit and/or em simulation, design optimization, and semiconductor design automation tools.
* strong problem-solving and software development skills with the ability to translate complex design workflows into scalable automation solutions.

**preferred qualifications**

* experience with machine learning frameworks such as pytorch, tensorflow, or scikit-learn.
* knowledge of surrogate modeling, design-space exploration, bayesian optimization, or other optimization techniques.
* familiarity with ads, cadence virtuoso, em simulation tools, or similar eda platforms.
* experience applying machine learning or intelligent optimization to semiconductor design workflows.
* experience working in agile software development environments.

the level of role will be based on applicable experience, education and skills; most offers will be between the minimum and the midpoint of the salary range listed below.

### **company description**

it started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at **intuitive**. as a global leader in **robotic-assisted surgery** and **minimally invasive care**, our technologies—like the **da vinci surgical system** and **ion**—have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide.

we’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world.

the problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. the work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life.

if you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help **transform the future of healthcare**, you’ll find your purpose here.

### **job description**

**primary function of position**

the **finance ai analyt** will design and deploy ai/ml-driven analytics solutions within the finance franchise of enterprise analytics. this role combines deep data engineering skills with hands-on experience in ai/ml techniques applied to financial data, translating business requirements into intelligent, automated insights.

**roles and responsibilities**

* design, build, and maintain ai/ml models and pipelines that support finance analytics use cases (forecasting, anomaly detection, classification, nlp on financial documents).
* develop and optimize data models in snowflake, leveraging cortex or equivalent tool ai functions.
* debug and troubleshoot complex data models across the enterprise data warehouse (edw) stack — trace data lineage, validate transformations, and resolve discrepancies at the model layer.
* partner with finance stakeholders to identify high-impact ai opportunities and translate them into production-grade solutions.
* evaluate and integrate emerging ai tools (llms, generative ai, vector search) into the analytics ecosystem.
* establish best practices for model monitoring, versioning, and governance.

* 2+ years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or applied ai/ml roles.

* ability to debug end-to-end data flows in a data warehouse environment — identify breakpoints in staging, transformation, and presentation layers.
* familiarity with finance data domains (gl, ap, ar, fixed assets, cost accounting) or sap finance.

title: Senior Data Scientist - Flex Pay
description:
**about the role:**

we are seeking a highly analytical and results-driven data scientist to join our buy now pay later (bnpl) sector called flex pay. you will play a key role in building predictive risk models, optimizing offers and pricing, and extracting insights that drive product development, risk mitigation, and customer strategy. this role requires a strong foundation in statistics, machine learning, and programming.

  

***while this position is ideally based in our san francisco office on a hybrid basis, we are also open to considering remote candidates.***

  

**what you'll do**:

  

* build and maintain credit and fraud policy simulators used to ensure properly functioning systems and identify risk decisioning enhancements.
* build and deploy statistical models and machine learning algorithms to solve business problems in areas like credit risk, fraud detection, pricing, customer segmentation, and marketing attribution.
* validate models to identify factors that may affect model performance.
* analyze large, structured and unstructured datasets using sql, python or similar tools.
* stay up to date with the latest trends and technologies in data science and fintech, actively research new tools and techniques available for model development.
* collaborate with cross-functional teams including risk, marketing, product, and engineering to define data-driven strategies.

title: Senior Data Engineer (REMOTE OR MA BASED)
description:
for more than 170 years, the hanover has been committed to delivering on our promises and being there when it matters the most. we live our values every day, demonstrating we care through our values, sustainability initiatives and inclusive corporate culture.
  
  
our technology team is currently seeking a senior data engineer to join our growing team in our worcester ma office, or via a remote work arrangement.
  
this is a full-time, exempt position.
  
  
**position overview:**  
the senior data engineer will lead a team of developers (internal and vendor resources) for the end-to-end design, development, implementation, and optimization of our enterprise data integration and warehousing solutions. in this role, you will build and maintain robust etl (extract, transform, load) pipelines, bridge source systems with target analytics platforms, and establish scalable data models.
  
you will work closely with external vendors for supporting data operations, data architects, business analysts, and reporting teams to translate complex business requirements into high-performing technical solutions across oracle, sql server, db2, and data lake environments. you will collaborate with business partners to define work priorities and assume a data/tech lead role on cross-functional teams delivering data/reporting solutions.
  
  
**in this role, you will:**  

* work with external vendors teams for supporting data operations.
* proven expertise in designing, implementing, and testing complex data mappings and transformations using informatica powercenter.
* strong background in data integration, etl processes, and data warehousing architectures, with hands-on experience optimizing ingestion pipelines for scale, performance, reliability, and cost-efficiency.
* advanced proficiency in sql along with deep technical experience in oracle, sql server, and db2 databases—specifically focusing on performance tuning, partitioning, pushdown optimization (pdo), and stored procedures.
* strong background in linux scripting and enterprise job scheduling software.
* familiarity with diverse integration connectors including apis, files, sftp/ftps, streaming data, database connectors, soap, and rest.
* experience in data governance & architecture with functional knowledge of data modeling, data governance frameworks, and metadata management strategies.
* ability to enforce and implement data quality, data security protocols, and strict industry compliance standards.
* operations & troubleshooting skills for large data sets, debugging technical issues, and continuously monitoring and maintaining active data pipelines.
* team leadership skills for professional communication, mentoring, coaching, and guide junior development team members.
* exceptional organizational skills to document data processes, workflows, and complete technical etl solutions.

**what you need to apply:**  

* bachelor’s degree or higher in computer science, information systems, business information technology, or an equivalent field.
* 5+ years of professional, hands-on experience in data engineering, data architecture, or data integration.
* must be eligible to work in the united states without requiring sponsorship now or in the future (i.e., us citizen or green card holder).

**bonus points for:**  

* experience working within agile development methodologies and modern devops environments.
* hands-on experience using git/github for version control and ci/cd pipelines.
* familiarity with bi reporting tools like power bi, obiee, hyperion essbase
* master’s degree in information systems, business information technology, or an equivalent field.

**career development:**

title: Sr. Machine Learning Engineer
description:
appfolio is more than a company. we’re a community of dreamers, big thinkers, problem solvers, active listeners, and multipliers. at every opportunity, we set the pace while delivering innovation built to carry real estate into the future. one in which every experience feels effortless, yet meaningful. where customers are empowered to take on any opportunity. we show up as one team, connected by our values to be a force for good. because together, we have the power to create extraordinary outcomes for our customers, our communities, and ourselves.

**realm-x** is appfolio's ai-native platform powering this transformation. it enables a new generation of intelligent capabilities across our products, including realm-x assistant (copilot), flows (ai agentic workflows) and performers (autonomous ai agents). realm-x serves as both a **foundation for internal teams to build and scale ai-powered products**, and a **core layer delivering intelligent, high-impact experiences directly to our customers**.

at its core, realm-x is built on a **structured domain ontology and a set of shared business primitives**—such as transactions, actions, reports, metrics, and skills—that enable ai systems to deeply understand and operate across the full context of property management workflows. this foundation allows us to build **context-aware, action-oriented ai systems** that go beyond simple assistance to power real automation and decision-making.

**who we are looking for**

we're hiring a senior machine learning engineer to design and ship the next generation of voice and conversational ai agents within realm-x. this role helps define appfolio's production voice and chat agent pipelines, working at the intersection of llm agent frameworks, real-time voice technology, and streaming infrastructure.

you will work with product, voice channel, and ml platform teams to translate cutting-edge agent and voice research into reliable, low-latency, multi-channel experiences that scale across our entire customer base.

**your impact**

* **ship voice & text agents:** architect and ship voice and text agent pipelines that handle real-time, multi-turn customer interactions.
* **reasoning vs. latency:** make principled trade-offs between reasoning depth and latency across frontier llms, smaller models, and routing strategies.
* **lead a pod:** lead a small pod of ml and platform engineers; raise the bar on agent evaluation, observability, and incident response.
* **define quality:** partner with product and voice channel teams to define kpis, eval harnesses, and acceptance criteria for agent quality.
* **optimize for voice:** drive selective small language model (slm) fine-tuning and inference optimization for voice latency and cost.

**qualifications**

* you have 5+ years of experience developing and scaling web-based applications, preferably in a saas environment.
* you have shipped production ai agents serving real users in voice and/or text channels.
* you think in pipelines and systems, not just models.
* you move fast, deliver impact, and maintain sound engineering judgment.
* you are humble, collaborative, and low-ego, and you elevate those around you.
* you value work-life balance as a foundation for sustained high performance.

**must have**

* **agent frameworks:** deep, shipped experience with langchain, langgraph, langsmith, and langchain deep agents (or equivalent agent frameworks).
* **voice stack:** hands-on with voice-to-voice models and traditional tts / stt pipelines; understands the trade-offs between end-to-end voice models and modular stt llm tts architectures.
* **llm fluency:** strong grasp of llm reasoning behavior, tool use, structured output, and reasoning-vs-latency trade-offs across providers.
* **telephony & cloud:** production experience with twilio (or comparable telephony) and aws.
* **engineering:** expert python, async programming, and websockets for real-time, bidirectional streaming.
* **ml fundamentals:** solid foundation in deep learning, model evaluation, and inference optimization; able to deploy with docker on aws.
* **leadership:** demonstrated ability to lead a small team, mentor engineers, and partner credibly with product and design.

**nice to have**

* bachelor’s, master’s, or ph.d. in computer science or related technical discipline.
* experience fine-tuning small language models for domain-specific voice applications.
* familiarity with rag over structured business data and tool-using agents over api surfaces.
* prior experience in regulated or customer-facing industries with strict reliability requirements.
* publicly verifiable work on github, in open-source agent frameworks, or in community competitions.

**location**

find out more about our locations by visiting our site.

the compensation that we reasonably expect to pay for this role is: $167,200 - $229,900 base pay. the actual compensation for this role will be determined by a variety of factors, including but not limited to the candidate’s skills, education, experience, and internal equity.

appfolio is the technology leader powering the future of the real estate industry. our innovative platform and trusted partnership enable our customers to connect communities, increase operational efficiency, and grow their business. for more information about appfolio, visit appfolio.com.

title: DATA SCIENTIST - EMERGENCY APPOINTMENT
description:
**type of recruitment**
  
open competitive - emergency

  

**filing dates**

applications will be accepted from thursday, october 15, 2026, at 8:00 a.m. (pt) until thursday, october 22, 2026, 5:00 p.m. (pt). all applications must be received **before** 5:00 p.m. (pt) on thursday, october 22, 2026, to be accepted.

  

**exam number**

hh1763b-ea

  

the la county board of supervisors recently declared a local state of emergency for homelessness, and the county is working to revise and expand our response to help all who are affected. we are looking for qualified and passionate individuals to help us in the mission of addressing issues like housing, mental health, and substance use. if you are looking for a new career that will directly benefit the population of la county, this may be the opportunity for you.

  

the department of homeless services and housing (hsh) is seeking qualified candidates to fill emergency health program analyst iii vacancies related to the homelessness crisis.

  

under the emergency order, applicants who meet the requirements may be hired for an initial period of up to 90 days, with an opportunity for permanent county employment.

  

during your initial work period, you will be assessed on your work performance. this assessment will be weighted 100%.

  

those who successfully pass the assessment will be considered for permanent appointment to data scientist.

**essential job functions**
---------------------------

* collaborates with division, department, and countywide stakeholders to solicit, define, and manage data science projects from conception through implementation, including identifying and developing statements of business problems; conducting exploratory data analysis and data mining; developing model specification requirements; and conducting advanced statistical analyses.
* develops and presents visualizations of findings and recommendations that can be used to support business decisions and allocate resources.
* works with departmental stakeholders to document business requirements and helps frame business problems so that appropriate corresponding data science techniques can be identified and applied.
* collaborates with department subject matter experts to understand, identify, and select available and relevant sources of data for use cases, including internal, external, structured, and unstructured data sources.
* works with departmental information technology organization to support collection, integration, and retention requirements for large sets of structured and unstructured data from various sources and consults with data engineers and architects on the design and architecture of relevant data systems and processes.
* collaborates with other data scientists, analysts, and it staff to select, evaluate, improve, and document tools and systems in order to strengthen divisional and departmental analytic capacity.
* independently conducts advanced analytical studies for the resolution of business problems and transfigures data into critical information by selecting and deploying appropriate advanced statistical techniques such as machine learning, bivariate and multivariate analyses, predictive/prescriptive analytics, and optimization.
* uses statistical computer scripting, domain-specific, and programming languages and other software and tools to digest, manipulate, prepare, augment, evaluate, analyze, summarize, and visualize data.
* plans, designs, and manages experiments, consumer surveys, and other data collection projects to augment existing sources of data as necessary to solve business problems.
* reviews the work of predictive data analysts and other lower-level analysts assigned to project for quality-control purposes.
* conveys findings and conclusions of work orally, in writing, visually, in presentations, and by developing interactive tools as appropriate to communicate effectively with a wide range of audiences, including technical and nontechnical staff, stakeholders, and members of the public.
* works with program staff to understand the implications of analyses and to ensure that findings are actionable and support data-driven program, policy, and operational decision-making.
* assists in implementing recommended business process changes in ways that both retain fidelity to best practices identified through the analysis and recognize the operational realities underlying existing business processes.
* works with functional teams to develop and implement products, services, and tools, such as dashboards and reports, emerging from the analysis.
* contributes to advanced analytic products (e.g., recommender engines, auto classification algorithms, predictive scoring, geo-spatial clustering, nlp classifier, etc.) and helps place them in production.
* recommends ongoing improvements to methods and algorithms that lead to findings, including new information.
* provides business metrics for departmental projects to show improvements both initially and over multiple iterations. provides ongoing tracking and monitoring of performance of decision systems and statistical models and troubleshoots and implements enhancements and fixes to systems as needed.
* accesses ongoing training and professional development to maintain familiarity with current industry and academic research to apply the latest and most useful statistical learning techniques to help extract pattern and trends from data.
* develops relationships with local academic data science programs to foster recruitment of data science interns and is responsible for overseeing their work on departmental data science projects.

**requirements**
----------------

**requirements to qualify**

**option i:** two (2) years of experience applying advanced statistical analyses, including predictive analytics, to produce actionable recommendations to support data-driven program, policy, and operational decision-making, at a level equivalent to the los angeles county class of predictive data analyst.

  
  

**option ii:** a bachelor’s degree from an accredited college in a field of applied research such as data science, machine learning, mathematics, statistics, business analytics, psychology, or public health that included 12 semester or 18 quarter units of coursework in data science, predictive analytics, quantitative research methods, or statistical analysis -and- four (4) years of experience applying machine learning, predictive analytics, data management, and hypothesis-driven data analysis to produce actionable recommendations to support data-driven program, policy, and operational decision-making. a master’s or doctoral degree from an accredited college or university in a field of applied research such data science, machine learning, mathematics, statistics, business analytics, psychology, or public health may substitute for up to two (2) years of experience.

  
  

you must meet the above requirement(s) in order to be appointed to fill any vacancies related to this recruitment.

  

**special requirement information**

* experience at the level of predictive data analyst is defined as using machine learning techniques to analyze complex data sets and find statistically significant, meaningful predictive patterns, relevant to program goals, that human intelligence could not identify on its own.

  

to receive credit for your education, include a copy of your official diploma or letter/certificate **-and-** official transcript from an accredited institution within seven (7) calendar days of the end of the filing period. please submit documentation to satajanyan@hsh.lacounty.gov and indicate your name, the exam name, and the exam number. the document should show the date the degree was conferred and be in english; if it is in a foreign language, it must be translated and evaluated for equivalency to u.s. standards. for more information on our standards for educational documents, please visit:
  
  
https://file.lacounty.gov/sdsinter/dhr/070812\_ppg123.pdfandhttps://file.lacounty.gov/sdsinter/dhr/205105\_ppg\_123\_ace\_resource\_guide.pdf ;
  
we do not accept password-protected documents. ensure documents are unlocked before attaching to your application or sending to the exam analyst.

**license**

a valid california class c driver license or the ability to utilize an alternative method of transportation when needed to carry out job-related essential functions.
  
  
**physical class**

ii - light: this class includes administrative and clerical positions requiring light physical effort that may include occasional light lifting to a 10-pound limit and some bending, stooping, or squatting. considerable ambulation may be involved.

  

**desirable qualifications**

one (1) year of experience within the last four (4) years in one or more of the following:
working with large, fragmented administrative datasets

* + - including individual-level records from social services, healthcare, or government programs.
  + selecting and applying statistical or machine learning models appropriate to the business problem, including model assumptions and limitations.
  + producing recurring reports or dashboards from administrative data systems using tools such as tableau, looker, power bi, databricks dashboards, sparks, azure synapse, or equivalent platforms.
  + developing dashboards or automated reports that translate analytic outputs into actionable information for program managers or operational staff.
  + collaborating with data engineers or it staff to scope data needs, provide feedback on data systems, and integrate analytic workflows into data pipelines.
  + applying version control (e.g., git) and basic software development practices, such as code documentation and reproducibility standards.
  + working on an extract, transform, and load (etl) process using data input tools to clean and combine datasets.
* experience presenting data analysis findings to non-technical stakeholders including homeless service program staff, leadership, and external bodies.

**additional information**
--------------------------

**exam content**

during your initial work period, the appointing department will evaluate your performance. those who achieve a passing score on this evaluation will be considered for permanent appointment.
  
  
**application and filing information**

applications must be filed online only and will be reviewed for interview consideration on an ongoing basis. if you have not been contacted within 60 days and the recruitment remains open or reopens for filing, we encourage you to submit a new application. this will allow you to reaffirm your interest and update any relevant information. please note, applicants will not receive individual notifications regarding their application or whether they meet the requirements.

description:

forward deployed engineer

et - ai platforms and innovation

all applicants

immediately

**job details:**

**general notes**
-----------------

this is a fixed term position that ends three years from the employee’s start date.

flexible work arrangements are available for this position, including the ability to work remotely at least 50% of the time within the united states. in-person meetings will be required when applicable. we prefer a candidate located in the greater austin area as travel to campus for occasional in-person events, training, team meetings, activities, etc., will be required.

this position provides a balance of life/work with typically a 40-hour work week, and travel limited to training (e.g., conferences/courses).

enterprise technology is dedicated to supporting the mission of the university of texas at austin of unlocking potential and preparing future leaders of the state.

**your skills will make a difference.**

you’ll be working for a university that is internationally recognized for research and the work you do will make a difference in the lives of our students, faculty and staff. if you’re the type of person that wants to know your work has meaning and impact, you’ll like working for our campus.

the university of texas at austin and enterprise technology provide an outstanding benefits package to our staff. those benefits include:

  

* competitive health benefits (employee premiums covered at 100%, family premiums at 50%)
* vision, dental, life, and disability insurance options
* paid vacation, sick leave, and holidays
* teachers retirement system of texas (a defined benefit retirement plan)
* additional voluntary retirement programs: tax sheltered annuity 403(b) and a deferred compensation program 457(b)
* flexible spending account options for medical and childcare expenses
* training and conference opportunities
* tuition assistance
* athletic ticket discounts
* access to ut austin's libraries and museums
* free rides on all ut shuttle and capital metro buses with staff id card

for more details, please see: https://hr.utexas.edu/prospective/benefits and https://hr.utexas.edu/current/services/my-total-rewards

must be authorized to work in the united states on a full-time basis for any employer without sponsorship.

this position requires you to maintain internet service and a mobile phone with voice and data plans to be used when required for work.

**purpose**
-----------

enterprise technology's ai studio serves as the central hub for the university of texas at austin's artificial intelligence initiatives and works to expand access to ai tools, services, and expertise across campus. the forward deployed engineer designs, develops, and implements ai-powered applications and solutions that address the evolving needs of the university community.

this position works directly with faculty, staff, researchers, and campus partners to identify opportunities for ai integration and transform ideas into functional, production-ready software. the forward deployed engineer combines full-stack software development, ai application engineering, and technical collaboration to deliver solutions that improve teaching, research, and institutional operations.

working closely with ai engineers, ai educators, campus it teams, and student innovators, this role helps bridge the gap between emerging ai capabilities and practical implementation. the position contributes to the development of reusable applications, shared engineering resources, and technical practices that support sustainable ai adoption across the university.

**responsibilities**
--------------------

### **ai application development and engineering:**

* design, develop, test, and deploy ai-powered applications that address academic, research, and administrative needs across the university.
* build full-stack software solutions using modern programming languages and frameworks, including python, javascript/typescript, and related technologies.
* develop backend services, rest apis, user-facing applications, and integrations that incorporate large language models (llms), generative ai, and other emerging ai capabilities.
* integrate ai models and services from providers such as openai, anthropic, microsoft azure, google, and other platforms into applications and institutional workflows.
* develop applications incorporating ai capabilities such as retrieval-augmented generation (rag), agentic workflows, tool calling, and structured data processing.
* design software architectures that prioritize reliability, maintainability, security, and scalability.
* implement authentication, authorization, and secure data-handling practices when integrating applications with university systems and services.
* develop automated tests, participate in code reviews, and apply software engineering best practices to maintain application quality.
* troubleshoot application issues, investigate unexpected ai model behavior, and implement improvements to enhance functionality and reliability.
* create reusable software components, development templates, and shared libraries that accelerate future ai application development.

### **campus ai solutions and technical collaboration:**

* partner with faculty, staff, researchers, and academic and administrative units to identify challenges that may benefit from ai-powered solutions.
* gather requirements, evaluate technical feasibility, and recommend implementation approaches that align with stakeholder needs and available resources.
* translate conceptual ideas and early-stage use cases into working prototypes, proof-of-concept applications, and production-ready solutions.
* collaborate with stakeholders throughout the development process to incorporate feedback and ensure applications meet functional expectations.
