title: Assoc. Dir, DSCS Digital Technologies, Decision Intelligence (m/f/d)
description:
job description
  
  
position overview - basic functions & responsibility
  
  
digital is the multiplier that will allow development sciences and clinical supply (dscs) to deliver better experiments faster, efficient filing and launch, more robust supply chains and higher-confidence decisions across the portfolio. the dscs digital technologies (ddt) organization is tasked with the mission to pioneer and deploy innovative digital technologies that drive the acquisition, automation and utilization of data to enhance insights, efficiency, and quality of dscs processes and methods.
  
the dscs digital technologies (ddt) organization within the research team is accountable for driving the digital transformation, data architecture, and technology solutions that enable execution and operations within the dscs organization.
  
  
the associate director, decision intelligence is a technical role responsible for developing advanced analytics and operations research capabilities to enable data-driven decision making and inform dscs business operations. this role will focus on modeling, simulation and optimization frameworks to solve complex business problems.
  
  
**the associate director, decision intelligence will:**  

* translate business problems into mathematical models/frameworks for business process simulation and optimization.
* design robust and sustainable analytics that can be seamlessly integrated with webapps and/or agents to streamline user interaction.
* develop and implement probabilistic forecasting and stochastic optimization techniques to enable strategic decision making given uncertainty.
* serve as a business analyst to develop business cases for new digital capabilities. define and track kpis aligned with the value proposition for digital transformation within dscs.
* contribute to designing, building, and implementing modern data foundations and pipelines.
* contribute to the development of custom web applications (webapps) that allow business users to seamlessly interact with data products and model outputs.
* work strategically with change management and dscs functional area smes to design and implement ai-enabled business processes.
* contribute to the advancement of the ddt decision intelligence strategic roadmap, developing reusable methods and components that support decision intelligence capabilities across business domains.

primary activities
  
  

* requirements translation: translate business processes and/or stakeholder requirements into accurate mathematical representations and technical specifications for corresponding models, agents and data products.
* decision intelligence strategy: provide expertise in translating data and model outputs into clear, concise and interpretable business insights. collaborate with digital operations change management and functional area smes to define and implement ai-enabled decision making processes across dscs.
* business case development: in collaboration with dscs smes, develop the business case and articulate the value proposition for new digital capabilities.
* performance monitoring: define and track kpis to monitor the value realized through digital transformation within the dscs organization.
* modeling & simulation: develop mathematical models to simulate and/or optimize business processes using techniques including but not limited to machine learning, discrete event simulation and optimization.
* data engineering: in collaboration with the digital operations shared services team, design, build, and optimize scalable data pipelines leveraging databricks, python, dataverse, and advanced sql. transform raw data into contextualized, ai-ready data products.
* agentic ai: in collaboration with agentic intelligence team, design, test, and implement agentic ai workflows using tools like copilot studio to automate decision-making processes and generate proactive business insights.
* web application development: in collaboration with digital operations shared services team, develop and deploy user-friendly webapps to support interaction with data and analytics.
* development & code management: utilize modern development environments (vs code) and ai coding assistants (cline) alongside github for robust version control of scripts, applications, and data models to ensure code quality.
* systems architecture: work closely with system architects to ensure scalable, secure, and efficient devops.
* documentation & enablement: document processes, code, mathematical models, data models, and system architectures; provide training and technical support to end-users as new digital capabilities are rolled out.

required skills and qualifications
  
  

* experience: 5+ years in data science, operations research, data engineering or a related highly technical role.
* pharmaceutical development and/or clinical supply chain experience. understanding of cmc development across modalities (ie small molecule, large molecule, vaccine) strongly preferred.
* core technical stack: strong expertise in python. experience building and deploying advanced machine learning models. databricks and mlops experience preferred.
* business analysis: proven track record of gathering complex requirements from non-technical stakeholders and translating them into actionable, technical roadmaps.
* agentic ai & automation: familiarity with or strong interest in agentic ai and integrating ai agents into workflows.
* devops & developer tools: proven experience with github for version control. highly comfortable leveraging ai-assisted development tools like cline. proficiency working in vscode or other equivalent integrated development environment. experience deploying apps or agents in preferred.
* analytical skills: strong analytical and problem-solving skills to tackle complex business challenges and translate them into mathematical problem statements and corresponding technical solutions.
* collaboration & influence: demonstrated ability to develop strong, trust-based relationships to drive change and execute priorities with a diverse group of technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* communication: excellent written and verbal communication skills; demonstrated ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders, including senior executives.
* independence: independent decision-making abilities with a proactive approach to leading projects and delivering results.

education and skills
  
  

* education: phd with 1+ year of experience or bachelor’s degree with 5+ years of experience in engineering, operations research, data science, or comparable technical field.

the salary range for the additional location (us) of this role is:

title: Senior Software Engineer - Remote
description:
optum tech is a global leader in health care innovation. our teams develop cutting-edge solutions that help people live healthier lives and help make the health system work better for everyone. from advanced data analytics and ai to cybersecurity, we use innovative approaches to solve some of health care's most complex challenges. your contributions here have the potential to change lives. ready to build the next breakthrough? join us in making healthcare work better for everyone through people-led, responsible ai while **caring. connecting. growing together.**

as a business intelligence application administrator on our technology team, you will drive the operational reliability, intelligent automation, and performance of enterprise business intelligence (bi) platforms in a remote working environment. in this role, you will combine robust application administration with modern solution engineering-designing, developing, and deploying ai-powered automations and tools to streamline workflows and elevate platform capabilities. working closely with cross-functional technical teams, you will evaluate emerging technology trends, enforce governance standards, and build scalable infrastructure solutions that support data-driven decision-making across the enterprise.

you'll enjoy the flexibility to work remotely \* from anywhere within the u.s. as you take on some tough challenges. for all hires in the minneapolis or washington, d.c. area, you will be required to work in the office a minimum of four days per week.

**primary responsibilities:**

* administer, configure, and maintain enterprise business intelligence (bi) application environments, servers, and tools to ensure high availability, security, and peak performance
* installing, configuring, and maintaining bi software on windows and linux servers, located in uhg data centers and azure public cloud. assignments to include the completion of multiple projects and priorities simultaneously
* monitor system capacity, resource utilization, and query execution, proactively identifying and resolving environment bottlenecks and error logs
* manage user security, role-based access controls, permissions, and single sign-on (sso) authentication across bi tools
* execute server software upgrades, system patches, hotfixes, environment migrations, and disaster recovery planning
* partner with software engineers, data engineers, and analytics teams to optimize query performance, data architecture, and dashboard deployment workflows
* design, develop, and deploy ai-powered solutions and intelligent automations to address complex bi platform challenges, with an emphasis on responsible ai use
* use enterprise-approved ai tools and scripting to streamline administrative workflows, automate system health checks, and drive continuous platform improvement
* evaluate emerging technology and ai trends to inform solution design, platform enhancements, and strategic technical innovation

you'll be rewarded and recognized for your performance in an environment that will challenge you and give you clear direction on what it takes to succeed in your role as well as provide development for other roles you may be interested in.

**required qualifications:**

* 3+ years of experience with vmware/linux/azure resource management, python, github, network firewalls and azure administration
* 3+ years of experience administering enterprise business intelligence platforms (e.g., power bi, tableau, microstrategy, or ssrs)
* 3+ years of experience managing user security, role-based access controls, and sso integration within application environments
* 3+ years of experience executing server software upgrades, patching, environment migrations, and system maintenance
* 2+ years of experience leveraging ai tools, machine learning capabilities, or intelligent automation to streamline system processes and operational workflows
* 2+ years of experience working with sql databases and database connection configurations
* candidate is required to hold or ability to obtain national agency check (nac) clearance for support of federal contracts
* bi deployments often require change deployment and war room support during non-core business hours to comply with business contract requirements and slas

**preferred qualifications:**

* bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
* relevant platform certification (e.g., tableau certified administrator, power bi administrator)
* experience building or integrating ai-driven tools, predictive models, or automated pipelines within azure bi environments (e.g. azure, aws, gcp)
* healthcare industry or healthcare data analytics experience
* passion for technical growth and flexibility for knowledge transfer amongst peers
* proven solid analytical, problem-solving, and collaboration skills across remote, cross-functional engineering teams

* all employees working remotely will be required to adhere to unitedhealth group's telecommuter policy

pay is based on several factors including but not limited to local labor markets, education, work experience, certifications, etc. in addition to your salary, we offer benefits such as, a comprehensive benefits package, incentive and recognition programs, equity stock purchase and 401k contribution (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements). no matter where or when you begin a career with us, you'll find a far-reaching choice of benefits and incentives. the salary for this role will range from $91,700 - $163,700 annually based on full-time employment. we comply with all minimum wage laws as applicable.

title: Product Support Solutions Developer
description:
with 1,000+ intelligence professionals serving over 1,900 clients worldwide, recorded future is the world's most advanced, and largest, intelligence company!

the **product support solutions developer** designs, builds, and maintains the technical infrastructure, tools, and automated workflows that power the customer support function. combining technical development expertise with support operations and enablement, this role is responsible for architecting scalable internal tooling, engineering custom integrations, and leveraging ai agents/automations to drive operational efficiency, reduce resolution times, and elevate customer satisfaction.

### **what you'll do:**

#### **1. custom tooling & integration development**

* design, build, and maintain custom applications, scripts, and webhook integrations across core support systems (e.g., zendesk, jira, salesforce service cloud, domo, statuspage).
* architect and optimize api connections, custom middleware, and automated workflows to streamline ticket routing, data syncs, and escalations.
* build custom ui components, apps, and macros within support platforms to enhance agent efficiency and desktop experience.
* determines methods and procedures for new or undefined assignments, considering company objectives—not only functional needs—to shape solutions

#### **2. ai agent & automation implementation**

* lead the evaluation, development, and deployment of ai agents, llm-powered assistants, and chatbots to automate tier-1 support interactions and internal agent assistance.
* fine-tune ai agent prompt workflows, knowledge ingestion pipelines, and retrieval-augmented generation (rag) models to improve self-service resolution rates.
* monitor and continuously optimize ai agent performance, accuracy, and customer satisfaction metrics.

#### **3. support operations & tool management**

* administer, configure, and optimize support systems, maintaining slas, routing rules, triggers, and automated workflows.
* conduct regular quality, tag, and compliance audits across systems to ensure high data integrity and adherence to support processes.
* assist platform operations and support leadership with outage communication tooling, incident escalation paths, and client updates.

#### **4. data engineering, analytics & reporting**

* build and maintain complex analytics dashboards and data pipelines (e.g., zendesk explore, domo, sql) to track kpis like ticket volume, mttr, csat, and backlog trends.
* partner with product analytics to build unified data reporting layers across disparate platforms.
* perform root-cause analysis on platform trends and negative csat ratings to identify automation opportunities and systemic fixes.

#### **5. technical enablement & process improvement**

* collaborate with support leadership to design and deliver technical onboarding and enablement programs for support staff.
* digest complex product handoffs from product and engineering teams, translating them into technical documentation, live training modules, and internal knowledge base resources.
* partner with documentation and training teams to create client-facing self-service e-learnings and articles that reduce inbound ticket volume.
* continuously audit support workflows to identify operational bottlenecks, create documented procedures to improve them, and develop automated solutions as necessary to eliminate them.
* maintains key relationships outside their area of expertise to bolster unified process improvement where necessary

title: Advanced AI Software Engineer
description:
as an advanced ai software engineer at honeywell, you will design, develop, deploy, and own advanced ai/ml and generative ai capabilities that power enterprise software applications and products. you will apply deep expertise in large language models (llms), generative ai, agentic ai, machine learning, and software engineering to build secure, scalable, reliable, and production-ready ai solutions.

you will provide technical leadership across the ai software development lifecycle, from architecture and experimentation through evaluation, deployment, observability, optimization, and production support. you will collaborate closely with software, product, data, cloud/platform, cybersecurity, and architecture teams to translate complex business requirements into robust ai-powered solutions.

you will report directly to our director of engineering, and you’ll work out of our phoenix, arizona location on a hybrid work schedule.

note: for the first 90 days, new hires must be prepared to work onsite 100% m-f.

  

**you must have**

* 4+ years of hands-on ai/ml engineering experience, including designing, developing, deploying, and supporting ai/ml and generative ai solutions in production environments.
* 4+ years of hands-on experience with modern ai/ml technologies, including large language models (llms), generative ai, agentic ai prompt/context engineering, embeddings, vector databases, semantic/hybrid search, transformers, and ai/ml frameworks.
* 4+ years of experience architecting and delivering production ai/ml applications, including apis/microservices, cloud deployment, model/llm evaluation, automated testing, observability, performance optimization, security, scalability, and cross-functional technical delivery.
5+ years of software engineering/programming experience, with strong hands-on proficiency in python and experience with at least one additional programming language such as c++ or java, developing scalable, maintainable, production-quality software.  

**we value**

* bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, artificial intelligence, machine learning, or a related technical field.
* advanced experience with ai/ml frameworks and ecosystems such as pytorch, tensorflow, hugging face, langchain, semantic kernel, or equivalent technologies.
* experience with enterprise-grade vector databases and search technologies such as azure ai search, elasticsearch, postgresql/pgvector, pinecone, or equivalent technologies.
* experience with azure ai services/azure ai foundry and/or google gemini/vertex ai and cloud-based ai infrastructure.
* experience with containerization and orchestration technologies such as docker and kubernetes.
* experience building automated deployment pipelines using ci/cd, devops, infrastructure as code, and mlops/llmops practices.
* experience with ai observability, model/application telemetry, prompt and model versioning, evaluation pipelines, and production quality monitoring.
knowledge of responsible ai, ai security, data privacy, model risk, prompt-injection mitigation, content safety, and enterprise ai governance.  

**benefits of working for honeywell**

in addition to a competitive salary, leading-edge work, and developing solutions side-by-side with dedicated experts in their fields, honeywell employees are eligible for a comprehensive benefits package. this package includes employer subsidized medical, dental, vision, and life insurance; short-term and long-term disability; 401(k) match, flexible spending accounts, health savings accounts, eap, and educational assistance; parental leave, paid time off (for vacation, personal business, sick time, and parental leave), and 12 paid holidays. learn more (https://benefits.honeywell.com/)

honeywell technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. we serve the building, industrial, and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions, and products, underpinned by our honeywell technologies accelerator operating system and honeywell technologies forge intelligence layer. by combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

**the business unit**

honeywell technologies process automation helps customers run complex industrial operations more safely, efficiently, and reliably. from automation and control systems to cybersecurity, digital solutions, and operational optimization, we enable critical industries to improve performance, reduce risk, and achieve their sustainability objectives.

  

**key responsibilities**

* architect, design, develop, and deploy production-grade applications and software platforms using large language models (llms), generative ai, and agentic ai technologies.
* design and implement advanced architectures, prompt and context-management strategies, embeddings, vector databases, semantic/hybrid search, reranking, and knowledge-retrieval pipelines.
* build ai agents and multi-step ai workflows, including tool/function calling, orchestration, memory/context management, and integration with enterprise applications and data sources.
* optimize ai workloads for latency, throughput, scalability, token consumption, infrastructure utilization, and cost.
* design and implement cloud-native ai solutions and integrate ai services with existing enterprise applications, apis, data platforms, and software architectures.
* provide technical leadership in architecture reviews, design reviews, code reviews, technical trade-off analysis, and engineering best practices.
* drive engineering standards for software quality, automated testing, ci/cd, security, scalability, resiliency, maintainability, and operational readiness.
* collaborate with product and engineering teams to translate business problems into technically feasible ai solutions and measurable outcomes.
* mentor engineers and provide technical guidance on ai/ml architecture, software engineering practices, troubleshooting, and production deployment.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
**about curium**

curium is the world’s largest nuclear medicine company with more than a century of industry experience. we develop, manufacture and distribute world-class radiopharmaceutical products to help patients around the globe. our proven heritage combined with a pioneering approach are the hallmarks to deliver innovation, excellence and unparalleled service.

  

with manufacturing facilities across europe and the united states, curium delivers spect, pet and therapeutic radiopharmaceutical solutions for life-threatening diseases to over 14 million patients annually. the name ‘curium’ honors the legacy of pioneering radioactive researchers marie and pierre curie, after whom the radioactive element curium was named and emphasizes our focus on nuclear medicine. the tagline ‘life forward’ represents our commitment to securing a brighter future for all those we serve: an enhanced quality of care for our patients. a trusted partner to our customers. a supportive employer to our valued team.

  

**summary of position**
-----------------------

we are seeking an experienced senior data engineer to design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines, data platforms, and analytical data products. the data engineer will collaborate with data architects, data scientists, analysts, application teams, and business stakeholders to deliver trusted data for analytics, reporting, machine learning, and operational use cases.
  
the ideal candidate has strong experience with modern cloud data platforms, data integration, data modeling, distributed processing, data quality, and governance. experience with databricks, snowflake, microsoft fabric, azure, or similar cloud platforms is highly desirable.

  

**work schedule:** m - f 8am - 5pm. this is a hybrid position: 4 days onsite, 1 day remote.

**essential functions**
-----------------------

* data engineering & platform development:
  + design, develop, and maintain scalable batch and real-time data pipelines.
  + build reliable etl/elt processes for structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data.
  + integrate data from databases, apis, saas applications, files, and event streams.
  + develop and maintain cloud-based data lake, lakehouse, and data warehouse solutions.
  + work with technologies such as databricks, snowflake, microsoft fabric, azure data factory, spark, sql, and cloud storage.
  + implement reusable data engineering frameworks, patterns, and standards.
  + support data platform modernization and migration initiatives.
* data modeling & data products:
  + design logical and physical data models for analytical and operational use cases.
  + develop dimensional, normalized, and lakehouse data models.
  + build curated data layers supporting reporting, analytics, and machine learning.
  + support domain-oriented data products within a data mesh operating model.
* data quality, governance & security:
  + implement data validation, quality checks, reconciliation, monitoring, and alerting.
  + support data cataloging, metadata management, lineage, and data ownership.
  + implement appropriate security, access controls, privacy, and regulatory requirements.
  + establish monitoring and operational processes for production data pipelines.
* performance & cost optimization:
  + optimize data pipelines, queries, storage, and compute workloads.
  + apply appropriate partitioning, clustering, caching, and workload-management techniques.
  + identify opportunities to improve platform performance, scalability, reliability, and total cost of ownership.
* collaboration & delivery:
  + partner with architects, data scientists, analytics engineers, bi developers, application developers, and business stakeholders.
  + translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
  + participate in architecture reviews, technical design sessions, code reviews, and agile delivery.
  + create technical documentation and operational runbooks.
  + mentor junior engineers and promote engineering best practices.
  + must maintain operational compliance with us and international regulatory agencies and guidelines (i.e. fda, dea, eu, hc, tga, pic/s, iso, usp, nrc, cgmp, etc.).

**requirements**
----------------

* must have experience / skills:
  + bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, or related field, or equivalent experience.
  + 5+ years of professional data engineering experience.
  + strong sql and database development skills.
  + experience developing production-grade etl/elt pipelines.
  + proficiency in python, scala, java, or similar programming language.
  + experience with cloud data platforms and cloud storage.
  + strong understanding of data modeling, data warehouses, data lakes, and/or lakehouses.
  + experience with git, ci/cd, testing, and deployment practices.
* nice to have experience / skills:
  + hands-on experience with databricks, snowflake, or microsoft fabric.
  + experience with apache spark / pyspark and distributed data processing.
  + experience with azure, aws, or google cloud.
  + experience with streaming technologies such as kafka, event hubs, or kinesis.
  + experience with orchestration tools such as azure data factory, airflow, or similar.
  + experience with delta lake, apache iceberg, or other open table formats.
  + experience implementing data mesh, domain-oriented data products, or federated data architectures.
  + experience with data catalog, lineage, governance, and observability platforms.
  + experience supporting ai/ml data workloads.
  + industry certifications or training in data engineering, cloud platforms, master data management, analytics, or project management.
  + experience with pharmaceutical regulatory guidelines, including electronic records and signatures, data integrity, cgmp, fda 21 cfr parts 11, 210, and 211, eu annex 11, mhra, and gamp 5.
  + additional languages a plus

**working conditions:**

* this position will work in typical office conditions with extensive time using computer equipment.
* close attention to detail required.
* willingness to work in a team-based environment.
* may be required to sit or stand for long periods of 8+ hours a day while performing duties.
* must possess good hand-eye coordination; close attention to detail is required.
* willingness to complete safety training within allotted timeframes, and work in a team-based environment.
* the position deals with many deadlines. must be able to work outside of regular work hours, including off shift, weekend, and holiday work as business needs require.

**disclaimer**

the above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this classification. they are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of employees assigned to this position.

  

**equal opportunity employer**

curium is an equal opportunity employer and believes everyone deserves respect, dignity and equality. all applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

title: Sr. QA Test Engineer (Quality Assurance)
description:
huron helps its clients drive growth, enhance performance and sustain leadership in the markets they serve. we help healthcare organizations build innovation capabilities and accelerate key growth initiatives, enabling organizations to own the future, instead of being disrupted by it. together, we empower clients to create sustainable growth, optimize internal processes and deliver better consumer outcomes.  
  
health systems, hospitals and medical clinics are under immense pressure to improve clinical outcomes and reduce the cost of providing patient care. investing in new partnerships, clinical services and technology is not enough to create meaningful and substantive change. to succeed long-term, healthcare organizations must empower leaders, clinicians, employees, affiliates and communities to build cultures that foster innovation to achieve the best outcomes for patients.  
  
joining the huron team means you’ll help our clients evolve and adapt to the rapidly changing healthcare environment and optimize existing business operations, improve clinical outcomes, create a more consumer-centric healthcare experience, and drive physician, patient and employee engagement across the enterprise.  
  
join our team as the expert you are now and create your future.

as a senior qa test engineer, you will be a key contributor in ensuring the quality of huron’s enterprise applications. the successful candidate will help define and ensure that huron’s applications meet high standards for reliability, usability, and performance. you will work closely with the product management and engineering teams in the design, implementation, release, and maintenance of multi-user, dynamic, web-based, and analytics applications. this role requires a passion for delivering exceptional products, the curiosity and drive to understand client application usage patterns and behaviors, the technical skills to develop reusable and automated tests to ensure a high-quality user experience, and the independence and persistence to own and drive quality throughout the product lifecycle. the role requires strong expertise in aws and performance testing using jmeter, selenium automation framework with java, basic database concepts including sql queries and data validation, troubleshooting and debugging, and experience working in agile development environments. the successful candidate must also possess excellent interpersonal and communication skills.  
  
under general direction, this individual is responsible for carrying out procedures to ensure that all software, hardware, applications and services meet the standards of the organization and end-user requirements, analyzing and testing software and application configuration to ensure that products meet design specifications and are within total quality management limits and standards. this individual is expected to participate actively in agile testing methodology including helping to develop quality standards, test cases, software/hardware and application testing, and documenting process and test outcomes. they are responsible for developing, modifying and executing test plans and suites and communicating with product developers and technical support specialists on software issues. in addition, they are expected to perform tests to ensure proper operation and freedom from defects. they may create test data to ensure thorough evaluation, documents and work to resolve basic problems and report progress on problem resolution to management.
  
  
the senior qa test engineer applies company policies and procedures to address a variety of issues. they are also responsible for assisting in the development of policies and standards and ensuring adherence to company procedures and best practices.

**position responsibilities**

* own and execute manual and automated testing activities across the complete software development lifecycle, ensuring releases meet quality objectives and timelines.
* design, develop, execute, and performance test scripts using jmeter, including workload modeling, test execution, results analysis, and performance reporting.
* analyze test and performance results, troubleshoot issues, perform root-cause analysis, and work closely with development teams to drive defects through resolution.
* develop and maintain ui automation using selenium with java, creating reliable and reusable automation scripts for functional and regression testing.
* review technical design documents and participate in design and architecture discussions, providing qa perspectives on testability, reliability, scalability, and performance.
* estimate qa effort for user stories and defects and develop test plans, test scenarios, and test cases.
* generate and maintain appropriate test data to address testing requirements and data gaps.
* perform database validation using sql queries and validate data integrity across application and backend systems.
* conduct performance testing to identify performance bottlenecks, capacity limitations, scalability concerns, potential performance debt, communicate performance issues to engineering teams.
* identify and communicate release risks, quality concerns, and potential production-impacting issues to qa and project leadership.
* participate in bug scrub meetings, release readiness discussion.
* evaluate and recommend new tools, techniques, and automation approaches to improve testing efficiency and product quality.
* review qa deliverables and provide technical guidance and feedback to other qa team members.
* participate actively in agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
* work closely with product management, engineering, and qa teams members to ensure requirements are testable and comprehensive test coverage is achieved.
* support qa/uat/prod environments and understand the build and deployment process.
* support test execution during release cycles and provide quality status, risks, and defect updates to stakeholders.
* ensure testing activities align with huron’s quality standards and contribute to delivering a reliable, usable, and high-performing product.
* contribute to continuous improvement of qa practices, automation frameworks, performance testing capabilities, and release processes.

**qualifications**  
**required / must have**

* 5+ years of professional qa/test engineering experience with strong experience in both manual and automation testing.
* good understanding of sql and database validation.
* familiar with aws services: cloudwatch, eventbridge, quicksight, batch jobs, lambda, s3, redshift, glue, bedrock.
* strong hands-on experience with performance testing using jmeter
* demonstrated ability to develop, execute, analyze, and troubleshoot jmeter performance tests.
* strong hands-on experience developing selenium automation using java.
* experience designing and maintaining reusable automation frameworks and automated regression suites.
* demonstrated experience with data lake, data warehouse, etl/elt, or data pipeline testing.
* strong troubleshooting, debugging, analytical, and root-cause analysis skills.
* experience with functional, regression, integration, system, api, and end-to-end testing.
* experience working in agile/scrum software development environments.
* experience with azure devops, jira, or similar tools.
* experience with ci/cd and devops practices.
* strong written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
* ability to work independently, take ownership of qa activities, identify risks proactively, and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
* bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.

**preferred / good to have**

* experience with ci/cd pipeline integration of automated and performance tests.
* experience with python for test automation, data validation, or test utilities.
* experience testing ai-powered applications and workflows.
* familiarity with ai-assisted testing tools and responsible ai practices.
* exposure to aws bedrock, microsoft copilot, openai, or similar ai platforms.
* knowledge of generative ai, llms, and prompt engineering.
* experience working with offshore/distributed teams.
* experience in new product development environments.
* experience in the healthcare domain.
* experience working with phi/pii and healthcare data, including applicable data privacy and security requirements.

title: Software Power Systems Engineer
description:
overview:

**we are designing the grid of the future!**

ener-i is a cutting-edge software solution from electric power engineers (epe) helping utility clients plan for the rapidly evolving electric grid and achieve their planning and operational goals through innovative digitalization. backed by the collective expertise of epe, ener-i brings decades of industry engineering experience to the world of cloud-based, enterprise computing software. ener-i's goal is to create a shared, secure, curated data platform, providing engineers with the means for intelligent data aggregation, insightful engineering analytics engines, gis, network connectivity models, machine learning & augmented intelligence. our mission is to close the gap between planning and operations; transmission and distribution and merge the interests of the government, the public, and private industry.

responsibilities:

**join us in leading the** **change!**

the software power systems engineer will work as a core member of the ener-i software development team, owning the power systems engineering behind the platform's analysis modules from algorithm design through production code. this involves designing, developing, testing, and validating scalable engines and workflows for distribution system analysis. such analyses include but are not limited to: quasi-static time-series (qsts) unbalanced power flow, hosting capacity and der interconnection screening, automated thermal and voltage violation mitigation, value of der and non-wires alternatives analysis, flexible interconnection, reliability analyses, resiliency analyses, and derms operational planning, and long-term capacity and investment planning.

the level of the role (engineer iii, senior, principal, or senior principal) will be aligned to the candidate's depth of experience. principal-level engineers are expected to set technical direction for the platform's powerflow analysis architecture and lead cross-team initiatives.

  

* the software power systems engineer will also engage with the ener-i product, engineering, and client delivery teams for tasks such as:
* distribution model conversion, validation, and onboarding (e.g., cyme, synergi, windmil, opendss)
* translating utility planning practices and criteria into technical specifications
* technical design reviews and architecture decisions for analysis engines
* validation of platform results against commercial tools and field data
* performance benchmarking and scale testing on utility-sized models
* client technical workshops, demonstrations, and user training
* perform and deliver ener-i based distribution planning studies when needed

**how you can make an impact:**

  

* design and implement production-grade python libraries and services for distribution analysis, power flow orchestration, and optimization within the ener-i platform.
* scale simulations across thousands of feeders and full-year time-series through parallelization, cloud batch processing, and performance tuning – including compiled languages (e.g., rust, c++) where it matters.
* build and maintain distribution data models and model converters that bring utility network models (cyme, synergi, windmil, opendss, gis) into a common, validated representation.
* develop algorithms for automated mitigation, hosting capacity, der valuation, and grid planning using optimization (lp/milp), heuristics, and data-driven methods.
* establish test automation, validation suites, and engineering benchmarks that keep platform results accurate and trustworthy.
* serve as a distribution subject matter expert to developers, product owners, and product managers; review requirements and user stories for engineering correctness.
* propose and prototype new ener-i modules and help shape the technical roadmap with product management.
* mentor engineers and developers, contribute to code and design reviews, and raise the bar on engineering practices across the team.
* represent epe through publications, open-source contributions, and industry working groups where appropriate.
* perform other duties as assigned.

  
qualifications:

**bring your passion, here's what’s needed:**

  

* master's degree or ph.d. in electrical engineering with a power systems focus, or a bachelor's degree with equivalent experience.
* 3+ years (engineer iii) or 7+ years (principal) of combined experience in distribution system analysis and software development; national laboratory, research, utility, and vendor experience all count.
* expert understanding of three-phase, unbalanced distribution systems, power flow formulations, and distribution planning practices.
* hands-on experience with at least one distribution modeling tool (e.g., opendss, cyme, synergi, windmil, or gridlab-d), including its apis or automation interfaces.
* strong python software engineering skills beyond scripting: packaging, typing, automated testing, git, code review, and ci/cd. opendss experience is a plus.
* a track record of building tools that other people use: libraries, applications, or open-source projects with real users.
* experience applying numerical methods and optimization (e.g., pyomo, jump, gurobi, highs) to power systems problems.
* experience working with large data sets (time-series, ami, scada) using tools such as pandas/polars, sql, or parquet.
* strong communication skills, both written and verbal, particularly with respect to explaining complex technical matters.
* proven team player skills with ability to build and maintain internal and external relationships.
* familiarity with agile software development methodologies (e.g., scrum).

**beneficial experience:**

* proficiency in a compiled or high-performance language such as rust, c++, julia, or java.
* contributions to open-source power systems tools (e.g., opendss/altdss, ditto, gridlab-d, powermodelsdistribution, pandapower).
* experience with cloud-native development, containers, and distributed or high-performance computing (e.g., aws, docker, kubernetes).
* experience with der integration topics such as hosting capacity, ieee 1547, derms, flexible interconnection, non-wires alternatives, and electrification load forecasting.
* breadth across transmission, controls, or t&d co-simulation.
* familiarity with gis tools (preferably esri) and utility network data models.
* experience leveraging machine learning and ai tools responsibly to improve engineering quality and productivity.
* publications or participation in ieee pes or similar industry working groups.

be a part of an innovative team shaping the grid of the future through advanced energy intelligence. for more than half a century, electric power engineers (epe) has partnered with power and energy clients across the globe, providing consulting expertise and energy intelligence software solutions for complex engineering and grid modeling challenges. as leaders in the renewables space, we are focused on building a modern, secure, and resilient grid. join us in making an impact on the communities we serve and the environment in which we live. together we can transform the future of energy.

**how we support you:**

* comprehensive health and wellness benefits including medical, dental, and vision with 100% premium coverage for you
* generous pto and paid holidays
* myshare employee ownership program
* work with industry leaders
* 401k, up to a 4% match (100% vested from day 1)

***location***: this position is open to remote for highly qualified candidates

***travel***: occasional travel may be needed (10% or less)

description:
working at the naval nuclear laboratory we foster pride in belonging to an organization whose culture is made up of these core values: trust, empowerment, and collaboration. our company promotes a positive culture while ensuring the safety and reliability of our nation's naval nuclear reactors, and training the sailors who operate those reactors in the u.s. navy's submarines and aircraft carrier fleets. looking for a lifetime career? apply today!

**job description**
-------------------

working at the naval nuclear laboratory we foster pride in belonging to an organization whose culture is made up of these core values: trust, empowerment, and collaboration. our company promotes a positive culture while ensuring the safety and reliability of our nation's naval nuclear reactors, and training the sailors who operate those reactors in the u.s. navy's submarine and aircraft carrier fleets. join the naval nuclear laboratory (nnl) as a data & ai engineer and play a central role in modernizing the data foundations that power the naval reactors program. in this role, you will help transform the financial data ecosystem by designing, building, and maintaining secure, scalable data infrastructure that enables accurate, timely, and actionable analytics across the enterprise. you will partner with teams across financial services, it, digital transformation, and other mission-critical organizations to advance nnl's growing data-driven decision-making capabilities. this work supports the multi year modernization of financial systems and analytics platforms, enabling cloud-forward architectures, integrated data repositories, standardized data structures, and automated data flows-all essential to ensuring nnl's financial insight, compliance, and operational excellence. looking for a lifetime career? apply today!

  

what you'll do:  

* design, build, and maintain high?quality data pipelines and workflows that integrate data from multiple systems.
* develop and support data warehouses and data lakes to enable secure, efficient access to structured and unstructured data.
* implement etl/elt processes that deliver clean, consistent, and well?governed datasets.
* collaborate with analysts, software developers, and business partners to create data models that support reporting and advanced analytics.
* improve data quality, performance, and reliability through monitoring, validation, and optimization.
* ensure adherence to data governance, security, and compliance requirements.
* evaluate new tools, cloud technologies, and automation capabilities that enhance scalability and efficiency.

**required combination of knowledge and skill**
-----------------------------------------------

* bachelors degree from an accredited college or university in a related engineering or science field and a minimum of 4 years of relevant experience; or
* masters degree from an accredited college or university in a related engineering or science field and a minimum of 2 years of relevant experience; or
* doctorate degree from an accredited college or university in a related engineering or science field; or
* currently an advanced reactor training engineer, refueling engineer, or field (rpco) engineer at the company.

**preferred skills**
--------------------

* degrees in computer science, data science, or computer engineering are preferred, but not required.
* experience integrating and transforming enterprise data from erp, tms, or epm systems into analytical platforms, using etl/elt tools (such as azure data factory, synapse pipelines, ssis, notebooks) and data engineering languages (python, sql).
* proficiency in designing and optimizing modern data architectures, including data lakehouse/cloud patterns, dimensional modeling (star/snowflake schemas), and power bi analytics (datasets, dashboards, dax, m).
* familiarity with software development lifecycle, devops practices (git-based source control, ci/cd pipelines, automated testing), and emerging ai/ml platforms (azure ml, microsoft copilot, azure open ai), with attention to data privacy and responsible ai.
* strong ability to collaborate in cross-functional teams, communicate effectively, and apply analytical and problem-solving skills.

**compensation and benefits**
-----------------------------

* health, dental, vision & voluntary benefits
* disability, life & accident insurance
* 401(k) savings program & capital accumulation plan
* personal & medical time off
* paid parental leave
* flexible work schedules
* tuition assistance for eligible employees
* student debt benefit personal time off sell program
* employee assistance program (eap)
* wellness program
* visit us online to view all nnl benefits!

**pay range**
-------------

$95,700.00 - $149,600.00 annually
  
  
salary information provided is a general guideline only. annual salary is based upon candidate experience and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations.

for more than 75 years, the naval nuclear laboratory has developed advanced nuclear propulsion technology, provided technical support, and trained world-class nuclear operators to ensure the safe and reliable operation of our nation's submarine and aircraft carrier fleets. the naval nuclear laboratory is a national asset solely dedicated to the naval nuclear propulsion program. we rely on the dedication and innovation of our nearly 8000 engineers, scientists, technicians, and support personnel.

title: Business Intelligence Engineer
description:
azenta inc.

### **at azenta, new ideas, new technologies and new ways of thinking are driving our future. our customer focused culture encourages employees to embrace innovation and challenge the status quo with novel thinking and collaborative work relationships.** **all we accomplish is grounded in our core values of customer focus, achievement, accountability, teamwork, employee value and integrity**

**job title**
-------------

business intelligence engineer

**job description**
-------------------

**how you’ll add value:**

  

the business intelligence (bi) engineer is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining enterprise data and analytics solutions that enable data-driven decision-making across the organization. this role will build and optimize cloud-based data platforms, design scalable etl (extract, transform, load) pipelines, and develop curated datasets that support reporting, dashboards, advanced analytics, and artificial intelligence initiatives.

working within aws, snowflake and postgresql-based data environments, the bi engineer will transform complex business and operational data into trusted, actionable insights while ensuring data quality, governance, and scalability.

  

**what you’ll do:**

  

**data engineering and etl development:**

  

* design, develop, and maintain etl pipelines that integrate data from enterprise applications, operational systems, apis, and third-party platforms
* build automated processes to extract, load, and transform structured and unstructured data into analytics-ready datasets
* implement data validation, cleansing, enrichment, and monitoring processes
optimize data pipelines for performance, scalability, and reliability  

  

**snowflake data platform:**

  

* design and manage snowflake databases, schemas, tables, views, and data models
* develop and maintain dimensional, operational, and semantic data models to support analytics and reporting. create structured and governed datasets that enable self-service business intelligence
optimize snowflake performance through effective clustering, partitioning, and query tuning  

**aws data lake & cloud analytics:**

  

* develop and support aws-based analytics solutions utilizing:
  + amazon s3
  + amazon sagemaker
  + aws glue
  + amazon athena
  + aws lambda
  + amazon aurora postgresql
* design and maintain s3 data lake structures and table architectures that support enterprise reporting and analytics
* support data ingestion and transformation processes from multiple internal and external data sources
design, develop, and optimize postgresql database objects including schemas, tables, views, materialized views, stored procedures, and data transformation logic to support analytics and reporting workloads  

**reporting & business intelligence:**

  

* partner with business stakeholders to understand reporting and analytics requirements
* create and maintain reusable datasets, kpis, metrics, and reporting structures
* support dashboard and visualization development utilizing bi and reporting tools
enable self-service analytics through governed data models and semantic layers  

**ai & advanced analytics enablement:**

  

* collaborate with data science and ai teams to prepare and curate datasets for machine learning models
* support data engineering activities required for amazon sagemaker and ai initiatives
develop scalable data assets that support predictive analytics and operational intelligence  

**data governance & quality:**

  

* establish and maintain data quality standards and controls
* document data lineage, mappings, business rules, and transformation logic
* ensure compliance with data governance, security, and regulatory requirements
participate in master data and metadata management initiatives  

  

**what you will bring:**

  
* bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, data analytics, engineering, or related field
* 4+ years of experience in business intelligence, data engineering, analytics engineering, or related disciplines
* strong experience with etl development and data integration.
* hands-on experience with snowflake
* hands-on experience with postgresql, including query optimization, schema design, indexing strategies, and performance tuning
* strong sql development, data modeling, and postgresql database development expertise
* experience working within aws cloud environments
* experience developing and managing enterprise reporting datasets
* knowledge of dimensional modeling, data warehousing, and analytics best practices
experience with python or other scripting languages for data processing  

**preferred qualifications:**

  

* experience with amazon sagemaker and machine learning data preparation

* experience with aws glue, athena, lambda, and s3-based data lake architectures

* experience with power bi, tableau, or similar analytics platforms

* familiarity with apache iceberg, parquet, or modern data lake table formats

* aws and/or snowflake certifications

* experience supporting ai, predictive analytics, or enterprise data strategy initiatives

* experience with postgresql advanced features such as partitioning, materialized views, json/jsonb, extensions, and analytical query optimization

* experience implementing medallion architecture (bronze/silver/gold) or similar multi-layer data lake design patterns

experience with change data capture (cdc), event-driven architectures, data products, and operational analytics platforms  



**your working conditions:**

  

* general office setting
this position qualifies for a hybrid schedule - 4 days in-office,1 day working remote

description:
at verint, we believe customer engagement is the core of every global brand. our mission is to help organizations elevate customer experience (cx) and increase workforce productivity by delivering cx automation. we hire innovators with the passion, creativity, and drive to answer constantly shifting market challenges and deliver impactful results for our customers. our commitment to attracting and retaining a talented, diverse, and engaged team creates a collaborative environment that openly celebrates all cultures and affords personal and professional growth opportunities. learn more at www.verint.com .

**overview of job function**

the senior software engineer is responsible for all aspects of the development of platforms and applications. this is a highly skilled hands-on role requiring extensive proficiency involved in all aspects of the development of cloud-based software solutions. subject to their specialization, this senior software engineer leads the design, development, testing, publishing, and/or support of different cloud-based products and solutions and serves as subject matter expertise for customer implementation and cloud platform support. the senior software engineer works closely with a global team of engineers to build robust solutions that meet our business objectives following continuous integration and continuous deployment processes, while supporting software and associate software engineers. additionally, this role provides recommendations to management as to process, technologies, or other improvements intended to benefit productivity, efficiency and/or quality of the solutions developed by the team and leads the implementation of new solutions.

**principal duties and essential responsibilities**

* ongoing evaluation (test) of feature design – proactively work with others to identify issues or potential risk areas with the architecture and performance
* distill requirements from feature level into implementation level tasks
* develop features using best practices and ensure it fits with the architecture for the product
* ensure the right work is being done - ensure product qualities such as unit tests, automation, throughput, capacities, security & performance will be sufficient
* ensure design and implementation work meets the stakeholder’s requirements
* ensure that the feature design is correct for operations, as well as deployment and sustainability
* support departmental and team initiatives
* work with team technical architect and lead to define, document, and communicate coherent feature design
* communicate relevant risks and issues to team lead and other relevant team members inside and/or outside the team
* provide technical leadership to less experienced members of the team – mentor, coach, continuous improvement
* take responsibility for technical implementation and decision making including the delivery of features
* identify, monitor and resolve feature related issues; escalate if individual resolution is not possible
* review documentation and guides created by more junior members of the team
* guide software engineers on how to create sufficient, complete documentation and guides that help onboard new people to the team
* ensure stakeholders understand feature architecture
* maintain communication with stakeholders and ensure changes to any previously agreed solutions are communicated; understand evolutionary paths
* work with assigned partners to ensure an effective and productive relationship, both within the product house and the wider regional verint support organization.
* prioritize and resolve technical problems and assist others with the same
* ensure the prioritization of scope (including defects) is understood
* understand the development process and suggest improvements to it
* identify areas of technical risk in a feature and options to de-risk
* support opportunities to address technical debt as part of a release
* support the design process and ensure it complies with product architecture
* support planning as regards estimates, dependencies, risk areas, and sequencing tasks

**minimum requirements**

* bachelor’s degree in computer science / software engineering (or similar)
* 5 years' experience in design and programming large scale applications through all phases of the software development life cycle including testing, implementation and auditing
* proven track record of delivery of complex features end-to-end
* 2 years experience mentoring mid to entry level engineers and influencing technical direction within a cross-functional squad
* strong proficiency in java (spring boot, spring mvc, jpa/hibernate)
* solid understanding of restful api design, oauth 2.0/jwt, and microservices patterns
* strong working knowledge of relational databases (postgresql, ms sql, oracle) including schema design and query optimization. solid exposure to nosql stores (redis, elasticsearch, mongodb)

title: Software Engineer 1 – Full-stack, Generative AI, Cloud
description:
at u.s. bank, we’re on a journey to do our best. helping the customers and businesses we serve to make better and smarter financial decisions and enabling the communities we support to grow and succeed. we believe it takes all of us to bring our shared ambition to life, and each person is unique in their potential. a career with u.s. bank gives you a wide, ever-growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive at every stage of your career. try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at—all from day one.

**job description**
-------------------

this position will be responsible for the analysis, design, testing, development and maintenance of best in class software experiences. the candidate is a self-motivated individual who can collaborate with a team and across the organization. the candidate takes responsibility of the software artifacts produced adhering to u.s. bank standards in order to ensure minimal impact to the customer experience. the candidate will be adept with the agile software development lifecycle and devops principles.  
  
**key responsibilities**

* design, develop, test, and maintain modern software applications using **java, spring boot, react, and typescript**.
* build and integrate **ai-powered capabilities**, including large language models (llms), retrieval-augmented generation (rag), and intelligent ai agents into business solutions.
* develop and support **rest apis, microservices, and cloud-native applications** following engineering best practices.
* collaborate with product owners, architects, and cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
* participate in all phases of the **software development lifecycle (sdlc)**, including design, coding, testing, deployment, and production support.
* contribute to ai experimentation, proof-of-concepts, and production implementations that drive business value and innovation.
* implement secure coding standards and comply with enterprise risk, security, compliance, and ai governance requirements.
* support **ci/cd pipelines, devsecops practices, automated testing, application monitoring, and cloud operations** to ensure reliable software delivery.

**basic qualifications**  

* bachelor’s degree, or equivalent work experience
* two to three years of relevant experience

**required skills & qualifications**

* experience developing applications using **java, spring boot, react, typescript, and restful apis**.
* knowledge of **sql and/or nosql databases** with the ability to design and interact with scalable data solutions.
* familiarity with cloud platforms such as **microsoft azure, aws, or google cloud platform (gcp)**.
* understanding of **object-oriented programming, software design patterns, and modern software engineering principles**.
* exposure to **generative ai technologies**, including llms, prompt engineering, ai agents, and retrieval-augmented generation (rag).
* experience using development tools such as **git, github, github copilot, ci/cd pipelines, and automated testing frameworks**.
* knowledge of **cloud-native architectures, containerization, docker, kubernetes, and microservices-based application development**.
* strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills with a passion for learning emerging technologies and delivering customer-focused solutions.

**technologies used**: java | springboot | react | typescript | rest apis | github | github copilot | azure | ai services | azure openai | azure ai search | aws bedrock | sql/nosql databases | docker | kubernetes | ci/cd pipelines.

**location expectations**  
this role requires working from a u.s. bank location three (3) or more days per week.

if there’s anything we can do to accommodate a disability during any portion of the application or hiring process, please refer to our disability accommodations for applicants.

**benefits:**

our approach to benefits and total rewards considers our team members’ whole selves and what may be needed to thrive in and outside work. that's why our benefits are designed to help you and your family boost your health, protect your financial security and give you peace of mind. our benefits include the following:

* healthcare (medical, dental, vision)
* basic term and optional term life insurance
* short-term and long-term disability
* pregnancy disability and parental leave
* 401(k) and employer-funded retirement plan
* paid vacation (from two to five weeks depending on salary grade and tenure)
* up to 11 paid holiday opportunities
* adoption assistance
* sick and safe leave accruals of one hour for every 30 worked, up to 80 hours per calendar year unless otherwise provided by law

review our full benefits available by employment status here.

u.s. bank is an equal opportunity employer. we consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, religion, color, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or veteran status, and other factors protected under applicable law.

u.s. bank participates in the u.s. department of homeland security e-verify program in all facilities located in the united states and certain u.s. territories. the e-verify program is an internet-based employment eligibility verification system operated by the u.s. citizenship and immigration services.

u.s. bank will consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records for employment. u.s. bank conducts background checks consistent with applicable local laws, including the los angeles county fair chance ordinance and the california fair chance act as well as the san francisco fair chance ordinance. u.s. bank is subject to, and conducts background checks consistent with the requirements of section 19 of the federal deposit insurance act (fdia). in addition, certain positions may also be subject to the requirements of finra, nmls registration, reg z, reg g, ofac, the nfa, the fcpa, the bank secrecy act, the safe act, and/or federal guidelines applicable to an agreement, such as those related to ethics, safety, or operational procedures.
