title: AI and Data Platform Engineer
description:
**position:** ai and data platform engineer – full time/exempt

**department:** information technology

**reports to:** director, cloud and system engineering

**location:** arizona cardinals (tempe, az) *note: starting 2028, this role will be based at the* *new arizona cardinals training facility in north phoenix, az* (https://www.azcardinals.com/news/new-arizona-cardinals-practice-facility-on-target-for-opening-in-2028)*.*

**format:** in-person

*note: applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the u.s. we are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of a student or employment visas (including, but not limited to f-1, m-1, j-1, h-1b, opt and/or cpt programs, etc.).*

  

**cardinals organizational summary:**

the arizona cardinals football club is a professional football team within the national football league (nfl). we compete in the national football conference (nfc) west division and call state farm stadium, in glendale, arizona, our home.

as one of the oldest pro football franchises in the u.s., the club has established itself as a sport and cultural hallmark within arizona, as well as a trailblazer for diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging (deib) initiatives and firsts around the league. our vision is to build a leading sports organization that competes for championships, drives business results, creates loyal fans, develops proud employees, and inspires hope in our community. we are relentless in our pursuit of greatness on and off the field, while positively impacting our people, our fans, and our community.

if you want to join an organization that values putting the team first, doing what is right, growing with positivity, valuing every voice, while driving performance, we would love for you to join our team. learn more about the arizona cardinals and see what’s happening here (https://www.azcardinals.com/community/).

  

**job summary:**

the arizona cardinals are seeking a highly motivated, innovative, and technically skilled ai and data platform engineer to support the organization's expanding artificial intelligence, data management, and enterprise technology strategy.

this role serves as a critical bridge between modern data platforms, cloud-based ai services, business applications, and enterprise systems. the ai & data platform engineer will be responsible for designing, administering, and optimizing cloud data and database platforms, supporting ai initiatives and use cases, enabling secure access to enterprise data, and integrating ai capabilities into business applications, workflows, and data solutions.

the ideal candidate possesses strong experience with modern cloud data platforms, database technologies, and ai solutions, with a passion for building secure, scalable, and data-driven systems that improve decision-making, operational efficiency, employee productivity, and business outcomes.

this position supports the arizona cardinals' business operations, football operations, stadium operations, and corporate functions while ensuring data integrity, security, governance, and compliance with organizational and league requirements. ai, cybersecurity, and data governance are strategic priorities of the arizona cardinals and the national football league; therefore, this role will play a key part in enabling secure, responsible, and scalable ai adoption across the organization. other responsibilities include event support, game day duties at games, training camp and extended trips. this position will be required to work at all home games and team functions at the state farm stadium located in glendale, az.

  

**primary job duties:**

the ai and data platform engineer position will have the daily responsibilities, without limitation, to include the following:

ai platform administration & enablement

* administer and support enterprise ai platforms including microsoft copilot, azure ai services, approved large language model (llm) platforms, and future ai technologies.
* partner with business units to evaluate, prioritize, and implement ai use cases that drive operational efficiency and business value.
* support ai training, prompt development, adoption programs, and end-user enablement initiatives.
* assist with ai model integrations, automation workflows, and ai-powered business processes.
* monitor ai platform usage, performance, security, and adoption metrics.
* serve on the cardinals ai council to manage the ai use case requests and communication with the nfl.
* support ai governance initiatives, documentation, and compliance requirements.
* collaborate with cybersecurity teams to ensure ai solutions are implemented securely and align with organizational policies.

database & data systems administration

* design, administer, monitor, optimize, and maintain enterprise databases and data repositories.
* ensure database performance, availability, reliability, backup, recovery, and disaster recovery capabilities.
* manage sql server and other database technologies supporting business-critical applications.
* support database migrations and modernization initiatives, including migration from traditional on-premises databases to paas and cloud-native database services.
* develop and maintain database standards, procedures, documentation, and operational runbooks.
* troubleshoot database and data platform issues while ensuring minimal disruption to business operations.

data integration & enterprise systems support

* design and support integrations between enterprise applications, cloud services, databases, and ai solutions.
* develop and maintain apis, data pipelines, etl processes, and automation workflows.
* enable secure access to structured and unstructured data for analytics, reporting, and ai use cases.
* collaborate with application owners and business stakeholders to improve data quality and accessibility.
* support data warehouse, reporting, business intelligence, and analytics platforms.

data governance & security

* maintain data integrity, quality, classification, retention, and lifecycle management practices.
* support data governance initiatives and compliance with internal standards, league requirements, and regulatory obligations.
* implement security controls for databases, ai platforms, and integrated systems.
* assist with audits, reporting, and risk assessments related to data and ai environments.
* ensure appropriate access controls and role-based permissions are maintained.

collaboration & innovation

* partners with it, cybersecurity, cloud engineering, football operations, business intelligence, and business units to identify opportunities for innovation.
* participate in technology evaluations, proof-of-concepts, and pilot programs involving ai and emerging technologies.
* provide technical guidance and recommendations regarding enterprise data architecture, ai adoption, and systems modernization.
* support stadium operations, special events, training camp, and game-day technology initiatives as required.
* other duties as assigned.

  

**qualifications/requirements**

* **education:** bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, data science, information technology, software engineering, or a related technical field

* **experience:** at least 2 – 5 years of experience in in database administration, systems administration, cloud platforms, or related technology roles.

* ai & automation
* + knowledge of artificial intelligence, generative ai, machine learning, and enterprise ai platforms.
  + experience supporting ai tools such as microsoft copilot, azure ai services, openai, anthropic, or comparable solutions.
  + understanding of prompt engineering, ai adoption practices, and ai governance principles.
  + familiarity with automation platforms such as microsoft power platform, power automate, logic apps, or similar technologies.
* data engineering & modern data platforms
* + support data lake and lakehouse architectures using technologies such as azure data lake storage, amazon s3, databricks, microsoft fabric, delta lake, and apache spark.
  + experience with database performance tuning, optimization, monitoring, backup, recovery, and disaster recovery.
  + partner with analytics and ai teams to create trusted, reusable data products and curated datasets for power bi, ai applications, and advanced analytics. experience supporting large-scale enterprise data environments.
  + prepare and optimize enterprise datasets for generative ai, machine learning, semantic search, and retrieval-augmented generation (rag) use cases.
  + understanding of lakehouse architecture, medallion architecture, dimensional modeling, data warehousing, and data mesh/data product concepts.
  + knowledge of data modeling, database architecture, and data integration methodologies.
  + experience supporting large-scale enterprise data environments.
* systems integration
* + experience developing and supporting apis, integrations, etl processes, and enterprise workflows.
  + develop and maintain etl/elt pipelines using azure data factory, fabric, databricks, aws glue, lambda, step functions, or comparable services
  + understanding of cloud-based integration services and modern data architectures.
  + experience integrating ai services with enterprise applications and business systems.
* cloud & enterprise technologies
* + knowledge of microsoft azure cloud services and enterprise cloud architectures.
  + familiarity with microsoft 365, power platform, active directory, entra id, and enterprise collaboration tools.
  + understanding of data warehousing, analytics, and business intelligence solutions.
* cybersecurity & governance
* + understanding of cybersecurity best practices related to databases, ai platforms, and enterprise applications.
  + knowledge of data governance, data privacy, retention, and compliance principles.
  + experience implementing security and access controls across enterprise systems.
* strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* excellent organizational and project management skills.
* ability to communicate complex technical concepts to technical and non-technical audiences.
* strong customer service orientation and stakeholder management skills.
* ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, highly visible environment.
* commitment to continuous learning and staying current with emerging ai and data technologies.
* experience supporting generative ai deployments in an enterprise environment, preferred.
* familiarity with data cataloging, data classification, and data governance platforms, preferred.
* experience within professional sports, entertainment, media, or large event-based organizations, preferred.
* experience supporting mission-critical operations requiring high availability and rapid issue resolution, preferred.

* flexibility to work evenings, weekends, and holidays; hours will vary depending on business needs.

* must complete all pre-employment forms and successfully pass a background check.

  

**cardinals benefits/perks summary:**

the arizona cardinals football club has developed a comprehensive benefits package that provides economic and inclusive benefits to full-time employees. the cardinals benefits offer care, protection, and support for employees and their loved ones. the cardinals organization encourages an environment that is conducive to living a healthy, productive, and flexible lifestyle.

benefits and perks include, but are not limited to:

* health, dental, and vision insurance options; effective the first day of hire
* 401 (k) retirement option with employer match contribution
* paid time off accruals (including sick time accruals)
* paid time off for most federal holidays
* time off for maternity, paternity, military, and bereavement
* mdlive: 24/7 medical support
* flexible spending accounts (fsa) & health care saving account options
* discounts on cardinals gear & paraphernalia
* tuition reimbursement & professional growth opportunities
* daily free lunch
* complimentary season tickets
* subsidized gym memberships

  

*the arizona cardinals football club is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, disability, gender identity, marital or veteran status, or any other protected class.*

title: Customer Reliability Engineer
description:
### **about us**

ai coding is the largest use case of enterprise ai adoption today, as is evident from the success of anthropic on claude code, cursor’s $60b exit to spacex, and cognition’s $48b valuation.  
  
the bottleneck now has moved from code generation to security and safety - ai agents write code faster than any team can review it, and over 65% of the lines of code produced by them are insecure. vulnerabilities are piling up 16x faster than companies can fix them, and adversaries are able to exploit these new vulnerabilities within hours.  
  
auri by endor labs closes that gap. it runs inside the harness where coding agents work, through hooks, skills and mcp, so the controls sit outside the model and every agent action is visible. underneath is our patented code context graph, which maps code, open source, containers and infrastructure. it shows which vulnerabilities can actually be reached and exploited, then delivers fixes that won’t break the application. security teams get evidence instead of noise, and developers get fixes instead of tickets.  
  
the companies building ai trust us to secure it - our customers include openai, spacex, doordash, dropbox, atlassian, mongodb, snowflake, robinhood and peloton to name a few.  
  
endor labs is the third company from founder & ceo varun badhwar, who built prisma cloud, the platform that helped define cloud security, from $0 to $300m arr at palo alto networks. we’ve raised $163m from lightspeed, coatue, dfj growth, salesforce ventures and dell technologies capital.  
  
software runs everything around our lives today - banking, hospitals, airports and power grids. ai now writes more of it every day, and our mission is to make sure the world can trust that software. come build that future with us.

#### **about the role**

customer reliability engineering (cre) is the highest-level technical support function within customer solutions. it operates as an escalation function, a peer to account management and closely aligned with post-sales field engineering. cre bridges customers and engineering by owning complex product behavior in the field, so other post-sales teams can stay focused on strategic platform use rather than firefighting.

✱ cre is a customer engineering role, not just a support role. we don't stop at diagnosing a problem. when the right fix is in the code, we write it, and when the team needs a tool that doesn't exist, we build it.

we work with urgency (the baton is on fire), we fix root causes rather than just patching today's problem, and we take extreme ownership of every engagement from start to finish. nobody should ever have to ask cre for a status update. if they do, we've failed to exceed the urgency or to communicate next steps clearly.

**how you'll make an impact**
-----------------------------

* **own technical escalations end-to-end.** lead complex product issues from first report to resolution, coordinating across customer solutions and engineering.
* **run point on incidents.** lead response to global and customer-specific incidents, understand customer impact, and communicate clearly and proactively to technical users and executives alike.
* **diagnose, root cause, and fix.** investigate unexpected product behavior using diagnostic tools, system logs, and the endor labs codebase, and hand engineering a clear path to the fix. if you’re comfortable in the codebase, you’re welcome to open the pr yourself.
* ✱ **build tools and applications.** design and build internal tools, scripts, automations, product features, and lightweight applications that speed up diagnosis, automate repetitive escalation work, and give support and account teams better visibility into customer health.
* **drive reliability and prevention work.** turn incident patterns into durable fixes, runbooks, tests, and guardrails so the product is easier to support at scale.
* **partner across the company.** share field insights with account teams, engineering, and product, and raise the quality of technical support across customer solutions through mentorship and enablement.
* **coordinate with engineering and r&d.** file, track, prioritize, and expedite resolution of critical customer bugs and complex technical issues, and make your own code contributions easy for them to review.
* **balance reactive and proactive work.** respond to account-team-triggered escalations while investing in fixes that stop tomorrow's version of today's issue from happening.
* **help define success.** contribute to the kpis and slas for escalation and incident response, including our 24x5 coverage for larger enterprise customers.

**what you'll bring to the table**
----------------------------------

* **5+ years of experience** in a customer-facing tier 3, escalation support, customer support engineering, sre, or software engineering role within a saas or developer tools environment.
* ✱ **strong software engineering skills.** you're a proficient programmer in go, python, or javascript/typescript (or a proven record of picking up new languages quickly), with real experience writing production-quality code, tests, and pull requests.
* ✱ **a track record of building.** you can point to tools, services, or applications you've designed and shipped, whether internal automation, dashboards, clis, or full applications.
* **proven troubleshooting skills.** you can dive into complex, unfamiliar codebases, analyze system logs, and debug api and infrastructure interactions.
* **incident management experience**, including staying calm and communicating clearly during high-severity, high-visibility events.
* **a structured problem-solving approach.** you can synthesize inputs from multiple sources and prioritize under pressure.
* **outstanding written and verbal communication**, with a knack for translating complex technical concepts for both developers and executive leaders.
* **an ownership mindset.** you're proactive, resourceful, and willing to drive issues to resolution with incomplete information, without waiting to be chased.
* **a passion for application security (appsec)**, open-source software, and developer workflows.

**nice to have**

* hands-on experience with source control systems (github, gitlab, bitbucket) and ci/cd pipelines.
* deep familiarity with cloud-native technologies, including docker, kubernetes, and major cloud providers (aws, gcp, azure).
* experience troubleshooting full-stack or api-backed applications, and building tools on top of observability and ticketing systems.
* experience writing runbooks, postmortems, or tooling that reduces repeat incidents.
* active use of ai-assisted development tools (e.g., cursor, claude, github copilot) to accelerate diagnosis, fixes, and tool-building.

#### **why endor labs**

we're building at the intersection of developer productivity and security, one of the fastest-growing spaces in software. our developer-loved platform delivers measurable roi, strong market momentum, and a customer base that deeply values our mission.

at endor labs, we **think big, start small, and learn fast**. we take ownership, move with purpose, and always start with customer success. we debate with data, make the complex simple, and challenge each other with kindness and candor. we celebrate wins, learn from misses, and have fun along the way, because when our customers win, we all win.

*endor labs is an equal opportunity employer. we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. even if you don't meet every single requirement listed above, we strongly encourage you to apply. we value diverse perspectives, transferable skills, and a passion for learning.*

title: AI Platform Engineer
description:
**about us**

johnson controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

for more than 140 years, johnson controls has delivered performance where it really matters. backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results and help move society forward.

johnson controls international (jci) is looking for an ai platform engineer to join the ai engineering & platforms team. this role focuses on building, automating, securing, and operating the enterprise landing zones and shared services that enable ai, machine learning, generative ai, and agent-based solutions across jci.

you will work across cloud platform engineering, infrastructure as code, devops, networking, security, observability, and service operations. the role is platform-first: creating reusable capabilities, governed deployment patterns, and reliable self-service experiences for ai engineering, data science, product, and business teams.

**how you will do it**

**enterprise ai landing zones & cloud platform engineering**

  

* build and operate secure, scalable ai landing zones and shared platform services, primarily on azure and increasingly across aws.
* develop reusable infrastructure modules and deployment patterns using terraform and terragrunt, with consistent configuration across development, test, and production environments.
* provision and support azure ai foundry, azure machine learning, azure openai, ai search, document intelligence, container apps, app services, function apps, key vault, azure container registry, storage, cosmos db, redis, application insights, log analytics, and supporting services.
* contribute to aws ai/ml platform capabilities using services such as amazon bedrock, sagemaker, api gateway, lambda, s3, iam, and associated networking and security services.
* design platform services so new capabilities can be onboarded through repeatable modules, documented standards, and approved deployment patterns.

**ai gateways, model access & runtime services**

  

* build and operate governed access to foundation models and ai services through azure api management and equivalent cloud gateway patterns.
* implement authentication, authorization, secrets management, rate limiting, quotas, routing, retries, circuit breakers, usage tracking, and cost controls for model and api consumption.
* support pay-as-you-go and provisioned-throughput model deployments, model upgrades, endpoint lifecycle management, capacity planning, and controlled access for consuming teams.
* enable secure hosting patterns for apis, agents, containerized workloads, scheduled jobs, and event-driven services using managed cloud platforms.

**automation, ci/cd & developer enablement**

  

* create and maintain azure devops pipelines for infrastructure deployment, validation, policy checks, application hosting, and controlled releases.
* build automated testing for terraform modules, platform services, networking, security controls, and deployment smoke tests.
* create sample projects, templates, reference implementations, runbooks, and onboarding documentation that help teams adopt the platform safely and quickly.
* work with consuming teams to troubleshoot platform access, networking, identity, certificates, private endpoints, deployment, and runtime issues.

**security, governance, reliability & operations**

  

* implement private networking, managed identities, entra id integration, rbac, least-privilege access, secrets management, logging, auditability, and secure-by-default configurations.
* partner with cybersecurity, cloud engineering, networking, enterprise architecture, ai governance, and service owners to move solutions from development into supported production environments.
* build dashboards, alerts, health checks, monitoring, and operational metrics for platform availability, model usage, cost, capacity, and service quality.
* participate in incident response, root-cause analysis, problem management, platform maintenance, change management, and continuous improvement.
* support platform request, approval, provisioning, documentation, and handover processes, ensuring solutions remain supportable and compliant.

**collaboration & engineering standards**

  

* collaborate with ai engineers, data scientists, solution architects, product teams, and cloud specialists to translate use cases into reusable platform capabilities.
* contribute to architecture reviews, technical design decisions, backlog refinement, sprint delivery, code reviews, and platform roadmap planning.
* promote engineering practices focused on automation, reliability, security, maintainability, cost awareness, and clear technical documentation.

**qualifications & skills**

**required**

  

* bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5+ years of experience in cloud, devops, platform, sre, infrastructure, or mlops engineering roles.
* hands-on experience building production azure solutions using terraform and azure devops.
* strong knowledge of cloud networking, private endpoints, dns, identity, rbac, managed identities, secrets, and secure service-to-service connectivity.
* experience with containerized and managed application platforms such as azure container apps, app services, functions, docker, or kubernetes.
* experience implementing ci/cd, automated testing, deployment controls, monitoring, alerting, and operational support for production services.
* proficiency in at least one scripting or programming language such as python, powershell, or bash.
* ability to diagnose complex infrastructure, networking, authentication, certificate, deployment, and runtime issues.
* clear communication and documentation skills, with the ability to work across engineering, architecture, security, governance, and product teams.

**preferred**

  

* hands-on experience with azure ai foundry, azure openai, azure machine learning, azure ai search, document intelligence, or similar managed ai services.
* experience designing or operating api gateways using azure api management, including policies for authentication, routing, throttling, retries, observability, and usage controls.
* experience developing reusable terraform modules and working with terragrunt, remote state, module versioning, and environment promotion patterns.
* experience with enterprise landing zones, hub-and-spoke networking, private cloud services, policy enforcement, and multi-subscription or multi-account environments.
* experience operating ai or ml platforms, including model endpoints, capacity, quotas, evaluation services, vector search, rag infrastructure, or agent runtimes.
* working knowledge of cloud cost management, service reliability, incident management, and platform product thinking.

**nice to have**

  

* experience with aws platform engineering, including bedrock, sagemaker, api gateway, iam, lambda, s3, vpc networking, terraform, or terragrunt.
* experience with multi-cloud ai gateway, model-routing, or centralized model-access patterns.
* knowledge of llmops, agent orchestration, mcp, rag, embeddings, vector databases, model evaluation, safety, or observability patterns.
* experience with opentelemetry, siem integration, dashboards, load testing, resilience testing, or performance engineering.
* exposure to servicenow-based request and fulfilment processes, cmdb, application onboarding, or enterprise architecture approval processes.
* relevant certifications such as azure administrator, azure solutions architect, azure devops engineer, azure ai engineer, aws solutions architect, or terraform associate.
* experience supporting global teams and services across multiple regions, time zones, and regulatory environments.

**mindset**

  

* platform-first engineer who looks for reusable solutions rather than one-off deployments.
* security-conscious and comfortable balancing delivery speed with enterprise controls.
* operationally minded, with a focus on reliability, supportability, automation, and continuous improvement.
* pragmatic problem solver who can work through ambiguity and evolving cloud and ai technologies.

title: Software and Data Engineer - Software Engineer III- Agentic Pricing
description:
**job description**  
  
  

we have an exciting and rewarding opportunity for you to take your software engineering career to the next level.
  
  
as a software engineer iii at jpmorganchase within the commercial and investment bank digital & platform services, data analytics, you serve as a seasoned member of an agile team to design and deliver trusted market-leading technology products in a secure, stable, and scalable way. you are responsible for carrying out critical technology solutions across multiple technical areas within various business functions in support of the firm's business objectives.

jpmorganchase is hiring top talent to join the growing commercial & investment bank technology organization within digital & platform services / data analytics, building production ai agents on neo that leverage the firm's scale, data, and full-service advantage to deliver measurable impact across the commercial & investment bank and payments. as a senior ai application engineer, you'll design, productionize, and operate llm-powered agents on neo (the firm's agent runtime paas on aws/azure), partnering closely with business, product, and engineering teams in a fast-paced environment.  
  
**job responsibilities**

* design and ship production agents on neo across the federated portfolio, owning them from prototype through production.
* build retrieval that holds up in production: graph rag combining knowledge-graph traversal with vector search, plus chunking, ranking, and grounding strategies that keep answers accurate and auditable.
* design agent memory: episodic and semantic memory organized as memory nodes, with recall, summarization, and decay policies tuned per use case.
* own organizational context management — assembling entitlement-, lineage-, and tenant-aware context so each agent reasons over only what it's allowed to see.
* compose multi-agent workflows using a2a, and integrate tools and data through mcp servers (bitbucket, confluence, databricks, kubernetes, snowflake, splunk).
* build and run evals: task-level and end-to-end agent evaluations, regression suites, llm-as-judge, and quality/safety gating before release.
* deploy and operate solutions on public cloud (aws and, or azure) with strong sdlc, security, resiliency, and observability practices.
* partner with product and business partners across cib and payments to turn use cases into shipped, supported agents.
* proactively identifies hidden problems and patterns in data and uses these insights to drive improvements to coding hygiene and system architecture

**required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* formal training or certification on software engineering concepts and 3+ years applied experience with working on ai/ml solutions.
* hands-on practical experience delivering system design, application development, testing, and operational stability
* advanced in one or more programming language(s) - strong programming skills in python, with deep knowledge of data structures, algorithms, machine learning, data mining, information retrieval, and statistics.
* hands-on experience building llm-powered or agentic applications in production, including tracing, evaluations, and guardrails.
* deep proficiency with kubernetes and amazon eks, micro-vm isolation (e.g., firecracker, kata containers, gvisor), and sidecar architectures, with proven experience designing defense in depth across the stack: network and mtls, workload identity, fine-grained authorization, runtime isolation for untrusted or adversarial workloads, and application-level guardrails
* practical rag experience — retrieval quality, embeddings, and vector stores; expert knowledge of at least one of: aws, azure, kubernetes.  
  knowledge of data management and data model design; real-time processing using  
  both sql (e.g., postgres) and nosql stores (e.g., opensearch, redis).
* excellent communication skills with the ability to partner effectively with senior technical and business stakeholders.
* proficient in all aspects of the software development life cycle
* advanced understanding of agile methodologies such as ci/cd, application resiliency, and security
* in-depth knowledge of the financial services industry and their it systems

  **preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills**
* ms in computer science, statistics, mathematics, machine learning, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* experience with agent frameworks or runtimes, a2a, or mcp. agent memory design (memory nodes, episodic/semantic memory) and organizational context management.
* knowledge graphs and graph databases used for retrieval. graph rag a strong plus.
* understanding of llm fine-tuning and small language model inference.
* ability to develop full-stack products using modern javascript/typescript frameworks (e.g., next.js, svelte) for agent uis (ag-ui , neo ui sdk).
* experience working in the financial or payments domain at a large institution (investment banking, markets, securities services, or adjacent).
* knowledge of high-performance languages such as go or rust

**about us**  
  
  

jpmorganchase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the j.p. morgan and chase brands. our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.

we offer a competitive total rewards package including base salary determined based on the role, experience, skill set and location. those in eligible roles may receive commission-based pay and/or discretionary incentive compensation, paid in the form of cash and/or forfeitable equity, awarded in recognition of individual achievements and contributions. we also offer a range of benefits and programs to meet employee needs, based on eligibility. these benefits include comprehensive health care coverage, on-site health and wellness centers, a retirement savings plan, backup childcare, tuition reimbursement, mental health support, financial coaching and more. additional details about total compensation and benefits will be provided during the hiring process.

we recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. we are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. we do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. we also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. visit our faqs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

jpmorgan chase & co. is an equal opportunity employer, including disability/veterans

  
  
**about the team**
  
  
j.p. morgan's commercial & investment bank is a global leader across banking, markets, securities services and payments. corporations, governments and institutions throughout the world entrust us with their business in more than 100 countries. the commercial & investment bank provides strategic advice, raises capital, manages risk and extends liquidity in markets around the world.

title: Senior Backend Software Engineer
description:
kensho is s&p global’s hub for ai innovation and transformation. with expertise in machine learning, natural language processing, and data discovery, we develop and deploy novel solutions to innovate and drive progress at s&p global and its customers worldwide. kensho's solutions and research focus on business and financial generative ai applications, agents, data retrieval apis, data extraction, and much more.

at kensho, we hire talented people and give them the autonomy and support needed to build amazing technology and products. we collaborate using our teammates' diverse perspectives to solve hard problems. our communication with one another is open, honest, and efficient. we dedicate time and resources to explore new ideas, but always rooted in engineering best practices. as a result, we can innovate rapidly to produce technology that is scalable, robust, and useful.

kensho’s applications group develops the web apps and apis that deliver kensho’s ai capabilities to our customers. our teams are small, product-focused, and intent on shipping high-quality code that best leverages our efforts. we’re collegial, humble, and inquisitive, and we delight in learning from teammates with backgrounds, skills, and interests different from our own.

  

as a senior backend engineer, you will develop reliable, secure, and performant apis that apply kensho’s ai capabilities to specific customer workflows. you will collaborate with colleagues from product, machine learning, infrastructure, and design, as well as with other engineers within applications. you have a demonstrated capacity for depth, and are comfortable working with a broad range of technologies. your verbal and written communication is proactive, efficient, and inclusive of your geographically-distributed colleagues. you are a thoughtful, deliberate technologist and share your knowledge generously.

**what you’ll do:**

* work with key stakeholders to develop system architectures, api specifications, implementation requirements, and complexity estimates

* thoughtful and efficient communication skills (both verbal and written)

title: Analytics Engineer, Data Platform
description:
proper hospitality builds and operates a growing collection of luxury lifestyle hotels, restaurants and residences defined by design, culture, wellness and a strong sense of place, across proper hotels, by proper and the collective.  
  
**position overview**  
we're seeking an analytics engineer to join our corporate team in los angeles. our warehouse and core raw pipelines are built. your job is to keep them healthy, make them easy to use, and strengthen the foundation for ai-native work like workflows and data agents.  
  
this is an end-to-end, full-stack role focused primarily on data pipelines and  
foundations, with a front-row lens into how the hospitality industry runs.  
  
***what you'll do***

**maintain & improve our pipelines (core of the role)**

* monitor, triage, and resolve data pipeline bugs and failures, and find root  
  causes rather than patching symptoms
* manage the intake and prioritization of data issues and requests, and keep stakeholders informed
* keep data models, tests, and documentation current so the warehouse stays trustworthy
* spot recurring failure patterns and build monitoring, alerting, and data quality checks to prevent them

**build internal tooling & infrastructure**

* design and deploy tools and infrastructure that let teams access and work with data in our data hub
* automate repetitive operational work (backfills, access provisioning,  
  validation, reconciliation)
* own the deployment and configuration of the supporting services behind  
  these tools

**build the foundation for ai-native work**

* make sure data is clean, well-modeled, secure, and documented enough to support ai workflows, data agents, ml, and advanced analytics
* partner with analysts, data scientists, and operators to productionize datasets, features, and agent-ready data
* help make ai tools usable and trustworthy for non-technical operators

**support stakeholders**

* respond to data requests from finance, revenue, marketing, operations, and property teams
* translate business questions into the right data answers, and know when  
  something needs a new model rather than a one-off query
* document institutional knowledge such as data quirks, definitions, and lineage

**occasional analytics work**

* build and maintain reports and dashboards as needed

**learn the business from the ground up**  
the best data work comes from understanding the operations behind the  
numbers. expect to:

* take part in site visits to our properties
* join training sessions and hands-on operator learning experiences
* spend time with the front desk, f&b, events, and revenue teams to see how the systems you support are used day to day

***what we're looking for***  
  
**ideal background**

* 3+ years of experience in data engineering, or 5+ years in data science or  
  analytics
* new grads 1-2 years of experience in a data or analytics role) will be  
  considered if they demonstrate extremely strong proficiency, extraordinary tenacity, and genuine humility

**required**

* strong sql and deep, hands-on experience with snowflake, including building and operating pipelines with orchestration (tasks, streams, dynamic tables, or an external orchestrator)
* experience building data pipelines and models that others depend on  
  python (or a comparable language) for tooling, automation, and pipeline work
* working knowledge of git and ci/cd, or a willingness to learn it quickly
* a methodical approach to debugging: you reproduce, isolate, and find the root cause
* strong fundamentals in coding and systems design that you can demonstrate without ai assistance
* clear communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders, and the judgment to manage competing requests

**nice to have**

* experience with a range of business intelligence and visualization tools (e.g., tableau, looker, sigma, power bi)
* experience with our stack:
  + snowflake security and governance: rbac design, masking policies, row-level access, and data sharing
  + github actions for orchestration and deployment, alongside native  
    snowflake orchestration
  + transformation frameworks (e.g., dbt) and ingestion tools
  + python services deployed on a cloud hosting platform, and infrastructure as code
  + hospitality source systems: property management infor hms, f&b point of sale toast, sales crm, hr, and revenue management  
    experience building with llms, agents, ai-powered workflows, or internal data apps
  + data modeling and dimensional design, plus testing and observability practices

**what success looks like**

* first 30 days: take ownership of the issue queue and stakeholder requests. you learn the stack, visit a property, and become the person teams go to when something looks off.
* first 90 days: help generate new, value-additive work: new datasets,  
  analyses, or interactive data tools that give the business something it didn't have before.
* first 6 months: raise the quality of our data pipelines and make a major  
  change to our core snowflake platform to make it more scalable, with  
  improvements across data security, data modeling, cost management, or  
  rollout infrastructure.

**our interview process**  
we want to see how you think, so part of our process is a technical assessment  
completed without ai assistance. you should be able to work through a systems design discussion and a basic coding exercise on your own. we use ai heavily in our day-to-day work and expect you to as well, but strong fundamentals are what let you direct it well and catch it when it's wrong. beyond that, expect conversations about your past work and how you approach stakeholders and ambiguity.  
  
**logistics**

* in-person hybrid at our santa monica, ca office, 3 days per week
* occasional travel to our properties for site visits and training
* **compensation**: $140,000-160,000, based on experience and skills

  

***proper perks & benefits***

**culture of growth & belonging**

* **culture of growth**: a collaborative, design-forward environment that values creativity, intelligence, and curiosity — where learning and excellence are a daily practice.
* **guided skills development**: access to training, leadership programs, mentorship, and cross-property mobility to encourage achievement and discovery.
* **diversity, equity, inclusion & belonging**: we honor individuality while fostering a culture of respect and belonging across all teams.
* **community engagement**: opportunities to give back through local volunteerism, sustainability, and charitable partnerships.

**health & wellness**

* **comprehensive health coverage**: medical, dental, and vision plans through aetna, designed to fit a range of personal and family needs.
* **wellness access**: company-subsidized memberships with equinox and classpass, plus wellbeing
* workshops and mental health resources.
* **employee assistance program (eap)**: confidential support for emotional wellbeing, financial planning,
* and life management through unum.

**time off & flexibility**

title: Senior Front-End and Agentic-UI Engineer
description:
**your future evolves here**

evolent partners with health plans and providers to achieve better outcomes for people with most complex and costly health conditions. working across specialties and primary care, we seek to connect the pieces of fragmented health care system and ensure people get the same level of care and compassion we would want for our loved ones.

join evolent for the mission. stay for the culture.

**what you’ll be doing:**

**job description**

**position summary**

the senior software engineer leads the design, development, and deployment of complex features in the web user experience for the evolent platform. this role builds high-performance react and next.js (typescript) features and works closely with product managers, ux designers, and other engineers to translate business needs into technical solutions.

this individual drives the technical direction of features, contributes to front-end architecture discussions and long-term planning, and mentors junior engineers to foster a culture of continuous learning and technical excellence. the role is expected to use approved ai-assisted tools to accelerate delivery and improve quality while remaining fully accountable for every result delivered.

**ai-assisted engineering expectations**

evolent engineers are expected to effectively leverage approved ai-assisted development and productivity tools (e.g., code assistants, copilots, automation agents, knowledge assistants, and analytics tools) to improve quality, efficiency, and innovation while maintaining accountability for all delivered work. these expectations span the full engineering lifecycle, not only code generation, including iterating with ai on solution design and architecture, evaluating alternatives, revising existing architecture, and producing design artifacts. engineers remain responsible for validating outputs, ensuring solution quality, protecting sensitive information, and complying with security, privacy, regulatory, and responsible ai standards.

**key responsibilities**

**design and development**

* lead the design, development, and deployment of complex front-end features in react and next.js, ensuring scalability, accessibility, and maintainability.
* build server and client components that follow the team’s rendering and caching standards, including read-your-writes behavior for decision forms.
* implement backend-for-frontend (bff) endpoints and integrate with .net (c#) and python (fastapi) services, and entra id / openid connect authentication.
* build data-heavy screens, including large grids, pdf and document viewers, rich-text editors, and workflow wizards, using component libraries such as kendoreact or mui.
* collaborate closely with product managers, ux designers, and other engineers to translate business needs into technical solutions.
* drive the technical direction of features, contributing to front-end architecture discussions and long-term planning.

**agentic user experience**

* build streaming user interfaces (sse) that render agent narratives, tool calls, citations, and generative ui using the vercel ai sdk, assistant-ui, and copilotkit over the ag-ui protocol.
* implement human-in-the-loop flows that let reviewers approve, modify, or override agent recommendations, including pydantic ai tool-approval interrupts.
* implement robust handling for slow, interrupted, or failed agent calls, including retries, timeouts, resumable streams, and clear status messaging.
* contribute to the ag-ui event contract and shared-state design with the agent team.

**engineering excellence**

* conduct thorough coding reviews, provide constructive feedback and ensure adherence to best coding practices.
* mentor and coach junior engineers, fostering a culture of continuous learning and technical excellence.
* build accessible components that meet wcag 2.1/2.2 aa and section 508 and resolve accessibility defects.
* write component and end-to-end tests using vitest, react testing library, and playwright.
* identify and implement improvements to ci/cd pipelines, supply-chain controls, and opentelemetry instrumentation.
* troubleshoot and resolve production issues, working to ensure high availability and reliability of the user experience.

**ai-enabled delivery**

* utilize approved ai-assisted engineering tools, such as github copilot, to accelerate software development, testing, documentation, troubleshooting, and analysis activities.
* evaluate and validate ai-generated outputs for correctness, security, maintainability, compliance, and business appropriateness.
* continuously identify opportunities to improve engineering productivity and solution quality through ai-enabled workflows and automation.
* contribute reusable prompts, skills, agents, and ai-assisted development patterns to benefit the team.

**governance and compliance**

* follow enterprise policies governing ai usage, intellectual property protection, security, privacy, phi handling, and responsible ai practices.
* handle patient data safely under hipaa, keeping phi out of browser storage, client logs, and telemetry.
* ensure no confidential, regulated, or protected information is used with unapproved ai services or tooling.
* participate in peer reviews and validation processes for ai-assisted solutions.

**required qualifications**

* 5+ years of professional software development experience, including 3+ years building production web applications with react and typescript.
* hands-on experience with next.js, including server and client components, server-side rendering, and streaming.
* experience building streaming or real-time user interfaces using server-sent events or websockets.
* experience building data-heavy enterprise screens using component libraries such as kendoreact (telerik) or mui.
* experience integrating front ends with rest apis and backend services, including the backend-for-frontend pattern.
* experience implementing authentication with entra id (azure ad) and openid connect.
* strong knowledge of wcag 2.1/2.2 aa and section 508, with experience building accessible applications.
* experience with vitest or jest, react testing library, and playwright.
* experience with docker, ci/cd with github actions, and git-based workflows, including pull requests.
* strong, daily use of ai-assisted development tools such as github copilot.
* ability to work both independently and as part of a globally distributed team of technical and non-technical colleagues.
* excellent problem-solving skills, with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex technical issues quickly.
* strong communication skills, with the ability to lead technical discussions, present to stakeholders, and write detailed documentation.

**preferred qualifications**

* hands-on experience with agentic ui frameworks and protocols such as ag-ui, copilotkit, assistant-ui, or the vercel ai sdk.
* experience designing human-in-the-loop experiences for ai agents, including approval and override workflows.
* familiarity with python and pydantic ai.
* experience with fhir r4; da vinci prior authorization support (pas) a plus.
* experience consuming events from azure service bus or similar message brokers.
* experience with kubernetes (aks) and opentelemetry.
* experience with c# and .net.
* experience integrating ai services, models, or agents into production applications.
* healthcare domain experience, including handling phi under hipaa.

**education**

* bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

to ensure a secure hiring process we have implemented several identity verification steps, including submission of a government issued photo id. we conduct identity verification during interviews, and final interviews may require onsite attendance. all candidates must complete a comprehensive background check, in-person i-9 verification, and may be subject to drug screening prior to employment. the use of artificial intelligence tools during interviews is prohibited and monitored. misrepresentation will result in immediate disqualification from consideration.

**brief posting description:**

the p eb enterprise data & analytics department of the p enterprise architecture & planning division at hawaiian electric company has 1 management vacancy available. (role: professional)

  

**job function:**

the business analytics engineer is a recognized subject matter expert in data analytics supporting the enterprise or specific domains by leading business analytics services and data-driven solutions through the data science disciplines. these roles focus on optimizing data models, business aggregate (“last mile”) data pipelines and leveraging data as a strategic enterprise asset to enhance business performance, process effectiveness, predict outcomes and develop business intelligence to support data driven decisions. these roles are able to tell the story of data, evangelize good data usage, advise, and teach while transforming data into information, information into insight and insight into business actions.

  

specific functional domain expertise may be required: this position works across all functional data domains and enterprise-wide across hawaiian electric company, hawaii electric light company and maui electric company (the companies).

  

**essential functions:**

* **data science & analytics:** extracts knowledge and insights from high volume, high dimensional data using advanced statistical analysis, algorithms, predictive modeling, experimentation and pattern recognition to create solutions that enable enhanced business performance.
* **data modelling & transformation**: converts existing or new models into scalable analytical solutions and creates processes for data modeling, mining, and production and applies software engineering best practices to analytics code to provide clean, transformed data ready for analysis.
* **machine learning:** provides support for developing machine models and research into new artificial intelligence applications.
* **data solution management:**
  + supports and/or leads the companies to timely deliver, manage, enhance and upgrade analytical solutions that increase business value, improve data reliability, efficiency, quality, useability and meet corresponding key performance indicators (kpis).

  + proactively monitors industry, functional, and technology trends, guiding business partners on emerging opportunities and new technology/product development and maintains multi-year data analytic plans, roadmaps and strategy for leadership consumption.
* remain available for both scheduled and unscheduled work. said work is occasionally required outside normal business hours and on weekends.
* participates in company emergency response activities as assigned, including any activities required to prepare for such emergency response.

  

**basic qualifications:**

**knowledge requirements**

* a bachelor's degree in data analytics, data science, computer science, management information systems, business analysis, business management, engineering, finance, statistics, or related fields (or equivalent work experience) is required.
* requires thorough knowledge of business and data analysis, including working with unstructured data, in support of business data requirements elicitation, documenting, standardizing, validating and thorough to extensive knowledge of operations and delivery concepts, principles, standards, tools, techniques, methodologies for data analytics to solve complex problems.
* understanding of distributed computing, cloud technologies with azure experience preferred.
* familiarity with agile methodology, devops, and experience leading cross-functional teams in a dynamic environment.
* working knowledge of utility business, business and/or engineering principles & practices preferred.
* proficiency in key analytical tools: for example, pyspark (preferred), r, python/jupyter, sas, power bi, tableau, matlab, etc.
* strong knowledge of popular database programming languages including sql, pl/sql, for relational databases and upcoming nonrelational databases/distributed data/computing tools.
* thorough experience working with popular data discovery, analytics and bi software tools like power bi, tableau, and others for semantic-layer-based data discovery.
* experience in commercial/open-source data discovery/analysis platforms for “big data” with preference for: spark, databricks ml, with thorough knowledge and practical experience using databricks for machine learning/data science strongly preferred.
* working knowledge of statistical methods and data mining techniques (predictive modeling, segmentation, regression, etc.) and experience in working with data science teams in refining and optimizing data science and machine learning models and algorithms.

  

**skills requirements**

* demonstrated leadership and interpersonal skills (effective written, oral and listening communication) in order to work effectively with all levels of the company and with outside contractors and consultants.
* demonstrated strong analytical skills and thorough data literacy with the ability to describe business use cases/outcomes, data sources and management concepts, analytical approaches/options and solve business problems with advanced analytical solutions.
* ability to communicate complex information to technical and non-technical audiences, facilitate multi-level briefings and superior presentation skills, including storytelling and other techniques to guide and inspire.
* ability to conceptualize new ideas quickly and ability to learn new technologies on the job.
* communicates difficult concepts and negotiate adoption of new perspectives across the enterprise while mentoring teams and facilitating knowledge transfer.

* several (3-5) years experience with project management, working in cross-functional teams with business stakeholders, in support of multi-departmental data management and analytics initiatives is preferred.
* electric utility experience and azure, databricks, sap, big data, cloud based architecture experience is desirable.

title: Automation Software Engineer
description:
**description**

sanmina corporation (nasdaq: sanm) is a global powerhouse in integrated manufacturing solutions serving the fastest growing segments of the global electronics manufacturing services (ems) market. we are a global engine providing the end-to-end manufacturing backbone for the world's most essential and innovative brands. whether it's autonomous vehicles, life-saving medical tech, next-gen aerospace, or ai/cloud infrastructure - our integrated solutions don’t just meet standards—they redefine them.

### **summary**

sanmina turtle lake, wisconsin is a full-service plastic injection molding, electronics integration and design service facility. they have 50 injection molding machines and expertise with engineering-grade resins. sanmina turtle lake has long standing business partnerships with both tool designers and manufacturers. as a software engineer on the automation team, you are expected to contribute to the evolution of our company’s smart factory initiatives, fostering innovation through advanced automation, analytics, and digital solutions. your responsibilities include building, deploying, and maintaining software solutions that bridge operational environments and enterprise it systems. these systems will be utilized by our manufacturing group for informed decision making. your daily activities include conducting factory assessments, defining scope of work, identifying missing data and hardware, and implementing various levels of coding and mes configuration to ensure accurate data flow from machines to the system.

automation software engineer

### **what you'll do**

* conduct plant surveys to evaluate the current automation landscape, identifying missing data points, hardware gaps, and network limitations required for mes deployment
* develop detailed design proposals that define the scope of work for mes production order control implementation
* collaborate proactively with multi-disciplinary teams
* develop and maintain 42q iot application modules
* contribute to the development of iot platforms
* participate in iot standardization discussions and planning (connectivity standards, web of things, etc)
* determine optimal communication routes for data transfer between machine/line control plcs, mes, and scada systems
* interface with instrumentation, sensors, and process control equipment to capture relevant production data
* validate and troubleshoot mes integration, ensuring accurate, real-time data flow from shop floor equipment to mes servers
* conduct thorough data validation tests to ensure collected information is accurate, reliable, and aligned with business requirements
* collaborate with software developers, digital transformation teams, and factory engineers to design and implement innovative solutions
* research and introduce new digital technologies, including ai-driven analytics, predictive maintenance solutions, and process automation enhancements

### **experience you'll bring**

* application & scripting development: design, write, and maintain clean, scalable, and modular code using object-oriented and scripting languages.
* system integration & networking: bridge technical gaps between plant operations and it by understanding network architecture, protocols, and constraints. provide technical guidance to it teams to prevent operational roadblocks.
* server & container management: deploy, configure, and manage applications using docker containers and standard linux server environments.
* database management: structure, query, and maintain relational databases supporting internal systems and operations.
* designs iot systems that analyze performance trends
* interface with departments to define and manage projects
* designing scada systems which may include databases and database interfaces, data handling & reporting, scripting (42q, vb, python, etc.) and general programming
* understanding project requirements to develop/configure industrial control packages for use in our manufacturing environment
* understanding technical and operational constraints to create projects and implementation plans
* documentation & record keeping: maintain excellent records and write comprehensive, easy-to-understand documentation for code, apis, and system configurations to ensure smooth transitions and clarity for future developers.
* troubleshooting & debugging: perform root-cause analysis on complex software and system issues to quickly identify and resolve bugs.
* cross-functional communication: gather and translate project requirements across diverse stakeholders, including global business systems, global security, global it, and local plant teams.

### **how to stand out**

* operating systems: strong proficiency in linux environments, as it will serve as the primary environment for programming, server management, and application deployment.
* programming languages: proficiency with object-oriented and scripting languages, specifically typescript, javascript, and python.
* databases: practical experience managing and querying relational databases (mysql, postgresql).
* containerization & devops: solid understanding of docker, writing dockerfiles, and managing multi-container applications with docker compose.
* version control: proficiency with git and platform workflows in gitlab (branching, merge requests, ci/cd pipelines).
* solid understanding of http requests, restful apis, and messaging protocols like mqtt.
* foundational knowledge of enterprise networking infrastructure, ip protocols, and network configuration principles to effectively interface with it teams.
* infrastructure: experience with linux-based server deployment, configuration, and continuous management.
* experience with java and/or c/c++.
* hand-on experience working in or interfacing with manufacturing plant environments.

education & experience:

* bachelor degree in computer science, computer/software engineering, automation or equivalent experience

### **why join us?**

at sanmina, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. this provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.

#optumtechpj

description:

* energy + climate + nature
* food + water + waste
* health
* learning + society

**project description**

xprize is seeking an experienced ai-native software engineer to support the build of our new **prize execution platform** — a unified system replacing our current, fragmented set of tools and expanding significantly on what they do today. the platform will manage the full lifecycle of an xprize competition in a single ecosystem connecting four core user groups:

* **xprize staff**, who design and configure competitions, manage milestones and timelines, oversee submission intake, coordinate judging, and track prize disbursement.
* **competitors**, who register teams, submit applications and milestone deliverables, track their progress through the competition lifecycle, and receive ai-assisted matchmaking with relevant mentors.
* **judges**, who review and score submissions — supported by ai-assisted scoring and automated submission review tools that surface relevant context and flag issues before human review.
* **alumni**, who stay connected to the xprize ecosystem post-competition through community and continued-engagement features.

ai is embedded directly into the product, not just the development process. core ai-powered capabilities include:

* **ai-assisted judging and scoring** to support judges with consistent, efficient evaluation.
* **automated submission review** to pre-screen and triage incoming applications and deliverables.
* **competitor-mentor matchmaking** to connect competing teams with relevant subject-matter mentors.
* **an applicant-facing chatbot** to answer questions and guide competitors through the application and submission process.

this is a net-new platform, not a like-for-like migration — it will consolidate and significantly extend the capabilities of xprize's current tooling. the engagement will be built using spec-driven and ai-assisted development practices on a .net, angular/react, and python stack.

the ideal consultant can move quickly within a defined scope, work independently with minimal ramp-up, and deliver production-quality results on a set timeline — while also helping xprize's internal engineering team build lasting capability in ai-assisted and spec-driven development practices.

**scope of work:**

* design, develop, and deliver features and modules across the prize execution platform, including competition management, submission intake, judging/scoring, competitor and mentor matchmaking, and applicant-facing ai tools within the defined project scope, using .net, angular/react, and python as needed.
* collaborate with the internal product and engineering team to confirm requirements, milestones, and acceptance criteria for the engagement.
* deliver clean, maintainable, and tested code that meets the quality, security, and testing criteria defined in the statement of work and the technical guidelines provided at kickoff.
* submit work product for xprize review at agreed milestones, and join technical planning and review sessions as needed to confirm requirements and acceptance criteria.
* use ai-assisted development tools (e.g., claude code, github copilot, or similar) as the primary development workflow — for scaffolding, refactoring, test generation, debugging, and documentation.
* apply ai-first, spec-driven development practices, translating specifications into ai-assisted implementation, and document this workflow so it's reusable by the internal team after the engagement ends.
* evaluate and refine ai-generated code for correctness, security, and architectural fit.
* transfer knowledge to xprize's internal engineers — including training on ai-assisted and spec-driven development methods used on this project — as part of project deliverables.
* deliver clear technical documentation enabling the internal team to maintain and extend the solution post-engagement.

**qualifications:**

* bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering, or equivalent experience.
* minimum 4 years of hands-on experience developing full stack web applications, including prior consulting/contract engagements.
* demonstrated ability to ramp up quickly on an existing codebase and deliver independently within a defined scope and timeline.
* hands-on experience using ai coding tools such as claude code, github copilot, cursor, or similar in a professional workflow, with concrete examples of impact on delivery speed and quality.
* demonstrated experience with ai-first, spec-driven development, with the ability to teach this approach to an internal team as part of a knowledge-transfer deliverable.
* ability to critically evaluate ai-generated code for security, performance, and architectural consistency.
* strong proficiency in .net technologies and python.
* proven experience with angular (v12+) or react w/ typescript.
* solid understanding of html5, css3, javascript, and typescript.
* proficiency with sql server or other relational database systems.
* familiarity with azure, git, and ci/cd pipelines (e.g., github actions, azure devops, or similar).
* able to deliver the milestones in the statement of work within the engagement timeline.
* excellent problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills; comfortable working independently with minimal day-to-day oversight.

**work arrangement**

this is a fully remote engagement. the consultant may work from any location within the united states, subject to applicable tax and legal requirements. the consultant determines when and where the work is performed. the consultant will attend milestone reviews and collaboration sessions, which are scheduled by mutual agreement and are expected to occur approximately 2-3 times per week. the consultant is expected to be reasonably responsive to xprize team communications during u.s. pacific business hours. expected effort is approximately 30-40 hours per week, not to exceed 40 hours without written approval.

**tools and access**

xprize will provide access to the ai-assisted development tools, repositories, cloud environments, and accounts needed for this engagement (including claude code, github, azure etc.). to protect xprize data and systems, the consultant will use xprize-provided tools and environments for all work involving xprize code, data, or confidential information, and will not input xprize confidential information into unapproved ai tools or services. the consultant is responsible for providing their own computer, internet connection, and general office equipment. access will be revoked at the end of the engagement.

**intellectual property and confidentiality**

all work product created under this engagement, including code, documentation, specifications, prompts, workflows, and training materials, will be owned by xprize and assigned to xprize under the consulting agreement. the consultant will be required to sign a confidentiality agreement and ip assignment before starting work.

**independent contractor status**

the consultant will be engaged directly by xprize as an independent contractor and will receive irs form 1099. the consultant is not an employee of xprize and is not eligible for employee benefits, including health insurance, retirement plans, or paid time off. the consultant is responsible for their own taxes, insurance, and business expenses. the consultant controls the means and methods of their work, within the scope, milestones, and acceptance criteria agreed in the statement of work.

**compensation**

$75-85/hour based on skills and experience

please note: submitting a resume or proposal does not make you a candidate for engagement. you will be considered a candidate only after xprize contacts you directly to begin the engagement process, which may include interviews, a technical assessment, reference checks, and a background check where permitted by law. final engagement is contingent on execution of a written independent contractor agreement, including confidentiality and ip assignment terms. xprize is an equal opportunity organization and considers all qualified individuals regardless of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic.
