title: Sr. Data Scientist - Supply Chain
description:
are you a current us foods employee? please apply directly through our internal workday career site

join our community of food people!

the sr data scientist – supply chain role will lead forward-looking analytics initiatives across time series forecasting, supply chain demand, buying, and inventory optimization, including data exploration, decision modeling, statistics, measurement sciences, and machine learning operations. the main responsibilities include, but are not limited to, developing and productionalizing customized forecasting and optimization models that improve demand accuracy, inform buying decisions, and right-size inventory, while enhancing supply chain replenishment by balancing a breadth of constraints, variables, and cost considerations. this role requires a deep analytical, technical, and complex problem-solving skill set with expertise in time series forecasting, mathematical optimization, statistical analysis, and advanced machine learning and deep learning techniques.  
  
the sr data scientist proactively works with cross-functional teams to understand the business context of supply chain problems that may be solved using ml and optimization, and presents data science solutions to stakeholders in an iterative fashion. they work with associate data scientists, data scientists, and decision scientists to translate business challenges into well-structured forecasting, optimization, or ml problems, kickstarting foundational work including data exploration, feature engineering, hypothesis testing, and baseline modeling. they play a key role in selecting and implementing the appropriate analytical approach and create the model feasibility document in close collaboration with the team. the sr data scientist may have direct reports including associate data scientists and data scientists.

**the work for the sr data scientist position is completely remote anywhere in the united states except hawaii or united states territories.**

**responsibilities**

as a sr data scientist, you will be expected to:

* work with associate data scientists and data scientists in researching data sources, data cleansing, feature engineering, and creating baseline models
* independently lead the formulation and development of forecasting, optimization, and ml models while managing multiple model development projects
* design, implement, and refine advanced ml and deep learning models for both time series forecasting and optimization to solve large-scale, real-world supply chain demand, buying, inventory, and replenishment problems
* collaborate and engage with various cross-functional stakeholders to ensure close coordination between data science and business stakeholders including the product management team
* provide full ownership of the model development from inception to implementation including the machine learning pipeline, documentation, model drift, and remodeling strategy
* mentor the associate data scientists and data scientists in data science knowledge and their interactions with other stakeholders
* coordinate with the ml team, anticipating deployment issues upfront, setting the stage for resource requirements, and ensuring the success of model deployment and retraining
* take and delegate ownership of critical tickets or issues faced by business stakeholders as assigned by the lead data scientist or director of data science
* read and independently navigate through extensive codebase with a focus on troubleshooting, debugging, and/or improvement of code
* contribute to coding standards and coding conventions and proactively participate in enforcing sound coding practices across the data science team
* create and maintain documentation of the ml models, data sources, and methodology
* assist in the creation of feasibility documents
* proactively participate in the core team processes including r&d, recommending, and implementing process improvements or new methodologies
* share knowledge with other various teams and members by presentation at periodic internal team sessions/workshops
* guide usage of development methodologies (scrum, kanban, etc.) and assist in their implementation in the group projects by deciphering details including features, tasks, estimates of efforts and timing, etc.

**relationships**

* **internal:** associate data scientists, data scientists, lead data scientists, principal data scientists, and director of ds.

**minimum qualifications**

  

as a sr. data scientist, you have:

* master’s degree in data science/mathematics/cs/statistics or similar field and 3+ years of experience or bachelor's degree and 6+ years of experience in data science
* effective written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to work and communicate effectively with team members and cross-functional teams
* an expert-level understanding of the following topics:
  + classification, regression, clustering, dimensionality reduction, association rule learning, bagging (e.g., random forests), boosting (e.g., adaboost, gradient boosting), neural networks and deep learning, model evaluation and metrics, cross-validation, hyperparameter tuning, optimization algorithms, nlp and more

* working knowledge of agile/scrum methodologies with 1-2 years of experience and a practical understanding of the epics, features, and tasks that may be most relevant and how much effort is required for them
* sufficient intellectual curiosity to investigate the latest developments in the field (for example llm/generative ai models)
* ability to see the big picture and anticipate issues in terms of deployment limitations, data latency, appropriateness of a particular implementation of algorithms, and mathematical details/assumptions
* at least 1+ years of working with a major cloud platform, creating ml models using frameworks from data exploration to deployment
* working knowledge in handling large datasets in a cloud environment
* working knowledge of how apis work, ci/cd (continuous integration/continuous deployment)
* understanding of devops and mlops principles
* 1+ years of writing production-grade code in scripting languages including bash, python, and sql with the ability to identify the areas of improvement, optimal choice of data structures, optimization of the code, and creating custom code to address unique situations
* proven, independent ability to navigate a data lake environment while creating training datasets or feature stores
* effective skills in creating, deploying, and troubleshooting containers in the context of ml modeling
* 1+ years of experience with version control systems/concepts, such as git, for tracking changes in machine learning projects
* ability to investigate/research ml frameworks/algorithms, datasets, feature stores, and contribute to solving data science problems
* capability of providing macro-level thought leadership to the junior members including the data scientists regarding best practices, issues, causes, and respective resolutions of those issues

**preferred qualifications**

  

* 2 years of supply chain analytics experience, preferably in replenishment systems, time series forecasting, order optimization, network optimization, inventory management, and/or logistics

  

* preferred 1+ year of optimization & operations research experience with experience writing production-grade code in optimization modeling languages; gurobi, pyomo, pulp, etc.

this role may also receive annual incentive plan bonus

program.

title: Sr. Data Analyst - Tableau Developer
description:
**location:**

4910 tiedeman road, brooklyn ohio

**job description**

as part of key’s second line-of-defense compliance risk management function, the risk evaluation and assurance program (the “rea program”) has the responsibility for evaluating key’s ongoing compliance with applicable laws and regulations through the execution of compliance and operational risk monitoring and testing across key’s lines of business, products, and functional activities. this role will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining tableau dashboards and reporting solutions that support regulatory compliance, risk management, control monitoring, and executive decision-making. the ideal candidatde possesses strong data visualization skills, experience working with large and complex datasets, and an understanding of governance, risk, and compliance processes. this individual will work closely with rea, risk management, internal audit, data analytics, and technology partners to transform data into actionable insights that support effective risk oversight and regulatory compliance.

**essential job functions**

* work within a team of risk evaluation and assurance professionals, working to design, develop, and maintain tableau dashboards, scorecards, and self-service reporting solutions to provide an independent second-line-of-defense approach to risk-based monitoring, testing, and analytics.
* demonstrate strong collaboration skills by partnering with business teams to gather reporting requirements and translate them into scalable analytical solutions.
* explore and analyze data to identify trends and outliers, evaluate compliance with internal policy/procedures and/or regulatory requirements, and assess root cause(s) of any issues identified.
* develop data models and data visualization standards that support regulatory reporting, compliance monitoring, control testing, risk assessments, and issue management activities. ensure data accuracy through validation, reconciliation, and quality assurance procedures. optimize tableau workbooks for performance, usability, scalability, and maintenance.
* connect tableau to multiple data sources, including sql server, cloud-based data warehouses, data lakes, and enterprise reporting repositories.
* develop and support automated reporting processes and recurring management reporting packages. create technical documentation, data dictionaries, and user training materials.
* support audits, regulatory examinations, and management inquiries related to compliance reporting and analytics.
* working knowledge, as well as ability and interest in maintaining, and continuously developing knowledge of banking products (e.g. – lending, deposits, etc.) and ability to understand its applicability to data analytics, testing, and monitoring strategies.
* ability and interest in developing knowledge of financial services industry source systems (e.g. loan origination/servicing, deposits, etc.), operations/process flows, banking regulations, and compliance frameworks.

**required qualifications**

* bachelor’s degree in information technology/systems (it / mis), business analytics, computer science, or other related quantitative or it field of study.
* minimum 2 years of practical and functional experience in data analysis and reporting typically achieved through work as a: business, data, operations, compliance, or risk analyst; internal auditor; or role that includes significant aspects of the listed essential job functions.
* strong sql skills, including complex joins, aggregations, window functions, and performance optimization.
* skill and ability to work with big data and navigate data warehouse(s) and retrieving, combining, and analyzing data.
* experience with retrieving and a proficient understanding of banking products and transactional data and customer information data.
* autonomous, self-motivated, and flexible with the ability to adapt quickly to change or shifting priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* high ethical standards, strong critical/strategic thinking, detective, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* strong interpersonal skills, effective communication (verbal and written) with the ability to develop and maintain strong, collaborative relationships in a team environment and with mid- to senior-level management and internal clients.
* **required technical skills:** tableau desktop, tableau server / tableau cloud, sql, data visualization and dashboard design, microsoft excel

**preferred skills/competencies**

* knowledge of financial services industry source systems (e.g. loan origination/servicing, deposits, etc.), operations/process flows, banking regulations, and compliance frameworks.
* advanced knowledge, professional certification, or expertise in database querying, data transformation, data visualization, and/or analytical software or programming languages (e.g. sas, sql, acl, tableau, etc.)
* **preferred technical skills:** python, sas, bigquery, power bi, etl and data integration tools

title: Junior Software Engineer
description:
**junior software engineer, boulder, co or raleigh, nc (hybrid)**

  

we're building a pipeline of top-tier **software engineer** candidates at ascend analytics to be part of a collaborative team advancing software solutions and analytics to support the clean-tech power revolution. your strong software engineering skills will support mission critical decision analytics for renewable and battery storage power providers around the globe. while we may not have an immediate start date for every applicant, we review applications on an ongoing basis and reach out directly as new openings arise.

**our mission**

at ascend analytics, our mission is to create sustainable economic value for energy buyers and producers and transform the power industry. our team combines advanced analytics, cloud-based technology, and deep market expertise to help our clients solve complex challenges across grid reliability, power market volatility, renewable integration, infrastructure development, and energy investment strategy. as a high-growth, private equity-backed company, ascend continues to expand its market presence while investing in innovation, talent, and scalable solutions for an increasingly dynamic energy market.

**your impact**

real influence. real outcomes. at every level.

* **technical ownership.** build and ship features across our saas platform, writing clean, tested, well-documented code that our customers and internal teams rely on. you’ll take real tickets from day one and own them from design through deployment.
* **growth with support.** work alongside senior engineers who invest in your development through code reviews, pairing, and mentorship, so your technical skills grow with every sprint you ship.
* **engineering excellence.** help keep our codebase healthy by writing unit and integration tests, contributing to ci/cd pipelines, triaging bugs, and improving the reliability and performance of the systems that power our analytics products.
* **collaborative partnership.** work closely with product managers, data scientists, and fellow engineers to turn ideas into working software, and be a dependable voice in standups, design discussions, and cross-functional projects.

  

**key responsibilities**

* design and write clean, scalable, production code (our backend team primarily works in python, sql, sas, and c#; our frontend team works in react).

* refactor code for improved performance, stability, and scalability.

* develop automatic tests.

* work with our team of analysts and data scientists to integrate,  
  generalize, and prototype mathematical and data science models within production software.

* communicate clearly and effectively (orally and in writing) with both technical and nontechnical stakeholders.

* the software development team follows an agile scrum process, and all team members are expected to contribute to technical design reviews, implementation strategies, operational system support, and sprint planning.

  

**required qualifications**

* bs in engineering, computer science, data/information science, mathematics, or a related field.
* 3.0 cumulative gpa or higher.
* demonstrated academic or professional software coding experience in one or more of the following languages: python, ruby, .net, java, c++, c#, kotlin, rust, or javascript, including object-oriented design.

* strong background in programming related to applied mathematical, engineering, and physical sciences.
* team player with a willingness to learn.
* strong interpersonal skills, teamwork skills, and work ethic.

  

**preferred qualifications**

* self-starter who has implemented full-stack solutions (front-end and back-end development).

* candidates with the drive, work ethic, and desire to learn and quickly advance in their careers.

* knowledge of referential databases, such as sql server, oracle, or postgresql.
* knowledge of wholesale electricity markets is a plus.

  

**our values**

ascend analytics promotes a culture of teamwork, inclusion, work-life balance, creative thinking, and learning. we work with five core pillars:

* **integrity:** we act with honesty and uphold the highest ethical standards, doing the right thing even when it's difficult.
* **purpose driven:** we are united with a shared purpose to deliver meaningful impact on our customers, our industry, and the energy transition to a low-carbon future.
* **belonging:** we foster a respectful, inclusive environment where everyone is valued, diverse perspectives are embraced, and fair opportunities are provided for all.
* **innovation:** we predict and address new challenges, embracing change and continuous improvement
* **one team mindset:** we collaborate across teams and functions, supporting one another and prioritizing shared success over individual wins.

  

**your value**

we offer generous, fair compensation, calibrated to your experience and structured to grow with you, along with a comprehensive benefits package:

* **medical, dental, and vision** coverage.
* **life and disability** insurance.
* **parental leave** for growing families.
* **fsa, hsa, and dependent care** accounts.
* **401(k)** with a 3% non-elective contribution.
* **flexible pto** to take time when you need it.

  

**join a team that values your work, supports your growth, and invests in your future!**

we offer a competitive salary range of $78,000 — $91,000. compensation is flexible and tailored to your qualifications, relevant experience, and location of hire. but the perks don’t stop there — we’re committed to creating a workplace where people can do meaningful work, grow their careers, and still have a life outside the office. you’ll enjoy a comprehensive benefits package, flexible work hours, a collaborative environment, and real opportunities for advancement.

**collaboration is in our dna, and we thrive on the energy of working together — the spontaneous ideas, face-to-face teamwork, and culture you can only build in a room.**

but we also value the focus and freedom that remote flexibility brings. that's why our boulder, co office and raleigh, nc workspace run on a hybrid schedule (3 days in-office, 2 days remote).

**need accommodations? contact us at** **recruiting@ascendanalytics.com****.**

ascend analytics is an equal employment opportunity employer. we celebrate diversity and are committed to an inclusive environment for all employees regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, veteran status, disability, or genetic information.

by applying, you'll be considered for this role as positions open, and we'll follow up directly when there's a match to discuss next steps. have questions about our hiring timeline? reach out to us — happy to clarify what to expect.

**note:** we regret that we are currently unable to offer visa sponsorship.

information technology (it) is a strategic enabler for many functions at cornell university, with staff located across colleges, administrative units, and campuses throughout the institution. while comprised of many organizations, it operates as one partnering closely with faculty, staff, and students to support teaching, research, and business operations. by being embedded where the cornell community is, it is well positioned to provide support ranging from day‑to‑day needs to large, complex initiatives that advance major academic, research, and operational objectives across the university. check out this link to find out more about it@cornell

the **ai engineer** is responsible for designing, developing, and deploying production‑grade ai solutions that support administrative, academic, and research needs across the university. this role builds and maintains secure, scalable, and high‑performing ai applications—primarily leveraging generative ai, large language models (llms), and cloud‑native technologies. the ai engineer collaborates with project managers, business analysts, architects, developers, faculty, and it teams to deliver innovative solutions aligned with institutional strategy and technology standards.

the position contributes to building reusable ai capabilities, integrating ai services with enterprise systems, ensuring strong security and identity controls, and implementing engineering best practices. the ai engineer participates in the full software development lifecycle, supports production operations, and provides technical expertise to improve reliability, performance, and user experience.

  
  

while position responsibilities vary, every member of our community is expected to foster a culture of belonging and a healthy work environment by communicating across differences; being cooperative, collaborative, open, and welcoming; showing respect, compassion, and empathy; engaging and supporting others regardless of background or perspective; speaking up when others are being excluded or treated inappropriately; and supporting work/life integration of oneself and others.

title: AI Automation Engineer
description:
live events are fun.
  
  
concerts, sporting events, and festivals create memorable lifelong experiences with clients, prospects, partners, friends, and family—and they drive real business impact.
  
companies spend more than $600 billion each year on client entertainment.  
  
ticketmanager is the enterprise platform they trust to source, manage, track, and report on live event tickets and hospitality—while maintaining compliance, control, and visibility across the organization.
  
  
built at the intersection of live events, technology, and enterprise operations, ticketmanager makes client entertainment easy and measurable. our industry-leading software supports everything from invitations and event execution to post-event reporting, helping companies clearly prove roi and strengthen relationships through unforgettable experiences.
  
  
ticketmanager is trusted by thousands of global brands, including anheuser-busch, verizon, american express, nike, and visa, as well as fortune 500 companies, professional sports leagues, and major organizations such as the nba, nfl, ncaa, and nascar.  
  
we’re also proud to partner with some of the most iconic teams and venues in sports and entertainment, including the new york jets, philadelphia eagles and phillies, capital one arena, texas rangers, lafc, and seattle seahawks, along with more than 50 professional and collegiate teams, franchises, universities, and technology providers.  
  
**why work at ticketmanager**  
  
at ticketmanager, you’ll help build technology that brings people together through live experiences—while solving complex, real-world problems for the world’s best companies. we’re a fast-growing, profitable company that values ownership, collaboration, and excellence, and we’re building a team that’s passionate about making work impactful and fun.  
  
if you’re excited about live events, cutting-edge technology, and doing work that truly matters, you’ll feel right at home here.  
  
**the role**  
  
ticketmanager is building its ai and automation infrastructure from the ground up, and we are looking for a partner to build it with. as an ai automation engineer, you will work directly with the vp of enterprise technology & ai strategy to turn ai strategy into working systems: n8n workflows, mcp servers, llm integrations, chat and voice agents, and ai-driven engineering automation that makes the whole team faster.  
  
this is not a role with a fully written roadmap. requirements are fluid, projects range from a one-afternoon automation to a multi-month platform build, and the technology changes monthly. you will break things and fix them faster, stay endlessly curious, and set your own priorities. when the first three approaches fail, you find the fourth, because we believe there is always a way. your work will directly shape how ticketmanager operates, serves customers, and scales.  
  
**responsibilities:**

* build, maintain, and measure workflow automations in n8n across crm, erp, support, and fulfillment systems, from first prototype through stable production
* build, maintain, and measure custom mcp servers that connect claude and other models to internal systems and data
* build and manage integrations with claude, gemini, and other model apis, including prompt engineering and structured outputs

title: Senior Associate, Full-Stack Engineer
description:
bny's wove trading & rebalancing team builds and operates the technology platform behind pershingx — the digital investing, trading, and portfolio management experience for wealth management firms, advisors, and asset managers.

the platform spans 50+ microservices and microfrontends processing portfolio rebalancing, order generation, trade execution, sleeve allocation, tax harvesting, and investment operations across multiple custodians and investment products (sma, urpm, uma). our users range from individual financial advisors managing client portfolios to large-scale asset managers executing firm-wide model changes across thousands of accounts.

we ship production code daily across a polyglot stack: angular microfrontends (module federation), a nestjs graphql bff, java 21 / spring boot 3.x backend services, and kafka-driven event pipelines — all deployed on bny's cloud-native app engine infrastructure. we use ai-assisted engineering practices to accelerate the full software development lifecycle.

**the role**  
we are looking for a vice president, full-stack engineering lead in new york city to own the technical direction, delivery, and operational health of the wove trading & rebalancing platform.
  
this is a hands-on leadership role. you will write code, review architecture, lead incident response, and mentor engineers, while also driving the strategic roadmap with product and business stakeholders. you will be responsible for a platform that must be correct (it moves money), resilient (market hours are non-negotiable), and scalable (the client base is growing rapidly across multiple wealth management firms).

**architecture & system design**

* own the technical roadmap for the trading & rebalancing platform — from rebalancing compute engines and order generation pipelines to advisor-facing trading dashboards.
* design and evolve a multi-personal, multi-custodian entitlements architecture that supports advisors, home office users, portfolio managers, and asset managers — each with distinct data hierarchies, trading discretions, and custody constraints.
* drive the "one bff" initiative: consolidating functional and data entitlements resolution into a unified nestjs graphql middleware layer using strategy patterns, guard chains, and per-persona data scoping.
* make architecture decisions across the full stack — angular microfrontends, nestjs services, spring boot microservices, kafka consumers/producers, hazelcast distributed caching, and the datalake api persistence layer.

**full-stack engineering**

* build and maintain high-performance backend services in java 21 / spring boot 3.x — order generation engines, rebalancing workflows, allocation services, validation engines, custodian rules engines, and trade automation pipelines.
* develop and extend angular microfrontends using module federation — trading worksheets, order review screens, overview dashboards, trading rules configuration, tax harvesting, sleeve allocation, and custom rebalance uis.
* design and operate a nestjs graphql bff that resolves entitlements from ems and admin center, orchestrates downstream service calls, and delivers persona-aware data to the frontend.
* implement secure service-to-service communication using mtls certificates, oauth2/jwt, and kerberos authentication — all integrated with bny's api gateway and marketplace token exchange.
* trading & rebalancing domain
* deliver capabilities for portfolio rebalancing workflows, model management, proposed order generation, order review, and order submission — supporting equities, fixed income, and multi-asset sleeve strategies.
* build systems that handle multi-custodian complexity: pershing, schwab, and bank custody-including cross-hierarchy custodian bindings where different firms route through different custodians.
* implement per-client trading discretion configuration (e.g., one firm can trade true uma while another is restricted to sma/urpm only).
* ensure platform compliance with regulatory, audit, and risk requirements in a financial services environment.

**ai-enabled engineering**

* champion ai-assisted development across the sdlc- design, coding, testing, code review, documentation, and production support.
* drive engineering productivity through ai-powered tools for automated test generation, release impact analysis, and incident root cause identification.
* lead adoption of agentic ai workflows that integrate with the team's existing ci/cd, sonarqube quality gates, and gitlab pipelines.
* **operational excellence**
* own production readiness across the service catalog -availability, resiliency, observability (splunk, dynatrace), and platform health.
* lead major incident resolution and root cause analysis. market-hours downtime is not acceptable.
* reduce operational burden through automation, intelligent monitoring, and self-healing patterns.
* drive continuous improvement in deployment frequency, change failure rate, and mean time to recovery.

**people leadership**

* lead and mentor engineers across frontend, backend, bff, and platform disciplines.
* foster a culture of ownership, engineering excellence, and continuous learning.
* support hiring, talent development, and organizational growth.

**required qualifications**

* 5+ years of software engineering experience, with significant time designing and delivering distributed systems in financial services.
* deep hands-on expertise in at least two of the following, with working knowledge of all:
* java 17+ / spring boot 3.x -microservices, virtual threads, security filter chains
* angular 15+ -component architecture, signals, module federation / microfrontends
* nestjs / typescript- graphql resolvers, guards, interceptors, strategy patterns
* strong experience with event-driven architectures — kafka producers/consumers, async messaging, dead-letter queues, idempotent processing.
* experience with nosql persistence (mongodb or document stores) data modeling, query optimization, api-mediated access patterns.
* solid understanding of authentication and authorization in enterprise environments — oauth2, jwt, mtls, kerberos, entitlements systems.
* experience building multi-tenant or multi-persona platforms where different user types see different data, have different permissions, and follow different workflows.
* proven track record of leading agile engineering teams and delivering in a ci/cd environment with automated quality gates (sonarqube, security scanning).
* strong communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills.
* bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or equivalent professional experience.

**preferred qualifications**

* experience with wealth management, trading, or portfolio management platforms — rebalancing, order management, custody, or investment advisory systems.
* experience modernizing monolithic applications into microservices using the strangler pattern.
* familiarity with distributed coaching (hazelcast, redis) and real-time data patterns (websockets, sse).
* experience with observability platforms — splunk, dynatrace, appdynamics, or opentelemetry.
* experience implementing ai-assisted software development practices and engineering automation.
* knowledge of cloud platforms, container orchestration, and infrastructure-as-code.
* experience managing geographically distributed teams.
* series 7 / series 63 or cfa/caia is a plus but not required.
* advanced degree in computer science, engineering, finance, or a related field.

title: Machine Learning Operations Engineer I
description:
kensho is s&p global’s hub for ai innovation and transformation. with expertise in machine learning, natural language processing, and data discovery, we develop and deploy novel solutions to innovate and drive progress at s&p global and its customers worldwide. kensho's solutions and research focus on business and financial generative ai applications, agents, data retrieval apis, data extraction, and much more.

kensho is s&p global’s hub for ai innovation and transformation. with expertise in machine learning, natural language processing, and data discovery, we develop and deploy novel solutions to innovate and drive progress at s&p global and its customers worldwide. kensho's solutions and research focus on business and financial generative ai applications, agents, data retrieval apis, data extraction, and much more.

  

the mlops team is the de facto ml platform team at kensho. our team’s mission is critical: empower our ml engineers with state-of-the-art processes, tooling, and infrastructure to iterate quickly, build reliably, and identify potential production issues early. we sit at the intersection of infrastructure and ml, and work closely with all our ml teams (ml product teams, r&d, …) and our infrastructure teams (core infra, sre, security). we are a small and high-leverage team: our work practically touches every ai project at kensho. we balance pragmatic platform development with hands-on exploration at the frontier: building agentic applications ourselves, contributing to open-source tools, and defining what a mature agentic platform looks like before the industry has settled on the answers. you’re equally likely to find us at a top ml conference (neurips, iclr, icml) and at major software and infra conferences (amazon re:invent, pycon). to illustrate the point, within the same month, the same engineer went from reimplementing a prompt optimization research paper to shipping prometheus alerts.

digicert is a global leader in intelligent trust. we protect the digital world by ensuring the security, privacy, and authenticity of every interaction. our ai-powered digicert one platform unifies pki, dns, and certificate lifecycle management, to secure infrastructure, software, devices, messages, ai content and agents. learn why more than 100,000 organizations, including 90% of the fortune 500, choose digicert to stop today's threats and prepare for a quantum-safe future at www.digicert.com

**job summary**

**this position is for the ssl store, powered by digicert**

we are hiring a senior software engineer to build and run the platform behind our certificate management, tls and vulnerability monitoring, uptime, and security products. the platform is a typescript monorepo: fastify and express services, next.js and react frontends, mysql and redis, queues and workers on aws, deployed to kubernetes through terraform, helm, and azure devops pipelines. it also carries a legacy .net estate that we are steadily retiring, and a growing set of ai-assisted features and internal tooling.

you will own features end to end, from schema and api through ui, pipeline, and production. we work in a small team with a lot of surface area, so the job rewards engineers who pick up whatever the problem needs, whether that is a new framework, a scanner's quirks, or a cloud primitive they have not touched before

**what you will do**

* design, build, and ship features across the full stack: fastify or express apis, next.js and react frontends, mysql schemas and migrations, sqs-driven workers, and the infrastructure that runs them.
* own services in production: observability with sentry and grafana, on-call participation, incident root-causing, and the follow-through fixes.
* build and evolve security and monitoring products that scan, probe, and score real customer infrastructure at scale, with correctness and performance budgets that matter.
* maintain and incrementally retire legacy .net and python components, moving behavior into the typescript platform with parity verified rather than assumed.
* extend ci/cd and infrastructure: azure devops pipelines, docker images, helm charts, and terraform for eks, rds, sqs, and related aws services.
* integrate third-party and partner apis (certificate authorities, scanners, identity providers) and keep those integrations resilient.
* use ai-assisted development tools as part of daily work, and build ai-backed features where they genuinely improve the product.
* review code, write tests, and raise the bar on standards that apply to human and ai-generated code alike.
* mentor other engineers and write up decisions so others can act on them without you in the room.

  

**what you will have**

* 6+ years building and operating production web services and the frontends on top of them.
* strong typescript and node.js, including a modern api framework (fastify preferred, express acceptable) and a react framework (next.js preferred).
* production experience in more than one language or ecosystem, and at least one stack change you drove or adapted to in the last few years. depth in a single language is not enough for this role.
* solid relational database skills on mysql or postgres: schema design, migrations, indexing, query performance, and transaction and locking behavior.
* comfort owning what you ship: logging, metrics, alerting, and calm, evidence-led debugging in production.
* security awareness as a habit: authentication and authorization flows, secrets handling, input validation, and dependency hygiene.
* clear written communication. you can explain a design, a trade-off, or an incident to engineers and non-engineers.

  

**nice to have**

* hands-on aws (compute, queues, storage, secrets) and the ability to read and change terraform.
* containers and kubernetes at a working level: writing a dockerfile, reading a helm chart, debugging a failing pod.
* ci/cd pipeline work in azure devops or similar, plus cloudflare or aws waf experience.
* grafana, sentry, or equivalent observability tooling beyond basic dashboards.
* experience with pki, tls, or certificate lifecycle management, or with monitoring and scanning products (uptime, vulnerability, dns or email security).
* oauth 2.0 and openid connect implementation experience, especially multi-tenant identity providers.
* c# and .net, enough to read, maintain, and migrate legacy services without making them your home.
* python for data pipelines, scanners, or tooling.
* large-scale scanning or crawling systems: fleets of workers, rate limits, timeouts, and the cost math behind them.
* building with llm apis, mcp servers, or agentic workflows in a product context.

  

**benefits**

* competitive compensation and comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage
* retirement savings programs with company matching (401(k) or rrsp)
* generous paid time off, including holidays, and vacation
* paid parental leave and family support benefits
* life and disability coverage
* flexible spending and health savings options (where applicable)
* health and wellness support, including gym reimbursement and wellness programs
* employee assistance program with 24/7confidential support for employees and families
* education assistance and professional development opportunities
* access to linkedin learning and continuous learning resources
* employee referral bonus program and additional company perks and discounts
* internal rewards and recognition platform (motivosity) to celebrate and acknowledge project wins, milestone achievements, and the outstanding contributions of our colleagues
* business travel insurance and global employee support programs

to protect candidate information and maintain a secure hiring process, all applications must be submitted through our careers portal. resumes or cvs sent directly via email will not be reviewed or considered.

digicert is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to diversity in its workforce. in compliance with applicable federal and state laws, digicert prohibits discrimination on the basis of race or ethnicity, religion, color, national origin, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, veteran's status, status as a qualified person with a disability, or genetic information. individuals from historically underrepresented groups, such as minorities, women, qualified person with disabilities, and protected veterans are strongly encouraged to apply.

title: ML Engineer, Agentic Systems
description:
viridien ( www.viridiengroup.com ) is an advanced technology, digital and earth data company that pushes the boundaries of science for a more prosperous and sustainable future. with our ingenuity, drive and deep curiosity we discover new insights, innovations, and solutions that efficiently and responsibly resolve complex natural resource, digital, energy transition and infrastructure challenges.

  

**job summary**

we are hiring an ml engineer to build production agentic applications that automate complex geoscience workflows. you will design agent-based systems, integrate tools and external apis, implement persistent state management, provide agents with the right context, and deliver well-tested services with lightweight web interfaces for operators and end users.

  

beyond implementation, you will help shape what these applications do: which workflows to automate, where people stay in the loop, and how results are presented and verified. you will also be responsible for designing and executing llm fine-tuning strategies when model adaptation is required.

  

**about the team**

we work together to build high-impact tools and platforms that drive innovation – from scientific seismic algorithms to data visualization tools to intuitive web apps. combining our expertise across regions to drive innovation and impactful results. our team values collaboration, continuous learning, and innovation, and we take pride in supporting each other to achieve shared goals.

**key responsibilities**

* shape the application logic and user experience: define what a good result looks like, remove what does not help users decide, and make outputs easy to verify.
* design agent workflows with branches, loops, sub-workflows, and explicit routing, choosing the simplest structure that solves the problem.
* implement human-in-the-loop approvals, and decide which actions an agent may take on its own.
* give agents the right context: tool-based search over files, logs, code, and databases, using text search, sql, and semantic retrieval where appropriate.
* ground answers in cited evidence, enforce tool permissions, and guard against prompt injection and unsafe actions.
* integrate tools and external apis. handle concurrency, retries, and error paths.
* add database-backed persistence. ensure workflows can pause and resume reliably.
* design and execute llm fine-tuning strategies when needed: data curation, supervised fine-tuning with parameter-efficient methods such as lora, preference optimization (e.g., dpo), reinforcement learning methods such as grpo with verifiable rewards, evaluation sets, and rollback criteria.
* instrument agent runs with tracing and continuous evaluation, making decisions and actions auditable and detecting quality regressions early.
* deliver production-ready services with automated tests and ci/cd, and expose apis where other teams or systems need them.
* collaborate with domain experts, product, and engineering. present clear design docs and trade-offs.
leverage ai coding agents such as claude code or codex effectively and responsibly: plan and direct their work, review and test what they produce, and stay accountable for every change that ships.  

  

**qualifications:**

***required:***

* bachelor’s degree or higher in computer science, engineering, physics, mathematics, geophysics, or a related field.
* strong academic performance, including a minimum cumulative gpa of 3.5 on a 4.0 scale for all earned degrees. equivalent academic grading systems will be considered for degrees obtained outside the u.s.
* strong programming and software engineering fundamentals, including asynchronous and concurrent programming.
* sound design and product judgment: you can explain why a system is built the way it is, what was left out, and how its quality is measured.
* hands-on experience building multi-agent or graph-based llm workflows, using established frameworks or custom implementations.
* experience designing how agents find information: tool-based search over files, logs, and databases, and semantic retrieval with reranking when needed.
* practical llm fine-tuning experience: parameter-efficient methods such as lora, dataset preparation and quality assurance, offline and online evals; a working understanding of rl-based fine-tuning and reward design.
* experience with tracing and evaluation of llm applications.
* experience building web services and apis (e.g., fastapi), and working with postgresql, docker, and git.
* ability to harness ai coding agents such as claude code or codex: understand how they work, break down tasks, guide their execution, critically review their output, recognize failures, and take ownership of the resulting code.

***preferred:***

* experience designing complex agent systems, including task decomposition, parallel execution, result aggregation, and human-in-the-loop orchestration.
* hands-on experience with llm post-training techniques (e.g., dpo, grpo), including reward design for verifiable outcomes and multi-step tool use.
* experience running enterprise-scale applications in production, including retries, idempotency, timeouts, and rate limits.
* prior work in workflow automation; exposure to geoscience or scientific computing is a plus.
* frontend experience building lightweight operator dashboards.

**houston benefits:**

* 401k retirement plan - when you contribute up to 5%, not only will we match that, but we will also add an additional 2%
* free on-site fitness centre offering group exercise classes
* short-term disability and long-term disability coverage at no cost to you
* parental leave program allowing mothers and fathers to take time off from work for childbirth, adoption and to bond with your new child
* pet insurance – options to meet every budget
wellness program – resources provided to support your personal wellness and participation in activities can earn you $65 quarterly.  

  

**our hiring process**

at viridien, we are committed to delivering a respectful, inclusive, and transparent recruitment experience.

due to the high volume of applications we receive, we may not be able to provide individual feedback to every applicant. only candidates whose qualifications closely match the role criteria will be contacted for an interview. we do, however, aim to share personalized feedback with those who progress to the first round of interviews and beyond.

we are also dedicated to ensuring that our hiring process accessible to all. if you require any reasonable adjustments to fully participate in the application or interview stages, please don’t hesitate to contact your recruiter directly.

we see things differently. diversity fuels our innovation, we value the unique ways in which we differ, and we are committed to equal employment opportunities for all professionals.

title: Agentic AI Engineer
description:
### **when you join verizon**

you want more out of a career. a place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. at verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. we do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. our v team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. in crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. want in? join the #vteamlife.

we are seeking an **agentic ai engineer** to architect and implement autonomous, multi-agent workflows that go beyond static text generation. you will be responsible for building reliable agentic systems that interface with enterprise databases, execute real-world apis, manage long-term state, and operate safely within strict performance and governance guardrails.

you will be responsible for the following but not limited to:

* **agent architecture & orchestration:** design stateful, multi-step agentic workflows using reasoning frameworks (e.g., react, plan-and-solve, reflection).
* **tool & api integration:** build reliable execution layers connecting llms to external systems via rest apis, database connectors, and protocol standards like **model context protocol (mcp)**.
* **context & memory management:** implement short-term and long-term memory architectures, state persistency, context window optimization, and hybrid rag retrieval layers.
* **evaluation & guardrails:** establish offline test sets ("golden sets") and real-time observability pipelines (using llm-as-a-judge, trace analysis, and latency/cost monitoring) to prevent hallucinations, infinite loops, and unwanted drift.
* **production deployment:** containerize and deploy multi-agent microservices using scalable async patterns, distributed queues, and fallback mechanisms.

**what we’re looking for...**

you thrive on creating smart, customer-centric solutions that simplify user interactions and deliver immediate answers. your expertise allows you to build secure, scalable ai frameworks using established software engineering practices, ensuring smooth integration with downstream enterprise tools. as a trusted engineer, teams rely on you to navigate challenging obstacles in nlp, ai integration, and search relevance. by combining deep technical proficiency in ai with an analytical, collaborative mindset, you will directly enhance our user journey.

**you’ll need to have:**

* bachelor’s degree or four or more years of work experience.
* four or more years of relevant experience required, demonstrated through one or a combination of work and/or military experience, or specialized training.
* experience building **multi-agent systems** with complex delegation models (human-in-the-loop escalation paths).
* hands-on experience developing enterprise-grade agentic workflows, multi-agent topologies, and task orchestration pipelines using platforms such as **langgraph**, **google adk / ces**, **sierra**, **decagon**, or similar
* experience with large language models (llms), prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (rag) architectures, and generative ai guardrails.

**even better if you have one or more of the following:**

* bachelor’s degree in computer science, computer engineering, artificial intelligence, or a related technical field.
* experience in programming in modern languages (python, java, nodejs) for building custom fulfillment webhooks, microservices, and backend apis.
* experience implementing vertex ai search / enterprise search, grounding models, custom data store connectors, and tuning search relevance and rankings.
* experience integrating google ai solutions with non-google enterprise architectures via rest/soap apis, pub/sub messaging, and webhook integrations.
* knowledge of contact center integrations (telephony adapters, crm platforms like salesforce/genesys, and live agent hand-off protocols).

if verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.

### **where you’ll be working**

in this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes working from home and a minimum of three days per week in the office, which will be set by your manager. employees are responsible for maintaining compliance with hybrid work policies.

### **scheduled weekly hours**

40

### **equal employment opportunity**

verizon is an equal opportunity employer. we evaluate qualified applicants without regard to veteran status, disability or other legally protected characteristics.

### **benefits and compensation**

our benefits are designed to help you move forward in your career, and in areas of your life outside of verizon. from health and wellness benefit options including: medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability, basic life insurance, supplemental life insurance, ad&d insurance, identity theft protection, pet insurance and group home & auto insurance. we also offer a matched 401(k) savings plan, up to 8 company paid holidays per year and up to 6 personal days per year, paid parental leave, adoption assistance and tuition assistance, plus other incentives, we’ve got you covered with our award-winning total rewards package. depending on the role, employees have the opportunity to receive compensation in the form of premium pay such as overtime, shift differential, holiday pay, allowances, etc. newly hired employees receive up to 15 days of vacation per year, which grows with additional service. for part-timers, your coverage will vary as you may be eligible for some of these benefits depending on your individual circumstances.

the salary will vary depending on your location and confirmed job-related skills and experience. this is an incentive based position with the potential to earn more. for part-time roles, your compensation will be adjusted to reflect your hours.the annual salary range for the location(s) listed on this job requisition based on a full-time schedule is: $101,000.00 - $194,000.00.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
altana is the network for trusted trade. our ai-powered product network empowers governments and businesses to build a more resilient and secure global economy while keeping trade flowing.

**the opportunity at altana**

the engineering team is responsible for building out the product for bringing this vision to life. we are creating a platform fundamentally driven by ai, which scales to a massive trove of data, and a diverse customer base; it is a complex system that will stretch engineering in many directions.

shipping products that customers actually adopt, not just products that ship, takes a particular kind of engineering practice. it means starting inside the customer's workflow rather than at the ticket. it means treating every release as a hypothesis you can prove or disprove. it means reaching for ai as a primary building block, not a feature you bolt on at the end. and it means owning a product end‑to‑end, from the first conversation through the telemetry six months later.

as a senior engineer at altana, that's the work and you'll lead others doing it. you'll embed with product and design, get on calls with users, form hypotheses about where the real pain is, and lead a small team turning those hypotheses into shipped, adopted products. you'll measure your work in customer outcomes, not commits.

  

**you will**

* **spend real time with customers.** sit alongside them in their workflows, watch where they get stuck, and translate what you learn into product bets your team is willing to ship behind.
* **partner with the product team to decide** ***what*** **to build, not just** ***how***. form hypotheses about customer value, design the smallest experiment that could prove them out, and learn fast. push back on briefs that aren't grounded in evidence.
* **take new product surfaces from 0 to 1.** pitch, prototype, ship, and drive adoption with real users. you are as fluent in "did this land?" as you are in "is this maintainable?"
* **build ai‑native by default**. llms, agents, evals, retrieval, and modern ai tooling are first‑class building blocks in your stack, not bolt‑ons. you make principled choices about where ai changes the product equation and where it doesn't.
* **own end‑to‑end outcomes**. from the first customer conversation to telemetry on the dashboard six months later — including the architecture and instrumentation choices that make that telemetry meaningful.
* **set the technical bar for your team**. review designs and code with a high standard for quality, simplicity, and customer impact, and a low tolerance for engineering work that can't be traced back to a customer outcome.
* **mentor engineers in customer‑centric, hypothesis‑driven product development**. help them build the instincts to talk to users, run experiments, and tell when a feature is done because it's loved, not because the ticket is closed.
* **drive technical decision‑making with a bias toward shipping**. choose practical, iterative designs that get a working version in front of customers fast, then evolve them as you learn.

**you have**

* you've deployed production code and services to cloud-hosted environments.
* you have demonstrated experience delivering incremental releases from proof-of-concept to mvp to production.
* self-starter with demonstrated experience working on large, complex problems.
* you care deeply about engineering excellence, clean code, and knowledge-sharing.
* you have strong written and verbal communication skills.
* experience leading other engineers on complex projects.

**nice to have, but not required**

* experience with python machine learning toolsets (numpy, pandas, dedupe).
* experience with container technologies like docker and kubernetes.

**technologies we love to use at altana**

* languages: python, pyspark
* tools: docker, git, kubernetes, swagger/openapi, aws/azure, mlflow, celery
* datastores: databricks and delta lakes

**this role is based in brooklyn, ny, usa with hybrid work flexibility and candidates must be within commuting distance from our williamsburg, brooklyn office**

**us salary range and benefits**

$170,000 - $200,000 usd

the salary range, to the extent specified for this role, is a good faith statement of the minimum and maximum levels of the annual based salary for the position. the base salary offered to a successful candidate will depend on a wide range of compensation factors, including, but not limited to, work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of altana's total compensation package. altana also offers either a discretionary bonus or a variable compensation plan depending on the role. additionally, altana offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

* flexible time off: altana operates with a flexible time oﬀ (fto) policy that gives you agency over your own time oﬀ so you can maximize your work-life balance.
* parental leave: we oﬀer industry leading paid parental leave (ppl), providing 14 weeks of leave for non-birthing, adoptive, and foster parents and up to 26 weeks of leave for birthing parents, all paid at 100% of your base salary.
* health benefits: we have a full suite of medical, vision, and dental benefits with generous employer contributions, designed to give you flexibility and choice for your individual health situation. our high deductible health plan is 100% employer paid for employees and supplemented with an employer contribution to your health savings account (hsa). there is also a flexible spending account (fsa) option.
* supplemental benefits: altana provides life, short- and long-term disability, and ad&d insurance coverage, all at no cost to you, so you know that you and your loved ones are covered in case of an emergency.
* 401(k) savings: save for and invest in your future using our guideline 401(k) retirement savings program.
* commuter benefits: save money on your commute by setting aside pre-tax funds for public transit or parking!
* wellness: because we value mental and emotional health, every altana employee has access to a free premium subscription to calm, the #1 app for meditation, sleep, and mindfulness.
* pet insurance: pets are family too! keep them healthy with wishbone insurance and / or our total pet vet service and telehealth discount plan.
* employee assistance program: free access to confidential personal support.
* dependent care fsa: you will have access to a dependent care fsa, which allows you to set aside pre-tax funds for childcare expenses

the recruiter assigned to this role can share more information about the specific compensation and benefit details associated with this role during the hiring process.

### **our values**

our values are the core beliefs that shape who we are, what we stand for, and how we behave.they form the foundation of altana's culture and integrity and guide how we hire, design, build, and connect with each other and our customers.

* **trust:** our customers and partners entrust us with missions of the highest importance. we honor that by keeping our word, meeting commitments, and ensuring every action we take reinforces confidence in us. we rely on each other to deliver, to speak openly, and to hold ourselves accountable.
* **resilience:** in a world of uncertainty and complexity, our work must withstand challenges, evolve with conditions, and ensure reliability over time. resilience is both how we operate and what we deliver. it's how we respond when things don't go to plan –– we adapt, we support each other, and we keep moving forward.
* **stewardship:** we are stewards of every mission we touch. because our work impacts lives and futures, we hold ourselves accountable to delivering mission impact and never compromising. our responsibility extends beyond individual projects to the broader system of global trade. we believe that stewardship starts from within so that we can bring focus, creativity, and excellence to our work. each of us is personally responsible for fostering a workplace where people can thrive. and we are stewards of the greater good of the company. by holding ourselves and each other accountable, we build a culture of innovation and collective success that reflects the scale of our mission.
* **courage:** courage is what unlocks the seemingly impossible for our customers. it's the core value that drives us make bold moves and take on big, complicated network problems—the ones others avoid. we know success isn't guaranteed, but we have the audacious vision to believe a solution is possible and to build it. courage fuels our growth mindset. it means embracing challenges that make us stronger, and it's demonstrated by how we approach hard conversations and complex projects.

at altana, we believe that a diverse workforce enables greater creativity, performance, and adaptability. we're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome you to join us as you are. our employment opportunities and decisions are based on business needs and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religious creed, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, family care or medical leave status, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by the laws or regulations in the areas in which we operate. we prohibit discrimination and harassment of any type, in any situation.

*offers related to employment at altana will come from an altana.ai email address. we will never ask for payment as part of the interview or onboarding process.*

title: Sr. Revenue Data Analyst

10% - other
completes other projects and duties as assigned.

title: Senior BI Platform Operations Engineer
description:
##### **project description**

we are looking for a hands-on bi platform operations engineer to provide production operational support, administration, maintenance, and technical troubleshooting for our enterprise business intelligence platforms and associated aws services.
  
the role will primarily support tableau and amazon quicksight / amazon quick suite, including a custom bi-as-a-service (biaas) platform built on top of amazon quicksight. the biaas platform consists of multiple backend services, restful apis, aws serverless and data services, and a web-based user interface.
  
this is primarily a platform engineering and production support role, rather than a dashboard/report development position. the successful candidate will be comfortable troubleshooting across bi, application, api, data, ai-assisted analytics, and cloud infrastructure layers and working with engineering teams to maintain a reliable and stable production service.
  
for canada this role is for subcontractor.
  
for nyc: compensation 90000-115000 uas gross per year and based on your interview results.

##### **responsibilities**

production operations & support

* provide day-to-day production operational support for tableau, amazon quicksight / quick suite, the bi-as-a-service platform, and its supporting aws services.

* monitor platform availability, performance, capacity, scheduled workloads, and overall service health.

* investigate and resolve production incidents, user issues, failed jobs, connectivity problems, access issues, api failures, and platform errors.

* perform root-cause analysis and work with engineering, application, data, and infrastructure teams to resolve recurring issues.

* support incident, problem, release, and change-management processes.

* develop and maintain operational runbooks, troubleshooting procedures, and support documentation.

* identify opportunities to automate repetitive operational and administrative activities.

* proactively identify platform health, reliability, and supportability improvements.

tableau platform administration

* administer and maintain the enterprise tableau server environment.

* support tableau server infrastructure, configuration, upgrades, patching, and platform maintenance.

* manage sites, projects, users, groups, permissions, and content access.

* troubleshoot extracts, refresh schedules, data-source connectivity, authentication, and performance issues.

* monitor tableau server processes, logs, resource utilization, and platform health.

* assist with platform upgrades, migrations, configuration changes, and infrastructure-related activities.

amazon quicksight / quick suite administration, authoring & support

* provide day-to-day amazon quicksight / quick suite production support, administration, and operational troubleshooting.

* support the lifecycle, administration, and troubleshooting of bi and analytics assets, including:

o analyses

o dashboards

o datasets

o data sources

o themes

o folders

o templates

o topics and conversational bi capabilities

o other quicksight / quick suite assets and platform objects

* troubleshoot issues related to creating, updating, publishing, sharing, and accessing analyses and dashboards.

* support quicksight authoring capabilities and assist authors with analysis, visualization, dataset, data-source, dashboard, and semantic configuration issues.

* troubleshoot dataset ingestion and refresh failures, including spice ingestion, scheduled refreshes, and direct-query scenarios.

* diagnose data-source connectivity and access issues involving amazon athena and other supported data sources.

* support and troubleshoot themes and reusable assets, including permissions and sharing.

* manage and troubleshoot users, groups, namespaces, folders, asset permissions, and access controls.

* troubleshoot dashboard and analysis permissions, sharing, ownership, and access issues.

* understand and troubleshoot security and aws integrations, including iam-based access and permissions.

* support and troubleshoot programmatic management of quicksight assets using quicksight apis and aws sdks.

* troubleshoot api operations involving analyses, dashboards, datasets, data sources, themes, permissions, and other supported assets.

* support embedded quicksight capabilities and troubleshoot embedding, authentication, authorization, and access-related issues where applicable.

amazon q / generative bi & quick suite capabilities

* support and develop operational familiarity with amazon q capabilities within quicksight / quick suite, including natural-language and generative bi experiences.

* support amazon q topics and associated semantic configurations used to provide business context for natural-language analytics.

* troubleshoot user access, permissions, data availability, semantic configuration, and other issues affecting amazon q experiences.

* support conversational bi capabilities that allow users to ask questions of enterprise data using natural language.

* support newer quick suite conversational and agentic experiences, including chat agents, agents, and spaces, where adopted by the platform.

* understand how spaces organize relevant data, content, context, and resources used by quick suite experiences.

* assist with operational support and troubleshooting of amazon q / quick suite agents, including access, configuration, underlying data/content availability, and integration-related issues.

* work with platform and engineering teams as amazon q and quick suite capabilities evolve and are incorporated into the bi-as-a-service offering.

bi-as-a-service platform

provide operational and technical support for our internally developed bi-as-a-service platform built on amazon quicksight, including the aws data, api, serverless, monitoring, and analytics services that underpin the platform.

platform & quicksight integration

* understand the end-to-end biaas architecture and troubleshoot issues across apis, backend services, aws infrastructure, data services, quicksight, and quick suite capabilities.

* support integrations with amazon quicksight using quicksight apis and aws sdks.

* troubleshoot the programmatic creation, update, deployment, sharing, and management of quicksight assets.

* troubleshoot asset provisioning, permissions, embedding, authentication, authorization, and other quicksight integration workflows.

* analyze application and aws service logs to diagnose production issues.

* work closely with platform engineering and development teams to identify defects and implement sustainable fixes.

* assist with deployments, configuration changes, environment maintenance, and production releases.

aws data & analytics services

* support and troubleshoot amazon athena queries and integrations used by bi applications and reporting workloads.

* understand athena connectivity, permissions, workgroups, query execution, and common performance or operational issues.

* support the aws glue data catalog, including databases, tables, metadata, schemas, partitions, and integrations with athena and quicksight.

* troubleshoot metadata, schema, partition, and data-discovery issues involving the glue data catalog.

* understand and support aws lake formation permissions and data-access controls.

* troubleshoot access issues across lake formation, glue data catalog, athena, iam, and quicksight.

* understand the end-to-end data-access path from underlying data sources through athena and the glue data catalog to quicksight.

aws serverless & rest api services

* support and troubleshoot aws lambda functions used by the bi-as-a-service platform.

* understand lambda configuration, iam roles, environment variables, triggers, execution failures, and timeouts.

* support amazon api gateway endpoints integrated with lambda and other backend services.

* troubleshoot api gateway routing, authentication/authorization, request and response handling, integration failures, and http errors.

* understand and troubleshoot restful apis, including http methods, headers, request/response payloads, authentication, authorization, and error handling.

* use api testing and troubleshooting techniques to diagnose service integration issues.

* understand interactions between api gateway, lambda functions, backend services, aws apis, and quicksight apis.

monitoring & observability

* use amazon cloudwatch to monitor and troubleshoot the biaas platform and its supporting aws services.

* analyze cloudwatch logs, metrics, dashboards, and alarms to identify and diagnose production issues.

* troubleshoot lambda executions and api gateway requests using cloudwatch logging and metrics.

* correlate events and logs across multiple services to identify the source of end-to-end transaction failures.

* support and improve operational monitoring, alerting, and platform-health dashboards.

* identify monitoring gaps and opportunities to improve proactive detection of production issues.

##### **skills**

must have

required skills & experience

* strong hands-on experience supporting enterprise bi platforms in production environments.

* strong experience with tableau server administration and operational support.

* strong hands-on experience with amazon quicksight administration, authoring, and production support.

* experience supporting and troubleshooting quicksight analyses, dashboards, datasets, data sources, themes, folders, templates, permissions, and related assets.

* experience troubleshooting spice ingestion, dataset refreshes, direct queries, data-source connectivity, dashboard publishing, sharing, and access issues.

* experience with amazon quicksight apis / aws sdks, including programmatic management of quicksight assets and permissions.

* working knowledge of amazon athena and troubleshooting athena-based bi workloads.

* working knowledge of the aws glue data catalog, including databases, tables, schemas, partitions, and metadata.

* understanding of aws lake formation, particularly permissions and data-access management.

* experience with aws lambda and troubleshooting serverless application components.

* experience with amazon api gateway, particularly lambda integrations and rest apis.

* strong understanding of restful api concepts and experience troubleshooting api integrations.

* hands-on experience with amazon cloudwatch, including logs, metrics, dashboards, and alarms.

* strong understanding of aws iam, roles, policies, permissions, and service-to-service access.

* experience troubleshooting bi platform infrastructure, data connectivity, authentication, authorization, permissions, and performance issues.

* ability to analyze application, server, api, lambda, and aws service logs to troubleshoot issues across multiple technology layers.

* experience with production incident management, problem management, and root-cause analysis.

* experience with scripting or automation using technologies such as python, powershell, bash, aws cli, or similar tools.

* strong troubleshooting, analytical, documentation, and communication skills.

nice to have

* experience or familiarity with amazon q in quicksight / quick suite, including conversational and generative bi capabilities.

* experience with amazon q topics and semantic configuration for natural-language analytics.

* familiarity with quick suite agents, chat/agent experiences, and spaces.

* understanding of modern web applications and experience with angular, javascript, or typescript.

* experience operating a bi platform-as-a-service or bi-as-a-service environment.

* experience supporting custom applications built around amazon quicksight apis.

* experience with embedded quicksight and programmatic dashboard or asset management.

* experience troubleshooting end-to-end data flows involving quicksight, athena, glue data catalog, lake formation, s3, and iam.

* experience supporting serverless architectures involving api gateway and lambda.

* experience with tableau server infrastructure upgrades, backup/restore, monitoring, and performance tuning.

* familiarity with ci/cd pipelines and application deployment processes.

* familiarity with infrastructure-as-code and cloud deployment practices.

* familiarity with itil-based incident, problem, and change-management practices.

* experience supporting enterprise environments with strong security, governance, and access-control requirements.
