title: AI Engineer – Startups & Partnerships
description:
**discover your future at citi**
--------------------------------

working at citi is far more than just a job. a career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. at citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**job overview**
----------------

**about citi:**

citi, the leading global bank, has approximately 200 million customer accounts and does business in more than 160 countries and jurisdictions. citi provides consumers, corporations, governments, and institutions with a broad range of financial products and services, including consumer banking and credit, corporate and investment banking, securities brokerage, transaction services, and wealth management.

as a bank with a brain and a soul, citi creates economic value that is systemically responsible and in our clients’ best interests. as a financial institution that touches every region of the world and every sector that shapes your daily life, our operations & technology teams are charged with a mission that rivals any large tech company. our technology solutions are the foundations of everything we do from keeping the bank safe, managing global resources, and providing the technical tools our workers need to be successful to designing our digital architecture and ensuring our platforms provide a first-class customer experience. we reimagine client and partner experiences to deliver excellence through secure, reliable, and efficient services.

our commitment to diversity includes a workforce that represents the clients we serve from all walks of life, backgrounds, and origins. we foster an environment where the best people want to work. we value and demand respect for others, promote individuals based on merit, and ensure opportunities for personal development are widely available to all. ideal candidates are innovators with well-rounded backgrounds who bring their authentic selves to work and complement our culture of delivering results with pride. if you are a problem solver who seeks passion in your work, come join us. we’ll enable growth and progress together.

  
  

**the team:**
=============

the **startups & partnerships team** is the forward scout of the citi's head of ai organization. our mandate: identify, evaluate, and rapidly onboard the emerging technologies that will define citi's next chapter with artificial intelligence as our number one strategic priority right now. we don't sit in a lab waiting for ideas to trickle in. we move across every line of business at citi, sit down directly with business stakeholders and clients, and go toe-to-toe with the sharpest startups and frontier ai labs in the market. we run fast, we run lean, and we run with the full weight of a global institution behind us.

  
  

**the opportunity:**
====================

as an **ai engineer** on the startups & partnerships team, you will be at the **tip of the spear** for citi's ai strategy - building, testing, and shipping real applications that touch real business problems across the bank, not writing whitepapers about them from the sidelines.

you'll get a level of exposure that's rare in a tier-1 global bank: direct access to business requirements, hands-on evaluation of the newest models and platforms from the industry's leading ai labs, and the mandate to move at startup speed inside an institution operating at global scale. if you want to build things that matter, get them in front of real users fast, and shape how one of the world's largest financial institutions adopts ai - this is the seat.

  
  

**what you'll do day to day**
=============================

* **build and ship ai applications** - architect, develop, and deploy production-grade ai-powered tools, pipelines, and workflows that solve real business problems across citi's lines of business.

* **evaluate emerging ai technology** - run structured proof-of-concepts and sandbox "bake-offs" to rapidly assess new models, platforms, and startup tools (llms, agentic frameworks, orchestration layers) for real-world fit.

* **prototype at speed** - turn a business idea into a working demo in days, not quarters, and iterate quickly based on stakeholder feedback.

* **integrate across the stack** - connect llms and agentic systems to enterprise apis, data pipelines, and lightweight front-end or tooling layers to deliver end-to-end working solutions.

* **deliver pocs into production pathways** - work with governance, risk, and platform teams to shepherd validated solutions from prototype toward scaled deployment.

* **communicate impact** - translate technical work into clear, compelling narratives for senior business and technology stakeholders.
  

  

**required skills**
===================

* a **full-stack engineer with applied ai/llm experience** - this is explicitly **not** a data science or ml research role. we need builders, not modelers.

* proven experience **building and shipping ai applications, pipelines, and workflows** in live, production environments - not just notebooks and academic experiments.

* hands-on proficiency with **large language models (llms)**, prompt engineering, and **agentic frameworks and orchestration tools** (e.g., langchain, llamaindex, autogen, or similar).

* strong software engineering fundamentals - comfortable working across the stack, from backend services and api integrations to lightweight front-end or internal tooling layers.

* strong communication and stakeholder management skills - you can work directly with business leaders and clients, not just other engineers.

* a track record of learning and adopting new tools and platforms quickly as the ai landscape evolves.

* comfort operating in a large, regulated, global institution while bringing a startup-speed mentality to your work.
  

  

**nice-to-have skills**
=======================

* experience working directly with startups, venture teams, or technology scouting functions.

* familiarity with vector databases, retrieval-augmented generation (rag), or knowledge graph-based retrieval.

* experience with containerization and cloud-native deployment (docker, kubernetes) for ai services.

* prior exposure to financial services, banking, or other highly regulated industries.

* experience presenting technical concepts to non-technical, senior business audiences.
  

  

**education**
=============

* bachelor’s degree/university degree or equivalent experience
* master’s degree preferred

title: Senior Perception Learning Engineer
description:
apptronik is a human-centered robotics company developing ai-powered robots to support humanity in every facet of life. our flagship humanoid robot, apollo, is built to collaborate thoughtfully with people, starting with critical industries such as manufacturing and logistics, with future applications in healthcare, the home, and beyond.  
  
we operate at the cutting edge of applied ai, applying our expertise across the full robotics stack to solve some of society's most important problems. you will join a team dedicated to bringing apollo to market at scale, tackling the complex challenges like safety, commercialization, and mass production to change the world for the better.

you will drive research and development of advanced perception systems that empower apptronik's humanoid robots to understand and interact with complex human environments. your work will focus heavily on slam, visual-inertial odometry, world modeling, and learning-based perception, alongside object detection and multi-sensor fusion, creating the foundation for robust autonomy in real-world settings.

you will design and optimize deep learning models for real-time detection, tracking, segmentation, scene understanding, and state estimation while contributing to scalable pipelines for training, evaluation, and deployment. you will also integrate data from multiple modalities—cameras, lidar, depth sensors, and imus—into unified world models that support navigation, manipulation, safety, and human-robot interaction.

this role requires balancing research innovation with practical engineering to deliver deployable, high-performance slam and perception stacks. you will collaborate across reinforcement learning teams, platform software team, and systems teams, and contribute to shaping apptronik's perception and autonomy roadmap. your work will directly accelerate the development of humanoid robots that can safely operate in human spaces, adapt to dynamic environments, and extend human capability.

### **core responsibilities**

* lead design, develop, and optimize perception and slam pipelines for humanoid robots, including visual-inertial odometry, mapping, localization, object detection, tracking, segmentation, pose estimation, and scene understanding.
* develop multi-sensor fusion frameworks that integrate cameras, lidar, depth sensors, and imus for robust real-time state estimation and mapping in dynamic human-centered environments.
* contribute to scalable data pipelines, training infrastructure, and inference frameworks to accelerate model development, evaluation, and deployment.
* drive research and deployment of learning-based models for slam, 3d scene understanding, and perception optimized for humanoid locomotion, manipulation, and human-robot interaction.
* implement performance profiling, regression testing, and telemetry systems to ensure perception and slam modules meet strict latency, accuracy, and reliability requirements on edge devices.
* collaborate with planning, control, and hardware teams to define perception-to-action interfaces, ensuring real-time compatibility with locomotion and manipulation pipelines.
* guide the integration of synthetic data (e.g., simulation frameworks like isaacsim) with real-world datasets to enhance model generalization and robustness.
contribute to best practices in code quality, model versioning, reproducibility, and deployment.  

### **required qualifications**

* ms/phd in computer science, robotics, computer engineering, or related field.
* 3- 5+ years building and shipping perception and/or slam systems in robotics or real-time vision applications.
* strong background in slam, vio, probabilistic state estimation, and deep learning for computer vision.
* practical expertise in detection, segmentation, multi-object tracking, 3d perception, and learning-based mapping/localization.
* hands-on experience with modern ai frameworks (pytorch, jax, tensorflow) and computer vision / multi-modal libraries such as opencv, detectron2, yolo, and foundation models for perception and language (e.g., sam, clip, dinov2, flamingo).
* proficiency in python and modern c++, with strong software engineering fundamentals (version control, testing, ci/cd).
* deep understanding of 3d geometry, camera models, and probabilistic estimation (ekf/ukf, factor graphs, slam, vio).
* experience deploying optimized perception or slam models on edge hardware (gpu/npu/embedded platforms) under compute, latency, and thermal constraints.
track record of shipping ml/perception or slam systems from r&d into production robotics platforms.  

### **preferred experience**

* experience with humanoid robots, bipedal locomotion, and manipulation tasks.
* experience with modern slam frameworks (e.g., orb-slam, vins, kimera, cartographer) or learning-based slam systems.
* strong classical computer vision skills (geometry-based methods, feature extraction) complementing learning-based approaches.
* expertise in model acceleration, quantization, or compression (tensorrt, onnx runtime).
* familiarity with real-time frameworks and middleware such as ros 2, gstreamer, or zero-copy pipelines.
* knowledge of synthetic data generation and domain adaptation techniques for training perception and slam models.
* contributions to open-source robotics or vision software stacks.

  

the annual salary range is $220,000 - $250,000

title: Senior Software Engineer, Applied AI
description:
**secure every identity, from ai to human**  
  
identity is the key to unlocking the potential of ai. okta secures ai by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. this work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. we are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.  
  
this is an opportunity to do career-defining work. we're all in on this mission. if you are too, let's talk.

**the senior software engineer opportunity**

the team that built jeeva ai is building digital workers, a new suite of autonomous agents for identity operations and security inside okta. the team works directly with todd mckinnon, okta's co-founder and ceo, with the opportunity to bring this product to okta's 20,000+ customers. you will help shape the product with the ownership and pace of a startup and the resources of a public company.

you will build the harnesses and evaluations that make these workers reliable. they investigate risk, use tools, wait for approvals and complete tasks across enterprise systems. bring depth in agent execution or model quality and help turn it into working software customers can trust.

**about you**

*production builder:* you have shipped ai software and know what changes when real users depend on it.

*careful evaluator:* you investigate failures and use evidence to judge quality.

*strong owner:* you follow an improvement through code, evaluation, release and customer use.

**what you will be doing**

* build the agent harness for planning, tool use, memory, context compaction, interruption and recovery during long-running work.
* integrate openai and anthropic model apis. select models using measured quality, latency and cost, with clear failure handling.
* evaluate existing harnesses and build only the missing pieces. keep the harness connected to aws workflow execution and approval state.
* keep authorization and sensitive writes behind application policy checks. require evidence of the resulting state before marking work complete.
* build evaluation datasets and replay tests for valid findings, access decisions, app setup and ai agent onboarding.
* measure false positives, missed risks, unsafe actions, completion rate and cost. turn production failures into regression tests.
* test prompt injection, stale evidence, conflicting instructions and unsafe tool use. protect tenant boundaries in retrieval and memory.
* improve prompts, retrieval, tools and model routing. evaluate fine-tuning or other post-training methods when results justify them and data use is approved.

**what you will bring to the role**

* strong python engineering skills and experience shipping an llm application that uses tools.
* hands-on experience building agent workflows or evaluation systems for tool-using llm applications. for harness work, relevant experience includes claude agent sdk, openai codex sdk, strands agents, langchain deep agents, langgraph or a custom implementation.
* experience integrating model apis, structured outputs and asynchronous services. experience with openai or anthropic is especially relevant.
* depth in agent execution or evaluation systems, with working code and failure analysis you can explain.
* ability to distinguish a plausible model response from a supported finding or verified action.

**scope by level**

senior: own an agent capability or evaluation pipeline with measurable improvements.

**our stack**

our core stack is python fastapi, aws step functions, amazon bedrock agentcore, postgresql on amazon rds and pgvector. openai and anthropic model apis are part of the integration plan.

we plan to add an agent harness and a dedicated analytics layer using clickhouse or bigquery. the harness choice is open. experience with equivalent tools also counts.

**and extra credit for**

* open-source contributions, agent observability, security evaluations or synthetic evaluation data.
* fine-tuning, preference data, post-training evaluation or model distillation using approved datasets.
* identity and security workflows. foundation-model research experience is optional.

**summary**
-----------

support an industry-sponsored research project, funded by a honda ai+x seed grant, that develops an explainable, cost-sensitive machine-learning framework to predict equipment component failures within 24 hours and turn those predictions into practical maintenance recommendations. the research assistant will combine manufacturing and maintenance knowledge with data science skills to prepare equipment data, build and evaluate predictive models, and translate results into decisions that make sense on the plant floor. work collaboratively with other project team members and the faculty supervisor.
  
  
**career readiness competencies**

* take initiative to learn new tools, systems, or procedures on the job.
* ask questions to gain clarity on job expectations and responsibilities.
* use appropriate grammar, punctuation, and formatting in written work.
* identify when additional information is needed before making a decision.
* build positive working relationships across campus departments.

**essential functions**
-----------------------

* help define the project scope and the input-output data schema for machine sensor readings (voltage, rotation, pressure, vibration), error logs, maintenance and component-replacement records, and machine attributes.
* acquire candidate datasets (public or partner-provided) and audit data quality, including duplicates, missing records, and timestamp alignment.
* build a reproducible python pipeline to clean and merge the records, construct 24-hour failure labels, and prevent temporal leakage.
* engineer tabular features (current readings, 3-hour and 24-hour trends, recent event counts, time since maintenance) and prepare sequence windows from the sensor data.
* implement a sensor-threshold baseline, then train and compare a lightgbm model and a compact temporal convolutional network (pytorch) using chronological data splits.
* evaluate models using pr-auc, precision, recall, brier score, and calibration plots, and apply sigmoid or isotonic probability calibration.
* develop maintenance cost ratios and inspection-capacity assumptions, and implement the cost-sensitive alert-ranking policy.
* evaluate results at the event level (failure coverage, alert lead time, false alerts per machine-month, daily inspection workload).
* generate model explanations using treeshap and integrated gradients, and interpret them from a maintenance and reliability perspective.
* maintain clear, version-controlled code and documentation (github), contribute to the final technical report and presentation, and support the final project showcase.
* perform other related research duties as assigned within the scope of the position.

**minimum qualifications**
--------------------------

* currently enrolled bgsu student (undergraduate or graduate) in good academic standing.
* major in industrial/systems engineering, manufacturing or mechanical engineering technology, computer science, data science, statistics, or a related field.
* working python skills (pandas, numpy, scikit-learn) and coursework or project experience in data analysis or machine learning.
* basic understanding of manufacturing operations, equipment maintenance, or reliability concepts.
* strong written communication skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently with appropriate supervision.

**additional information**
--------------------------

* preferred qualifications:
  + coursework or experience in predictive or preventive maintenance, reliability engineering, quality control, or lean six sigma.
  + industry or internship experience in a manufacturing environment.
  + experience with lightgbm or xgboost, pytorch or tensorflow, time-series or sensor data, or model explainability (shap).
  + familiarity with git/github, jupyter, and reproducible research practices.
* two openings. total hours are capped at 120 hours for one student (manufacturing focus) and 100 hours for the other (computational focus). work period: hire date through december 31, 2026, up to 20 hours per week, scheduled flexibly around the student’s classes. work can be done in the lab or remotely, as arranged with the supervisor. students are expected to attend and help present the project at the final showcase during the week of january 11, 2027. time is reported bi-weekly. the position reports to dr. md imran hasan tusar, assistant professor, systems engineering (eic #295). to apply, submit a resume and a brief statement (half a page at most) describing relevant coursework and experience. unofficial transcripts are optional.

title: Data Engineer
description:
hendrick autoguard - hiclocation: 6030 east independence blvd, charlotte, north carolina 28212

**position summary**

the data engineer is a mid-level individual contributor responsible for the systems and structures that make hendrick autoguard's data reliable, accessible, and useful. this role owns the design and operation of the ingestion pipelines, transformation logic, and data models that serve both business intelligence and ai initiatives.

this is not a role that waits for requirements to arrive fully formed. the data engineer is expected to develop a working understanding of how the business operates and to apply that knowledge when making technical decisions. a pipeline that runs on time but models the business incorrectly has not done its job. that distinction sits at the center of this role.

the role works alongside the analysts and bi developers who build reporting on the data platform, the data science and ai teams who use curated data for model development, and the team that administers the underlying cloud infrastructure. the data engineer makes sure the data layer serves each of these groups well, so that none of them has to rebuild it for their own use.

**what this role does**

the data engineer owns the movement of data from source systems into the snowflake data platform. in practice that means designing, building, and maintaining ingestion pipelines; orchestrating workflows in dagster so they are observable, reliable, and operationally sound; and monitoring pipeline health and data availability. when a load fails or data arrives late, the data engineer investigates, fixes the underlying cause, and puts alerting in place so the same problem surfaces early next time rather than in a stakeholder's report.

once data lands, the data engineer develops and maintains the dbt transformation models that turn raw source data into clean, tested, and well-documented datasets. that includes designing dimensional models and data marts that support both reporting and machine learning use cases, and implementing data quality checks and testing standards throughout the transformation layer. downstream consumers should be able to trust a dataset without re-verifying it themselves.

the data engineer also prepares data for ai. that work includes structuring feature datasets and training data pipelines, and collaborating with data science and ai teams to make sure the data meets their requirements for quality, freshness, and structure. the data engineer contributes to the semantic layer that gives ai and analytics consumers consistent, well-defined access to business metrics and entities, and keeps data lineage and governance in view, since ai applications raise the stakes on knowing where data came from and how it may be used.

the data engineer is also expected to advise on the strategic direction of the data engineering toolset, weighing in on platform and feature updates and evaluating new capabilities as they become available. staying current with best practices and industry advancements in data engineering, ai data preparation, and orchestration is part of the job, not a side interest, and that knowledge should inform how the team's tools and standards evolve over time.

across all of this work, the data engineer builds working knowledge of the autoguard business processes it supports, including vehicle service contract and protection product sales through dealership partners, claims administration, and cancellations, along with the workflows and decisions that depend on data from those areas. the data engineer engages directly with business stakeholders to understand their data needs, translates those needs into sound technical designs, and applies business context when weighing modeling decisions, pipeline priorities, and data quality standards. that knowledge makes each new request faster to scope. it also makes the data engineer a useful partner when a team is still working out which question it needs to answer.

**adjacent competencies**

dashboard and report preparation are not a routine part of this role, and primary ownership of that work belongs to analysts and bi developers. the data engineer may occasionally need to support that function, though, whether by building or troubleshooting a report in a pinch or by helping an analyst work through a modeling issue at the source. the data engineer's core job is to deliver the modeled, tested data those teams build on, and to work with them when a reporting need exposes a gap in the data layer.

**experience and qualifications**

a candidate for this role has 3–7 years of professional experience in data engineering or a closely related discipline. they are proficient in sql and have hands-on experience with a cloud data warehouse, a data transformation and modeling framework, and a workflow orchestration tool. experience with snowflake, dbt, and dagster is strongly preferred, as is familiarity with aws, including storage, iam, and basic networking concepts.

preferred experience includes python for pipeline development or data scripting; exposure to data quality frameworks, data contracts, or observability tooling; supporting ml pipelines or ai data preparation workflows; familiarity with medallion architecture or similar layered data design patterns; and involvement in data governance or data catalog efforts. the current technology environment includes snowflake, dagster, dbt, aws (s3, ec2, and iam), python, and github.

candidates must be able to engage with non-technical stakeholders and translate business needs into technical requirements. clear written and verbal communication is not optional in this role. the data engineer produces model documentation, dataset descriptions, and design notes that analysts, data scientists, and business stakeholders rely on. that documentation needs to be accurate, specific, and usable without a follow-up conversation.

**working conditions**

the data engineer works on site at hendrick automotive group headquarters in a standard office environment, collaborating in person with technology teams and the business stakeholders this role supports. travel is minimal, and may be by car or plane. position is not remote due to essential functions of the job. position is required to sit for prolonged periods of time, extensive use of computer and related functions like typing and other office equipment used in regular performance of essential functions like phone, printer.

hendrick is an equal opportunity employer. minorities, women, veterans, and individuals with disabilities are encouraged to apply.

title: Data Scientist Senior Associate

title: AI Engineer
description:
**company information**

fríant is a leading manufacturer of innovative, accessible office furniture. operating at the intersection of style and function, we’re passionate about upholding the ethos that quality craftsmanship and practicality aren’t mutually exclusive. from panel systems and seating to desks, storage, and more, our team is busy year-round creating everything needed for a total office solution. with headquarters and manufacturing in san leandro, california and a plant in suffolk, virginia, our 630,000 square feet of facilities are equipped with state-of-the-art equipment and skilled fabric and woodworkers. we craft product that helps teams get things done while feeling good doing it, regardless of industry — because at fríant, all work styles are welcome.

**summary/objective**

the ai engineer designs, develops, deploys, and maintains scalable ai-powered solutions that improve operational efficiency, business intelligence, customer engagement, and process automation across fríant. this hands-on role combines software engineering, machine learning, large language models, ai automation, and enterprise system integration. the position works with business stakeholders, it, customer success, operations, sales, and product teams to translate complex requirements into secure, production-ready ai solutions and supports the full ai lifecycle from architecture and development through deployment, monitoring, governance, and continuous improvement.

**responsibilities**

**ai solution development**

* design, build, and deploy ai and machine learning solutions that address business challenges and improve operational efficiency.
* develop and optimize machine learning and deep learning models for predictive analytics, classification, recommendation systems, and automation.
* build applications using large language models, generative ai, and intelligent agents.
* design retrieval-augmented generation architectures that securely connect enterprise knowledge bases and business systems.

**ai automation and agents**

* develop and manage ai agents that automate workflows, support business operations, and improve employee productivity.
* create intelligent document processing solutions for extracting, classifying, and analyzing structured and unstructured data.
* implement conversational ai solutions, virtual assistants, copilots, and chatbot platforms.
* design workflow automation using ai orchestration platforms, apis, function calling, and tool-use architectures.

**data and integration**

* build and maintain reliable data pipelines for model training, inference, evaluation, and analytics.
* integrate ai solutions with crm, erp, customer support, ecommerce, knowledgebase, and other enterprise applications.
* develop apis, microservices, webhooks, middleware, and event-driven architectures that support ai deployment.
* partner with data engineers, it, and business teams to define practical and scalable ai architecture.

**ai operations and governance**

* monitor model and application performance, reliability, quality, cost, and business impact.
* implement mlops and llmops practices for deployment, version control, automated evaluation, monitoring, and lifecycle management.
* apply responsible ai, privacy, security, data governance, and access-control requirements.
* establish guardrails and risk controls for ai applications, and continuously improve accuracy, latency, scalability, and efficiency.
* create and maintain technical documentation, architecture diagrams, operating procedures, and user guidance.

**competencies**

* strong analytical, critical-thinking, troubleshooting, and problem-solving abilities.
* ability to translate business challenges and user requirements into practical ai solutions.
* excellent written and verbal communication, stakeholder collaboration, and technical documentation skills.
* ability to work independently while contributing effectively across cross-functional teams.
* comfort working in a fast-paced environment where technologies, priorities, and requirements evolve.
* strong commitment to responsible ai, security, privacy, and data governance.

**required education and experience**

* bachelor’s degree in computer science, artificial intelligence, data science, software engineering, or a related field; master’s degree preferred.
* 3+ years of hands-on experience developing and deploying ai or machine learning solutions in production environments.
* strong proficiency in python and practical experience with sql, git/github, rest apis, and at least one application framework such as fastapi or flask.
* experience with machine learning frameworks such as tensorflow, pytorch, scikit-learn, or hugging face transformers.
* strong understanding of supervised and unsupervised learning, deep learning, neural networks, natural language processing, feature engineering, and model evaluation.
* hands-on experience with enterprise generative ai and llm technologies such as openai apis, azure openai, anthropic apis, langchain, llamaindex, semantic kernel, mcp, prompt engineering, fine-tuning, function calling, ai agents, and rag.
* experience with vector databases or search platforms such as pinecone, weaviate, faiss, chroma, or azure ai search.
* experience with at least one major cloud platform, including microsoft azure, aws, or google cloud platform.
* knowledge of docker, kubernetes, ci/cd pipelines, infrastructure as code, mlflow, model versioning, observability, performance monitoring, or automated evaluation frameworks.

**preferred qualifications**

* experience implementing ai within crm, erp, customer service, ecommerce, or knowledge-management platforms.
* experience with zoho crm, salesforce, hubspot, microsoft dynamics, microsoft 365, teams, sharepoint, or power platform.
* knowledge of ocr, document intelligence, intelligent document processing, analytics, reporting, or forecasting solutions.
* experience supporting customer success, operations, sales, manufacturing, or warehouse-distribution environments.
* experience with javascript or typescript and ai observability or prompt-monitoring platforms.
* relevant azure ai, aws ai/ml, google cloud, or other industry certifications are a plus.

---------------

we are seeking a highly skilled data scientist to drive the adoption of algorithmic decision-making at scale within group digital. this role will focus on developing and deploying machine learning models, neural networks, support mlops practices, to enhance personalization, and automation within our digital products.

**key responsibilities**
------------------------

### **machine learning & ai development**

* develop and optimize predictive and prescriptive models to extract insights and enhance decision-making. knowledgeable in supervised and unsupervised learning.
* deep learning and neural network techniques for classification and profiling, and personalization.
* utilize mlops to efficiently deploy, monitor, and maintain ml models in production.

### **agentic ai capabilities**

* design, build and deploy reliable ai agents capable of planning, reasoning, using tools, maintaining context and completing multi-step business workflows.

* implement observability for agent traces, tool calls, intermediate state, failures, token usage, latency and business outcomes.

* strong engineering experience in python, typescript/javascript or java, including api development, testing, version control, ci/cd and cloud deployment.
* practical experience developing llm-powered applications using model apis, structured outputs, function/tool calling, streaming, multimodal inputs and asynchronous workflows.
* experience with agent-orchestration frameworks such as openai agents sdk, langgraph, google agent development kit, semantic kernel or equivalent frameworks.
* experience designing and integrating mcp clients and servers, including tools, resources, prompts, authentication, authorization and secure capability exposure.
* knowledge of rag and search technologies, including vector databases, hybrid search, embeddings, rerankers, document-processing pipelines and knowledge graphs.
* experience designing and developing recommendation systems, including collaborative filtering, content-based and hybrid approaches, candidate generation, ranking, personalization, feature engineering, and offline/online evaluation through a/b testing.
* strong understanding of information retrieval concepts and search relevance, including indexing, tokenization, query understanding, lexical, vector and hybrid search, embeddings, reranking, relevance tuning, and evaluation metrics such as precision@k, recall@k, ndcg and mrr.
* experience with agent state, memory, event-driven workflows, queues, retries, timeouts, idempotency and long-running or resumable processes.
* familiarity with llm evaluation and observability tools such as langsmith, opentelemetry, phoenix, arize, weights & biases or equivalent platforms.
* strong understanding of ai security, including prompt-injection defense, data-loss prevention, least privilege tool access, sandboxing, secrets management, audit logging and model-risk controls.

**preferred qualifications**
----------------------------

* hands-on experience in llms (e.g. gemini, chatgpt, bert, llama, claude) and generative ai technologies.
* background in retail and personalization web technologies.
* proficiency in business intelligence (bi) tools and data visualization.
* passionate about machine learning, mlops, knowledge graphs, and cutting-edge ai.
* experience with multi-agent architectures, including hierarchical, planner-executor, reviewer-critic and ensemble patterns.
* experience deploying agents in isolated execution environments or sandboxes.
* familiarity with agent interoperability standards, model routing, fallback strategies, context engineering, prompt versioning and cost optimisation.
* experience building voice, vision, document-understanding or computer-use agents.
* contributions to internal ai platforms, reusable agent components, mcp servers, evaluation frameworks or open-source projects.
* experience in regulated environments, privacy-by-design, model governance and ai risk management.

title: AI/ML Engineer
description:
### **ai/ml engineer – generative ai platforms (remote)**

### **about cognizant**

cognizant is one of the world's leading professional services companies, helping clients modernize technology, reimagine processes, and transform experiences. we engineer modern businesses to improve everyday life. our associates around the globe help clients build stronger, more agile, and innovative organizations.

our ai and digital engineering practice helps clients unlock value through artificial intelligence, machine learning, intelligent automation, cloud transformation, and data modernization. we partner with global enterprises to build scalable ai-powered solutions that accelerate innovation, improve productivity, and drive business outcomes.

### **role overview**

cognizant is seeking an experienced **ai/ml engineer – generative ai platforms** to join our growing ai engineering team.

this is a hands-on engineering role focused on designing, developing, deploying, and supporting ai-powered document processing and ai authoring platforms. the ideal candidate will have deep experience building enterprise generative ai solutions leveraging large language models (llms), retrieval-augmented generation (rag), intelligent document processing (idp), semantic search, and cloud-native ai architectures.

you will collaborate with solution architects, product owners, data engineers, and software engineering teams to develop innovative ai solutions that deliver scalable, secure, and production-ready business capabilities.

### **work model**

this position is **fully remote within the united states**, providing the flexibility to work from home while collaborating with global teams across multiple locations and time zones.

occasional travel may be required for client meetings, planning sessions, team collaboration events, and strategic initiatives.

### **key responsibilities**

### **generative ai solution development**

* design, develop, and deploy enterprise-grade generative ai solutions using large language models (llms).
* build intelligent document processing and ai-assisted authoring capabilities supporting complex business workflows.
* develop and optimize retrieval-augmented generation (rag) architectures to enhance response quality and contextual relevance.
* implement prompt engineering strategies to improve ai performance, accuracy, and reliability.
* collaborate with product and business teams to translate business requirements into scalable ai solutions.

### **document intelligence & ai authoring**

* develop capabilities for:
  + document extraction
  + document classification
  + data validation
  + knowledge retrieval
  + ai-assisted content generation
* design workflows that automate document understanding and content creation processes.
* build validation frameworks that improve accuracy, traceability, and confidence in ai-generated outputs.
* support end-to-end lifecycle management of ai-powered document solutions.

### **rag, semantic search & knowledge retrieval**

* design and optimize embedding strategies for enterprise data and document repositories.
* implement vector search and semantic retrieval solutions to improve knowledge discovery.
* develop grounding mechanisms that ensure ai responses are accurate, contextual, and explainable.
* build and maintain retrieval pipelines that support high-performance search and content generation capabilities.
* evaluate and enhance retrieval effectiveness using modern ai evaluation methodologies.

### **api & microservices development**

* design and develop apis and microservices using python and fastapi.
* build scalable and reusable backend services supporting ai applications and integrations.
* develop secure api-based connections between ai platforms, enterprise systems, and third-party applications.
* support microservice deployment, monitoring, maintenance, and optimization activities.

### **aws cloud & ai platform engineering**

* build and support cloud-native ai solutions leveraging aws services.
* develop and maintain solutions utilizing:
  + aws bedrock
  + aws lambda
  + amazon s3
  + amazon rds
  + related aws services
* implement scalable, secure, and highly available cloud architectures for ai workloads.
* collaborate with cloud and platform engineering teams to optimize performance and cost efficiency.

### **testing, quality & operational excellence**

* create and execute:
  + functional tests
  + integration tests
  + ai quality validation tests
  + performance tests
* support ai model evaluation, monitoring, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* troubleshoot production issues and implement long-term solutions.
* contribute to quality engineering processes and automated testing frameworks.

### **security, governance & responsible ai**

* ensure solutions comply with enterprise security standards and governance requirements.
* implement responsible ai practices that support explainability, transparency, and risk management.
* adhere to data privacy, compliance, and information security requirements.
* support auditability, monitoring, and governance controls within ai platforms.

### **required qualifications**

* bachelor's degree in computer science, artificial intelligence, machine learning, data science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
* strong hands-on experience developing enterprise ai/ml solutions.
* expertise in:
  + python
  + fastapi
  + rest apis
* experience with:
  + large language models (llms)
  + generative ai
  + prompt engineering
  + retrieval-augmented generation (rag)
* strong understanding of:
  + embeddings
  + vector databases
  + semantic search
  + knowledge retrieval
* hands-on experience with:
  + aws bedrock
  + aws lambda
  + amazon s3
  + amazon rds
* experience with:
  + postgresql
  + git
  + docker
  + ci/cd pipelines
* strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
* excellent communication and collaboration skills.

### **preferred qualifications**

* experience building enterprise generative ai applications.
* experience with intelligent document processing (idp) platforms and solutions.
* expertise in:
  + semantic search
  + knowledge retrieval systems
  + ai authoring applications
* experience with:
  + langchain
  + langgraph
* knowledge of:
  + ai evaluation frameworks
  + model monitoring
  + ai governance
* experience working within life sciences, pharmaceutical, healthcare, or other regulated industries.
* familiarity with cloud-native architecture patterns and microservices frameworks.

### **technical expertise**

candidates should demonstrate experience in:

* generative ai
* large language models (llms)
* prompt engineering
* retrieval-augmented generation (rag)
* intelligent document processing (idp)
* semantic search
* knowledge retrieval
* vector databases
* pgvector
* python development
* fastapi
* rest api design
* aws bedrock
* aws lambda
* amazon s3
* amazon rds
* postgresql
* docker
* git
* ci/cd
* langchain
* langgraph
* responsible ai

### **salary and other compensation**

the annual salary for this position is anticipated to be between **$120,000 and $145,000**, depending on experience, qualifications, geographic location, skills, and other factors permitted by law.

in addition to base salary, this position may be eligible for:

* annual performance-based bonus
* merit-based compensation increases
* employee referral bonuses, where applicable

the compensation information provided is accurate as of the date of this posting. cognizant reserves the right to modify compensation information based on business needs and applicable laws.

### **benefits**

cognizant offers a comprehensive benefits package, including:

* medical, dental, and vision coverage
* prescription drug coverage
* life and disability insurance
* employee assistance program (eap)
* paid vacation and company holidays
* retirement savings programs (subject to eligibility)
* parental and family support benefits
* employee wellness programs
* tuition reimbursement and professional development opportunities
* access to training, certifications, and career development programs

benefits are subject to eligibility requirements and applicable provincial regulations.

### **why cognizant**

* help shape the future of enterprise ai and generative ai solutions.
* develop cutting-edge ai-powered document processing and authoring platforms.
* work with leading cloud, ai, and data technologies.
* collaborate with experienced architects, engineers, and data scientists across global teams.
* gain exposure to large-scale enterprise ai transformation initiatives.
* access ongoing learning, certification, and career advancement opportunities.

### **equal opportunity employer**

cognizant is an equal opportunity employer. we are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where all associates feel valued, respected, and empowered to contribute their unique perspectives. all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ancestry, place of origin, colour, ethnic origin, citizenship, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

**applications will be accepted until the position is filled.**

title: Software Engineer
description:
surescripts serves the nation through simpler, trusted health intelligence sharing, in order to increase patient safety, lower costs and ensure quality care . we deliver insights at critical points of care for better decisions — from streamlining prior authorizations to delivering comprehensive medication histories to facilitating messages between providers.

**job summary**
===============

  

design, develop, assess, and troubleshoot software applications in an agile environment for the one of the nation's largest and most trusted healthcare information network. collaborate with architects, customers, product partners, and other engineers to solve complex engineering challenges by building high-volume applications that process millions of transactions a day, store multiple terabytes of data, and serve hundreds of thousands of customers.

software engineers are expected to use approved ai tools to improve speed, quality, and outcomes while remaining fully accountable for results.

  

**responsibilities**
====================

* develop and troubleshoot software applications in an agile environment, collaborating with others to produce high quality working tested software.
* contribute throughout the software development life cycle by estimating work, refining requirements, iterating on designs, delivering working software, communicating with partner teams, and supporting critical applications.
* lead or participate in design and code reviews; create and maintain automated tests; validate acceptance criteria; and monitor production systems to identify defects, incidents, and opportunities for improvement.
* apply shift-left quality practices to shorten feedback loops, reduce rework, prevent recurring defects, and ensure software is secure, reliable, observable, maintainable, and production-ready.
* cultivate and share application development, testing, troubleshooting, documentation, security, data privacy, and agile best practices.
* use approved ai-assisted development tools across design, implementation, testing, debugging, analysis, and documentation; review all output and remain accountable for delivered software’s correctness, security, performance, and maintainability.
continuously improve ai-assisted workflows based on measurable impact to delivery speed, quality, operations, and customer outcomes.  

  

**qualifications**
==================

**basic requirements:**
-----------------------

* bachelor’s degree in software engineering, computer science, a related field, or equivalent experience.
* 2+ years of experience in related, progressive software engineering roles.
* experience with multiple programming languages, such as c#, java, groovy, scala, python, typescript, or javascript.
* experience with current tools and platforms for developing, building, testing, deploying, and monitoring software systems.
* experience using modern ai-assisted software development tools to support coding, testing, debugging, documentation, and software delivery workflows.
demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively, communicate clearly, learn continuously, and ask for help or escalate issues when appropriate.  

  

**preferred qualifications:**
-----------------------------

* experience with high-volume, data-intensive applications.
* experience building web services and distributed systems.
* hands-on software troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and production support experience.
* familiarity with relational and non-relational database technologies.
* knowledge of application security, observability, data privacy, and responsible software delivery practices.
* healthcare technology industry experience.
* understanding of ai governance, security, privacy, compliance, quality, and responsible-use practices for software systems.
experience effectively leveraging generative ai tools, such as github copilot, claude, gemini, chatgpt, or similar tools, throughout the software development life cycle.  

  

**some of the technologies we use:**

* **languages:** c#, java, groovy, scala, python, typescript, javascript
* **frameworks:** .net core, spring/spring boot
* **front-end technologies:** angular, bootstrap, openid connect
* **infrastructure and data platforms:** kafka, cassandra, influxdb, hashicorp consul, docker, jenkins, ansible, google cloud platform, bigquery, airflow, composer, and terraform

surescripts embraces flexibility through its flexible hybrid work model for most positions. this model allows employees to work virtually while still utilizing our offices as collaboration centers. with alignment and agreement from your leadership, you can come and go from the office as needed.

to be considered for employment, applicants must have a valid u.s. work authorization allowing work without restrictions with surecripts in the u.s. at this time, we are unable to provide support or provide sponsorship for immigration benefits such as work visas. additionally, we do not participate in academic training programs or work-study programs through an academic institution that require employer endorsement of f-1/cpt or f-1/stem.

**what you’re like**
====================

you’re relentless in getting stuff done. you apply your expertise in an agile/devops world with other talented people. you’re curious about new technology and use your curiosity as fuel to deliver meaningful solutions. and you’re into incremental efforts that ultimately reap huge results.

**what we’re like**
===================

we’re a smart team that loves to work toward a common goal: delivering innovative, industry-leading solutions that improve patient care. we pride ourselves on quality work grounded in transparency and accountability. our goal is to make a positive impact on healthcare, be it on quality, cost, or patient safety.

**what the work is like**
=========================

is your thinking cap on? (do they still make those?) here, our challenge is to connect disparate, cross-functional skills to create the desired result. we focus on important milestones, work to understand diverse technologies and develop relationships with various groups of people with varied perspectives.

**why wait? apply now**

description:
**overview**
------------

at ford, you’ll work on ideas that matter, alongside passionate people who want to make a global impact. together, we’re shaping the next era of transportation—grounded in purpose, driven by progress. make your move.

* job type: full time
* work type: hybrid

  

**sr. specialist, yield management - gtm data engineer**  
  
  
  
we made history and now we work to transform the future – for our customers, our communities and our families. you'll see your work on the road every day, helping people move freely and pursue their dreams. at ford, you can build more than vehicles. come build what matters.

  

our **marketing, sales & service** organization advances the ford reputation as a visionary vehicle and mobility services company and helps deliver a trusted customer experience. use your marketing, sales and service expertise to turn data-driven insights into innovative solutions that enhance sales and customer loyalty. join us and be the eyes, ears and voice of ford.

**in this position...**
  
this role sits at the intersection of data engineering, business intelligence, data science, and data governance, and is ideal for someone who enjoys solving a business problem from raw datasets to endpoint to business-ready metric.
  
you'll work closely with data analysts, data scientists, and business stakeholders to ensure data and metrics are well-defined, accessible, reliable, well-documented, and easy to consume across the organization.
  
we are looking for a data engineer to design, build, and maintain end-to-end data solutions — from raw data ingestion through to curated metrics that power advanced analytics, business intelligence dashboards and business decision-making.

**what you'll do...**

* design, build, and maintain scalable etl/elt pipelines to ingest, transform, and deliver data from diverse sources into google bigquery and other cloud data platforms.
* develop, document, and maintain curated business-ready metrics to expose data and metrics to internal advanced analytics ai/ml models, dashboards, and variety of consumers.
* design and manage a curated data layer that translates raw data into consistent, business-friendly metrics and definitions.
* design, build and manage business friendly dashboards that provide valuable business insights to the executive leadership
    
  implement and maintain a data catalog / knowledge catalog (e.g., google data
* catalog) to improve data discoverability, lineage tracking, and metadata management.
* optimize bigquery performance through partitioning, clustering, query tuning, and cost-management best practices.
* build data quality checks, monitoring, and alerting to ensure pipeline reliability and data trustworthiness.
* collaborate with cross-functional teams (analytics, product, business) to gather requirements and translate them into scalable data models, metrics
* enforce data governance, security, and access control standards (pii handling, role-based access, encryption).
* write clean, well-tested, and maintainable code (python/sql, and backend frameworks for api based ingestion routines).
* create and maintain ci/cd pipelines for seamless deployments and change reviews across the code base.
participate in code reviews, architecture discussions, and ci/cd pipeline development for data and application deployments.  

**you'll have...**

**bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, or a related field or foreign equivalency degree** or equivalent combination of relevant education and experience.

* 5+ years of experience in data engineering, software engineering, or a full-stack data role.
* 3+ years in roles demonstrating strong programming skills in python, sql, bigquery, dataflow
* 3 years of strong hands-on experience with google bigquery, dataform (data modeling, query optimization, cost management, scheduled queries).
* 3 years of practical experience building and maintaining a data mart to standardize business metrics.
* 2+ years of experience in utilizing business intelligence tools like looker, power bi, tableau or custom apps built using dash
* 2+ years of proven experience designing and building ingestion routines based on apis (rest).
* 2+ years of experience in roles requiring a strong understanding of testing, monitoring, reliability, and maintainable software design
    
    
  **even better, you may have...**
* master's degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, or a related field
* experience using ai to build/maintain code/pipelines
* document data flows, api specifications, metric definitions, and system architecture for internal and cross-team use.
* experience working with a data catalog / metadata management tool (e.g., google data catalog) including lineage, tagging, and governance workflows.
* strong sql skills and experience with python for data pipeline development and automation.
* experience with cloud platforms, preferably google cloud platform (gcp) (cloud storage, cloud functions, dataflow, pub/sub, composer/airflow).
* solid understanding of data modeling concepts (dimensional modeling, star/snowflake schemas, normalization).
* familiarity with version control (git) and ci/cd practices for data and application deployments.
* strong understanding of data governance, security, and privacy best practices.
* experience with orchestration tools such as apache airflow / cloud composer.
* experience in the automotive, manufacturing, or connected vehicle data domain (a plus, given ford's business context).
* knowledge of bi/visualization tools (looker, tableau, power bi).
    
    
  you may not check every box, or your experience may look a little different from what we've outlined, but if you think you can bring value to ford motor company, we encourage you to apply!
    
    
  as an established global company, we offer the benefit of choice. you can choose what your ford future will look like: will your story span the globe, or keep you close to home? will your career be a deep dive into what you love, or a series of new teams and new skills? will you be a leader, a changemaker, a technical expert, a culture builder…or all of the above? no matter what you choose, we offer a work life that works for you, including:
    
  + immediate medical, dental, vision and prescription drug coverage
  + flexible family care days, paid parental leave, new parent ramp-up programs, subsidized back-up child care and more
  + family building benefits including adoption and surrogacy expense reimbursement, fertility treatments, and more

  + tuition assistance
  + established and active employee resource groups
  + paid time off for individual and team community service
  + a generous schedule of paid holidays, including the week between christmas and new year’s day
  + paid time off and the option to purchase additional vacation time.

title: Full-Stack Senior Developers
description:
natoli engineering is hiring two senior full-stack developers to design, build and run our software portfolio. for more than 50 years, natoli has made tablet compression tooling, tablet presses and related equipment for manufacturers worldwide from its headquarters in st. charles, missouri. our software includes instrumentation and control software for our presses, tooling management and inspection tools, customer portals such as tabletcad and our online store, internal business systems, and natoli.com.

this is a hands-on, senior individual-contributor role. you will write production code most days and take work from first conversation with a stakeholder through requirements, design, testing, deployment and support. the two developers share ownership of the portfolio and report to the head of it; neither role leads or manages a team.

ai is central to how we will build software. we want developers who already use ai coding assistants and agents every day, know how to build ai into development tools and practices, and know where ai output needs a careful human check. you should also have shipped and maintained real enterprise software, care about quality and documentation, and explain technical trade-offs clearly to non-technical people.

**key responsibilities**
------------------------

### **portfolio ownership and technical direction**

* share ownership of natoli's software portfolio with the other senior developer: software sold with our equipment, customer portals, internal business systems and natoli.com. divide the work and back each other up.
* shape the technical roadmap and architecture for each application, and agree priorities with the head of it: new features, customer commitments, security fixes and technical debt.
* help set and follow engineering standards: coding conventions, branching strategy, code review and definition of done.
* review code from peers and contractors, and pair on the hardest problems.
* recommend build-vs-buy decisions and evaluate frameworks, libraries, vendors and tools.

### **ai-enabled development**

* use ai coding assistants and agents [such as claude code, github copilot or cursor] every day across the sdlc: design, coding, refactoring, testing, code review and documentation.
* review, test and take responsibility for every line of ai-generated code before it ships.
* build ai into natoli's development tools and practices: ai-assisted pull request review, test generation inside a tdd workflow, documentation generation, and ai steps in ci/cd pipelines.
* maintain the shared context that makes ai tools effective here: repository instruction files, prompt libraries, coding conventions, and connectors (such as mcp servers) to internal systems and documentation.
* work with the head of it on ai guardrails: approved tools, what code and data may go to which ai service, security review of ai output, and licensing and ip.
* add ai features to natoli products and internal apps where they earn their place, such as search and assistants over technical documentation, using llm apis, retrieval and evaluation.
* measure the effect of ai on cycle time, defect rates and review effort, and evaluate new models and tools as they appear.
* share what works with colleagues across it through demos, short guides and pairing.

### **requirements and sdlc**

* gather requirements from customers, sales, support and internal users, and turn them into user stories, acceptance criteria and technical specs.
* own the full sdlc: discovery, design, build, test, release, maintenance and retirement.
* work in an agile cadence (scrum or kanban as each product needs) and help run backlog refinement, sprint planning, reviews and retrospectives.
* estimate effort, track delivery and report status, risks and trade-offs to the head of it.
* plan releases and versioning for customer-facing products, including release notes and upgrade paths.

### **architecture, data and performance**

* design secure, scalable, maintainable systems: front ends, apis, services and integrations with third-party systems (erp, crm, payments, identity).
* design relational schemas: normalization, keys and constraints, indexing, and safe, versioned migrations.
* choose the right data store for each job (relational, document, key-value, search) and tune queries for performance.
* design caching at every layer (cdn, http, application, distributed caches such as redis), including invalidation strategy.
* design multi-tenant patterns for saas products, including tenant data isolation.

### **quality and testing**

* practice and champion test-driven development (tdd).
* maintain a layered automated test suite: unit, integration, contract and end-to-end tests.
* build quality gates into the pipeline: test coverage, static analysis, linting and dependency and security scanning.
* triage production incidents, find root causes and write blameless post-incident reviews.

### **ci/cd, cloud and operations**

* build and maintain ci/cd pipelines that take every change from commit to production safely and repeatably.
* manage environments (dev, test, staging, production) with infrastructure as code, containers, feature flags and fast rollback.
* set up monitoring, logging and alerting, and define uptime and performance targets for each application.
* own application security: owasp top 10, secrets management, patching, access control, and support for customer and regulatory audits.

### **documentation**

* write and maintain architecture diagrams, architecture decision records (adrs), api docs (openapi), data dictionaries and runbooks.
* keep onboarding guides current so a new developer can ship code in their first week.
* work with support and marketing on customer-facing technical documentation.

### **company website**

* own the natoli.com platform, hosting, performance, security and uptime.
* keep it accessible (wcag 2.2 aa), fast (core web vitals), and technically sound for seo and analytics.
* partner with marketing on new pages, forms, campaigns and integrations (crm, marketing automation).

**required qualifications**
---------------------------

replace the bracketed technologies with your actual stack; keep the rest as written.

* bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* 7+ years of professional software development, including 3+ years at a senior level owning the design and delivery of production systems.
* a track record of shipping and supporting enterprise applications in production, ideally several products at once.
* expert, daily use of ai coding assistants and agents [claude code, github copilot, cursor or similar] in professional work, with concrete examples of faster delivery or higher quality.

title: Senior Health Data Modeler
description:
for over twenty-seven years rcr technology corporation has delivered the highest quality services to our clients with an expansive portfolio of industry-relevant services, and deep technical capabilities around data management and application development.

  

we are seeking a hands-on senior health data modeler to support the illinois enterprise data warehouse (edw) within the enterprise data warehouse & analytics group. the data modeler will work with large healthcare datasets and translate the client’s business requirements into enterprise systems, applications, and process designs for large, complex health data solutions.

this role owns the design, governance, and evolution of the conceptual, logical, and physical data models that underpin the edw platform and its modernization initiatives. it drives and supports initiatives for the il edw while participating in the wider edw group’s focus areas — data usage and governance, information management, privacy and security, data analytics and visualization, and information modeling — bridging the current-state teradata edw to the future-state cloud (azure / snowflake) architecture.

working closely with data architects, etl/data engineers, bi developers, dbas, and business subject matter experts, the senior health data modeler ensures data structures are scalable, standards-compliant, well-documented, and aligned to enterprise and regulatory requirements across the health and human services ecosystem.

roles & responsibilities

data architecture & strategy

* develop and deliver long-term strategic goals for data architecture vision and standards in conjunction with data users, clients, and other key stakeholders.

* lead data architecture, data modeling, and data movement initiatives to enhance the data warehouse supporting analytics for medicaid, medicare, and commercial healthcare data — including domains such as claims, provider, tpl, and member information subject areas.

* create an end-to-end vision for how logical design translates into one or more physical databases and how data flows through successive stages.

* document data architecture and the enterprise environment to maintain a current, accurate view that supports a single version of the truth and scales to future analytical needs.

data modeling & design

* analyze and translate business needs into long-term solution data models; evaluate existing data systems and work with the development team to create conceptual data models and data flows.

* design and maintain conceptual, logical, and physical data models across staging, integration, and semantic/presentation layers.

* develop dimensional models (kimball star/snowflake), normalized (oltp/3nf), olap, and data vault patterns; implement slowly changing dimensions, role-playing dimensions, dimensional hierarchies, surrogate keys, and data classification.

* define primary/foreign keys, indexes, partitioning, constraints, and referential integrity rules to ensure data quality and performance.

* produce and maintain entity-relationship diagrams (erds), data flow diagrams, and model documentation using erwin or equivalent tools.

governance, quality & compliance

* ensure data strategies and architectures are in regulatory compliance; identify where existing policies and procedures require change or where new ones are needed.

* oversee the mapping of data sources, data movement, interfaces, and analytics with the goal of ensuring data quality.
