title: Data Scientist II
description:
**company description**

since opening our first self-storage facility in 1972, **public storage** has grown to become the **largest owner and operator of self-storage facilities** in the world. with **thousands of locations** across the u.s. and europe, and more than 170 million net rentable square feet of real estate, we're also one of the largest landlords.

we've been recognized as **a great place to work** by the great place to work institute. and, our employees have also voted us as having **best career growth**, ranked us in the **top 5% for work culture**, and in the **top 10% for diversity and inclusion**.

we're a member of the **s&p 500** and **ft global 500**. our common and preferred stocks trade on the new york stock exchange.

public storage is the nation’s leading self-storage provider, recognized for its iconic orange doors and commitment to delivering simple, reliable solutions to millions of customers across the country. we are expanding our creative team to enhance our consistent and engaging visual brand presence.

 **job description**

at public storage, data science sits right next to the decisions. prices move every day across thousands of locations, and our models help decide them. as a data scientist ii, you’ll be the go-to data scientist for one part of the business: customer and revenue, capital allocation (acquisitions, development and finance), or operations. you’ll be part of their planning, shape the questions, and build the models they rely on.

we’re a small, senior team that works like a startup inside an s&p 500 company. ideas get to production quickly, you own your work, and it shows up in the business rather than in a slide deck.

*what you’ll do*

* **build and own production models.** pricing and elasticity, promotions, marketing effectiveness, demand forecasting, retention, lifetime value and recommendation. you’ll write production-grade python and sql, and use llms, embeddings and rag where they’re the right tool.
* **be the data science partner for your business area.** join their planning, turn ambiguous questions into well-scoped problems, and present results as decisions and dollars, not model metrics.
* **run experiments that change what we do.** design and analyze a/b tests, holdouts and quasi-experiments. set the success metric before launch and report the honest result after it.
* **build once, reuse everywhere.** work from our shared customer and real estate data and certified metrics, and add reusable models to a shared catalog so the next problem starts faster.
* **grow the team around you.** mentor analysts and junior scientists through code review and pairing, and back up a teammate’s business area when needed.
* **own the full model lifecycle.** versioning, retraining, drift monitoring and documentation, meeting our model governance standards before anything goes live.

*what success looks like*

* business partners depend on your models every week.
* your experiments change what the company does, not just what it knows.
* junior scientists get better because of your code reviews.

  
**qualifications**  

* bachelor’s degree in a stem or quantitative field, such as statistics, computer science, economics, engineering or applied mathematics.
* 3+ years in a production data science role, or 2+ years with a master’s, or 1+ year with a phd.
* strong sql and python in production settings, not notebooks alone.
* applied statistics in both frequentist and bayesian frameworks, plus experimental design and causal inference.
* a track record of shipping models that drove measurable business outcomes.
* experience with a cloud data platform. google cloud and bigquery preferred; snowflake, aws or azure considered.
* able to turn an ambiguous business question into a scoped problem, and explain uncertainty and trade-offs to non-technical partners.

*preferred*

* 5+ years of production data science in pricing, revenue management, marketing, real estate, retail or consumer analytics.
* the modern ml stack: scikit-learn, xgboost/lightgbm, pytorch, pymc, prophet, and experiment tracking with mlflow or vertex ai.
* mlops experience: model registries, ci/cd, scheduled retraining and monitoring.
* dbt and orchestration tools such as airflow or cloud composer.
* hands-on experience with llm applications, vector search, rag or agentic ai workflows.

  
**additional information**

**workplace**

* one of our values pillars is to work as one team and we believe that there is no replacement for in-person collaboration but understand the value of some flexibility. public storage teammates are expected to work in the office five days each week with the option to take up to three flexible remote days per month.

public storage is an equal opportunity employer and embraces diversity. we do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or any other protected status. all qualified candidates are encouraged to apply.

\*\*sponsorship for work authorization is not available for this posting. candidates must be authorized to work in the u.s. without restrictions or requiring sponsorship now or in the future. we do not provide training plans or support for f-1 opt, stem opt extensions, or future visa sponsorship.\*\*

title: Senior Devops Engineer
description:
localize (https://localizejs.com/) is seeking a senior devops / platform engineer to join our growing product engineering team. as localize expands, the scalability, reliability, and performance of our infrastructure and applications have become paramount. as a critical member of our product engineering team, you will own and improve localize's technical infrastructure, databases, and platform tooling, including monitoring, alerting, and maintenance. your scope extends beyond delivering product tickets: you will strengthen the software development lifecycle (sdlc) and be responsible for the scalability, stability, reliability, performance, and security of the localize platform.

you will partner closely with leadership and fellow product engineers to translate business priorities and customer needs into execution, remove obstacles, and make thoughtful tradeoffs that keep the team moving forward. like every product engineer at localize, you are expected to be customer-obsessed and business-aligned: connect technical decisions to customer trust, product quality, and business outcomes. this role reports directly to the engineering manager.

**key responsibilities:**

* oversee and manage localize's infrastructure across aws and cloudflare.
* ensure the scalability, reliability, performance, and security of localize's data stores, specifically redis and mongodb, through effective configuration, monitoring, query optimization, and backup management.
* own and improve deployment ~~process.~~and release processes, emphasizing automation, repeatability, safe rollouts, and reliable rollback procedures.
* partner with product engineers to improve the full sdlc, including development environments, ci/cd, automated quality and security checks, and release readiness. treat this work as a core engineering responsibility alongside product delivery.
* take a leading role in infrastructure security and soc 2 type ii compliance, partnering with engineering leadership and compliance stakeholders to operate and improve technical controls, maintain audit-ready evidence, support audits, and remediate findings. responsibilities include access management, vulnerability management, change management, logging, and backup and recovery controls.
* help lead incident response and blameless post-incident reviews, translating lessons into improvements that protect customers and reduce recurring operational risk.
* prioritize infrastructure and sdlc improvements based on customer impact, business priorities, and risk. communicate tradeoffs clearly and assess results through reliability, delivery speed, security, and cost-efficiency.
* own and improve monitoring of uptime and performance using tools such as datadog, clickhouse, hyperdx, and more
* identify, plan and implement improvements and optimizations for infrastructure regarding cost, reliability, scalability.
* develop and maintain detailed documentation and maps of our infrastructure and dependencies.
* actively learn new technologies and systems to improve the efficiency and capabilities of our infrastructure.

technologies

*experience with the specific technologies below is a plus unless listed under must-have skills. security and compliance, including support for soc 2 type ii, are core responsibilities of this role—not optional areas of involvement.*

* aws: elastic beanstalk, sqs, cloudfront, ec2, elasticache, route 53, vps
* platforms: kubernetes, aws beanstalk, argocd, github actions
* languages: terragrunt, opentofu, terraform
* monitoring: clickhouse, datadog, hyperdx, grafana
* security & compliance: soc2 type ii
* cloudflare dns, workers, zero trust (warp)
* business intelligence: stitch, metabase, snowflake
* application technology: mongodb (atlas + cloud manager), typescript, react

**must-have skills:**

* 5+ years engineering experience. at least 4 years of experience in a devops role.
* expertise in managing and optimizing infrastructure in aws.
* redis and mongodb, including configuration, monitoring, optimization, and management of backups.
* expertise in infrastructure as code (iac) tools opentofu and terragrunt
* experience with manual or automated deployment & release management.
* understanding of continuous integration and continuous deployment (ci/cd) processes and tools.
* hands-on experience securing production infrastructure, including least-privilege access controls, vulnerability remediation, secrets management, and security monitoring.
* ability to translate security and compliance requirements into repeatable engineering practices, maintain evidence of control operation, and support soc 2 type ii audit readiness and remediation.
* experience partnering with product engineers to improve the sdlc and balance feature delivery with reliability, security, and developer productivity.
* a customer-obsessed, business-aligned approach: understand how infrastructure decisions affect customers, prioritize work by impact, and explain technical tradeoffs to technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
* skills in assessing and optimizing performance of infrastructure and applications for improved performance, reliability, scalability, and cost-efficiency.
* proficiency in command line scripting
* disaster recovery planning including data integrity and availability in case of emergencies.
* experience with apm and logging tools such as datadog, new relic, sentry, or kibana.

**nice-to-have skills or experience:**

* product engineering languages and frameworks such as typescript, react, mongoose, less, and more
* applied llm engineering:
  + hands-on experience integrating llms into production systems (openai, anthropic, gemini, or similar)
  + strong understanding of prompt engineering, context engineering, and token management
  + experience designing or implementing rag pipelines, embeddings, and vector search
  + familiarity with emerging llm infrastructure patterns and protocols (e.g., mcp, tool/function calling, agents)
* working in a fast-paced environment where you're accountable for your work and you're passionate in working with customers

**benefits & perks:**

you'll be joining a close knit and talented team, with plenty of opportunity for professional growth. we offer compensation + benefits that are on par with large companies, while also placing a high value on maintaining a healthy work-life balance.

* competitive salary
* 401(k) plan + 4% matching
* 100% company-paid health, dental, and vision insurance
* company-paid life insurance and ad&d insurance
* work anywhere in north america (we are 100% remote)
* new macbook (or computer of your choice)
* monthly stipend for home internet costs
* generous pto package

**about localize:**

the localize platform is used by 700+ companies to automate the translation of their web and mobile applications and bring their products & services to new markets at record speed. we support organizations like the bay area toll authority (https://www.bayareatollpaymentplan.org/s/) in translating their payments website, baptist health (https://www.baptistjax.com/) in making their healthcare site multilingual, and the massachusetts department of elementary and secondary education (https://www.doe.mass.edu/) in offering their content in several languages. to see our product in action, click any of those links and use the website's language switcher to switch from english to another language.

localize works by providing a code snippet (similar to the google analytics javascript snippet) that our customers add to their website/web app. the localize snippet pulls in content from the page into the localize dashboard where our customers log in to add translations and manage their content. localize automatically deploys those translations to the customer's production site, reducing development costs and accelerating time to market.

we are a team of ~30 people working fully remote. we offer competitive pay, a full benefits package, and a culture with an emphasis on work + life balance.

**to apply:**

along with your resume, send us a cover letter that showcases your personality and tells us why we should hire you. previous experience working in a remote position is a must.

*this position is only open to applicants who reside in and are eligible to work in the us.*

title: Data and Analytics Architect
description:
at orion180, we don’t just stand out for what we do; we shine because of how we do it. our mission is to deliver an exceptional insurance experience through innovative technology, unparalleled customer service, and a comprehensive suite of products. our vision is to be the premier global provider of insurance solutions and redefine the insurance industry.

orion180 is proud to call three vibrant cities home. our headquarters on florida’s stunning space coast in melbourne offers an exceptional quality of life, with affordable housing, excellent transportation, and close proximity to major cities like orlando, tampa, and miami. our irving, texas, office places us in a dynamic center of culture, business, and entertainment, keeping us closely connected to innovation and growth. our draper, utah, location, nestled in the heart of the salt lake valley, connects us to a rapidly growing tech ecosystem and provides access to the outdoor lifestyle and natural beauty the region is known for.

**about the role:**

we believe analytics isn't a back-office function. it's not a reporting layer bolted onto the business after the real decisions get made. it's the foundation that tells you where risk actually lives, where growth is hiding, and where you're missing opportunities before it's too late to do anything about it.

that belief is driving real investment in our people, platforms, and in how deeply analytics is woven into the way we operate. from underwriting to distribution to customer experience, we're building a data culture where insight drives action.

it also means evolving how we think about the role of a data and analytics architect.

the expectation isn’t just technical execution. it’s curiosity. ownership. the ability to step into ambiguity, frame the problem, and help guide the business toward better decisions.

**what you’ll do:**

in this role you will be designing and governing scalable data platforms on the microsoft cloud. key responsibilities include bridging the gap between complex core insurance systems (policy admin, claims, billing) and our analytical consumers, implementing data lakehouse architectures, ensuring data governance, and leading cloud migrations and platform integrations. ideal candidates require expert-level proficiency in azure data services and data modeling. you will collaborate with data scientists, analysts, and business leaders to turn raw data into scalable, production-ready assets for real-time analytics engines, portfolio risk platforms, and client-facing digital products.

**data architecture & modeling**

* design secure, scalable, and resilient data architectures using the medallion (bronze/silver/gold) pattern and **delta lake** pattern in close partnership with the enterprise innovation & technology (i & t) organization.
* lead physical and logical data modeling efforts across relational, dimensional (kimball / star schema), and data vault methodologies.
* develop high-performance data processing logic using pyspark, spark sql, and python on **azure databricks** and synapse analytics.
* define data abstraction layers ensuring third-party saas and legacy databases map cleanly to machine-readable schemas for efficient and measurable consumption.
* architect secure, scalable model context protocol (mcp) servers and gateways to connect llms and ai agents to internal analytical data repositories.

**platform & engineering standards**

* establish architectural patterns and best practices for data ingestion, transformation, and pipeline orchestration.
* evaluate, benchmark, and recommend components of our modern data stack in alignment with i & t’s strategy and be an active participant/contributor to the architecture review board.
* work closely with data engineers to conduct architecture reviews and mentor engineers on scalability and pipeline efficiency.
* architect semantic layer solutions and data product structures to power self-service power bi implementations.

* 6+ years of experience designing and supporting production machine learning solutions in cloud environments.

**preferred qualifications**

* hands-on experience with azure machine learning, databricks, mlflow, or comparable ml platforms.

title: Python Software Architect
description:
**python software architect- remote**  
  
bright vision technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, ai, data, and enterprise solutions across the united states.  
  
this is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.  
  
**job title**: python software architect  
**location**: 100% remote (u.s.)  
**position** **type**: full-time, direct w2  
**salary range**: $100,000–$150,000 annually  
**experience** **required**: 6+ years  
  
**sponsorship:** u.s. citizens, green card holders, ead holders, and h-1b transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. we are unable to sponsor new h-1b visa petitions for this position.  
  
**job summary**  
  
we are seeking an experienced python software architect to design, build, and continuously enhance complex enterprise-grade applications, data-intensive services, and automation platforms. this is a hands-on engineering role focused on delivering robust, secure, and high-performance python systems that operate reliably within distributed and mission-critical production environments. the ideal candidate will bring deep python expertise combined with strong fundamentals in software architecture, data engineering, and operational support, and will partner closely with product, data, and infrastructure teams to translate ambiguous business problems into well-engineered technical solutions. you will be expected to think beyond surface-level fixes, identify root causes of complex issues, and proactively raise the engineering bar across the team.  
  
**key responsibilities**

* provide end-to-end design, development, and advanced technical troubleshooting for complex enterprise-grade python applications, reaching beyond routine approaches to solve novel and non-trivial technical problems.
* develop secure, high-quality, production-ready python code and implement algorithms that perform reliably within distributed systems, with thoughtful consideration of concurrency, fault-tolerance, and observability.
* produce architecture and design artifacts for complex applications, ensuring that day-to-day development adheres to defined design constraints, performance requirements, and enterprise standards.
* develop and optimize data processing logic for large-scale datasets, including extraction, transformation, validation, deduplication, enrichment, and performance tuning to support both batch and near-real-time workloads.
* gather, analyze, and synthesize large and diverse datasets to support continuous improvement of applications and business processes, surfacing insights that lead to measurable improvements in product, reliability, or cost.
* develop reporting mechanisms, dashboards, and data visualizations where required to support operational insights, leveraging libraries and tools appropriate to the stakeholder audience.
* identify hidden defects, performance bottlenecks, and architectural weaknesses, and proactively implement improvements to coding standards, system reliability, and overall maintainability.
* contribute substantively to engineering best practices, conduct thorough peer code reviews, and participate constructively in architectural design discussions, mentoring less-senior engineers along the way.
* participate fully in agile development cycles and ci/cd processes, ensuring consistent, stable, and frequent deployments with appropriate testing, rollback, and monitoring strategies in place.
* collaborate closely with cross-functional stakeholders — product managers, data scientists, operations engineers, and business analysts — to clarify requirements and translate them into scalable technical solutions.
* support operational stability through structured incident response, debugging, log analysis, and post-incident reviews in enterprise environments, contributing actionable preventative measures.

**required qualifications**

* bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* five or more years of applied python development experience in enterprise-grade environments.
* strong experience building and maintaining large-scale production applications with significant uptime and reliability requirements.
* hands-on experience with relational database systems such as oracle, ms sql server, postgresql, or sybase, including query tuning and schema design.
* strong understanding of the full software development lifecycle (sdlc), including requirements, design, build, test, release, and ongoing support.
* proven hands-on experience across system design, application development, automated testing, and operational support.
* strong working knowledge of data structures, algorithms, and computational efficiency, with the ability to make sound design trade-offs.
* demonstrated experience debugging and maintaining complex, enterprise-level applications in production.
* solid understanding of agile methodologies, ci/cd practices, application resiliency patterns, and secure coding standards.
* ability to manage multiple concurrent projects in dynamic, fast-changing environments while keeping stakeholders well informed.
* strong written and verbal communication skills, with experience collaborating with both technical and business teams.

**preferred qualifications**

* strong shell scripting skills in unix/linux environments and comfort working with command-line tooling.

title: Software Engineer- Full Stack
description:
at lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. we unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. headquartered in indianapolis, indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. this is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. if you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.
  
  
full stack software engineer – software product engineering
  
come develop great software solutions to solve exciting problems that help patients!
  
the software product engineering team is looking for a full stack engineer. are you determined to own and complete complicated and technically ambitious work? are you passionate about technology, with extensive full stack development experience across both front-end and back-end systems? our team is actively adopting ai across the development lifecycle to help us build better software, faster, and we're looking for engineers who are excited to be part of that evolution while bringing strong engineering fundamentals. if so, please apply.
  
  
**what you'll be doing:**  
as part of a collaborative team of versatile engineers, you will build reusable, composable software components, taking them from design and requirement specifications through implementation, testing, and integration into software product engineering's next-generation platform ecosystem. by continuously improving the design, building for maintainability, and ensuring the product meets both business and patient needs, your work will transform patient experiences and improve treatment outcomes.
  
  
**how you'll succeed :**  

* develop, test, and deploy components into provisioned cloud platform environments through automated continuous integration and deployment (ci/cd) processes.
* review and implement technical designs, translating them into apis, user interfaces, libraries, and services across a range of programming languages while adhering to lilly's architecture, design, implementation, and security standards.
* use ai coding tools to accelerate design exploration, implementation, testing, and debugging, while owning the correctness, security, and maintainability of everything you ship.
* build and integrate ai capabilities into products, such as llm-powered features and agent tools, where they improve patient and user outcomes.
* build working knowledge of medical device delivery models and quality systems, including gxp expectations, to ensure solutions align with regulatory requirements and timelines.
* integrate open source and licensed components into larger solutions, making practical reuse decisions and ensuring dependencies are sourced through approved enterprise channels (e.g., artifactory) and meet security and licensing requirements.
* investigate and propose solutions to development and design problems through open collaboration and healthy debate, including scope estimation and forecasting.
* collaborate effectively with product managers, designers, engineers, stakeholders, and vendors within the team and across lilly.
* establish strong relationships with technical leaders and architects to influence technology direction for software product engineering platforms and products.
* practice effective source control, code review, and collaborative programming to drive high-quality outcomes.
* partner with data professionals to implement database and data warehousing solutions.
* complete projects with minimal supervision and direction.

**what you should bring :**  

* experience designing and building cloud-native applications using containerized services and microservices architectures on aws or azure.
* exposure to large-scale architectural patterns, ideally with hands-on experience implementing event-driven systems using apache kafka (or similar) for scalable, resilient processing.
* strong object-oriented programming skills, excellent debugging skills, and expertise with data serialization, rest apis, and version control.
* experience with typescript, node.js, or a jvm language (e.g., kotlin) for building front-end and back-end services, along with html, css, and sass; python experience is a plus.
* experience building applications with modern javascript frameworks (e.g., react, angular, vue, next.js, or nuxt) and modern build tooling (e.g., vite, webpack).
* familiarity with build automation and containerization technologies such as github actions, jenkins, docker, and kubernetes.
* experience using ai coding tools (e.g., claude code, github copilot, cursor) in your development workflow; familiarity with llm application patterns such as rag, tool use, or mcp is a plus.
* a proven track record of agile software development, demonstrated through a portfolio of software development projects.

**your basic qualifications :**  

* bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, or a related technical engineering discipline, including software engineering, computer engineering, information systems, cybersecurity, information science, network engineering, systems engineering, computer information systems (cis), management information systems (mis), cloud computing, data science
* 2+ years of experience in software engineering, including full stack development across front-end and back-end systems
* experience with multiple languages (polyglot programming), including javascript/typescript or a jvm language (e.g., kotlin)
* professional experience delivering software solutions across the full development life cycle, including project initiation, design, development, testing, deployment, maintenance, support, and retirement
* qualified applicants must be authorized to work in the united states on a full-time basis. lilly will not provide support for or sponsor work authorization or visas for this role, including but not limited to f-1 cpt, f-1 opt, f-1 stem opt, j-1, h-1b, tn, o-1, e-3, h-1b1, or l-1.

additional information
  
position based in san francisco, california with a hybrid work model.
  
about the organization
  
tech @ lilly builds and maintains capabilities using groundbreaking technologies like most prominent tech companies. what differentiates tech @ lilly is that we create new possibilities through tech to advance our purpose – creating medicines that make life better for people around the world, like data driven drug discovery and connected clinical trials. we hire the best technology professionals from a variety of backgrounds, so they can bring an assortment of knowledge, skills, and diverse thinking to deliver innovative solutions in every area of our business.
  
lilly's software product engineering (spe) organization is focused on building core foundational software platforms to accelerate our ability to reach and support patients, digitally. this organization is powered by software engineering experts that solve challenging problems around patient engagement and drug discovery with code.

title: US- Java Engineer - Pricing
description:
at moneygram, we're combining the strength of a trusted global brand with the agility of a tech-forward, growth driven culture. with 85+ years of experience and a presence in more than 200 countries and territories, we've built a foundation of stability and trust to help millions of people around the world send funds quickly, securely, and affordably.

if you're eager to shape the future of cross-border payments and financial services, join us as we transform how the world moves money.
  
  
**about the role & team culture:**  
we are looking for strong engineering and product professionals who excel in a dynamic environment. at moneygram, we value engineers who can navigate ambiguity without waiting for direction and take ownership of outcomes rather than simply completing tasks. in this role, you will be expected to make sound decisions using available information, communicate proactively, and balance autonomy with collaboration. we are building a culture where individuals seek solutions rather than assigning blame, always aiming to build trusted relationships across functions while maintaining a steadfast focus on business and customer outcomes over functional wins.
  
  
**job summary:**  
we are seeking a highly skilled a java engineer with 2-5 years of experience to contribute to the design, development, and deployment of our high-volume enterprise applications. in this role, you will architect and build robust, secure, and compliant transactional backend systems, optimize billing/pricing engines, and drive technical excellence. you will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to build high-performance, low-latency financial software hosted on aws.
  
  
**core responsibilities:**  

* architect, design, and implement high-availability, fault-tolerant enterprise java applications.
* write clean, secure, and highly optimized code utilizing modern java features to handle large-scale financial transactions.
* design and scale distributed microservices architectures optimized for transactional consistency and speed.
* optimize complex data models, design transactional database schemas, and manage relational and nosql databases.
* build and secure robust apis for seamless third-party financial network integrations and erp connections.
* manage and automate secure cloud-based deployment pipelines using modern devops practices on aws.
* lead code reviews, enforce strict financial security coding standards, and mentor engineering team members.
* identify financial transactional bottlenecks, optimize query performance, and ensure zero-downtime production deployments.

* databases: postgresql, oracle db and couchbase.

* testing & tools: junit 5, mockito, testcontainers, automated contract testing, maven, or gradle.

**experience requirements:**  

* minimum 2 to 5 years of professional backend software engineering experience.
* proven track record of working on large-scale distributed systems, enterprise saas products, or transactional banking/financial applications.
* extensive experience building and deploying software within agile/scrum environments.
* demonstrated experience migrating monolithic applications to distributed microservices architectures.

**qualifications & competencies:**  

* bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, information technology, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* strong system-level troubleshooting skills with the ability to make sound decisions using available data.
* self-starter mindset with the ability to navigate ambiguity and execute tasks without waiting for step-by-step direction.
* exceptional proactive communication skills to build trusted relationships and influence outcomes across cross-functional teams.
* excellent english written and verbal communication skills

**preferred (good to have) skills:**  

* direct experience building or maintaining complex pricing-related applications, financial billing engines, monetization platforms.
* hands-on technical exposure or integration experience with ouaf framework or oracle revenue management system (ormb).
* familiarity with integrating machine learning models into java backends, using ai apis, or implementing predictive intelligence for financial workflows (e.g., fraud detection, intelligent routing).
* hands-on experience with google cloud platform analytics tools such as bigquery, looker, cloud dataflow, or dataproc for financial data processing.

this role will collaborate with architects and key stakeholders to interpret and implement engineering and operational guidance within a specific security domain or program. contribute to multiple projects, leading the creation of comprehensive roadmaps for various projects or departments. this role will involve championing operational excellence by designing and executing advanced process improvement initiatives. drive significant cost optimization efforts by identifying and implementing strategic savings opportunities. additionally, enhance security risk visibility by developing and overseeing robust risk management frameworks. also, participate in domain-related incident response efforts as needed, maintain defined security architecture, and manage domain-specific security tools.  
  
this specific role will apply application security engineering, assessment, and secure software development practices across cloud-native, web, api, containerized, and microservices-based applications. it supports the application vulnerability assessment lifecycle and integrates security controls and testing throughout the software development lifecycle and devsecops pipelines.

**job description:**

  

* works with architects and key stakeholders to interpret engineering and operational guidance in a specific security domain/program and contributes to multiple projects related to it.
* lead the creation of comprehensive roadmaps for multiple projects or departments.
* champion operational excellence by designing and executing process improvement initiatives.
* drive significant cost optimization efforts by identifying and implementing strategic savings opportunities.
* enhance security risk visibility by developing and overseeing robust risk management frameworks.
* participate in domain related incident response efforts as needed, maintain defined security architecture, and manage domain specific security tools.

**the posting range for this position is:**

118,500.00 - 171,825.00

**qualifications:**  
  
**education**

* required bachelor's degree in computer science, information security, or related field or equivalent work experience.

**experience**

* required 5+ years cybersecurity experience with a preferred focus on application security, vulnerability assessments, and secure software development practices
* experience implementing risk remediation prioritization and collaboration with key stakeholders to understand risk drivers and remediation blockers.
* experience monitoring and tracking remediation efforts, staying abreast of emerging threats, and leading the design, implementation, and maintenance of domain specific toolsets.
* experience conducting static application security testing (sast), dynamic application security testing (dast), software composition analysis (sca), software bill of materials (sbom) analysis, api security assessments, secure code reviews, threat modeling, and risk assessments.

**knowledge skills and abilities**

coreweave is the essential cloud for ai™. built for pioneers by pioneers, coreweave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale ai with confidence. trusted by leading ai labs, startups, and global enterprises, coreweave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. founded in 2017, coreweave became a publicly traded company (nasdaq: crwv) in march 2025. learn more at www.coreweave.com.

the strategy and transformation team builds intelligent internal systems that improve how coreweave operates. the team partners with groups including finance, supply chain, hr, and core business operations to develop ai-powered workflows and first-party applications that connect enterprise platforms such as erp, hris, mrp, pdm, and dcim.

we're looking for a curious, energetic, and innovative **software and ai engineer** to join our strategy and transformation team. you'll help build intelligent ai agents and full-stack applications supporting finance, supply chain, hr, legal and data center operations, integrating with systems such as erp, hris, mrp, pdm, and dcim.

this role is ideal for an early-career engineer with solid programming fundamentals who wants to grow at the intersection of software engineering, product development, and applied ai.

as a software and ai engineer, it systems, you'll develop well-defined features, application components, and ai workflows with guidance from experienced engineers. you'll contribute across the development lifecycle, including implementation, testing, deployment, documentation, and production support.

* familiarity with git, collaborative development, and ci/cd concepts.
* basic understanding of cloud platforms such as aws, azure, or gcp.

* familiarity with workato, boomi, or other integration and automation platforms.

bitdeer ai, a full-stack ai cloud provider (ai data center, iaas, paas, maas) under bitdeer technologies group and a preferred nvidia cloud partner, is engineered to power the ai of tomorrow.

with the group's 3 gigawatts of power capacity deployed and under development globally, bitdeer holds a decisive advantage in the ai era: the massive energy, physical infrastructure, and compute foundation required to run intelligence at global scale. operating across strategic international hubs, including the united states, singapore, and europe, we build on one core promise: one cloud, infinite possibilities.

career opportunities within the program:

* cloud platform engineering
* ai operations, mlops & site reliability engineering
* maas, model serving & ai training infrastructure
* ai agent & application engineering
* ai & cloud security engineering
* ai research

successful candidates will start in one of the above areas based on the interview assessment and business needs. opportunities to rotate across different roles will also be provided as part of career development.

**how you will stand out**

* fresh graduates (bachelors, masters, phd) from all disciplines and/or candidates with up to 2 years of related work experience.
* strong programming ability in one or more languages, including go, python, c++, java, rust, or related technologies.
* experience with kubernetes, docker, helm, terraform, openstack, prometheus, grafana, argo, istio, postgresql, redis, message queues, distributed storage, or other cloud-native technologies is highly preferred.
* experience in developing or operating large-scale cloud platforms, kubernetes platforms, ai training platforms, inference platforms, or agent platforms is highly preferred.
* deep enthusiasm for cutting-edge ai infrastructure, cloud-native technologies, and building large-scale, globally distributed systems.
* proven achievements in academics, engineering projects, top-tier publications, open-source contributions, or programming/algorithm competitions.
* a strong ownership mentality, engineering discipline, and a commitment to creating a meaningful impact early in your career as we build the foundation for next-generation ai.

* an inclusive, respectful environment with open workspaces and an energetic, start-up spirit.
* a fast-growing company with opportunities to network with industry pioneers and enthusiasts.
* the ability to contribute directly and make an impact on the future of the digital asset and ai computing industry.
* involvement in new projects and in developing processes/systems.
* personal accountability, autonomy, rapid growth, and learning opportunities.
* attractive benefits and development such as training and mentoring.

title: Full Stack Software Engineer
description:
**job requisition:** full stack software engineer

**department:** information technology

**reports to:** head of ai program management

**location:** remote

**employment type:** full-time

**role overview**

alaris acquisitions serves as a premier m&a advisory firm exclusively dedicated to the wealth management industry. we are seeking a mid to senior level full stack & data engineer to drive the technical evolution of our proprietary applications, including our lens compatibility platform. you will collaborate closely with our internal engineering team and our barcelona-based agency partners, nexus creative, to develop comprehensive seller and buyer portals, webflow-driven marketing web applications, and a robust data infrastructure.

key responsibilities

* **data lakehouse architecture:** build and manage an open-format raw data layer using azure databricks, starting with our initial workspace and catalog rollout.
* **pipeline & data engineering:** ingest raw, unchanged data from google drive, postgres, databricks and n8n platforms. manage complex workflows using n8n to execute on a single data layer.
* **backend & api development:** build, extend, and maintain restful apis in c# on .net core, and work with our agency partner nexus creative we migrate our backend.
* **ai-first integration & data prep:** structure and prepare data for advanced analytics and local-model execution using claude and related llm tools, ensuring continuous feeds for ingesting scripts and vector storage.
* **security & governance:** implement strict role-based access controls to guarantee that buyer, seller, and internal data remain completely isolated. ensure robust data lineage so that every fact traces back to its source file. so when we access data only data the user has access to is visible.
* **portal development:** architect and optimize dynamic buyer and seller portals on azure app service, ensuring a premium front-end ui/ux for our wealth management clientele.
* **strategic execution:** operate within our entrepreneurial operating system (eos) framework, taking ownership of q4 rocks, maintaining our weekly scorecard, and presenting key stage 2 architecture decisions on the level 10 (l10) meeting list. align all engineering deliverables with our enterprise it transformation roadmap (txrm).

technical requirements & experience

* **core full-stack & backend (4+ years):** 4+ years of professional full-stack development experience building secure web applications, including 2+ years of dedicated experience utilizing .net core for scalable backend architecture.
* **cloud infrastructure (3+ years):** 3+ years of hands-on experience within the azure ecosystem, prominently featuring azure app service and azure databricks. cumulative multi-cloud experience (including google cloud and aws) is highly desired and considered a strong plus.
* **data engineering (3+ years):** proven experience building scalable etl/elt pipelines using databricks, pyspark, and a deep understanding of delta lake architecture and managing open file formats.
* **front-end & cms (3+ years):** front-end expertise in modern javascript/typescript frameworks (react, vue, or similar), alongside proven experience managing and integrating webflow into broader custom application ecosystems.
* **workflow automation (2+ years highly desired):** extensive experience building and maintaining advanced automation workflows specifically using n8n to centralize and execute data matching.
* **ai-first & vector integration (1+ years):** applied experience with ai-first development methodologies, utilizing claude and related llms/tools to build out vector databases and power localized models.
* **governance & compliance:** experience structuring data catalogs (familiarity with classification standard v3.0 is a plus) and implementing complex data lineage and role-based access.
* **rag development:** we are seeking a generative ai engineer to design and scale production-ready retrieval-augmented generation (rag) systems and agentic workflows. the ideal candidate must have hands-on experience optimizing vector databases (such as pinecone, milvus, or qdrant) and orchestration frameworks like langchain or llamaindex.

ideal candidate profile

* you are highly autonomous and comfortable stepping into a lean, fast-paced technical team to take ownership of both front-end features and major backend architectural shifts.
* you understand how to balance rapid feature deployment for marketing initiatives with the rigorous data security requirements inherent in financial services m&a.
* you communicate effectively across disciplines, translating complex data engineering realities to executive leadership and collaborating seamlessly with international creative partners.

* 401(k)

* professional development and certification support

title: Associate Software Engineer, AI Solutions
description:
the exciting world of scientific research is fueled by people with a passion for solving complex problems. at cayuse, we are committed to our customers' success by empowering organizations to conduct globally connected research that advances their impact on science, discovery and society. we build on that commitment with proven, integrated and easy-to-use technology that delivers exceptional value, and world class service and support that accelerates outcomes.

but we are more than just an empowering platform powered by advanced technologies. we are a collaboration of exceptional, highly skilled people with multi-disciplinary expertise, and are building our team to support our ambitious growth plans. cayuse's foundational strength comes from our customer and employee focused values and commitment to industry-leading solutions. it's an exciting time to become a key member of our growing team.

join our remote first culture as an associate engineer, an entry-level, hands-on engineering role focused on building ai capabilities directly into cayuse products. you will work alongside senior engineers to design, build, test, and ship ai agents, model context protocol (mcp) servers, and llm-powered features that help research institutions and their administrators work faster and with less manual effort. this is not a data science or ml research role. it is a software engineering role for someone early in their career who writes solid code, learns quickly, and wants to grow into a strong ai engineer by shipping real features to real customers.

#### 

#### **responsibilities**

as an associate engineer, you will contribute across the full development cycle of ai-powered product features, with mentorship and code review from senior engineers. success in this role means delivering well-tested, maintainable code, understanding the problems you're solving, applying feedback, and progressively taking on more complex engineering responsibilities.

* **ai agent development:** build and maintain ai agents that use large language models (such as claude) to complete multi-step tasks within cayuse products — calling tools, retrieving data, and taking actions on behalf of users. implement prompts, tool definitions, and orchestration logic under the guidance of senior engineers.
* **mcp server development:** help build and extend model context protocol (mcp) servers that allow ai assistants to securely interact with cayuse products. work with senior engineers to implement tools, apis, authentication, and permission checks using established engineering standards. write clear documentation and tests to ensure these integrations are reliable and reusable.
* **hybrid ai validation:** help turn ai-extracted rules, such as requirements parsed from funding opportunity instructions, into deterministic, auditable validations that run alongside existing form rules and are reviewed by people before use.
* **product integration:** integrate ai features into existing cayuse applications through platform apis. build on the shared capabilities and patterns set by the architecture team instead of one-off implementations, and partner with product teams so ai fits naturally into customer workflows.
* **testing & evaluation:** write unit and integration tests for ai features, and help build evaluation sets that measure the accuracy, reliability, latency, and cost of llm outputs. contribute to time-boxed ai pilots and help document whether each should go, pivot, or stop. investigate failures, identify root causes, and propose fixes.
* **deployment & operations:** ship code through ci/cd pipelines to cloud environments (aws, including amazon bedrock). add logging and monitoring to ai services and help troubleshoot production issues.
* **learning & collaboration:** participate in code reviews, design discussions, and sprint ceremonies. keep current with the fast-moving ai tooling ecosystem and share what you learn with the team.
* **governed ai platform:** develop ai features using cayuse's shared ai platform and established engineering standards. learn how our platform handles model access, security, tenant isolation, usage tracking, and auditing. work with senior engineers to ensure new features follow these patterns rather than introducing one-off solutions.
* **responsible ai & security:** follow established security and privacy standards when developing ai features. learn to recognize and test for risks such as prompt injection, unauthorized data access, and inaccurate ai outputs. work with senior engineers to ensure ai features respect user permissions, protect customer data, and maintain proper tenant isolation. raise potential security or reliability concerns early.

#### **qualifications**

**core experience**

* 0–2 years of professional software development experience, including internships, co-ops, or apprenticeships.
* demonstrated ability to build working software through coursework, internships, personal projects, open-source contributions, or hackathons. a portfolio or github profile is strongly encouraged.
* exposure to team-based development using version control (git), code review, and agile practices.
* bs in computer science, software engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

**technical skills**

* **software development:** proficient in at least one general-purpose language (python or typescript/javascript preferred; java with spring boot also valued). solid grasp of data structures, apis, error handling, and writing tests.
* **ai & llm fundamentals:** demonstrated interest in ai technologies and how they can be applied to software development. experience experimenting with llm apis, prompt engineering, tool calling, or retrieval-augmented generation (rag) through coursework or personal projects is a plus. a willingness to learn and understand how these technologies work is more important than prior experience with any specific ai framework.
* **agents & mcp:** familiarity with the model context protocol, agent frameworks, or ai coding assistants (such as claude code or github copilot).
* **apis & integration:** working understanding of rest apis, json, and authentication basics (api keys, oauth).
* **cloud & infrastructure:** exposure to a cloud platform (aws preferred; amazon bedrock a plus), containers (docker), or ci/cd pipelines is a plus.
* **data fluency:** comfortable writing basic sql queries and working with structured data. exposure to snowflake or another cloud data warehouse is a plus.

**collaboration & communication**

* clear communicator — writes readable code, documentation, and pull request descriptions, and raises questions early when blocked.
* strong problem-solving instincts: you break ambiguous tasks into smaller steps and work through them methodically.
* coachable and growth-oriented — you seek out feedback and apply it.
* collaborative and adaptable — effective in a remote-first environment and when coordinating across offshore, nearshore, and onshore teams.
* genuine curiosity about how ai is changing software and knowledge work, paired with practical judgment about where it adds real value.

  

**benefits**

* competitive medical benefits (ppo + hsa available)
* vision, dental, short-term disability fully covered by cayuse
* unlimited pto + holidays + flexible work schedule
* remote work stipend
* equal paid parental leave
* 401k with employer matching
* quarterly wellness reimbursement
* remote work environment, supporting the ultimate employee experience

title: Sr Advanced R&D Engineer/Scientist
description:
as a sr advanced r&d engineer/scientist here at solstice, you will drive innovation, develop cutting-edge technologies, and lead advanced research initiatives to enhance aerospace safety, efficiency, and reliability. you will report directly to our r&d manager, and you’ll work out of our morris plains, nj location on a hybrid schedule.

at solstice advanced materials, we are committed to offering the highest value-add specialty solutions in the advanced materials sector. our goal is to solve our customers' most complex challenges through a robust and innovative product portfolio and by doing so, deliver exceptional value to our stakeholders. we have identified actionable strategies to grow by expanding into new products and markets and through strategic acquisitions, while keeping our top operating margins.

joining our team means becoming part of an organization which leverages its long-standing reputation to capture growth trends by investing in innovation and manufacturing enhancements and maintaining deep customer relationships.

we foster a collaborative and inclusive work environment that values contributions and supports professional development. with a focus on innovation and sustainability, the team is dedicated to delivering value and making a meaningful impact in advancing our customers' success. let’s make that impact together.

as a sr advanced r& d engineer/scientist you will develop and apply statistical, machine learning, and scientific modeling methods to accelerate materials discovery, product development, and manufacturing optimization. the role will partner closely with scientists and engineers to transform experimental and process data into validated models, actionable insights, and scalable r&d capabilities. this position is available in morris plains, nj, or buffalo, ny.

  

**about solstice advanced materials**

solstice advanced materials is a leading global specialty materials company that advances science for smarter outcomes. solstice offers high-performance solutions that enable critical industries and applications, including refrigerants, semiconductor manufacturing, data center cooling, nuclear power, protective fibers, healthcare packaging and more. solstice is recognized for developing next-generation materials through some of the industry's most renowned brands such as solstice®, genetron®, aclar®, spectra®, fluka™, and hydranal™. partnering with over 3,000 customers across more than 120 countries and territories and supported by a robust portfolio of over 5,700 patents, solstice’s approximately 4,000 employees worldwide drive innovation in materials science. for more information, visit advanced materials .

  

**key responsibilities**

* **-** analyze complex experimental, analytical, and manufacturing datasets using statistical and machine learning methods to identify trends, patterns, and relationships.
* **-** develop and validate predictive models to improve material performance, evaluate the effects of key variables, and support product and process development.
* **-** partner with chemists, materials scientists, engineers, and business stakeholders to define data needs, develop analytical solutions, and influence decisions.
* **-** evaluate and implement state-of-the-art data science methods for advanced materials applications, informed by relevant scientific and technical literature.
* **-** design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines and databases for experimental and analytical data.
* **-** establish data quality practices that ensure reliable, traceable, and reproducible datasets and analyses.
* **-** communicate findings, recommendations, and technical limitations through clear visualizations, reports, and presentations for technical and non-technical audiences.

  

**must have**

* master’s or ph.d. in data science, materials science, statistics, applied mathematics, or a related field.
* minimum of 5 years of experience in data analysis or data science roles within a materials science or engineering domain.
* proficiency in programming languages such as python and familiarity with data manipulation libraries relevant to chemistry and materials (e.g., rdkit).
* experience developing physics-informed neural networks, surrogate models, cheminformatics models, or quantitative structure–property relationship models.
* strong understanding of statistical modeling, machine learning algorithms, and data visualization techniques.
* experience with data visualization tools or packages (e.g., tableau, power bi, origin, matplotlib, seaborn) and databases (e.g., sql, nosql).

**we value**

* deep knowledge of advanced materials, including polymers, nanomaterials, ceramics, metals, small molecules, formulations, or composites.
* familiarity with experimental methods in materials characterization and testing.
* familiarity with chemical manufacturing processes, process modeling, and process optimization.
* excellent problem-solving abilities and critical thinking skills.
* strong interpersonal and communication skills, capable of engaging with technical and non-technical audiences.
* ability to work independently and manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
* commitment to continuous learning in data science and materials science.

**compensation**

the annual base salary range for this position is **$146976k - $183425k** . please note that this salary information serves as a general guideline. solstice advanced materials considers various factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to the scope and responsibilities or the position, the candidate's work experience, education and training, key skills, as well as market and business considerations.

in addition to a competitive salary, leading-edge work, and developing solutions side-by-side with dedicated experts in their fields, solstice advanced materials employees are eligible for a comprehensive benefits package. this package includes employer-subsidized medical, dental, vision, and life insurance; short-term and long-term disability; 401(k) match, flexible spending accounts, health savings accounts, eap, and educational assistance; parental leave, paid time off (for vacation, personal business, sick time, and parental leave), and 12 paid holidays. for more information visit: click here

title: Senior Business Data Analyst
description:
at siemens, we help organizations transform maintenance and operations through connected insights, ai-powered technology, and intelligent asset management solutions. our software enables customers to manage the full lifecycle of assets, facilities, and infrastructure while improving efficiency, reducing risk, and optimizing long-term investments. by connecting data, people, and processes, we empower organizations to make smarter decisions, maximize asset performance, and achieve more resilient operations.

**description**

the **senior business data analyst** translates business needs into scalable, high-quality data and analytics solutions.

this is a hands-on senior analytics role combining strong business ownership with technical depth. you will work directly with stakeholders to understand business problems, clarify outcomes and requirements, investigate data, generate insights, and deliver analytical products from discovery through implementation.

you will join the smart infrastructure, asset management software information technology (si ams it) data & ai team and work across sales, marketing, customer success, finance, and other commercial functions. marketing will be an important area of focus, making previous experience in marketing analytics or related commercial domains particularly valuable.

the role offers significant ownership and visibility within a small, collaborative data & ai team. you will work with modern technologies including snowflake, dbt, sql, python, power bi, and qlik, while contributing to the continued evolution of our analytics, data products, and ai capabilities. we expect you to be an early adopter of generative ai, using it to accelerate delivery and expand into adjacent technical areas.

this role is ideal for an experienced analyst who enjoys owning the full analytics lifecycle, from understanding business problems and defining requirements through data modeling, analysis, visualization, and stakeholder adoption.

**you’ll make an impact by**

**business partnership and requirements engineering**

* partner with business stakeholders to understand problems, desired outcomes, success criteria, and business value.
* handle ongoing business requests as a trusted partner, not a ticket taker, focusing on the business need behind each ask.
* translate business needs into clear, actionable data and analytics requirements.
* resolve missing or ambiguous requirements and break larger problems into manageable use cases.
* build strong understanding of assigned business domains, processes, metrics, and business logic.
* lead discovery, solution demonstrations, validation, and business sign off for assigned use cases.
* collaborate with global stakeholders across north america and europe, with core working hours aligned to eastern time business operations.

**data analysis and insight generation**

* extract, combine, analyze, and validate complex datasets using advanced sql and analytical tools.
* identify trends, patterns, anomalies, and actionable business insights.
* apply statistical and analytical methods to support business decisions.
* assess data quality, completeness, and fitness for purpose.
* translate analytical findings into clear recommendations for stakeholders.
* use generative ai tools, such as claude code or gh copilot, to accelerate sql, dbt, and power bi development, and share what works with the team.

**data products and business intelligence**

* design and develop dashboards, visualizations, and analytical products using power bi, qlik, and other relevant tools.
* create intuitive data experiences that enable stakeholders to act on insights.
* contribute to reusable data products, shared metrics, and standardized analytics solutions.
* support use cases across customer segmentation, marketing effectiveness, revenue analytics, retention, and predictive analytics.

**data modeling and technical delivery**

* understand source systems, warehouse structures, data relationships, business definitions, and analytical data models.
* create or adapt analytical data models and transformations for individual use cases.
* work with platforms such as snowflake and tools such as dbt.
* investigate analytical data issues and partner with data engineering on production pipelines and shared models.

**end to end solution ownership**

* own assigned data use cases from initial business problem through delivery, validation, and adoption.
* act as solution lead and coordinate contributions from data engineering, data science, bi, ai, and other specialists.
* proactively manage dependencies, risks, and data availability constraints.
* share knowledge and reduce dependency on individual experts through office hours, training, self-service reporting, and recurring metric deep dives.

**data quality and governance**

* apply established data standards, definitions, governance requirements, and documentation practices.
* identify data quality risks and coordinate resolution with appropriate owners.
* maintain awareness of security, privacy, responsible data usage, and enterprise governance requirements.
* support traceability and consistency of important business metrics and analytical outputs.

**this is how you'll win us over**

* 7+years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, analytics engineering, or a related field, or equivalent demonstrated experience.
* advanced sql skills, including complex joins, common table expressions, window functions, and analytical transformations.
* strong analytical and data modeling capabilities, including experience working with relational data, transformations, data quality, validation, and complex datasets.
* demonstrated experience partnering with business stakeholders to translate business problems into analytical requirements and pragmatic solutions.
* proven track record of uncovering insights through data mining and analysis, and applying business acumen to recommend actions that shaped decisions.
* experience developing dashboards, visualizations, or analytical applications using power bi, qlik, or comparable bi platforms.
* hands-on experience with salesforce or other crm data, such as opportunities, accounts, leads, and campaigns.
* experience working with a modern cloud data platform such as snowflake, databricks, azure, aws, or comparable technologies.
* ability to independently investigate business and data problems and deliver analytical solutions with limited supervision.
* strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work independently and navigate ambiguity.

**you'll thrive even more if you also bring**

* experience working in smaller or lean analytics teams where individuals are responsible for multiple stages of the analytics lifecycle, from requirements gathering through solution delivery
* experience supporting marketing analytics or other commercial functions such as sales, customer success, revenue operations, or commercial finance.
* hands on experience with snowflake and dbt or comparable data transformation tooling.
* python experience for data analysis, automation, or analytical development.
* experience with go-to-market systems data, such as marketing automation, attribution, and customer success platforms.
* familiarity with dimensional modeling, semantic data models, and data pipelines.
* exposure to machine learning, predictive analytics, segmentation, ai enabled use cases, or enterprise data governance.
* familiarity with prompt engineering, ai-assisted analytics, predictive modeling, experimentation frameworks, or model performance evaluation.
* experience supporting saas, subscription, software, or recurring revenue business models.

**what success looks like**

within the first 6 to 12 months, the successful candidate should be able to:

* become a trusted analytics partner capable of independently leading complex business initiatives from discovery through business impact.
* build trusted relationships with stakeholders at all levels, from field teams to senior leadership, in one or more commercial domains.
* handle a steady flow of business requests with insights and recommendations that stakeholders act on.
* turn loosely defined business problems into structured, executable analytical solutions.
* deliver reliable analysis, data models, and bi solutions with limited day to day support.
* navigate si ams data structures and identify appropriate data sources, models, and dependencies.
* become a trusted owner of business logic, data investigation, and analytical delivery within assigned domains.
* collaborate effectively with data engineering, data science, ai, and other specialist functions.
* produce clear documentation covering business definitions, data sources, analytical logic, lineage, and solution design.
* contribute to a scalable and resilient data & ai environment through strong ownership, reusable solutions, and knowledge sharing.
* define measurable success criteria and experimentation approaches to evaluate business initiatives, campaigns, and ai-driven solutions
