title: Data & AI Analyst
description:
**data & ai analyst**

**the opportunity**  
• data and ai analyst at a growth-oriented energy company
  
• collaborate with senior technical professionals to develop the data and ai foundations that support critical refining & logistics, retail, and finance operations across par pacific.
  
• gain hands-on experience developing and deploying enterprise software solutions in google cloud platform (gcp).
  
• work closely with business and technical teams to understand complex business processes and transform manual, repetitive work into automated, scalable cloud-based workflows.
  
• grow your skills through hands-on work by building real-world solutions as part of larger technology initiatives, with experienced technical professionals providing mentorship and guidance on architecture, standards, and code reviews.
  
• reporting to the director, enterprise data and applications, you will work day-to-day with our senior developer and data architect, to contribute to the development of data pipelines, internal tooling, and ai-enabled automation.

key activities include:
  
data & sql
  
• assist in building and maintaining etl workflows on google cloud platform, primarily in bigquery, with support from the data architect on modeling and design decisions
  
• contribute to data quality checks, validation logic, and documentation for pipelines the team owns
  
• support ad hoc data pulls and analysis requests from business teams, escalating larger requests to the appropriate data resource
  
cloud & development practices
  
• deploy and maintain assigned components in gcp under the direction of senior team members, building foundational fluency in the services par pacific already runs on
  
• learn and apply the team's development practices: version control, code review, environment promotion, basic ci/cd, and infrastructure-as-code exposure
  
• assist with monitoring, logging, and troubleshooting for workflows the team supports
  
• follow established security, access, and governance standards; raise questions early when a requirement is unclear

ai & automation
  
• sit with business stakeholders to understand how work actually gets done today — the manual steps, the handoffs, the spreadsheets — and help document those processes clearly
  
• partner with the senior developer and data architect to evaluate where ai and automation are a good fit, and where they are not
  
• translate agreed-upon business logic into working prototypes, then help harden those prototypes into reliable, automated services deployed through the enterprise's existing cloud platforms
  
• assist in integrating ai components with enterprise data sources and identity/access tooling, connecting the pieces between systems that do not yet talk to each other
  
• contribute to testing, evaluation, and iteration of automated workflows once they are live

collaboration
  
• work closely with a small, lean technical team where your work is visible and your questions get answered directly
  
• coordinate with business, erp, and infrastructure teams to gather requirements and confirm assumptions before building
  
• communicate progress, blockers, and findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
  
note: this description is intended to give you a general overview of the position. additional responsibilities and opportunities may be identified based on current business needs.

**qualifications**  
to meet the basic qualifications for this role, you will have legal authorization to work permanently in the united states for any employer without requiring a visa transfer or visa sponsorship.

additional qualifications include:
  
• high school diploma or equivalent required; bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, data science, information systems, or a related field preferred
  
• minimum 1 year of professional experience in software development, data engineering, data analysis, or a comparable technical role required; relevant internship, co-op, bootcamp, or substantial personal project work will be considered
  
• working proficiency in sql, including joins, aggregation, and window functions, with the ability to reason about query performance, required
  
• proficiency in python for scripting, data manipulation, and automation preferred
  
• foundational understanding of cloud concepts and at least introductory hands-on exposure to gcp or aws (compute, storage, iam basics) required
  
• familiarity with modern ai tooling — llm apis, prompting, or agent frameworks — and a practical sense of what these tools are and are not good at, required
  
• demonstrated ability to break a problem down, ask clarifying questions, and communicate a solution in plain language required
  
• comfort working in a lean environment where priorities shift
  
• experience with git and collaborative version control workflows preferred
  
• exposure to data modeling concepts (dimensional, relational, or semantic) preferred
  
• exposure to bi tooling such as looker or power bi preferred
  
• exposure to containers, ci/cd pipelines, or infrastructure-as-code preferred
  
• exposure to workflow orchestration tools such as apache airflow or cloud composer preferred
  
• familiarity with oil & gas, retail, or finance data types (e.g., retail data, sap extracts, operations feeds) preferred
  
• cloud fundamentals certification (gcp associate cloud engineer, aws cloud practitioner, or equivalent) preferred

**about us**  
at par pacific, we own and operate market-leading energy and infrastructure businesses in logistically complex markets. we have built a team of downstream industry veterans and subject matter experts to lead our organization with an entrepreneurial spirit and a collaborative, problem solving approach. we bring our diverse strengths and motivation to complex markets where we seek out diamonds in the rough. as a nimble, growing organization, we actively pursue new opportunities with corporate financing know-how, respond to local market demands, and adapt to changing external environments.

**more good reasons to work for par pacific**
  
  
**unique culture and rich values**  
there is nothing ordinary about par pacific - a niche player in the energy space. and there's certainly nothing ordinary about par pacific employees. we are driven, hardworking, entrepreneurial-minded professionals who love to win. our rich values describe how we approach our work: respect for others, integrity, collaborative innovation, and heart. if that describes you, you'll fit right in.
  
  
**location, location, location**  
because par pacific operates in some of the most beautiful places throughout the country, our employees get to make these places their home and enrich their lives. the office where you'll work is in the citycentre in houston, texas, located on the west side of houston near i-10 and the sam houston tollway. it's a vibrant area of the city with plenty of places for lunch or to wind down after work.

**opportunistic growth strategy**  
at par pacific, we look for operations with strong fundamentals and great employees who can move a business forward. our management team has deep experience in the energy industry, as well as in leading mergers, acquisitions, and integrations of newly acquired companies.
  
  
**focused on the future**  
we are an energy company that has recognized the imperative and embraced the opportunity to begin the transition from fossil fuels. we are developing products that help reduce greenhouse gas emissions.
  
  
**excellent compensation and benefits**  
in addition to a competitive salary, we offer a strong comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, dental and vision insurance, a robust allotment of paid time off, a 401(k) with company match, retirement savings plans, educational reimbursement, and more. full-time employees (and their families) are offered medical (with prescription coverage), dental, vision, voluntary critical illness, accident, life/ad&d insurance, flexible spending account and employee assistance program. employees can purchase company stock at discounted prices through the employee stock purchase program.

**our headquarters**
  
par pacific holdings, inc., based in houston, texas, owns, manages and maintains interests in energy and infrastructure businesses. we are a growing energy company focused on renewable and conventional fuels in the western united states. par pacific also owns 46% of laramie energy, llc, a natural gas production company with operations and assets concentrated in western colorado. our common stock is publicly traded on the nyse under the trading symbol "parr".

**our refineries and logistics operations**  
we own and operate refineries in hawaii, montana, washington, and wyoming, with total operating throughput capacity of over 219 mbpd. par pacific owns and operates one of the largest energy networks in hawaii with 94,000 bpd of operating refining capacity, a logistics system supplying the major islands of the state and 90 retail locations. in the pacific northwest and the rockies, par pacific owns and operates 125,000 bpd of combined refining capacity and related multimodal logistics systems.
  
  
**our retail operations**  
we own and operate over 90 retail locations in hawaii under the hele and 76 brands and over 30 retail locations in washington and idaho under the nomnom brand.

title: Software Engineer, Agentic Runtime
description:
**about glean:**

glean is the work ai platform that helps everyone work smarter with ai. what began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full-scale work ai ecosystem, powering intelligent search, an ai assistant, and scalable ai agents on one secure, open platform. with over 100 enterprise saas connectors, flexible llm choice, and robust apis, glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize ai across their entire business - without vendor lock-in or costly implementation cycles.

at its core, glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. its enterprise graph and personal knowledge graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee. this foundation powers glean’s agentic capabilities - ai agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time. the result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level.

recognized by fast company as one of the world’s most innovative companies (top 10, 2025), by cnbc’s disruptor 50, bloomberg’s ai startups to watch (2026), forbes ai 50, and gartner’s tech innovators in agentic ai, glean continues to accelerate its global impact. with customers across 50+ industries and 1,000+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee ai-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality.

if you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across microsoft teams, zoom, servicenow, zendesk, github, and many more. you'll be deeply embedded where people get things done. you'll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring work ai to every employee, in every company.

**about the role:**

the agentic runtime team builds the low‑latency, reliable, and secure foundation that powers glean’s ai agents and assistant experiences at scale. you’ll design and operate core runtime services for multi‑turn orchestration, tool calling, model routing, memory, streaming, and safety. you’ll work across distributed systems, production observability, and ml infra integrations to deliver an experience that feels instant, accurate, and trustworthy — while optimizing cost and reliability.

**you will:**

* own impactful runtime problems end‑to‑end — from architecture and design to production launch and ongoing reliability.
* build and evolve core services for session lifecycle, streaming responses (e.g., grpc/websockets), structured tool execution, memory/state, and policy/guardrails.
* design for performance, correctness, and cost: reduce p50/p95 latency, improve tail behavior, and optimize token/tool budgets.
* integrate with leading llm providers (e.g., openai, anthropic, google gemini) and internal evaluation frameworks to improve quality and predictability.
* harden the platform with fault isolation, retries, timeouts, circuit‑breaking, backpressure, and graceful degradation.
* instrument deep observability (tracing, metrics, logs) and create playbooks/slos for high availability and on‑call excellence.
* collaborate closely with product, quality, and application teams to prioritize the most impactful roadmap investments.

**you are:**

* 3+ years of software engineering experience building production distributed systems or cloud‑native applications.
* bs/ba in computer science or related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* strong coding skills in at least one of: python, go, java, javascript, typescript, c++, with a focus on reliability, performance, and tests.
* product‑minded: you prioritize customer impact, clear slas/slos, and pragmatic iteration.
* ownership‑driven with a positive, proactive attitude; comfortable leading projects or learning from battle‑tested engineers.

* experience operating services on kubernetes and at least one major cloud (e.g., gcp, aws, or azure).
* familiarity with event/streaming systems (e.g., pub/sub, kafka), caching (e.g., redis), and data stores for low‑latency paths.
* practical understanding of llm/agents building blocks: tool/function calling, structured outputs, streaming, and model selection/routing.
* strong observability and debugging skills: tracing (e.g., opentelemetry), metrics, dashboards, and production forensics.
* background in one or more areas is a plus: policy/guardrails, multi‑tenant isolation, rate‑limiting, concurrency control, cost optimization.

**location:**

* this role is hybrid (4 days a week in our mountain view office)

**compensation & benefits:**

the standard base salary range for this position is $180,000 - $210,000 annually. compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits.

we offer a comprehensive benefits package including competitive compensation, medical, vision, and dental coverage, generous time-off policy, and the opportunity to contribute to your 401k plan to support your long-term goals. when you join, you'll receive a home office improvement stipend, as well as an annual education and wellness stipends to support your growth and wellbeing. we foster a vibrant company culture through regular events, and provide healthy lunches daily to keep you fueled and focused.

we are a diverse bunch of people and we want to continue to attract and retain a diverse range of people into our organization. we're committed to an inclusive and diverse company. we do not discriminate based on gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race.

#li\_hybrid

at glean, ai fluency is core to how we work and we're committed to ensuring every new hire feels confident integrating ai into their everyday work. **as part of the interview process, you'll complete a brief ai-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about, design, and use ai to drive impact in your role.** feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today — prior glean experience isn't required.

title: AI Engineer – Founding Member, NJ Office
description:
hi, i'm andreas. come build the new nu image® with us.

i'm the ceo of nu image®, and we're opening a new office in new jersey. i'm looking for an ai engineer to be a founding member of it, and yes, the desk next to mine is open.

here's the setup. we're building the next generation of our technology, and it's a small, tight core: you, working directly with our cto, with ai agents as the force multiplier. you'll own the ai engineering and the hands-on code development.

ai agents do most of the typing here. but make no mistake: you'll own the code, not just prompt it. you'll understand the architecture, read every line the agents write, and be able to debug and fix it by hand when they get it wrong. when something breaks in production, "the agent wrote it" isn't an answer. you are the builder, and the result is yours.

and here's the line i care about most: i don't want someone who waits to be told what to do. see a problem? fix it. see a better way? build it and show us. initiative is the job.

if you're the person at the meetup who can't stop talking about your agent setup, and you can also explain what's happening under the hood, keep reading.

who we are

- nu image® is a us telehealth company. founded in 2004, online since 2008.

- legitscript certified, serving all 50 states.

- we're opening a new office in the mahwah / wyckoff area of new jersey. this role is based there, in person.

- home page: https://nuimage.com

what you'll build (with our cto)

- a modern web platform and internal tools that people actually enjoy using.

- integrations and automation that connect systems and take busywork off people's plates.

- ai-powered workflows, plus the agent setups, guardrails and review steps that let a small core build like a much bigger one.

- secure, reliable, well-tested systems with healthcare-grade privacy and security baked in from day one.

what a week roughly looks like

no two weeks are the same, but expect a mix of:

- agents running in parallel on branches while you review diffs, push back on bad code, and write the tricky parts yourself.

- working through architecture and priorities with our cto, then turning them into shipped code.

- whiteboard sessions on new ideas, and turning the good ones into working prototypes.

- digging into a weird bug by hand: logs, queries, a debugger, and some stubbornness.

- spotting something nobody asked about (a slow query, a flaky job, a tool that would save us hours) and handling it.

- showing what shipped, what broke, and what you want to try next.

perks of the role (just for fun; these are about the job, not benefits)

- founding member of the nj office. you'll help shape how it works.

- first dibs on the whiteboard.

- you pick the office coffee machine. choose wisely.

- you get to name the agents.

- the ceo is one desk over, so your ideas get a fast yes or no.

- your ideas don't sit in a backlog for six months.

must-haves

ai (front and center)

- you ship with ai coding agents daily: cursor, the grok ecosystem (including grok bot), and similar tools. you have a setup, opinions, and receipts.

- you're current with today's ai tools and how they're changing month to month.

- you've built real agent workflows: task breakdown, parallel agents, prompt and agent orchestration, and review loops that catch bad output before it ships.

- you verify agent output: tests first, reading diffs line by line, and not trusting anything that just "looks right."

- you keep sensitive data (customer information, secrets, credentials) out of prompts, logs, and tools that aren't approved for it.

fundamentals (you own the result)

- you can build and debug it yourself, without ai, when needed. reading unfamiliar code, stepping through it, and fixing it by hand is normal for you.

- solid software architecture: you can explain why a system is shaped the way it is, and spot when an agent's design is going to hurt later.

- strong php and laravel: queues, jobs, the scheduler, events, and eloquent without the n+1 drama.

- real sql skills (mysql): schema design, indexing, migrations, reading query plans, and writing the query yourself.

- debugging: logs, stack traces, xdebug or similar, reproducing issues, and finding root causes, not just symptoms.

- security and privacy best practices: authentication and authorization, input validation, encryption, least privilege, owasp top risks, secrets handling.

the rest of the stack

- vue and tailwind on the front end.

- rest apis: designing them and integrating with third-party ones.

- redis for queues, caching, and locks.

- cloud experience (aws a plus).

- testing with pest or phpunit.

- ci/cd with github actions or similar.

- admin panel tools like laravel nova or filament.

how you work

- initiative. you find the work instead of waiting for it.

- ownership. if you shipped it (or your agents did), it's yours to understand, fix, and improve.

- you work well in a small core: direct with our cto, clear about your reasoning, and happy to explain it to an agent or to a person.

- you can show real, shipped work. we care about what you can do, not a years-of-experience number.

- you can commute to the mahwah / wyckoff area and want to be in the office.

nice-to-haves

- infrastructure as code (terraform, aws cdk, pulumi, or similar).

- observability: structured logs, metrics, tracing, and alerts.

- you've built your own mcp servers, agent tools, or custom agent integrations.

- evals for prompts and agents.

- laravel horizon, octane, pulse, or reverb.

- threat modeling and secrets management beyond the basics.

- open-source work, side projects, or talks at meetups.

how to apply

email jobs@nuimagemedical.com with the subject line "ai engineer – nj" and include:

1. your github, portfolio, or anything you've shipped that we can look at.

2. a short note (a few paragraphs is perfect) on the coolest thing you've built with ai agents. what it did, how you set up the agents, what went wrong, and how you fixed it. this is the part i'll read first.

3. where you're based.

no cover-letter templates, please. write it the way you'd explain it to a friend.

nu image medical, inc. is an equal opportunity employer. we consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.

we are seeking a highly skilled and innovative senior ai engineer to join our dynamic team. in this role, you will lead the development and deployment of cutting-edge artificial intelligence solutions that drive business insights and operational excellence. your expertise will empower us to harness the full potential of big data systems, machine learning frameworks, and natural language processing to create scalable, impactful ai models. this is an exciting opportunity for a passionate professional eager to shape the future of ai technology through advanced statistical modeling, generative ai, and cloud-based machine learning services.

**responsibilities**

* design, develop, and optimize ai models using frameworks such as tensorflow, spark mllib, and other machine learning tools.
* lead model training, evaluation, and deployment processes across cloud platforms like aws and integrated big data systems such as hadoop and spark.
* implement unsupervised learning techniques and predictive modeling analysis to extract meaningful insights from large datasets.
* collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop natural language processing applications and generative ai solutions that enhance user engagement.
* conduct statistical analysis for research purposes, ensuring rigorous validation of models through statistical analysis tools like sas and r.
* develop scalable data pipelines using etl processes with talend or bash scripting to support data mining and analytics initiatives.
* design and maintain sql databases and data warehouses for efficient data storage, retrieval, and management aligned with best practices in database design.

**skills**

* extensive experience with aws cloud services for machine learning model hosting and management.
* proficiency in python, java, c, sql, r, vba, bash (unix shell), and other programming languages relevant to ai development.
* deep understanding of big data systems including hadoop, spark implementation, and data analytics frameworks like looker.
* strong background in statistical modeling, statistical analysis tools, and statistical analysis for research applications.
* hands-on experience with machine learning frameworks such as tensorflow, spark mllib, and other ai/ml libraries.
* knowledge of natural language processing (nlp), generative ai techniques, and ai implementation strategies for diverse applications.
* ability to design scalable architectures that support high-volume data mining and predictive modeling analysis.
* familiarity with machine learning cloud services for model training, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring at scale.
* experience working with sql databases and designing efficient database schemas for large datasets.
* strong problem-solving skills combined with excellent communication abilities to translate complex technical concepts into actionable insights.

join us in pushing the boundaries of artificial intelligence! bring your expertise in big data systems, machine learning frameworks, statistical analysis tools, and cloud services to create innovative solutions that transform industries. your work will directly impact our ability to deliver intelligent products and services at scale—making a real difference every day!

description:

at blue origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of earth. we’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!

this role is part of blue origin operations, which is comprised of integrated supply chain, test operations, safety, quality, and mission assurance. this includes manufacturing and supply chain support across all blue origin facilities.

as a senior technical contributor on the supply chain business intelligence & data science team, you will **own the architecture and strategy for the highest-used supply chain data models at blue origin, and for the self-serve analytics platform built on top of them.** our team is a customer of blue origin's enterprise technology (et) data platform — we consume their governed, foundational data — and we design, build, and own the business-facing data models in databricks that sit on top of it, spanning procurement, inventory, logistics, and supplier performance. these models are the backbone of self-serve analytics and aws-hosted web applications used broadly across supply chain. this role blends deep data modeling expertise with architectural ownership of how the business self-serves insights, cross-team partnership with et, and mentorship of a growing engineering team.

key responsibilities

* **core data model ownership:** architect and own the primary supply chain data models in databricks — the most heavily used data assets across the organization — built on top of the data et provides.
* **self-serve analytics strategy:** own the strategy and architecture for how supply chain stakeholders self-serve data — including semantic layers, curated data marts, access patterns, and documentation — ensuring business users across the org can reliably find and trust the metrics they need without engineering support.
* **et partnership & data strategy:** serve as the primary technical liaison with et's data platform team, defining data contracts, advocating for supply chain data needs, and adapting the team's models as et's underlying platform evolves.
* **modeling standards & governance:** define and enforce data modeling standards, business logic ownership, and data quality frameworks that ensure trust and consistency across every downstream consumer of the team's supply chain models and self-serve tools.
* **web application & delivery strategy:** guide the architecture of aws-hosted internal web applications and self-serve analytics tools that are built on top of the team's core data models, ensuring performance, scalability, and usability.
* **technical leadership:** set engineering standards for gitlab ci/cd, vs code-based development, testing, and deployment; mentor data engineer i–iii team members on data modeling and self-serve enablement best practices.
* **ai-enabled engineering:** evaluate and integrate ai-assisted development, data modeling, and analytics tools (e.g., ai-powered query assistants, natural language interfaces) to further scale self-serve capabilities across the business.
* **cross-functional partnership:** act as the primary technical point of contact between supply chain leadership and the engineering team, ensuring the team's data models and self-serve tools evolve to meet changing business needs.
* **end-to-end coverage:** ensure comprehensive, reliable model and self-serve metric coverage across the entire supply chain function — procurement, inventory, logistics, supplier performance, and manufacturing supply — resolving gaps and inconsistencies as the business scales.

minimum qualifications

* 6+ years of experience building and operating production data pipelines and data models, including experience leading data modeling architecture decisions
* bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience
* expert-level proficiency in python and sql
* deep experience with databricks (or comparable lakehouse platform) architecting large-scale, business-facing data models
* proven experience partnering with or consuming data from a centralized enterprise data platform team, including managing data contracts and adapting to upstream changes
* strong experience architecting solutions on aws (e.g., s3, lambda, glue, ecs/eks, rds, api gateway)
* proven experience with git-based ci/cd workflows (gitlab preferred) and modern software engineering practices
* demonstrated ability to mentor engineers and lead cross-functional technical initiatives
* must be a u.s. citizen, lawful permanent resident, or protected individual as defined by 8 u.s.c. 1324b(a)(3), due to access to export-controlled data

preferred qualifications

* prior experience owning the highest-used/core data models for a business function (supply chain, finance, manufacturing) that consume from a centralized enterprise data platform
* experience embedding ai/llm-based tooling into production data modeling or governance workflows
* prior experience in a supply chain, manufacturing, or aerospace/defense data environment
* experience designing self-serve analytics platforms/semantic layers built on top of business-owned data models
* familiarity with enterprise data governance frameworks, catalogs, and lineage tools

title: Senior Application Software Engineer
description:
oracle cloud infrastructure (oci) is seeking an experienced senior platform software engineer, ai engineering to join the ai platform and productivity engineering team. in this role, you will contribute to ai innovation by designing, developing, and delivering solutions that improve employee productivity across oracle. you will use ai development tools to accelerate software delivery and build solutions for employee support, knowledge discovery, task automation, and collaboration. you will collaborate with engineers, product managers, technical leads, and partner teams to identify employee needs, solve business problems, and turn promising ai use cases into reliable enterprise capabilities.

this role will design, develop, and maintain ai platform capabilities, including ai control plane and data plane services, codex enablement, ai plugins and skills, gpt guidance, memory capabilities, and model routing. you will also design and develop backend services and apis, integrate ai models with enterprise systems, and build reusable ai workflows. working with technical leads and partner teams, you will implement testing, evaluation, and observability to ensure reliable, secure, and scalable operation.

  

**key responsibilities**
========================

* design, develop, deliver, and maintain secure, scalable ai software solutions that improve employee productivity across oracle.
* develop ai control plane and data plane services, codex integrations, memory capabilities, and model routing components in alignment with established architecture.
* build reusable ai plugins, skills, gpt integrations, custom applications, backend services, and apis for enterprise use cases.
* use codex and other ai development tools to accelerate implementation, testing, debugging, and documentation while maintaining engineering quality.
* collaborate with technical leads, product managers, and partner teams to clarify requirements, evaluate approaches, and deliver features from prototyping through production rollout.
* integrate ai models with enterprise applications, data sources, and workflows, implementing runtime and middleware patterns that support interoperability and multi-tenant scale.
* participate in architecture and code reviews, apply secure coding practices, and follow api versioning, compatibility, deprecation, and safe rollout standards.
* implement automated testing and ai evaluations to validate functionality, accuracy, security, reliability, and performance.
* diagnose and resolve complex issues across models, plugins, backend services, and integrations; translate employee and stakeholder feedback into product improvements.
* implement logging, monitoring, usage telemetry, and observability, and contribute to service-level objectives, capacity planning, resilience, and operational improvements.
* develop ai cost and usage intelligence capabilities, including cost attribution, forecasting, token budgets, threshold alerts, and reporting that supports informed investment decisions.
* implement model selection and usage controls that balance cost, quality, risk, and performance; optimize token consumption and context through caching, context management, and workload-specific routing.
* create technical guidance, migration guides, and adoption playbooks, and share engineering practices that make ai capabilities easier to adopt and maintain.

**minimum job qualifications**
==============================

**education and experience**
----------------------------

* bachelor of technology (b.tech) or another bachelor’s degree in computer science, computer engineering, software engineering, electrical/electronics engineering, computer information systems, information systems, information technology, telecommunications, mathematics, physics, or a related field, and at least 4 years of software development experience.
* 4+ years of experience designing, developing, and delivering backend services, apis, distributed systems, developer platforms, or cloud services.
* 4+ years of programming experience in one or more languages such as java, python, javascript or go.
* experience developing and deploying applications on cloud platforms such as oci, aws, azure, or google cloud.
* experience with relational or nosql databases, including data modeling, querying, and integration with backend services.
* experience with software design, api integration, automated testing, code reviews, debugging, and secure coding practices.
* experience supporting production services through logging, monitoring, observability, incident resolution, reliability improvements, and performance optimization.
* experience collaborating with engineering, architecture, security, product, and business stakeholders to deliver software capabilities.

**preferred skills**
====================

**ai engineering and platform development**
-------------------------------------------

* hands-on experience building, integrating, or operating ai-enabled applications, generative ai solutions, developer tools, or enterprise productivity applications.
* experience using codex or similar ai coding tools for development, testing, debugging, and documentation.
* experience with llm application patterns, including prompt design, retrieval-augmented generation (rag), tool/function calling, agents, memory, evaluations, and model routing.
* experience developing ai plugins, skills, gpt integrations, reusable workflows, or shared ai services.
* experience developing model context protocol (mcp) servers and tools to connect ai applications and agents with enterprise apis, backend services, and data sources, including authentication, authorization, testing, and observability.
* familiarity with ai control plane and data plane concepts and integrating ai capabilities with backend services, apis, and enterprise systems.
* experience implementing ai security, privacy, model-access controls, and policy-based model selection.
* experience with ai cost optimization, including token and context management, usage telemetry, cost attribution, forecasting, budgeting, and caching.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Unsecured Installments
description:
**about upstart**

at upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all americans. every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced ai to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence.

as the leading ai lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 3,000 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. but the numbers only hint at the impact. every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress.

we’re proudly digital-first, giving most upstarters the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80+ cities in the us and canada. digital-first doesn’t mean distant. we’re intentional about in-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. and whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in-person from one of our offices in columbus, austin, the bay area, or new york city, you’ll have the support to work in the way that works best for you.

if you’re energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we’d love to hear from you.

**the team:**

unsecured installments is one of upstart's core lending products, helping borrowers access credit through a seamless, digitally native experience. the team owns critical parts of the borrower journey across offer generation, pricing, underwriting, funding, and borrower experience, while working closely with the broader lending platform that powers upstart at scale. recent work has focused on improving borrower flows, repricing and rate flexibility, partnership experiences, and the overall quality of the customer-facing experience.

as a senior software engineer on the unsecured installments team, you'll be a technical leader for the frontend and full-stack experiences that borrowers interact with directly. working primarily in react and typescript, you'll own the delivery of large, multi-month projects, shape the architecture of the team's mobile-web and full-stack surfaces, and set a high bar for quality across the borrower experience. you'll partner closely with product, design, and backend engineers to turn ambiguous problems into durable, well-architected solutions, and you'll mentor other engineers along the way.

**how you’ll make an impact**

* own the design and delivery of large, complex frontend and full-stack initiatives using react and typescript, from planning and sequencing through launch and long-term maintenance.
* set technical direction for the team's frontend architecture and full-stack patterns, owning a 3–6 month roadmap and proactively addressing systemic gaps that threaten team effectiveness.
* partner closely with product, design, and backend engineers to translate roadmap priorities and borrower needs into scalable, high-quality experiences.
* raise the bar for engineering excellence through strong component and api design, thoughtful state management, testing, observability, and operational rigor across borrower-facing surfaces.
* lead through ambiguity, breaking down loosely defined problems into clear, testable plans and using data to inform tradeoffs on scope, performance, and user experience.
* mentor and grow other engineers through code reviews, design reviews, and technical guidance, and serve as a trusted collaborator across the team.
* contribute to how the team uses ai in development workflows and product capabilities, with a pragmatic view of where it can create meaningful leverage.

**minimum qualifications**

* bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience) and 6+ years of professional software engineering experience.
* deep proficiency building complex web applications with react and typescript, including component architecture, state management, performance optimization, and consuming rest or graphql apis.
* full-stack experience designing and building backend services and apis in a language such as python, java, kotlin, ruby, or node.js.
* track record of independently leading the design and delivery of large, business-critical frontend or full-stack projects in production.
* ability to work effectively in ambiguous environments where product requirements, constraints, and system boundaries evolve over time.
* strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to explain technical tradeoffs and align product, design, and engineering partners.

**preferred qualifications**

* experience serving as the frontend or full-stack technical lead for a product team or business-critical product surface.
* experience building consumer-facing products at scale with strong attention to performance, accessibility, and user experience.
* background in fintech, lending, payments, or other regulated financial products with complex user journeys and high quality expectations.
* experience with experimentation, a/b testing, or feature-flagging to drive iterative product improvements in production.
* familiarity with modern frontend tooling and testing frameworks (e.g., jest, react testing library, cypress) and ci/cd workflows.
* hands-on experience leveraging generative ai in product features or internal engineering workflows.
* passion for building products that expand access to credit and improve financial outcomes for consumers.

title: Knowledge Graph Engineer
description:
bioage labs (bioa) is finding new ways to treat disease by targeting the mechanisms of aging, with the ultimate goal of increasing healthy human lifespan. https://bioagelabs.com

we discover drug targets for aging and age-related disease by combining longitudinal human data with causal evidence from genetics and animal models, structured ontologies and curated external knowledge. a knowledge graph harmonizes these disparate sources to enable scientific discovery of targets, indications and mechanism of action.

we are seeking a **knowledge graph engineer** with hands-on experience in data engineering and graph technologies to design, build, and maintain scalable knowledge graph solutions. you will translate ontologies and semantic models into production systems, develop pipelines that connect enterprise data to graph platforms, and build queries that support downstream analytics and intelligent applications.

this role is ideal for someone who combines strong software engineering fundamentals with an understanding of graph modeling and semantic data. you will own solutions from architecture and technology selection through implementation, testing, and performance optimization, working closely with data engineers, ai teams, and stakeholders to turn business requirements into reliable systems.

**what you will do**
--------------------

* maintain and extend our knowledge graph, including its schema, ingestion pipelines and query layer (neo4j, cypher, apache jena fuseki, bigquery on google cloud).
* build and run validation and data-governance pipelines to maintain data quality, consistency, and performance. this covers schema and constraint checks, identifier reconciliation, provenance and versioning.
* maintain our ontologies and semantic models with the biology and data science teams, and develop the mapping tool scientists use to annotate new terms and analyses. this includes the validation that keeps their mappings consistent with the graph.
* integrate knowledge graph solutions with cloud platforms and enterprise data ecosystems, including google cloud and bigquery.
* collaborate with data engineers, data science, ai and biology teams to make graph data accessible and useful for downstream applications.
* write clean, testable, production-grade code and apply engineering best practices throughout development and delivery.

**what you bring**
------------------

**basic qualifications**

* bachelor’s degree or higher in computer science, data engineering, ai or a related field, with 3+ years of industry experience in data engineering.
* experience working with biological or biomedical data, such as genomics, proteomics, clinical or phenotype data, and familiarity with standard biomedical ontologies and identifiers (e.g. uniprot, gene ontology, efo, mondo).

**technical qualifications**

* hands-on experience with graph databases such as neo4j, stardog or graphdb, including writing and optimizing queries in cypher or sparql.
* working knowledge of semantic modelling concepts and standards such as rdf and owl, and the ability to turn an ontology into a working schema.
* experience designing and building apis (e.g. rest or graphql, using frameworks such as fastapi) that give applications and users access to graph data.
* experience building data-quality or validation frameworks.
* familiarity with google cloud and bigquery.
* strong python and working knowledge of javascript for building data pipelines, graph integrations, and production applications.
* strong software engineering practices, including data modeling, system design, testing, documentation and version control.
* (preferred) experience with llm or agent systems
* (preferred) experience with open targets and other drug-discovery knowledge bases.

**collaboration and ownership**

* strong problem-solving skills and sound technical judgment when requirements are still evolving or design priorities compete.
* ability to take ownership of a solution from initial design through implementation and ongoing maintenance.
* clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain architecture decisions and technical trade-offs to clients and stakeholders.
* ability to work effectively across data engineering, biologists and ai teams.

**our company**

bioage is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing therapeutic product candidates for metabolic diseases by targeting the biology of human aging. the company's lead product candidate, bge-102, is a potent, orally available, brain-penetrant small-molecule nlrp3 inhibitor being developed for cardiovascular risk and retinal diseases including diabetic macular edema. bge-102 has completed a phase 1 sad/mad trial demonstrating a well-tolerated profile and potential best-in-class reductions in hscrp and other inflammatory biomarkers in participants with obesity and elevated inflammation. phase 2 cardiovascular risk proof-of-concept data are anticipated in h2 2026, and phase 1b/2a diabetic macular edema proof-of-concept data are anticipated in mid 2027. the company is also developing long-acting injectable and oral small molecule apj agonists for obesity. bioage’s additional preclinical programs, which leverage insights from the company’s proprietary discovery platform built on human longevity data, address key pathways involved in metabolic aging. bioage has been listed on nasdaq (bioa) since 2024. for additional information about bioage, visit the company’s website at https://bioagelabs.com.

**our workplace**

bioage offers competitive salary, a comprehensive compensation package, and generous paid time off in addition to company-observed holidays. we provide comprehensive health and wellness benefits (medical, dental, and vision insurance) and a 401(k) retirement savings plan with matching employer contributions, and we support families through childcare and fertility benefits. we also pride ourselves in giving employees many opportunities for career development, including a generous annual budget for continued learning and a dedication to training and skill development. many positions (including this one) are remote, allowing our team members to work from anywhere. the salary for this role is expected to be approximately $140,000 - $175,000, depending on experience. we are open to the concept that different experience levels add value to the team in different ways, and therefore will consider a variety of experience and offer commensurate pay.

at bioage, we embrace diversity and differences while we learn from each other, and we believe that every team member has an important role to play. we are an equal opportunity employer. bioage prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type and affords equal employment opportunities to employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. bioage conforms to the spirit as well as to the letter of all applicable laws and regulations.

you want more out of a career. a place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. at verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. we do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. our v team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. in crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. want in? join the #vteamlife.

if verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.

40

verizon is an equal opportunity employer. we evaluate qualified applicants without regard to veteran status, disability or other legally protected characteristics.

our benefits are designed to help you move forward in your career, and in areas of your life outside of verizon. from health and wellness benefit options including: medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability, basic life insurance, supplemental life insurance, ad&d insurance, identity theft protection, pet insurance and group home & auto insurance. we also offer a matched 401(k) savings plan, up to 8 company paid holidays per year and up to 6 personal days per year, paid parental leave, adoption assistance and tuition assistance, plus other incentives, we’ve got you covered with our award-winning total rewards package. depending on the role, employees have the opportunity to receive compensation in the form of premium pay such as overtime, shift differential, holiday pay, allowances, etc. newly hired employees receive up to 15 days of vacation per year, which grows with additional service. for part-timers, your coverage will vary as you may be eligible for some of these benefits depending on your individual circumstances.

title: Data Management and Database Administration Specialist
description:
**come build the future with us**

at trellis company, we're passionate about creating opportunities that change lives.

our vision is to connect people to education-to-employment pathways that transform their lives. for more than 40 years, we've helped individuals achieve educational and career success through innovative solutions, strategic partnerships, and mission-driven service.

today, we're building on that legacy by partnering with employers, educational institutions, workforce organizations, and community leaders to create stronger connections between learning and employment while expanding pathways to economic opportunity.

our mission is to develop and advance initiatives that grow individual economic mobility and expand community prosperity.

at trellis, you'll find the purpose of a mission-driven nonprofit combined with the energy and innovation of an organization focused on the future. your ideas matter, your work has impact, and your contributions help create brighter futures for individuals, families, and communities.

join trellis and help create pathways to opportunity, economic mobility, and lasting success.

**job summary**

the data management and database services specialist provides advanced technical expertise for the administration, security, performance, governance, availability, and lifecycle management of trellis enterprise data platforms.

the position serves as the organization's primary technical resource for ibm db2, microsoft sql server, cloud-hosted database services, enterprise data management solutions, and data governance technologies. responsibilities include database architecture, administration, monitoring, optimization, backup and recovery, disaster recovery, cloud data platform management, data governance, data quality, metadata management, and support of enterprise analytics and artificial intelligence initiatives.

the position works collaboratively with business stakeholders, application owners, cybersecurity personnel, analytics teams, vendors, and technology staff to ensure enterprise data assets remain secure, reliable, compliant, discoverable, trusted, and aligned with trellis business objectives and regulatory requirements.

**location:**

the position is hybrid, two days weekly required in office. office location is round rock, texas.

**essential responsibilities**

the position incumbent is expected to perform the following essential duties and responsibilities of the position with reasonable accommodation.

**database administration and operations**

* serve as the primary technical administrator for ibm db2 and microsoft sql server database environments.
* install, configure, patch, upgrade, monitor, maintain, and support enterprise database platforms.
* administer databases operating on mainframe, distributed, virtualized, and cloud-hosted platforms.
* monitor database availability, capacity, performance, storage utilization, and operational health.
* troubleshoot and resolve database incidents, service interruptions, performance issues, connectivity problems, and data integrity concerns.
* design and implement indexing, query optimization, statistics, maintenance, and performance-tuning strategies.
* coordinate production database changes with application owners, developers, project teams, vendors, and business stakeholders.
* maintain database standards, inventories, dependency maps, configuration records, architecture documentation, and operational runbooks.
* maintain enterprise metadata, business glossaries, data inventories, ownership records, and data lineage documentation.
* develop and maintain documentation of data flows, integrations, interfaces, and dependencies.
* participate in 24x7 operational support, including on-call responsibilities, as required.

**backup, recovery, and high availability**

* design, implement, monitor, and maintain database backup and recovery strategies.
* administer database replication, clustering, failover, log shipping, and other approved high-availability solutions.
* develop and maintain database disaster recovery procedures and supporting evidence.

**cloud data platform management**

* administer enterprise cloud database and data platform services.
* manage azure sql database, azure sql managed instance, sql server hosted in azure, and other approved cloud database technologies.
* support microsoft fabric, azure data factory, azure synapse analytics, azure data lake storage, and other approved data services.
* support migration and modernization of legacy data workloads using approved cloud-native services.
* implement monitoring, governance, security, lifecycle-management, resiliency, and cost-optimization controls for cloud data environments.
* evaluate cloud data architectures for scalability, performance, availability, recoverability, supportability, and cost efficiency.

**data architecture and integration**

* review application, database, reporting, analytics, and integration designs for alignment with enterprise data standards.
* support development and maintenance of enterprise data architecture standards, naming conventions, and design patterns.
* design, develop, review, and support tables, indexes, stored procedures, views, schemas, and related database objects.
* support extract, transform, and load processes, application interfaces, and other approved data-integration methods.
* evaluate designs for scalability, integrity, security, recoverability, performance, and operational supportability.

**analytics and artificial intelligence enablement**

* evaluate, adopt, and apply ai-enabled technologies to support strategy, improve workflow efficiency, automate routine tasks, and enhance data-driven decision making.
* support data platforms used for reporting, business intelligence, analytics, machine learning, and artificial intelligence workloads.
* help ensure analytics and ai solutions use trusted, governed, appropriately classified, and authorized data sources.

**security, compliance, and risk management**

* implement and maintain database security controls in partnership with enterprise security services.
* administer database roles, privileged and service accounts, and access permissions using least-privilege and role-based-access principles.
* support encryption, data masking, tokenization, auditing, logging, monitoring, and data-loss-prevention controls where appropriate.

**monitoring, change management, operational support, and automation**

* implement proactive monitoring, alerting, health checks, capacity management, and performance baselines.
* participate in change-management processes and ensure database changes include testing, implementation, validation, and rollback procedures.
* develop corrective and preventive actions that improve reliability and reduce repeat incidents.
* automate recurring administration, compliance evidence collection, monitoring, and reporting activities using approved scripting and orchestration tools.

**technology planning and collaboration**

* research, evaluate, design, and recommend database, governance, and data-platform technologies.
* review vendor proposals, technical designs, licensing implications, support models, and implementation plans.
* develop knowledge-transfer materials and cross-train technology staff to reduce single-person dependency for critical database services.
* act as a good steward of trellis resources through responsible management of licensing, cloud consumption, storage, support costs, and technology investments.

**non-essential responsibilities**

* participate in technology governance and architecture review activities.
* maintain awareness of emerging database, cloud, governance, analytics, security, and ai technologies.
* perform other duties and special projects as assigned.

**knowledge, skills, and abilities**

* advanced knowledge of ibm db2 administration, architecture, security, backup, recovery, monitoring, and optimization.
* strong knowledge of relational database theory, sql, database design, logical and physical data modeling, and data integrity principles.
* knowledge of azure database and data services, including azure sql, data factory, data lake storage, synapse analytics, and microsoft fabric.
* knowledge of metadata management, data cataloging, data lineage, business glossaries, data governance, data stewardship, and data quality concepts.
* knowledge of master data management, reference data management, information classification, retention, privacy, records management, and secure disposition principles.
* knowledge of etl, application integration, hybrid data architectures, reporting platforms, analytics, and ai data-governance principles.
* knowledge of security controls including encryption, masking, tokenization, auditing, dlp, privileged access management, logging, and vulnerability management.
* understanding of applicable nist-based controls, and related compliance obligations.
* ability to automate activities using powershell, python, or comparable approved technologies.
* ability to evaluate technical risks and translate business, security, compliance, availability, and performance requirements into practical solutions.
* ability to plan and execute upgrades, migrations, maintenance, recovery testing, and complex production changes.
* excellent analytical, troubleshooting, organizational, documentation, and problem-solving skills.
* ability to manage multiple priorities, operational incidents, and technical initiatives simultaneously.
* skilled in utilizing ai-enabled tools and technologies to improve efficiency, enhance work quality and outcomes, and support innovation and continuous process improvement.
* ability to work independently and collaboratively with business stakeholders, peers, management, professionals, and vendors.

**qualifications**

**education**

* **required:** bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, data management, database administration, information technology, or a related field.
* experience beyond the minimum work-experience requirement may substitute for formal education on a year-for-year basis.

**preferred:** none specified

**experience**

**required:**

* five years of progressively responsible database administration or closely related data-platform experience.
* experience supporting business-critical production database environments.
* experience performing database installation, configuration, patching, upgrades, backup, recovery, performance tuning, capacity planning, and disaster recovery testing.
* experience implementing database security controls, privileged access, and access-review processes.
* experience supporting regulated or compliance-driven environments and sensitive data.
* experience developing technical documentation, operating procedures, recovery plans, and support standards.

**preferred:**

* student loan industry experience.
* hands-on ibm db2 administration experience.
* hands-on microsoft sql server administration experience.
* experience supporting cloud database technologies, data integration, or modernization initiatives.
* azure sql database or azure sql managed instance administration experience.
* microsoft fabric, azure data factory, azure synapse analytics, azure data lake storage, or power bi semantic-model experience.
* experience with database and infrastructure automation using powershell or comparable technologies.
* enterprise data governance, metadata management, data catalog, data lineage, master data, or data-quality experience.
* experience supporting analytics, reporting, machine learning, or ai solutions.
* experience supporting audits, security assessments, vulnerability remediation, access reviews, and disaster recovery exercises.

**licenses or certifications**

**required:** none required

**preferred:**

* microsoft certified: azure database administrator associate.
* microsoft certified: azure data engineer associate or successor data-engineering certification.
* microsoft certified: fabric analytics engineer associate.
* microsoft certified: azure fundamentals or azure data fundamentals.
* ibm db2 database administrator certification or comparable ibm certification.
* certified data management professional (cdmp).

**work environment**

* work is performed in an office and/or approved remote-work environment.
* the office work environment is climate controlled with no substantial exposure to adverse environmental conditions.
* the position may require scheduled after-hours maintenance, participation in an on-call rotation, and support during incidents or disaster recovery exercises.
* occasional travel may be required for training, projects, recovery exercises, or vendor engagements.

**physical and mental demands**

* when working in the office, occasionally must move about inside the office.
* repetitive motion. regularly operates a computer, phone, and general business equipment.
* regularly communicates with employees and internal or external contacts by phone, virtually, or in person.
* visual acuity. must have visual acuity to review technical documentation, dashboards, logs, reports, and information in computer systems.
* mental focus. requires sustained concentration, analytical reasoning, sound judgment, and accurate oral and written communication.
* must be able to maintain composure and exercise sound judgment during outages, security events, recovery situations, and other time-sensitive operational issues.
* requires the ability to manage competing priorities and make decisions during high-impact or time-sensitive events.
* must be able to participate in after-hours incident response, recovery events, or planned changes when required.
* reasonable accommodation may be provided to enable qualified individuals to perform the essential functions.

**benefits**

this position is also eligible for a corporate annual incentive, subject to the discretion and approval of the board of directors. trellis offers a comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, and retirement plans, tuition assistance, along with 12 paid holidays.

**equal employment opportunity statement**

trellis is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants. employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

title: AI Architech
description:
about meeru ai

meeru ai is building an ai-native platform that transforms how finance and accounting teams operate. we connect to enterprise financial systems — erps, crms, billing platforms, hris — and apply machine learning to turn fragmented operational data into grounded, auditable intelligence for cfos, controllers, and fp&a leaders.

we deploy on customer terms — **saas multi-tenant, saas single-tenant, and on-premises** — across **aws, azure, and gcp**. our customers are fortune 500 finance teams who require data isolation, auditability, and compliance.

the role

we are looking for an **ai architect** to help design and build the **intelligence engine** at the core of our platform, and the **conversational ai agents** that sit on top of it and serve answers **deterministically**.

our output sits adjacent to externally reported financials. "sounds plausible" is never good enough. the engine you help architect turns connected enterprise data into answers that are computed, reproducible, and traceable to verified source data — not improvised by a model. the agents that sit on top interpret what a user is asking, route it to the engine, and present the result in natural language without ever inventing the substance of the answer.

this is a deeply hands-on architecture role. you set technical direction for the engine and agent layer, partner closely with us-based ai leadership and the staff ai engineer on grounding and evaluation rigor, and raise the bar for how deterministic, auditable ai gets built across the team.

what makes this role different

* **deterministic by design** — the engine computes answers from verified data. the same question against the same data returns the same grounded, explainable answer.
* **a clear separation of concerns** — the engine reasons and decides; the conversational agents orchestrate and narrate, but never fabricate the substance.
* **auditable end to end** — every answer traces back to its source data and the logic that produced it, because our customers' auditors will ask.

**deploys in customer clouds** — including managed llms in-vpc, so customer data never leaves their environment.

 **requirements**  

* **senior or staff-level applied ai/ml experience.** you have shipped production ai systems, not just prototypes, and have led the technical direction on at least one of them.
* **deep fluency in modern llm patterns.** hands-on experience with retrieval-augmented generation (rag), tool-using agents, and structured output (e.g., json schemas, function calling).
* **agent orchestration.** you have built multi-step agent workflows with langgraph or a similar framework, including verification steps, fallbacks, and points where a human confirms before the system proceeds.
* **systems architecture.** you can design an engine, its data interfaces, and the agent layer on top as one coherent, maintainable system, and document decisions (e.g., architecture decision records).
* **grounding, hallucination control, and evaluation.** you have made "no unsupported answers" a hard rule in a real system, and measured faithfulness and hallucination with automated evaluations, ideally running in ci.
* **determinism on top of probabilistic models.** you know how to make the same question against the same data return the same answer, and can explain the techniques you used.
* **clear judgment about what a model can legitimately claim.** you understand why computed, traceable answers matter more than plausible-sounding ones in a high-stakes domain.
* **production software engineering in python.** you write robust, tested services with sql access to warehouses or databases (e.g., snowflake, postgresql), and you are comfortable with containerized deployment.
* **structured data and retrieval tooling.** working knowledge of vector stores (pgvector, pinecone, weaviate, or qdrant) and of computing reliable answers over structured data.
* **technical leadership.** you mentor engineers, run design reviews, and turn strategy set by us leadership into well-built execution.
* **strong communication.** you can explain architecture trade-offs to engineers, product managers, and non-technical stakeholders in clear english.
* **location and working hours.** based in hyderabad (preferred) or remote elsewhere, and able to keep a few hours of daily overlap with us time zones.
* **flexible engagement.** open to full-time, contract, or contract-to-hire, whichever suits you best.

nice-to-haves

* **finance, accounting, or other audited domains.** experience where outputs face auditors or regulators (finance, healthcare, insurance, legal).
* **knowledge graphs and reasoning engines.** experience with knowledge graphs, semantic layers, or rule/reasoning engines that model facts and relationships.
* **human-in-the-loop systems.** you have designed review, confirmation, or feedback loops that improve a system over time.
* **managed llms inside customer clouds.** hands-on with amazon bedrock, google vertex ai, or azure openai deployed in a customer's private network (vpc), so data never leaves their environment.
* **multi-cloud and on-prem deployment.** experience shipping ai to aws, azure, and gcp, including single-tenant and on-premises installs, and working with platform teams on model serving and inference cost.
* **ai observability.** experience with tracing and evaluation tooling for llm applications.

title: Infrastructure Security Engineer (Bare Metal & Platform)
description:
spacex was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. today, spacex is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

spacexsi is building super intelligence to understand the universe and help expand humanity's knowledge and capabilities. we work across the full super intelligence stack: compute (colossus supercomputers), models (grok), and applications (grok bot, grok build, grok imagine, grok voice, and x). we're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

### **about the role:**

we are seeking a hands-on infrastructure security engineer to build and secure spacexai's infrastructure from the bare-metal layer up through the platform and application stack. in this role, you will design, implement, and harden physical and private-cloud foundations—servers, networks, identity, and orchestration—and carry that security posture into containers, automation, and hybrid connectivity with public cloud.

this role focuses on securing critical infrastructure spanning data centers, colo, and hybrid environments, with work that may span platforms such as spacexai, x social, x money, and related systems. you'll operate with an automation-first mindset: building secure foundations at the metal and os layer, hardening platforms at scale, and partnering closely with engineering so security is embedded in how we build and run systems—not bolted on after the fact.

### **responsibilities:**

#### **bare metal, data center & network security**

* design and implement secure bare-metal and private-cloud architectures (servers, storage, out-of-band management, bios/uefi/bmc firmware posture)
* harden physical and virtual fleets: os baselines (linux/windows), cis benchmarks, patch and vulnerability management, and secure boot / measured boot where applicable
* hands-on firmware, bmc/idrac/ilo, pxe/kickstart provisioning, and hardware lifecycle security
* build and secure network foundations: segmentation, load balancers, dns, pki, nac, and ids/ips on real hardware
* own hybrid connectivity between on-premises and cloud (site-to-site vpn, direct connect / interconnect / expressroute, sd-wan, zero-trust access)
* manage identities and privileged access across active directory / ldap / kerberos and cloud iam (federation, saml/oidc, pam)
* assist with security assessments and audits of physical, on-premises, and hybrid infrastructure
* monitor and remediate infrastructure to comply with regulations and best practices (e.g., pci, nist csf, gdpr, hipaa)

#### **platform, containers & developer enablement**

* design and implement secure container and kubernetes standards on bare metal and private cloud (not only managed eks/gke/aks), including rbac, network policy, and secrets
* develop and maintain infrastructure as code and configuration management—especially puppet—with embedded security controls for physical and virtual fleets
* collaborate with development teams so security best practices are integrated into ci/cd pipelines
* secure and enhance ci/cd pipelines; integrate and maintain code and image scanning platforms

#### **detection, operations & tooling**

* monitor and respond to security events and incidents spanning bare metal, network devices, hosts, and hybrid cloud
* maintain siem data pipelines that ingest on-premises network, host, and cloud telemetry for reliable alerting
* build, deploy, and maintain security operations infrastructure using python, terraform, and puppet
* develop dashboards and alerts from security metrics across physical and platform layers
* develop and maintain infrastructure security policies, standards, and procedures from metal through platform
* own security projects end to end: identify issues and implement solutions
* stay current with emerging threats and mitigations for bare-metal, firmware, network, and hybrid-cloud infrastructure

### **basic qualifications:**

* bachelor's degree in computer science, cybersecurity, or a related field
* 3–5 years of experience in infrastructure security, platform security, or related hands-on roles
* proven experience securing bare-metal, data-center, or private-cloud environments (not cloud-only resumes)
* hands-on experience with firmware, bmc/idrac/ilo, pxe/kickstart provisioning, and hardware lifecycle security
* strong proficiency with puppet for configuration management and fleet hardening in production
* strong understanding of network security concepts and protocols, including hands-on work with firewalls, segmentation, and hybrid connectivity
* experience with hybrid identity (ad/ldap or similar) integrated or federated with cloud iam
* experience with infrastructure as code (e.g., terraform) applied to physical or vm fleets
* familiarity with containerization and kubernetes security implications, including on-premises or bare-metal clusters
* experience with languages (e.g., python, bash and golang) for automation and tool development
* familiarity with regulatory compliance requirements (e.g., gdpr, hipaa, pci dss, nist csf)
* experience in banking, money transmission, p2p payments, or similarly regulated financial platforms
* proactive mindset with strong ownership, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills
* located in the sf bay area, austin, new york, palo alto, or seattle, or willing to relocate to a us office

### **preferred skills and experience:**

* deep expertise operating and securing physical server fleets, colo, or private cloud (vmware, openstack, proxmox, nutanix, or similar)
* relevant security certifications (e.g., ccsp, cssk, oscp, network or cloud security specialty)
* strong proficiency with python and terraform on production fleets
* deep expertise in kubernetes and container security on bare metal or private cloud
* experience with multi-cloud and cloud-to-on-prem security
* knowledge of ci/cd best practices and tools; hands-on github actions or equivalent
* experience with observability and security operations tooling (e.g., prometheus, grafana, cloudwatch, karma; siem platforms such as wazuh)
